lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /le'u brgyad par ①bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ rang rig 'di ni ye shes te/ /ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul lo/ /'dis ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de rang bzhin/ /bdag byin gyis brlab pa nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa sna tshogs la ltos ①nas ming gzhan gyis gsungs te/ le'u bcu par/ de nyid rnam par shes pa'i tshul/ /skyes bu sngon rabs dbang phyug dang / /bdag dang srog dang sems can dang / /dus dang gang zag nyid dang yang / /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs can yang dag gnas/ /'phags pa lang kar gshegs par yang gsungs pa/ gang zag rgyun dang phung po dang / /rkyen dang rdul dang de bzhin du/ /gtso bo dbang phyug byed po rnams/ /sems tsam du ni nga smra'o/ /'dir smras pa/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes pa ni lus ni 'dir sprul pa'o/ /lus de la gnas pa ste/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid ①ye shes ni lus la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dmigs pa thams cad nye bar rtogs pa nyid kyi phyir de'i bden pa'i rnam pa ni 'di'o/ /de yongs su ma shes pa las phung po'i skye ba blangs pa yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na sngon dang sngon gyi bag chags kyi phung po 'gags nas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba las bag chags 'dzinadu/ bar ma do'i srid pa'i gnyen po khyad par gyi dga' ba'i mtshan nyid kyi ye shes 'byung ba yin no/ /de nas shes rab dang thabs kyi pad+ma dang rdo rje yang dag par sbyor ba mthong nas 'dod pa nye bar len pa las skye ba ste 'dzin pa po med pa'i rang bzhin mchog tu dga' ba'o/ /de nas gzung bar byas pas stong pa'i dga' ba yang ngo / /de nas rlung skye'o/ /de nas me'o0/ /de nas 5—326

sa'o| /de nas yang phung po lnga rnams dang ①po rnams dang yul rnams rim gyis 'byung ngo / /de dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud du gsungs pa/ rdo rje snying pos 'di skad gsol zhing bshad de/ kye bcom ldan 'das lus de la ye shes chen po rang bzhin gyis dag pa ci ltar na 'byung ba'i bdag nyid du 'gyur ba lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ni bo la dang kak+ko la sbyor zhing reg pa las te dag cing gzod ma nyid nas rang bzhin med par 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bde ba sbyin pas gsungs so/ /khrem gnyer med pa'i rang bzhin bdagasde /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /kye bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du 'byung ba chen po'i phung po lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bo la kak+ko la sbyar ba'i/ /reg pas sra ba'i chos kyis ni/ /sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur/ /byang sems chu yi rnam pa las/ /chu yi khams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bskyed ①pa las ni drod skye ste/ /'gro bas rlung du rab tu grags/ /bde bas nam mkha'i khams kyang ngo / /lnga po rnams kyis dhiyongs su bskor/ /de 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsal bar gsungs te/'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin las/ /kun du ru la lnga ru 'gyur/ /dga' ba chen po'i gcig nyid ni/ /dbye bas lnga ru 'gro ba yin/ /bo la kak+ko la sbyar ba/ /reg pas sra ba'i bag chags las/ /sra ba gti mug chos nyid phyir/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad do/ /gang phyir byang sems gsher ba las/ /gsher ba chu yi khams su 'dod/ /chu ni mi bskyod gzugs nyid phyir/ /zhe sdang mi bskyod 'dren pa'o/ /gnyis kyis bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /drod ni rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags dpag med rdo rje yin/ /'dod chags drod las 5—327

'byung bar 'gyur/ /kak+ko lar ni gang zhig sems/ /de ni rlung gi rang bzhin can—/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yin/ /don yod rlung las 'byung ba'o/ /bde ba 'dod chags khrag tu 'gyur/ /dga' ba nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' ser sna rdo rjer 'gyur/ /ser sna nam mkha' las byung ba'o/ /sems ni chen po gcig nyid la/ /lnga yi gzugs kyis mtshon pa yin/ /rigs ni lnga po de nyid las/ /stong phrag du ma skyes pa nyid/ /de phyir 'di dag rang bzhin gcig /bde chen mchog tu phan pa nyid/ /'dod chags la sogs sems lnga yi/ /dbye ba lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de nas yang khams dang phung po dang yul la sogs pa rnams kyi rang bzhin med pa ste ngo bo nyid kyis gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'o/ /kye rdo rjer yang gsungs te/ rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /brdzun min bden min de bzhin du/ /thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar/ /'dod pas rnal 'byor mas shes byis/ /'di lta ste gtsub shing dang gtsub stan dang skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba las glo bur du me 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /me 'di ni gtsub shing la mi gnas/ gtsub stan la yang ma yin/ skyes bu'i lag pa dag la yang ma yin te/ rnam pa thams cad du yongs su btsal na gcig na yang yod pa ma yin pas/ me de yang bden pa yang ma yin zhing brdzun pa yang ma yin no/ /de ltar chos thams cad rnal 'byor mas yid la gyis shig /de'i phyir de rnam par dag pa na ste/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /rnam dag ye shes rang bzhin can/ /zhes dbang gi le'u las gsungs pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /yang 'di nyid du gsungs pa/ dang por dga' ba 'gro ba'i gzugs/ /de bzhin mchog dga' 'gro ba'o/ /dga' bral dga' ba'ang 'gro ba nyid/ /5—328

gsum po rnams la lhan skyes med/ /'di la man ngag gis rnam par bshad pa ni mtshan nyid med pas brdzun pa ste 'gro ba'i ①ye shes skyes/ /dang po la ni de khyad par du bzung nas gsungs so/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i ye shes de ni gzung bar bya ba dang 'dzin pa po'i dngos po la dmigs nas 'dzin pa'i don to/ /dga' bral gyi dga' ba yang 'di dang 'dis gsungs te/ sems dang sems las byung ba dang ma rig pa rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs nyid kyi phyir ro/ /byang chub kyi sems 'di ni rnal 'byor pa'i rang rig pa'i ye shes te de ni rnal 'byor pa ye shes dang ldan pa la yin na de'i tshe so so'i skye bo rnams kyis ci ltar shes par bya/ gang du rtogs par bya ba yang yin nam zhe na/ brjod par bya ste bla ma bsnyen bkur ba las snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i rnam pa mngon sum du byas nas gzhan du gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams su yang shes par bya'o—/ /de kye rdo rjer gsungs pa/ e yig cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su waṃ gyis rnam par brgyan/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /skad cig dbye bas byed nyid las/ /dga' ba de la skye bar 'gyur/ /skad cig shes la bde shes pa/ /e waṃ yi ger rab tu gnas/ /sna tshogs dang ni rnam smin dang / /rnam nyid de bzhin mtshan nyid bral/ /skad cig bzhi la brten nas ni/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas shes 'gyur/ /'khyud dang 'o byed la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs bshad/ /rnam par smin pa de las bzlog /bde ba'i ye shes bza' ba ni④/ /bdag gis bde ba zos par ni/ /lta ba rnam nyed du rab gsungs/ /mtshan nyid bral ba gsum las gzhan/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par spangs/ /sna tshogs 5—329

dang po'i dga' ba ste/ /rnam don la ni mchog dga'o/ /rnam nyed la ni dga' bral dga'/ /lhan cig skyes dga' mtshan bral la'o/ /slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /dbang ni bzhi yi grangs kyis ni/ /dga' ba la sogs rim shes bya/ /dgod pa dag pa slob dpon te/ /lta ba gsang ba de bzhin no/ /lag bcangs la ni shes rab nyid/ /gnyis gnyis 'bud la de bzhin nyid/ /sems can rnams kyi dngos grub phyir/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi ru bshad/ /gtor dang bkrus pa zhes bya 'dis/ / de yis ①dbang zhes brjod par bya/ /da ni dga' ba la sogs pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid brjod par bya ste/ dang po reg par 'dod pa dang / /gnyis pa bde bar 'dod pa dang / /gsum pa 'dod chags 'jigs khrunyid phyir/ /bzhi pa'ang bsgom par bya ba min/ /'di nyid ni/ dga' bas bde ba cung zad de//mchog tu dga' ba de las lhag /dga' bral dga' ba chags bral 'gyur/ /lhag mas lhan cig skyes dga'o/ /de ltar ni 'phags pa lha'i zhabs kyis/ e ma bde ba e ma'o bde/ /ji lta ji ltar za ba na/ /sems ni mchog tu 'dod pa ste/ /dga' bral dga' ba tsam yin no/ /'dis 'di gsungs par byur pa yin te/ ma rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyi mtshan nyid dga' bral byi dga' ba la nye bar dmigs pa gang yin pa'i bde ba nyid kyis cung zad grib ma'i rjes su byed pa'i dpe'i bde ba des mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis 'chang zhing dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa ji ltar me long gi nang du ri mo'i rnam pa nye bar dmigs pa de bzhin nyid du mngon du byed pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ye shes su rdo rje bla ma'i zhal las rig par bya'o/ /de nas ①bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ ston pa sum 5—330

cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /khyab bdag dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de ltar yang klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ /me long dri ma med par ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar blta bya zhing ①/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol ba/ /shin tu bkri ba'i rdo rje sems/ /bla ⑧ma bzang la brten ①bya ste/ /bdag byin brlabs su de brjod bya//de ltar ni 'phags pa lha'i zhabs kyis kyang gsungs la/ de yang dzā larnya ri pa'i zhabs kyis rgya ④'grel rdo rje sgon mar bris pa 'di lta ste/ ji ltar shin tu dang ba'i me long la/ /gzugs brnyan yan lag kun ldan gzugs su snang / /de bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad brgyad cu yis/ /phyug pa'i rdo rje 'chang sku rtag pa nyid—/ /ces pa bdag byin gyis brlab pa ste rim pa gsum pa'o// //da ni rnam par dag pa'i rim pa brjod par bya ste slar yang phreng ba dang chu la sogs pa'i dbang gi rim gyis/ mthe bong srin lag dag gis de/ /slob ma'i khar ni lhung bar bya/ /zhes pa 'dis gsang ba la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba byin nas gsum pa khyad par byi dga' bas ⑤byin gyes brlab pa'i dga' ba'i rnam pa rtogs par byas te/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa 'dis de'i rnam par dag pa ni med par dgag pa'i 'jug pas de bzhin nyid kyi ④rnam par dag pa ni rnam pa gnyis te gzugs dang gzugs ma yin pa'i phung po la sogs pa rnams kyi lha'i rnam par dag pa dang / gzhan ni lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs rang rig pa'i bdag nyid can gzung bar bya ba la sogs pa'i gnyen po dga' ba gsum po bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid thob pa gang gi rnam par dag pa ste de bzhin nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rang bzhin no/ /de 5—331

bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ dngos por grags pa thams cad kyis①/ /rnam dag de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyin nas re re'i dbye bas de/ /lha rnams kyis ni brjod par bya/ /②gsungs pa/ phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga'i/ /mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam dag /mi shes nyon mongs sgrib sbyang bya/ /rang rig bdag nyid dag pa ste/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /yul rnams dag pa'i dngos nyid phyir/ /bde ba mchog ni rang rig pa'o/ /'dis 'di gsungs pa yin te bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas lha mo rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis gzugs kyi phung po la sogs pa rnams rnam par dag par ①gsungs so/ /bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid thob pa'i dga' ba gsum po rnams kyi rnam par dag pa ni rang rig pa'i bdag nyid can de bzhin de las ④rab tu zhugs pa zhes pa'i don te 'dis mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad stong par gsungs so/ /de kho na nyid kyi le'u yang gsungs pa/ dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing / /zhes pa la sogs pa'o—/ /slar yang / ngo bos gzugs med mthong ba ⑤med/ /sgra med thos pa po yang med/ /dri med snom pa po yang med/ /ro med myong ba po yang med—/ /sems med sems las byung ba med/ /dbang gi le'ur yang gsungs pa/mchog dga' bsgom pa med cing bsgom pa po yang med/ /lus kyang med cing gzung ba med cing 'dzin pa'ang med/ /sha dang khrag kyang med cing bshang dang phyi ba'ang med/ /skyug khro durmongs med gtsang sbra mchod phyir thogs med dang / /chags med sdang ba med dang rmongs med phrag dog med/ /ser sna med dang nga rgyal med cing mthong bya med/ /bsgom dang sgom po med cing bshes dang dgra 5—332

med cing / /khrem gnyer med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa sna tshogs nyid/ /'di yang ji ltar shes par bya zhe na/ /'di nyid du yang gsungs pa/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang las kyang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma brgyud pa nyer bsnyen dang / /rang la bsod nams las shes bya/ /de lta na yang lhan cig skyes pa la gang du yid ches/ brjod par bya ste/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i grib ma'i rjes su byed pa nyid kyi phyir bla ma'i man ngag las lhan cig skyes pa shes par bya'o/ /de bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ de la de nyid bstan par bya/ mchog mtha' dga' bral dang po mchog mtha' ①can//zhes pa ste/ gang gi dang po dga' bral yin pa de ni dga' bral dang po ste lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /mthar byed do zhes pa ni mtha' can no/ /mchog ni rab kyi mtha' pa ste de ni de lta bu yin no/ /dga' bral dang po yang yin la mchog mtha' can yang yin pa de ni dga' bral dang po mchog mtha' can no/ /rgyud rnams kun tu sbas pa ste/ /mtha' yi mtha' ①ni rab tu gsal/ /rdo rje mchod pa rab sbyar nas/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /lha de'i skad cig ji ltar lags—/ /gtso bo chen po bshad du gsol/ /der ni thog ma dbus mtha' med—/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan ni med pa ste/ /①'dir yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungasarjo/ /ji ltar dbang bskur gsol gdab pa'i/ /slob ma'i bya ba bshad par bya/ /bla ma phyag rgya ldan mthong nas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bstod mchod bya/ /bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig tu brtson/ /sgrub po phyag rgya tha mi dad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ / bya ba ⑤bdag la'ang 5—333

de mdzod cig /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhim pa'i bza' ba btung ba dang / /ba la che mchog ma da na①—/ /bdug pa lha bshos phreng ba dang / dril bu rgyal mtshan byug pa ste/ /slob ma dam pas rdo rje 'dzin/ /mchod pa 'di rnams kyis mchod do/ /mchod pa'i bar med par ston pa pos/ 'dis lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba khong du chud par bya ste/ gang phyir yid kyis mi bsgom par/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya/ /thams cad chos ni yongs shes na/ /bsgom pa nyid ni bsgom pa min/ /'di dang 'di ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba rnams kyi yang de kho na nyid do//'di lta ste/ thams cad thams cad stong pa zhes bya'o/ /de bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po gang / /rtsa ①lcug 'khri shing la sogs rnams/ /bdag gi dngos po'i rang bzhin las/ /dam pa'i de nyid nges bsgom bya/ /de rnams gcig pu gzhan yod min/ /bde ba chen po rang rig pa'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba yang dag thob/ /sna tshogs spangs pa'i skad cig la//ston pas smras pa sems dpa' che/ /bde ba chen po gzung bar gyis/ /de ltar yang 'phags pa lha'i zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ dga' ba la sogs rim pas phra mo la—/ /dmigs pa la ni brten nas skad cig ma/ /zad par 'gyur ba bzhi pa'i dus su ni/ /e ma dmigs pa zhes bya ci zhig yin/ /gang yang khrem gnyer med pa'i bde ba ni/ /myong ba'i rnam par gzhal bar bya ba tsam/ /de yang 'jigs ①pa yang ste de la ni/ /rnam par bsgyings pa 'ba' zhig dmigs pa med/ /e ma'o srid gsum gang ba yi/ /bde ba chen po sgeg pa ste/ /gang gis rang dang gzhan gyi char/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i skad cig go/ /'dis 'di gsungs 5—334

par gyur pa yin te/ gsum pa dga' bral rmi dga' ba'i dpe las/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i bde ba 'byung ba nyid du rtogs par byas nas de nyid rnam par dag pa las de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pas lhan cig skyes par rtogs par bya ba yin no/ /'di ni/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa 'di'i don to/ /snyoms par 'jug pa yod na ye shes gang yin pa thog mar gsungs pa ste/ de bzhin du 'dir yang lhan cig skyes pa rtogs pa las de ni de yang bzhi pa'i ye shes su 'gyur ba des na lhan cig skyes pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dpe las bde ba gang yin pa dang ye shes gang yin pa la yid ches par bya'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i grib ma'i rjes su byed pa nyid kyi phyir de ni de kho nyid du bshad pa ma yin byi 'byung ba chen po pa'o/ /gang gi phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /gang phyir 'a da pa ①che bde ba/ /de phyir bde ba de nyid min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di nyid slob ma'i dri ba'i tshig go/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal 'gyur bas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje yang dag sbyor/ /reg las rmad byung chen po yi/ /bde ba skye ba gang yin pa/ /de ni mchog dga'i byed po'o| /zhes pa la/ ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /ces pa ni de nyid mchog tu dga' bar bshad pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba las phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid can gyi dngos grub po/ /dmigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir na ma smad pa ste de'i phyir lhan cig skyes pa khong du chud pa'o/ /phung po la sogs pa brgyal ba de yod na ye shes gang rjes su myong ba yin/ des na bdag byin gyis brlab par ma dag par byas so/ /de bsgom pa rab kyi mthar son pa 5—335

na ste ji srid du phung po la sogs pa med par ma ①gyur pa de srid du phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mngon sum du byed par mi nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gsungs pa/ mchog tu bde ba phung po med/ /ces so/ /'di nyid kyang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis 'chi bar mngon par brjod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gsungs pa/ ji ltar pha las bde thob pa/ /de yi bde ba rang gis bzang ①/ /bde ba gang gis 'chi ba ste/ /de yi bde ba bsam gtan brjod/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog ni/ /zhes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs par rgyas par ro/ /mang du smra bas ci zhig bya/ /rdo rje theg pa'i de nyid las/ /rdzas kyi dngos por yod ces pa'ang / /rang bzhin rten nas de nyid do/ /brtags pa'i dngos po med pa ste/ /gzhan gyi dbang ni yod pa yin/ /zhes pa ste de la sogs pa'i sgras gzhan gyi dbang bzung ngo / /rgyu gzhan la brten pas na gzhan kyi dbang dang grub pa yin no/ /gzhan byi dbang ni 'gro ba'i bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de dag gi dngos po med pa ni yongs su grub pa'i gzugs lhan cig skyes par bshad pa mya ngan las 'das par yang gsungs te thams cad kyi ①thams cad du thams cad stong pa ni mu stegs pa rnams kyi cha shas yin no/ /de nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa skyed par mdzad ma'o zhes pa rnam par dag pa ste rim pa bzhi pa'o// //da ni rnam par dag pa las ldang ba'i rim pa rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /de la smras pa/ ldang ba ni bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid kyi dga' ba gsum gyi bdag nyid med pa yin pa'i phyir ci lta ④ba de ni su zhig gi yin par 5—336

'gyur zhe na brjod par bya ste/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan nyid med pa ni skyes pa ma yin gyi gang zhig bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par shes pa dang ①lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bsgoms pa las ji srid 'gog pa mngon sum du mi byed pa de srid du ldang ba ste skyed par ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir yang gsungs pa/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /rnam dag ye shes rang bzhin can/ /zhes pa'o/ /phyi nas zhes pa ni bdag byen gyis brlab pa'i de ma thag tu rang rig pa las skyes pa ni dngos grub po/ /ji skad du gsungs pa/rang rig las ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /rang rig phyir na bsgom pa'o/ /zhes pa'o—/ /sbar yang gsungs pa/ phyag rgya rgyu dang sbyor bral las/ /rnal 'byor snying rje thams su 'gyur/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems su brjod pa yin/ /'di nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis ②zung du 'jug pa ni lam dang zung du 'jug pa ni 'bras bur gsungs pa yin no/ /de gsungs pa/rang rig ye shes de nyid 'gyur/ /rang gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab shin tu 'dres/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par 'dres/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid mi 'gyur ba ma ④yin/ /de nyid thams cad bya ba rjopo/ /lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid du gsungs pa/ dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing / /de bzhin slar yang byon pa nyid/ /'dis ni shes rab rigs ⑤pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs par mngon brjod bya/ /de la rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ thabs gang gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 5—337

bka' stsal pa/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sogs thabs dang / /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pas kyang / /kun rdzob don dam gzugs can gyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu bskyed/ /kun rdzob kun+da lta bu ste/ /don dam bde ba'i gzugs can no/ /bud med sko la bde ba can/ /e waṃ yi ge'i rang bzhin du//bde ba srung ba nyid kyi phyir/ /bde ba can zhes brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi gnas/ /'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du no/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtog mi 'gyur/ /'khor ba gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /'khor ba tshor ba la sogs pa/ /'khor ba dbang po rnams nyid de/ /'khor ba zhe sdang la sogs pa/ /'di rnams chos ni mya ngan 'das/ /rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas ni/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /'dis chos 'di rnams kyi rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su mkhyen pa las rgyal ba mchog rnams kyis bdag nyid kyi skye ba gsungs pa yin no/ /gal te gzhan rnams kyis bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pas rang bzhin yongs su shes par 'gyur zhing so so'i skye bo rnams kyi yin pa de'i tshe de rnams kyi bdag nyid 'ba' zhig pa yang ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gsungs pa/ ma lus pa yi sems can gyi/ /skye ba gang la brjod bya ba/ /gang phyir sprul pa gnas brtan phyir/ /de la sprul pa'i sku nyid yin/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par te/ /sde pa sde ma ①zhes bshad pa//lto ba gnas su brjod par bya/ /skye gnas 'dod chags bral bar 'gyur/ /mngal gyi khru ma chos gos yin/ /de bzhin ma ni mkhan po'o/ /mgo bor thal 5—338

mo sbyar ba phyag /'gro ba'i bya ba basbab pa'i gnas/ /de bzhin sngags bzlas a dang haṃ/ /skye gnas 'khor lo'i yi ge a/ /bde chen gye yang yi ge haṃ/ /gcer bu skra dang kha spu byegs/ /sngags bzlas kyang ni dge slong skyes/ /tshogs pa 'di rnams kyis sems can/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /zla ba bcu yang sa rnams yin/ /sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go/ /'di nyid ye shes chen po ste/ /lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /gnyis dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso/ /brtan dang g.yo ba khyab nas gnas/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs can nyid du snang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sogs thabs kyis/ /rtag tu nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab byed pa/ /lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /de'i phyir bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i de bzhin nyid la rab tu zhugs pa'i de ma thag tu skyes pa'i rim pa shes par bya ste rnam pa gzhan du na 'khor ba zad pa tsam kho nar 'gyur ro/ /'khor bar gnas pa'i bar du yang dam pa'i don yang dag par rtogs ①pa'i thabs dang / stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i mchog tu bde ba chen po'i mtshan nyid kyi 'bras bu rang bzhin gyis thob par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /de gsungs pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom/ /spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med bya/ /sgyu ma ji bzhin rmi lam ni/ /ji ltar bar ma'i srid ji bzhin/ /rtag tu goms pa'i skyong ②ba las/ /de lta bu nyid dkyil 'khor snang / /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /ji ltar shes pa'i bde chen po/ /5—339

'di nyid de myong ba las te/ /gzhan las dkyil 'khor 'byung ba med/ /de ltar yang / phung po rnams nyid dri ma med pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ /thams cad lha mo mang por rnam par nges shing rtogs/ /dpa' bo te ru ka yang yin pa ste/ /'dzag med sku ste de bzhin nyid kyi ro yin no/ /kye rdo rje'i rgyud du yang gsungs pa—/ bde ba nag po bde ba ser/ /bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar/ /bde ba sngon po bde ba ljang / /bde ba nag po rgyu mi rgyu/ /bde ba shes rab bde ba thabs—/ /de bzhin kun du ru skyes bde/ /bde ba dngos dang dngos med pa//rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar brjod/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /de yi bde ba bde chen 'dod/ /rdzogs pa bsgom pa med pa yi①/ /bskyed pas dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /bcon ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /e ma byang chub sems chen 'di/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyon①/ /lus ni ①dngos med gang las bde/ /bde bar smra bar mi nus so//khyab bya khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ /bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa yin/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog med phyir shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs la sogs med pas/ /bde ba dmigs pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /dngos nga dngos po med pa nga / /dngos po rtogs phyir sangs rgyas nga / /gang zhig le los nyer 'tshe dang / /rmongs pa gang gis bdag mi shes/ /rje btsun lha mo'i bha gar ni//e yi rnam pa'i cha byad gzugs/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /bde ba can du rtag tu rgyu/ /'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /bsgrub bya 'gro ba'i ston pa nga / /'jig rten 'jig rten pa yang nga / /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin nga / /mchog mtha' dga' bral dad po can/ /5—340

—mun pa la ni mar me ltar/ /de bzhin bus kyang yid ches byis/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /btsun mo'i bha ga bde can du/ /khu ba'i ming gis rnam par gnas/ /gsungs pa'i rim pa 'di gnyis kyis/ /sngags rgyud sogs dang rnal 'byor la/ /gang gis te ru ka mi shes/ /de yis log par ngal ba'o//de med pas na bde med 'gyur/ /bde ba med na de med 'gyur/ /nus med nyid phyir ltos bcas te/ /lha yi rnal 'byor las bde'o/ /gang phyir lus las byung bas na/ /lha zhes brjod par bya ba yin/ /de phyir sangs rgyas dngos 'gyur min/ /dngos med tshul du'ang 'gyur nyid min/ /zhal phyag rnam pa gzugs can te/ /mchog tu bde bas gzugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes brjod bya/ /rnam par dag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang bzhin nyid ni mya ngan 'das/ /bzhin lag kha dog dbyebs las ni/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs su ni/ /skye ba tsam gyis rnam par gnas—/ /'on kyang tha mal bag chags las/ /de'i phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i lus med pas grol ba ma yin te/ de ni gang du yang 'dod par bya ba ma yin no/ /thams cad du stong pa nyid las lhan cig skyes pa ①bshad pa dngos pos grol ba de yang ma yin no/ /de'i phyir yang de dag gi rnam par grol ba ni stong pa nyid dang / snying rje dbyer med pa'i mthar thug ②pa'i gzugs byang chub kyi sems ma yin no zhes bya bar nges so/ /de ltar yang klu sgrub zhabs kyis/dngos po nyid kyis rnam grol bya/ /dngos po med pas 'gyur ba min/ /dngos po'i bdag nyid rnam grol te/ /dngos dang dngos med yongs shes pas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yang rgyud du gsungs pa/ /rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /5—341

dngos po nyid kyis rnam grol zhing / /dngos po'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur//de yongs shes pas grol ba yin/ /dngos po med pa'ang yongs shes pas/ /dngos po bsgom 'gyur shes rab can/ /dngos po med pa'ang yongs shes pas/ /te ru ka dpal de ltar bsgom/ /yang gsungs pa/ shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te—/ /de ①ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru yig bkod pa dang bral ba/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /de ltar shes nas rnal 'byor pa/ /gang zhig mnyam gzhag sgom byed pa/ /bsod nams zhan pa'i sdemi yis kyang / /the tshom med par de 'grub po/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor yang rnal 'byor petha ma'i 'o/ /bza' dang btung dang khrus byed dang / /sad dam nyams yang bsam par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon 'dod pas/ /de las rtag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa mnyam par gzhag pa 'di ni rnal 'byor ma dhi'abring po'i yin no/ /chen po'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis/ bza' btung ji ltar rnyed pa dang / /bgrod dang bgrod min mi spang zhing / /khrus dang gtsang sbra mi bya ste/ /grong gi chos ni spang mi bya/ /blo ldan sngags bzla ba nyid min/ /bsam gtan dmigs par bya nyid min/ /gnyid ni spang bar mi bya ste/ /dbang po rnams rgo mi dgag go/ /ba la thams cad bza' bar bya/ /rigs rnams ⑤la ni mnyam par spyad/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /btsun mo thams cad dga' bar bya/ /grogs la dga' bar mi bya zhing / /de bzhin gdug la zhe sdang min/ /rdo shing sa las byung ba yi/ /lha 'di rnams la phyag mi bya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par ro/ /de ltar yang / sngags kyi bzlas med dka' thub med cing sbyin sreg med/ /dkyil 'khor pa med dkyil 'khor yang ni med 5—342

pa ste/ /de ni sngags bzlas dka' thub de yin sbyin sreg de/ /de ni dkyil 'khor pa ste dkyil 'khor yang ni de/ /mdor bsdus nas ni sems su 'dus pa'i gzugs can no/ /gzhan du yang gsungs pa/ ji ltar dpa' bo rtog med pas/ /'jig rten pa yi gnas bcom nas/ /spyod pa thams cad spyad par bya/ /de tshe de yis sangs rgyas mthong / /zhes pa'o/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yis rgyud kyi rgyal por gsungs pa'i bla med rim pa lnga/ /dpal ldan dzā lan dha ri bzang po'i zhabs kyis bkod dang bla ma'i gsang ba'i bzhed/ /de thob skal ba bzang la yang dag gzhung byas bsod nams mchog gang thob de la①/ /ma lus sems can phung po'i 'gro bas bla med rim lnga nges par thob par shog /dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon dpal sgra gcan gsang ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di ni tshad med pa'i bsod nams kyi dpal la brten nas dzam bus mtshan pa'i gling gi byang phyogs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i srid la mnga' bsgyur zhing /bstan pa rin po che la sri zhu dang / bya ba lhag par bsgrub pa'i khur gyis mi ngal ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po/ grags pa 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lung stsal zhing / bdag rkyen mdzad nas/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na zhabs kyi zhal snga ②nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos gzhon nu dpal kyis phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po sne gdong rtse'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //5—343
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (6༷)

༄ga /yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba'i grub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣa ḍi ga sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo /dkyil 'khor sgyu ma la bzhugs chu zla dang mtshungs lha mo brgyad kyi bdag /kye'i rdo rje rnam thar bsdu dngos de bzhin nyid kyi zhal dang zhabs phyag sprul/ /bdud kyi snying ga nyams dga' ba yi gnas su sems can don mdzad dgyes/ /gar mkhan nam mkha' lta bus dregs par mdzad cing 'gro ba bsrung ba dang / /dang po sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku 'dra ba/ /skye ba'i chu bo sgol ba'i jig gcig pa/ /bla ma la gus phyag 'tshal rtog pa yin/ /kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud chen rgya mtsho lta bu las/ /ḍo bi'i zhal snga nas kyi rim rnyed pas/ /kye rdo rje'i shrī'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mi shes sgrib g.yogs mun 'dra ba'i/ /thur ma 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /dngos grub kyi ni sems 'di yis/ /mtshan mo'i dus su rang khyim dang / /dur khrod 5—349

chu 'gram de dag tu/ /'jigs pa med par bsam gtan bya/ /snying gar chu skyes nyi ma de'o/ /gzugs brnyan hūṃ las khyad par bsgom/ /bla ma rdo rje mchod nas ni/ /bdun po yongs su dag par ni/ /go rī la sogs lha mo brgyad—/ /mchod pa yongs su spro bar bya/ /sdig pa byas pa bshags pa dang / /byed pa yang ni sdom pa dang / /bsod nams rjes su ①yi rang dang / /de dag yongs su bsngo bar babyi/ /dkon mchog skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /byang chub mchog sems bskyed pa ②dang / /lam la gnas shing bdag kyang ni/ /gzhan byi don du dbul ba dang / /gnang ba nod dang tshangs pa yi/ /gnas ni bzhi po'i bsam gtan bya/ /dang po byams pa bsgom bya zhing / /gnyis pa snying rje'i bye brag bsgom/ /gsum pa dga' ba bsgom pa ste/ /thams cad tha ma btang snyoms so/ /yang ni stong pa'i byang chub ni/ /bsgom zhing 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ①ba at+pa ko3haṃ/ stong pad ram̐ skyes hūṃ dngos la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i bsam gtan bya/ /'gro ba'i bdud rnams sel byed pa'i/ /hūṃ las gsal bar spro bar bya/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/yi ge 'di brjod do/ /'di las rdo rje bskor ba'i gur/ /bla re yang ni bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i sa la nam mkha'i dbyings/ /yo re baṃ lo byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /hūṃ las 'khor lo'i steng du bdagarjo /bar ma'i skyes pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /'di ni 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /'khor lo 'di ni lnga pa'o//gcig 'gyur de las sangs rgyas kyi/ /gzhal yas khang du gyur pa ste/ /ngos bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra byed yang dag ldan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis shin tu spras/ /lha mo brgyad kyi 'od rnams 5—350

ni—/ /gsal ba yis ①ni snam bu yin/ /'di ni chu skyes 'dab ma ni/ /brgyad pa bri zhing phreng ba gcig /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /bdud bzhi yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lā nī ④ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ā ko3ho/ sangs rgyas pho brang bye brag rdzogs/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa ni//zla ba me long ye shes te/ /rta bdun pa ni mnyam pa nyid/ /lha yi sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /so sor rtog pa yin zhes zer/ /thams cad gcig 'gyur bya nan tan / /gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa de chos dbyings/ /ā li bsgom pa zla ba ste//kā li rta bdun pa yin no/ /gnyis kyi bar na oṃ dang hūṃ/ /de gnyis rdo rje gri gug gyur/ /zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /'di dag thams cad gcig gyur pa//chu dang 'o ma tha dad med/ /de 'dra'i rdo rje bsam gtan ni/ /zhal brgyad phyag ni bcu drug pa/ /'jigs byed zhabs ni bzhi pa'o/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /bdag med ma yis phrag nas 'khyud/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin pa'i lha/ /zla ba'i nor bu kha dog 'od/ /rtsa ba'i lus mdog g.yon gyi ni/ /zhal ni dmar dang dkar dang gzhan/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang seng ge de byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad pa ni/ /dang po glang po rim shes bya / /gzhi dang chu gnas rlung dang ni/ / me lha ④de nas snang byed dang / /phyi mthar byed dang nor sbyin ni/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gnag cing gyen du bsgreng ba ser/ /gri gug thod pa kha ṭī ga /'dzin cing stag lpags sham thabs can/ /oṃ pad+ma su khā dha dhir ma hā rā ga su khan+da da ⑤tsa tur/ ā nan+da bha ga bi shwa duhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ katram̐ ku ru ṣ+ṭa ⑦me—/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dz+wa ṣa tsa tur/ ā nan+da dā ya ka kha ga mu khi ka ra ⑧so nā tha 5—351

hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ka5 ku ru ṣ+ṭa me/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa kophohaṃ/ dang por skyes bu bsam de nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma de'i 'khor lo spro—/ /rdo rje rjes su chags byed pas/ /rgyal ba'i khu ba rjes su 'gyur/ /sa bon brgyad du gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thig le de/ /gi rtsa baṃ hūṃ paṃ saṃ lo ḍi/ lha mo'i sa bon dbyung ba'o/ /go rī dbang gshin chom rkun ma/ /ro langs ma ni chu bdag gnas/ /ghasma rī ni gsus po che/ /de bzhin puk+ka sī dbang ldan/ /ri khrod ma ni byin za'i grwa/ /gtum mo bden bral la gnas te/ /g.yung mo 'di ni rlung gnas na/ /lha mo'i 'khor lo rdzogs pa'o/ /ho gnyis dbus su gnas pa ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ste/ /'di ni bar ma'i sems can ming / /lha mo'i pad+mar bsam gtan bya/ /bar ma mnyam par 'jug pa ni/ /khu ba'i ngo bos rjes su dran/ /mtshams kyi ①lha mos bskul ba ste/ /de nas dbyangs kyis ④bskul bar bya/ /snying rje'i yid kyis bla med bzhengs/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin spangs nas ni/ /bdag la 'dod pa'i bde chen sbyor/ /spyod mi bzhugs na bdag 'gum pas/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par ni/ /kye yi rdo rje spyod bzhengs shig /'jig rten phyir smon 'dod pa'i gtso/ /ci phyir stong pa'i ngang las bzhugs/ /khyod mi bzhugs na phyogs mi khums/ /gtum mo bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yung mo bdag ni yid rmongs pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad par/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /khyod ni mig 'phrul lta bur bzhengs/ /bskul ba'i glu'o/ /bskul bas sngon gyi byang chub kyi/ /smon lam rjes su dran pa'o/ /khya ba'i gzugs las bzhengs pa ni/ /5—352

oṃ ①dang hūṃ gnyis rdo rje che/ /zhal brgyad zhabs ni bzhi pa ste/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa ste/ /phyed bcas pa yis gar mkhan ni/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che/ /g.yas pa ku mu da dang mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar po chen po 'jigs/ /phyi ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhis phyug /bdag med ma la bde ba ster/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mong / /mi dang seng ge de byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad po ni/ /dang po glang po rim shes bya/ /gzhi dang chu gnas rlung dang ni/ /me zla de nas snang byed dang / /phyi mthar byed dang nor sbyin ni/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /go rī kha dog nag mo'o/ /chom rkun ma ni btsod dang mtshungs/ /ro langs ma ni gser bsregs mdog /ghasma rī ni margata mtshungs/ /puk+ka sī ni dbang sngon mo/ /ri khrod ma ni zla nor 'od/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs masde/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs pa ru 'dod/ /go rī g.yas na gri gug ste/ /g.yon na nya ni de bzhin no/ /chom rkun ma g.yas cang te'u ste/ /g.yon na phag pa de bzhin no/ /ro langs ma g.yas rus sbal te/ /g.yon pa'i lag pa thod pa'o/ /za phod ma yi g.yas na sbrul/ /g.yon pa'i lag pa thod pa'o/ /puk+ka sī g.yas seng ge ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na dgra sta 'dzin/ /ri khrod ma g.yas dge slong ste/ /g.yon pa na ni gsil byed shes/ /gtum mo g.yas na 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon na thod pa de bzhin no/ /g.yung mo g.yas na rdo rje ste/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /go rī la sogs phyag gnyis shes/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du yin/ /phyag rgya lnga 5—353

yis shin tu mdzes/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /gshin rje nor gyi bdag po dang / /bden bral dang ni thags bzangs ris/ /go rī la sogs pa yi gdan/ /thams cad rdo rje 'di yis ni/ /rang sngags yi ge rdzogs pa dang / /phyag rgya phyag mtshan gyur pa las/ /snying gar ye shes bsam gtan bya/ /rang snying pad nyir hūṃ rdo rje/ /hūṃ ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i snying / /pad nyir gnas pa'i hūṃ rdo rje/ /hūṃ ye shes rjes su bsam pa'o/ /dam tshig 'khor lo la mnyam thim/ /ye shes 'khor lo chen po 'bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bsgrubs te gzhan yang du ma yin/ /dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥbaka' lung 'dis/ /go rī la sogs bzhi po 'dis/ /dgug dang 'di ni gzhug pa dang / /bcing dang rjes su dgyes par bya/ /mig la sogs pa gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum bsam/ /mig gnyis rdo rje gti mug ma/ /rna gnyis zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna ni ser sna ma zhes brjod/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /ming gi yi ge dang pos bskyed/ /phyag gnyis zhal gcig bzang po yirka/ /gri gug thod pa lag na bcas/ /sna tshogs mdog can ro yi gdan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su ni/ /oṃ uhūṃ ni 'di yi sngags/ /'di las mkha' spyod sa spyod ma/ /zhabs 'og gnas pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rigs gsum dngos/ /rang snying sa bon khyad par spro/ /lcags kyu'i gzugs kyi 'od zer gyes/ /sangs rgyas spyan drangs yang dag mchod/ /dbang bskur ba ni blang ba'o/ /mgon po de bzhin gshegs thams cad/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /de nas de 5—354

bzhin gshegs 'di dag /te ru ka gzugs byas nas ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa nyid kyi phyag gis bsnams/ /blugs te dbang bskur mtha' ru 'di'i/ /rtsa ba'i mi bskyod phyag rgya'o/ /de ni yang ni go rī dang / /puk+ka sī 'di'i phyag rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dpag med yang / /phyi ma drug la gnyis gnyis rim/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa lha kopho①haṃ—/ 'bud pa dang / 'bar ba dang / thod pa dang / lcags kyu lnga dang / sa bon lngar gyur pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro myong bar byed pa la/ rdo rje nas kyi 'bru tsam bsams te/ dpal kye rdo rje brtag pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na ⑧badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kopho①haṃ/ ye shes mchod pa sna tshogs sogs/ /lha mo 'di brgyad mchod pa ni/ /spro zhing 'khor lo'i bdag po ni/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid pas sngon mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3rjohaṃ / rnal 'byor ma ni de dag gis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo la bstod pa/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rnams bskor/ /nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs grub/ /⑤rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu mas byang chub sgrub pa'i yid/ /dgyes pa'i shrī te ru ka rdo rje bstod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophorjohaṃ/ rdo rje rjes su chags byed dang / /sangs rgyas gzhal med bye brag bsgom/ /dbang bskur bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /mchod pa bstod pa yan lag drug /yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor gang / /de ⑦ni myur du dngos grub thob/ /pho brang sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /dbang ni mi bskyod de bzhin gshegs/ /bdud rtsi rgyang ba 'od dpag med/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan dpal/ /mchod pa 5—355

don yod yang dag mchod/ /rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /dngos grub 'di ni nye ba yi/ /yan lag drug gis babyed pa ni/ /dang po sprin dang 'dra ba mthong / /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba ste/ /gsum pa glog gi rnam pa'o/ /bzhi pa mar me 'bar ba dang / /lnga pa thams cad snang ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba'o/ /phyis ni sgyu ma'i rnam pa mtshungs/ /rmi lam snang ba skad cig go/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te/ /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs pa/ /bsregs pas haṃ las ri bong 'byung / /bsam gtan mi nus rnal 'byor gang / /don ni dag pa rjes su dran/ /snying rje spyan ni dmar po ste/ /yan lag nag po byams pa'i thugs/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi pa ①ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa yin/ /bcu drug phyag ni stong pa ste/ /phyag rgya lnga ni sangs rgyas yin/ /khro bo gdug pa 'dul ba po/ /spyan gsum po ni sku gsum mo/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi pa'o②/ /gzugs ni rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba gsang ba'i go rī ma/ /de bzhin chu ma 'du shes phung / /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes 'di ni bdag med ma/ /don dam la ni phung po med/ /de ni yan lag drug tu 'gyur—/ /skye mched drug ni dag pa yi/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje ma/ /rdo rje ro ma 'bab ri yin/ /phrag dog rdo rje ma de bzhin/ /gti mug rdo rje ma yang ni/ /yin te rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ser sna gsang ba'i go rī ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /sa ni puk+ka sī ru brjod/ /chu rnams ri khrod ma zhes zer//drod ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu brjod/ /gzugs ni go rīr yang dag bshad/ /sgra ni chos rkun ma ru bshad/ /so so'i 5—356
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (61)5wa 359

༄ga /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgrub thabs bzang po yongs su gzung ba zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ su pa ri gra ha nā ma maṇ+ḍa la no dze+epi ka bi dhi/bod skad du/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgrub thabs bzang po yongs su gzung ①ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba 'jig pa'i me 'byung nad dang mya ngan phreng ba'i 'od 'phro bar/ /lhung bas duchu bur nad 'gyur bzlog dka' 'gro ba nyam thag zhi bya'i phyir/ /snying rje bdud rtsi'i char gyi chus gang 'gro la byams pa'i chu bo ni/ /gang 'di kun du rab 'bab sangs rgyas bcom ldan de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud kun don gyi cho ga ni/ /rgyas par rig pa yod min te/ /rgyud kun don gyi cho ga ni/ /bsgrub par nus pa ma yin no/ /de phyir tha snyad tsam gyis ni/ /rjes 'jug spros pa ma yin no/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bdag gis ni/ /legs par bsdu ba 'di rtsom mo/ /slob dpon rnyed dang bkur ma phrogs/ /bya ba mkhas shing dkyil 'khor mthong / /5—360

sgrub sprul legs par bsngags pa yi/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya zhi dang rgyas dang rab gnas sogs/ /'dod pa'i don ni byed nus pa'i/ /slob ma gnyis sam gsum gyi bar/ /dkyil 'khor bri phyir gsol ba gdab/ /tshogs 'phel bar ①dang bgegs zhi'i phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam shes pas②/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba yin/ /bsnyen pa med na 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gnas kyi bye brag rig pa yis/ /'phral du dben par 'dug nas ni/ /lha yi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /dub na de yis gsang sngags bzlas/ /'khor lo can gye sngags 'bum bzlas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha yi ①'bum/ /gzhan rnams kyi — khri nyid de/ /dngos grub mtshan ma mchog thob nas/ /rang gi lus la dkyil 'khor bsdu/ /'di ni sngon du bsnyen par brjod/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /bsnyen pas bgegs kyi tshogs bcom ste/ /sa ni yongs su gzung bar bya//ri bo grong dang grong khyer dang / /sa phyogs yid ni dga' ba ru/ /rus pa thal ba zug rngu rdo/ /bshang bas ma dag gzhan du bgrod/ /u dum wā ra n+ya gro a shrata tha/ ba la sha dang ba ku khārdzu na/ /ldan pa rus sbal rgyab dang 'dra ba yi/ /sa ni drug po rnam par spang bar bya/ /chu ni g.yas su 'khor ba dang / /shar dang byang du gzhol ba'i sa/ /zur ni bzhi ste dkar 'dra ba/ /brkos nas des bkang lhag gyur pa'o/ /sngags pa rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /snying rjes gang ba'i yid dang bcas/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi tshul gyis gnas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bsal bar bya/ /khru phyed brkos nas chu yis dgang / /gom pa brgya ru 'gro bar bya/ /myur du 'ongs nas blta bya ste/ /de bzhin 'dug na 5—361

lhag par bsngags①/ /der ni sa bdag zhing skyong ba/ /la sogs pa ni gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas sngags dang phyag rgya ru/ /bcas pas sa ni bslang bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /gnyi ga mtshalas kyi mtha' ru gzung / /sa bzang po 'di bdag stsol cig /ces pas bslang bar bya ba yin/ /oṃ hūṃ rjo dz+re ②swā hā/ sa bslang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma dang / /rjes mthun phyi de'i nyi ma la/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba 'am/ /yang na bgegs rnams gzhom par bya/ /sa 'dzin lta bur brtan pa'i blos/ /srung ba'i 'khor los sa legs bsrung / /pus mo lte ba rked tsam du/ /dngos grub rjes mthun brko bar bya/ /dgun zla ra ba la sogs nas/ /brtsams te zla ba gsum gsum du/ /lto 'phye lho dang nub dang byang / /shar du de yi mgo bo ste/ /g.yon pa'i zur gyis nyal ba yin/ /'di yi lto ba shes nas brko/ /mgo bo rgyab sogs nas brkos pa'i/ /skyon ni rgyas la snelas shes bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i sa brko ba'i cho ga'o/ /phub ma rdo dang gseg ma dang / /sol ba la sogs dor byas te/ /rin chen 'bru sman nang du gzhug /shin tu 'thas par brdung bar bya/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa thams cad ni/ /gal te bsal bar ma nus na/ /lag pas mnan te gsang sngags bzla'o/ /de nyid stobs ldan dag par 'gyur/ /oṃ ha na ha na kro ta rjohūṃ phaṭa/ sa sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /dri chus gtor zhing dag pa yidu/ /sa 'di yongs su gzung bar bya/ /mtshan mo lnga ni ma chad par/ /rdo rje slob dpon kyis bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /nu ma gnyis kyi mdun bzhag nas/ /thams cad kun ni bskrad byas te/ /de rjes sar ni 'jug par bya/ /oṃ a pa sa ran+tu bha brnyo yi ge tsi ta 5—362

sba na swa mi na/ de ba nā ga yak+ṣa di garnyarba ①bhū ta/ bhū ta ②ni/ ḍā ki ni/ satwa aze kṛ ya a ④pa re ba ga tsha tram̐ sri rjogro me wan+tu/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bskrad pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / /dra ba dag dang bla re dang //mda' yi dra ba phyi rol du/ /me ri yang ni byen gyis brlabs/ /oṃ me dī rī badz+re bha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ṅgā ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ yi hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra be+e dha na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la tra rjosaṃ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na 'a hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi rjohūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṭ+wā pa ya greṭ+wā ⑦pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duspya bighā ⑧hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ra a dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bispyo kā ya bākyit+ta badz+ra tī la ya tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūṃ muṅga ra badz+ra kā ⑨la ya/ ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags tshig grub pa 'di rnams kyis/ /'bar ba'i me yi phyi rol du/ /khro bo'i rnam pa'i phur bu ni/ /lugs su 'byung dang lugs min pas//bgegs rnams kyi ni spyi bor gdab/ /phur pa ⑩la sogs cho ga'o/ /rdo rje dril bu la sogs kyi/ /de nyid rnams dang mchod yon sogs/ /cho ga rgyas pa'i dam tshig ni/ /sgo skyong las kyi rdo rjes gdab/ /sor mo brgyad pa nas brtsams te/ /nyi shu'i bar du grangs mnyam bya/ /gser dang 'jon dmar sogs byung ba'i/ /rdo rje rnam pa ⑩gsum ni bzung / /rtse gsum pa dang rtse lnga pa—/ /rtse dgu pa ste rnam pa gsum/ /zhi dang ma zhi rab phyed pas/ /yang ni rnam pa gnyis su brjod/ /bzhi pa sna tshogs rdo rje nyid/ /rtse mo lnga pa gdong bzhi yin/ /dbus ma gzung ba'i gnas yin te/ /mtha' ma'i rtse mo de yi tshad//5—363

dbus ma'i rwa ni nas gzugs mtshungs/ /phyogs kyi cha las ma 'das par①/ /tha ma chu srin mche ba'i rtse/ /chu srin kha nas byung ba yin/ /rtsa sbom rtse mo byin gyis phra/ /rno zhing rim byis mgo bo gug /rwa rnams kyi ni nang gi char/ /dbus kyi rwa dang bar mtshalas bya/ /rdo rje rjes su mthun pa ru/ /sor mo gnyis cha bskyed 'bri ②bya/ /rtse mo phan tshun mnyam bya zhing / /dbu ma las ni cung zad thung / /ra ①brgyad rtsa ba'i yan lag tu/ /pad+ma kha bye pad+ma brtag /dbus kyi cha las cung zad tsam/ /lhag par ska rags bya ba yin/ /phan tshun mnyam pa'i lhag ma ni/ /rim gyis nyis 'gyur mthon po yin/ /chu skyes 'dab brgyad mdzes pa yis/ /mgo dang zhabs su phreng ba gnyis/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni rdo rje'i mtshan nyid do/ /dbus su rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ /shar yin de bzhin rin chen lhor/ /nub dang byang gi ra ④dag la/ /'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad dag pa/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'dab ma la/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad yin te/ /mtshan ma gsal bar blta bar bya/ /phyag na pad+ma byams pa dang / /nam mkha'i mdzod dang bzang po'i gsungs/ /gnod sbyin bdag po 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sgrib pa sel dang sa snying nyid/ /dbu ma kun gyi gzhir gnas te/ /sangs rgyas snying po za ma tog / rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa ma/ /⑤rdo rje lcags sgog sgrol ma'o/ /mtshalas su skul byed rin chen glog /lu gu rgyud ma gzhan mi thub/ /pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma ru gsungs/ /rwa rjol yang dag gnas brjod pa/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang du 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /nub tu ro langs mar shes bya/ /lho ru gtum mo dran par bya/ /dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /5—364

rdo rje'i de nyid 'dir 'dod do/ /dril bu kun du cha drug la/ /de yi cha bzhi 'khar ba yi/ /rang bzhin ma 'dres pa la bya/ /gzhan ni gzhan las brtag par bya/ /dril bu de yi nang gi mkha'/ /zheng dang chu ru mnyam pa yi①/ /phreng ba ut+pa la mtshan ma brgyad/ /steng dbus rim pa ji bzhin du/ /cho gas 'dab ma brgyad mtshan pa/ /ut+pal steng gi cha gcig la/ /phreng ba gsum gnas de steng du/ /bum pa gser ram zangs ma 'am/ /dngul lam ra gan las byas pa'o/ /de yi steng du de tshad tsam/ /shar bltas shes rab gdong pa bya—/ /gdong steng rdo rje phyed pa ste/ /sngon gyi rdo rje phyed lta bu/ /de ltar sor brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /dril bu rdo rje'i rjes mthun bya/ /cung zad chu skyes kha phye ba'i/ /khar gyur yang ni ba lang mchu/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni dril bu'i mtshan nyid do/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad du blta bya ba/ /lha rnams sa bon rnam par bsgom—/ /shar du lha mo sgol ma ste/ /gos dkar mo ni byang du yin/ /nub tu mā ma tīr shes bya/ /lho ru sangs rgyas spyan ma'o/ /mdog bzangs dmar dang 'od ma can②/ /rdo rje phreng ba ①mtshams nyid do/ /nang na gnas pa'i nam mkha' ni/ /gzugs med pa yi khams dag pa'o/ /gzugs khams rnam par dag pa 'di'i/ /ut+pal rtsa ba kha bye ba/ /shes rab bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i gzhi/ /steng gi chu skyes rdo rje no/ /rdo rje lta bur rnam par bsam/ /dbus kyi dbyug pa ye shes te/ /thams cad sdud cing spro bar byed/ /pad+ma'i bskor ba rnam pa lngas/ /gnas brgyad rnams su dkrol bar bya/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni dril bu'i de kho na nyid do/ /gser sogs rdzas dang mchod sbyin shing / /yang na ni ma pa'i shing las ni/ /dgang 5—365

gzar ring tshad khru do pa/ /de yi dbye ba bshad par bya/ /chu zhing sor mo brgyad pa la/ /khung bu de phyed mnyam pa brko/ /brkos pa dang mnyam rdo rje bru①/ /kha ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma mtshungs/ /mu khyud kyang ni gru bzhi ste/ /kun du sor mo bzhi yin no/ /sor gnyis brkos pa de tshad la/ /rdo rje rtse gsum pa nang du/ /'di yi khu bcud 'dzag pa yi/ /bu ga mthe'u chung tshad tsam yin/ /ska rags 'og tu de yi tshad/ /mdzes pa 'dab ma dag gi gnas/ /smyo byed me tog dang mtshungs pa/ /yu ba'i mgo bo dag tu bya/ /yu 'og sor gnyis rin po che/ /tha mar rdo rje sor drug pa/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni dgang gzar gyi mtshan nyid do/ /phyed bcas khru gang blugs gzar du/ /zhes bya 'di yi kha sor drug /chu skyes 'dab ma'i rnam pa mtshungs/ /de yi dbus su zheng zabs su/ /sor gsum bru bya de tshad tsam/ /rtse lnga pa yi rdo rjes mdzes/ /sor gnyis mdzes par byed pa'i gnas/ /rin chen sor gcig shes par bya/ /dgang gzar yu ba chang ba yisaske/ /gzung bar 'dod pa'i tshad tsam yin/ /cung zad phra ba blugs gzar gyi/ /rdo rje sor gsum bya ba'o/ /'di ni blugs gzar byi mtshan nyid do//gser dang dngul dang nya phyis dung / /rdo dang shing dang zangs ma'i snod/ /'di dag mchod yon snod yin te/ /mthar yang 'dab ma'i snod sbyar bya/ /mchod yon gyi snod bstan pa yin no/ /dri yi chu dang 'o ma mngar/ /chu gtsang me tog dkar po rnams/ /ji ltar rnyed snod nang bzhag ste/ /spos bdug gsang sngags mngon par bzlas/ /'di ni mchod yon sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /dkar po ser po dmar po ljang / /zhi dang rgyas sogs sgrub pa la/ /las dang rjes su mthun pa'i dri/ /chu la sogs pa de bzhin sbyar/ /mchod yon gyi dbye 5—366

ba'i cho ga'o/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri yi dung sogs g.yas su gzhag /g.yon du sngags kyi mchod yon sngon/ /mdun du yang ni snod gzhag bya| /mchod yon gyi snod la sogs pa dgod pa'o/ /yi ge gsum mam yi ge lnga//ji ltar rgyud du bstan pa'i sngags/ /ji ltar las kyi rjes mthun par/ /mchod yon la sogs sngags su bya/ /zhi la mtha' ru ba shaṃ ste/ /rgyas la mtha' ma bo ṣaṭa te/ /bsad ①la hūṃ phaṭa mtha' mar te/ /dgug dang dbang la dzaḥdang hriḥ—/ /mchod yon la sogs pa'i sngags yin no/ /dang por dri chu sbyin par bya//gnyis pa la ni 'o ma mngar/ /gsum pa nyid la chu gtsang ste/ /bzhi par me tog sbyar bar bya/ / dung gi kha yi ②dri yi chu/ /zhabs rtsa dag la dbul bar bya//oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ khaṃ zhabs bsil gyi sngags so/ /'thor 'thung la ni 'o ma dang / /mngar ba yin no bsang gtor ni/ /chu gtsang 'ba' zhig ku sha yi/ /chun po mchod yon sngags bzla'o/ /oṃ saza saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ zhal bsil dang bsang gtor gyi sngags so/ /ye shes dkar pos me tog ni/ /blangs nas mtha' sogs rim gyis dbye/ /zhabs bsil zhal baṅgal bzed zhal ni/ /chol zangs sam ni lcags kyi snod/ /gser dang dngul sogs rdzas gzhan las/ /byas pa'i snod ni man 'jir bzhag /zhabs bsel la sogs pa'i rab tu dbye ba'o—/ /zhabs bsil zhal bsel bsang gtor sogs/ /rim pa bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /'di kun mchod yon yan lag phyir/ /mchod yon sgra ru bshad pa yin/ /mchod yon dbul ba'i cho ga'i rim/ /khu tshur mnyam par dam bcings te/ /gung mo gnyis brkyang rtse mo sbyar/ /ar+ghaṃ chen por rab tu bstan| /oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ mchod yon dbul ba'i sngags dang phyag 5—367

rgya'o / /bdud rtsi 'khyel sngags yungs kar bzla/ /khu tshur gnyis kyis 'dod lha la/ /rang gi bskor bas rab bskor te/ /gnyis gnyis bar du sbyang bar bya/cig car khu tshur gnyis dag gis/ /g.yas su bskor ba yang bya'o/ /sngon bzhin yungs kar me snod la/ /sbyang bar bya phyir gzhug par bya/ /oṃ sar+bha pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya badz+ra satwa mya saza pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ 'di ni sbyang ba'i cho ga'o//ye shes rnam shes nang bkug ①ste/ /snyim pas chu ni blang byas nas/ /de bzhin bskor te sbyang phyir mer/ /yungs kar bzhin du gzhug par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ ta ṭi ②phaṭaske/ nye reg gi cho ga'o/ /zla 'od arje nī la dang / /pu sha rā ga dmar nor bu/ /margata mchog ste de rnams kyi/ /phye ma rin chen rdul tshon mchog /gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /rgyal po 'khyil ba byu ru rnams/ /'di dag rin chen lnga ru bshad/ /yal ga lnga po bshad par bya/ /'dzam bu dang ni ka dam pa/ /bil ba dang ni a mra dang / /pi dza pu ra las byung ba'o/ /til dang gro dang sran ma 'bras/ /nas rnams 'bru lngar shes par bya/ /ha sa de ba ka pi ra/ /kre tai dza li dṛ ha pa la/ /'di dag sman bzhir shes par bya/ /lnga pa kaṇi ①ka yin no/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri thra ha ti/ /ha sa de ba ha sa dang / /se te a pa ra dzi dang / /'di dag cig shos sman kyi tshogs/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang gur kum dang / /la ku dran thi ka dang lnga/ /'di dag dri lngar bstan pa ste/ /lha la khrus gsol bshad pa yin/ /u dusmra ra shi ri ṣa/ /a shwat+tha dang n+ya gro dha/ /par ka ti yi shun lpags lngas/ /lha khrus gsol ba'i mar khu bsaladu/ /ba yi mar dang phyi ba chu/ /zho dang 'o ma yang dag bsres/ /'di dag ba yi lngar shes bya| /lha rnams khrus gsol sgrub pa yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems 5—368

dpa' rnams/ /yang dag mnyes par bya ba ste/ /rtag tu dam tshig rig pa yis//dam tshig mchod pas mchod par bya/ /glu ni rdo rje can la dbul/ /gar ni sangs rgyas rnams la dbul/ /ha ri mchog la de bzhin dri/ /'jig rten rje la bza' dang btung / /gos kyi mchod pa rta mchog la/ /'di dag dam tshig mchog yin no/ /hūṃ rdo rje las byung ba'i dri/ /a ka ru nag te ru ka /tsan+dan dkar po rtag pa la/ /dmar po 'jig rten rje la dbul/ /kha che rdo rje snang ba la—/ /bdun gyi rgyal po thams cad do/ /kha dang tsha ba rdo rjer dbul/ /mngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lan tshwa 'jig rten rjer/ /rta yi rgyal po thams cad dam/ /bska ba rab tu brtag par bya/ /shing byung me tog nag mdzes pa/ /kye yi rdo rje 'chang ba la'o/ /ma li ka dang ma la ti/ /kun+da rtag tu sangs rgyas dbul/ /shing dbang mchog dang dri med pa//snang byed la ni dbul bar bya/ /ut+pal dmar po chu skyes dang / /ban+d+ra dmar po pa ta la/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang la dbul/ /thams cad rdo rje rta mchog la'o//rang gi lha yi sbyor byas te/ /mi mthun phyogs bskrad nges pa yis sa yi dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba gdab/ /ji srid 'khor lo yongs rdzogs par/ /bdag cag bsrung ba bya ba'i phyir/ /sa 'di byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas deng nyid 'os/ /'gal ba'i sems can rtsom pa'i tshogs/ /mkhas pa khros pas rnam par gzhol/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi mig dag la/ /ma las nyi ma ṭa las zla/ /rkang 'og rdo rje spro ba me / /'od zer rnams kyis klu sogs bsregs/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis brgyan pas/ /rdo rje gsor ba rol byed cing / /gnas rnams su ni dril 5—369

bu brdungs/ /rgyun du mthug pa'i hūṃ sgra sgogs/ /mkhas pas g.yas su bskor byas te/ /phyogs bzhi rnams su yongs su bskor/ /'gyur dang bcas shing sgeg pa mchog /dang por rol bcas rjes rgyu bas/ /rkang stabs brgyad du cho ga yis/ /rdo rje gom pas gar bya'o/ /me tog snying po'i sbyor ba bya/ /spos la yal ga'i sbyor ba nyid/ /mar me sdong bu'i lag tshul dang / /byug ①pa'i tshul byis byug pa dang / /lag pas mig dang de bzhin rna/ /rkang pa zung gis g.yas phyogs su/ /bskor te pheg rdob sbyor ba yis/ /de bzhin du yang g.yon du bskor/ /de nas rgyun gyi gar byas te/ /de rjes bskyod pa'i gar bya'o/ /myur brdebs de bzhin gar byas te/ /'khor lo lta bur 'khor bar bya/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang / g.yon brkyang ba dang / mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang /rdo rje'i rkang stabs dang / klum po dang / sna tshogs gcod ②pa dang / rus sbal gyi rkang stabs dang / bung ba 'phur ba lta bu zhes bya ba ni/ rkang stabs brgyad do/ /rgya mtsho bskyod pa dang / ri bo 'degs pa dang / mdzes pa'i gom pa dang / khro bo'i gom pa ste rkang stabs kyi bkod pa'o/ /rdo rje'i tshul dang / 'khor lo'i tshul dang / rin po che'i tshul dang / pad+ma'i tshul dang /ral gri'i tshul dang / mdung gi tshul dang / gzhu'i tshul dang / dbyug pa'i tshul dang / tho ba'i tshul dang / gtun shing gi tshul dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i tshul dang / kha bcu pa'i tshul dang / ral gri'i phru gu'i tshul dang / sna tshogs dbyig pa'i tshul dang / mdung thung gi tshul dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa'i tshul zhes bya ba ni tshul bcu drug go/ /ba dan gnyis pa dang / ba dan gsum pa dang / me tog gi tshul dang / spos kyi tshul dang / mar me'i tshul 5—370

dang / dri'i tshul dang / lā sre'i lag pa dang / phreng ba'i lag pa dang /glu'i lag pa dang / gar gyi lag pa dang / gling bu'i lag pa dang / pi wang gi lag pa dang /① rdza rnga'i lag pa dang / mu kuṇ+ḍa'i lag pa dang / bya ba mtha' yas pa'i lag pa'i bkod pa'o/ /rdo rje'i byas krung dang / sems dpa'i skyil krung dang / pad+ma'i skyil krung dang / bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang / skyil krung phyed pa dang / bkra shis kyi 'dug stangs te/ 'dug stangs kyi bkod pa'o/ /sgeg pa'i ro dang / dpa' bo'i ro dang / mi sdug pa'i ro dang / drag po'i ro dang / rgad po'i ro dang /② 'jigs su rung ba'i ro dang / zhi ba'i ro dang / rngam pa'i ro dang / snying rje ba'i ro zhes bya ba ni gar gyi ro dgu'o/ /tha nyi tha hi/ tha ga tha ga /thu ma thu ma/ tha ma tha ma—/ tho ho tho ho/ rtsa hi rtsa nyi/ dha sgo dha sgo/ kra ka kra ka /tha ka tha ka /ḍi hi ḍi nyi/ ta ṭa wa ta ṭa wa/ tram̐/ cang te'u cha lang rnga rings dang / /rdza rnga phyed pa de bzhin no/ /gling bu pi ldir yang de bzhin/ /pi wang rgyud mangs rgyud gcig pa/ /rnam gsum dbye bas brdung bar bya/ /dal ba drag po myur ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs gnas rnams su/ /mchod pa 'di ni bla na med| /'di dag ni rol mo'i bkod pa yin no/ /drug gi rjes su skyes pa'i glu dang / drang srong gi rjes kyi glu dang / sa 'dzin kyi rjes kyi gru dang / bar ma'i rjes kyi glu dang / lnga pa'i rjes kyi glu dang / blo gsal gyi rjes kyi glu dang /'khor mnyam ③pa'i rjes kyi glu dang / dal ba'i dbye ba dang / drag po'i dbye ba dang / rdzogs par dbye ba dang / zab par dbye ba dang / phyed phri ba dang / rnam par 'dres pa dang / dkyugs gnyis len par byed pa dang /5—371

dkyugs gsum len par byed pa dang /① mgrin par sgogs pa dang / rkan du sgrogs pa dang / lcer sgogs pa dang / sor sgogs pa ste/ 'di dag ni gru'i bkod pa yin no/ /sa gzhi yongs su gzung ba'i tshe④/ /dam tshig 'di dag rab tu bskul/ /las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang bas bya/ /rdo rje sa sogs grub rjes su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /chos 'byung bsgom bya de nang du/ /hri las byung ba'i pad+ma ste/ /pad stengs a las byung ba yi/ /kun du bltas pa'i rdo rje yin/ /rdo rje'i steng du rlung la sogs/ /de steng hūṃ las 'khor lo nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ro/ /de steng sangs rgyas yongs bsgoms te/ /spro zhing gzhal yas khang 'bar dgod/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs mdzes/ /pho brang nyams dga' bsgom par bya/ /dkar po gser sogs bye ma yis/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri bar bya/ /las kun byed pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bum pa lte ba'i dbus su gzhag /tshon sna lnga yi srad bu ni—/ /shar kyi 'dab mar rnam par dgod/ /lho ru rdo rje gzhag par bya/ /de bzhin byang du dril bu'o/ /bdud rtsi lngas ①gang dung phor ni/ /shar las gzhan pa'i 'dab mar dgod/ /rdul tshon sangs rgyas lnga yi cha/ /'bar ba re re tha dad pa'i/ /snod du gzhag par byas nas ni/ /so so'i mtshams su gzhag par bya/ /sku dang gdan rnams ji lta bar/ /bum par rdo rje 'chang ba bsgom / /mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag mchod/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bskul bar bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ka dam bcings te/ /ro tsa na dang dkar po brkyang //rtse mo rtse mo sbyar ba nyid/ /snying po'i phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /oṃ uswā hā/ snying 5—372

po'i phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /rdo rje rtse yis bum reg nas/ /gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā sngags so/ /chu des rdul tshon thig skud la/ /gtor nas mchod dang gtor ma sbyin/ /rang gi bdag po'i gsang sngags bzla/ /sku yang bsgom par bya ba yin/ /spro zhing 'khor lo bsdu bar bya/ /mtshan mo skad cig der gnas bya/ /'di dag ni sa yongs su gzung ba yin no// //rnal 'byor bdag nyid tho rangs langs/ /lus kyi bya ba kun byas te/ /bum pa sogs bsdus dkyil 'khor sa'i/ /lho phyogs cha ru gzhag par bya/ /yang ni dri yis nyer byugs te/ /baṃ las byung ba'i lha mo bsam/ /phyag gnyis bum pa bzang po 'dzin/ /sku mdog ser po'i 'od ldan zhing / /ye shes rdzogs pa yang dag mchod/ /lhag par gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes lan gsum brjod de sa'i lha mo gshegs su gsol lo/ /lus khrus bya zhing dri yis byugs/ /ji snyed 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /ser po'i gos ni bgos nas ni/ /phyi dro'i dus su 'jug par bya/ /dri dang me tog gcal bkram pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su 'dug byas te/ /bdag nyid 'dod pa'i lhar bsgoms la/ /spro dang bcas pas spros ①bzung nas/ /yan lag kun gyis rab btud de/ /rgyal ba rnams la gsol ba gdab/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo 5—373

rje 'chang chen che ge mo/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'byu bar 'tshal sangs rgyas la sogs kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni pa du gsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas la gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /slob dpon rdo rje sems mtshungs la/ /phyi nas rtag sogs rgyal ba dang / /mnyam pa rdo rje dril 'chang ba'i/ /slob ma rnams kyis gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can don gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /yang na tshigs bcad gcig pa 'di/ /bzhi yis mgrin gcig brjod par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /de nas langs te nam mkha' la/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la btud de/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sbyor bas nga rgyal bskyed par bya/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' bdag /rdo rje nyi ma bdag nyid de/ /don yod rdo rje chos bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid yin/ /hūṃ badz+re tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags kyis/ /rang gi mngon sprul 'khor lo ni/ /nam mkhar bteg par byas nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gar 5—374

gyis kun du bskor/ /sngar bshad pa yi sngags kyis ni/ /rdo rje sa gzhi'i rang bzhin bya/ /ra ba nyid dang dra ba dang / /bla re la sogs sngar bzhin ①bya/ /phur bu la ni khyad par du/ /phur pa sor mo bco brgyad pa'am/ /yang na sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /sboms su sor drug sor bzhi pa/ /seng ldeng rus pa lcags las byas/ /tsan+dan dmar pos byug par bya/ /phreng ba cod pan dmar pos mdzes/ /chang pa g.yon pas gzung bar bya/ /phur bu'i mgo ru tho ba ni/ /bzhag pa lag pa cig shos kyis/ /sngon gyi sngags kyis brdungs byas te/ /shar sogs gnas su gdab par bya/ /yang na sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /phur bu ra ba dra rnams bya/ /lag pa'i mthil ni steng bstan te/ /bzlog nas sa la brdab par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje phur bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis lu gu rgyud bcas te/ /gyen du brkyang nas phyi ru bzlog /oṃ hūṃ phaṭa dra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis khu tshur byas nas ni/ /ye shes pad+ma brkyang bar bya/ /sa gdugs dang ni rnam shes brgyad/ /ye shes dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /sa gdugs pad+ma sbyar byas te/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskor bar bya/ /oṃ dze+e bha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /bum pa lhag par gnas par bya//bum pa rtsa ba nag po sogs/ /spangs pa mdun du dgod par bya/ /mgrin pa ring ba lto che ba/ /yal ga bzang pos kha rnams mdzes/ /'o ma dri chu la sogs pas—/ /gang ba mgul par ras kyis dkri/ /rjes su mthun pa brtan byas te//dkyil 'khor khang par gzhag par bya/ /dngos grub brgyad don 'dod byed phyir//lan bdun bar du bzlas pa yin/ /oṃ taste taste ma ha taste swā hā/ gaṅgā'i chu 5—375

dgug pa'i sngags so/ /sa gdugs dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /lhag ma thams cad brkyang byas pas/ / bum par red nas gsang sngags 'dis/ /①lan bdun bar du mngon par bzlas/ /oṃ sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sgo'i bum pa'i lhag par gnas pa'o/ /dri med zig gis btab pa yis/ /'khor lo yi ni sgo bzhi ru/ /shar phyogs sgo nas brtsams byas te/ /bum pa rnams ni dgod par byaske/ /rgyal ba dang ni bkra shis zhes/ /bya ba shar sgo'i logs gnyis la/ /lho ru dngos grub srung bar bshad/ /nub tu rgyal dang zhi ba ste/ /byang du dngos grub rdzu 'phrul te/ /dngos grub rin chen dbul ba'o/ /gang zhig 'dir ni lha yi gnas/ /dkyil 'khor gang du nges pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ni dri lnga 'am/ /yang na gzhan gyis byug par bya/ /rang gi sngags kyis yig sprul pas/ /lha yi 'khor lo dgod par bya/ /dgug par bya ba'i sbyor bas der//ye shes 'khor lo dgug par bya/ /de nas mchod pa rnam pa lngas/ /rgyal ba dad pas yang dag mchod/ /dkyil 'khor ji srid rdzogs kyi bar/ /byen brlab don du gsol ba gdab/ /thugs brtse'i phan pa'i dgongs pa can/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sngags ②dang bcas par gshegs nas ni/ /sa gzhi yongs su gzung bar mdzod/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bdag ming 'di—/ /dkyil 'khor che ge mo bskyed phyir/ /ci nus pa yi nyer spyod kyis/ /nang par nam langs dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /slob ma rjes su gzung ba dang / /spyod rnams la yang mchod bgyid na/ /rjes su brtse ba bskyed nas ni/ /bsnyen te bzhugs par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod de dkyil 'khor gyi lha lhag par gnas pa'o// //5—376

de nas slob ma khrus byas te/ /gtsang ma'i gos ni bgos pa yis me tog snyim thogs phyag 'tshal nas/ /bla ma la ni gsol gdab bya/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs bcas pa/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khrod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol①/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol②/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol①/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /dam tshig slob mas gsol gdab pa'o / /rjokhyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyis/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di byis shig /de ltar slob ma la gdams nas/ /bshags dang yi rang sogs bya zhing / /dang por gsum la skyabs su gtang / /de nas byang chub sems bskyed bya/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla 5—377

na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud par bgyi/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum| /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar babyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes sdom/ /'di nas brtsams te dang por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /de nyid yang dag gzung bar babyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin po che yi rigs sbyor ba'i| /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni so sor gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis babyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don byi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung ngo / /de nas slob ma mdun bdar ba/ /dri yis gtor nas snying ga ru/ /rtse mo lnga pa'i rdo rje gzung / /sna tshogs dag gis rnam 'byed pa'i/ /rdo rje spyi bor rnam par bsam/ /mgrin pa'i gnas su chu skyes nyid/ /de nas me tog spos sogs kyis/ /mchod pa byas nas mdun du gzhag /so shing sor mo bcu gnyis pa/ /dri yi chu dang 'o mas bkru/ /rtse mo 5—378

me tog gis bcings la/ /lan bdun bzlas pa'i dri chu yang / /kha dag bya phyir sbyin par bya/ /cha.a dzi twa saṃ brta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ so shing la bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ s+thāḥb shurtse dhasmra saza pā paṃ nibya ①saṃ sho dha ya saza bai kalpa a pa na ya hūṃ/ chu sbyin pa'i sngags so/ /slob ma byang du mngon bltas pas/ /so shing ma gas par bcas nas/ /ba lang pags pa'i tshad tsam byis/ /sa yi phyogs su rab tu dor/ /steng 'phred kha tshur bltas lhung na/ /shin tu skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /phyi rim kha phar bltas pa ru/ /lhung na skal ba med par 'gyur| /bsrung ba'i don du srad bu la/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bzla/ /de nas mdud pa gsum bya ste⑦/ /slob ma'i dpung pa g.yas par bcing / /de nas phyir mi ldog bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams la spro ba bskyed/ /theg pa gzhan las ldog bya'i phyir/ /theg pa chen po'i che ba brjod/ /bdag nyid chen po spyod rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun rmis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su gzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir dzad rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /dzad rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med/ /zab mo rtog ge thams cad kyi/ /rab tu mi rtog ①gnas med pa/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /spros pa rnams kyis rnam par spros/ /lan dang bya ba la sogs bral/ /bden pa gnyis la gnas pa yi/ /5—379

theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di ni/ /tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ /bu kye nang par dkyil 'khor ni/ /'ji bar 'gyur ro nyol cig ces/ /smras nas rab zhugs yang dag mchod/ /dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /'dod pa'i lha yis sbyor byin la/ /de nas gzhal yas khang nang na/ /slob ma bcug la yang dag bsrung / /seng ge'i nyal stangs rab tu brtag /ku sha'i myu gu rtse ma nyams/ /dhi las byung ba bsam par bya/ /dang po gcig ni sngas su gzhag /gzhan dag stan du gding bar bya/ /yid dge nyol la ji lta bar/ /mi lam mthong ba ston cig ces/ /de ltar brjod la slob ma bsnyal/ /mi lam ci mthong dri bar bya/ /thos nas bzang ngam mi bzang ba/ /the tshom med par bshad par bya/ /dge bas dngos grub rnam gsum 'grub/ /mi dge sbyin sreg sogs zhi bya/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /gza' dang skar ma bzang sogs la/ /nyi ma bzhi pa'i zhag la yang / /bla mas sbyin sreg byas nas ni/ /slob mar bcas pas dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /zla ba drug dang gza' bzhi dang / /rgyu skar bcu bzhi gang yin dang / /tshes grangs bdun gyi grangs nyid la/ /rgyal bas rab gnas la sogs bsngags/ /dpyid 'bring tha dang dbyar tha'o/ /ston zla dgun gyi 'bring tha ma/ /gza' lhag phur bu pa ba sangs/ /zla ba'i gza' dang 'di dag bzang / /tshes gnyis dang ni tshes gsum dang / /lnga dang bdun dang bcu pa dang / /bcu gsum pa dang zla gang ba/ /zhag bdun po ni bzang po yin/ /rgyal dang me bzhi lha mtshalas dbo/ /snar ma byi bzhin mgo dang lag /sgon snrubs chu stod chu smad dang / /khrums stod khrums smad skar ma rnams/ /skar ma dbo la rab gnas bya/ /des ni shes rab 'phel bar 5—380

'gyur| /sems la gang ci gnas pa yi/ /dngos grub me bzhis 'grub par 'gyur//snrubs dang bye bzhin dag gis ni/ /bka' rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur/ /lag pa skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /snar mas nor rnams 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mgo la zhi bar brjod pa yin/ /chu stod chu smad bu 'phel 'byur/ /khrums stod khrums smad 'phel bar shes/ /rgyal la thams cad du ni rgyal/ /sbyon la bde ba yang dag stsol/ /lha mtshalas mchog ni rab tu ster/ /dus dang gza' bzang la brten nas/ /bya ba 'di ni lhag gnas yin/ /thig skud sar pa gtsang ma ni/ /mjos pa snal ma dgu 'am lnga/ /gcig tu bsgril ba lnga yi grangs/ /gsang sngags zlos shing bsgril bar bya/ /oṃ a byo n+ya ā nu ga ta saza dharmā ཿpa ra a nu pra baji saza dharma ①a t+yan+ta unu pra baṣ+ṭi ②saza dharmāḥ①zhes bya ba'i sngags so/ /'bar ba'i lta bas sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs nas 'od kyi thig skud bkug /lag pa sbyar ba'i dbus gnas par/ /thig skud de — rjes su bsgrub/ /oṃ a k+ṣiṃ.a ā slo swā hā/ thig skud sgrub pa'i sngags so/ /bla mas khu tshur g.yon pa ni/ /lte bar bzhag nas thig skud gzung / /de ma thag tu slob ma yis/ /sngags 'di yis ni gzung bar bya/ /oṃ dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/ /sngags kyis bum pa kun gyi chu//gtsang mas khyim gyi nang du gtor/ /thig skud gdab pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /ye shes thig skud rab tu brkyang / /oṃ saza saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor la sogs par gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra sru tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ ye shes thig skud kyi sngags so/ /mtshan ma med pas dngos mi 'grub/ /thig skud 5—381

chad pas slob dpon 'chi/ /ring thung khyer na nad kyis 'debs/ /phyogs 'khrul ba yis myong bar ①'gyur/ /g.yas kyi phyogs su bskor ba yis ji ltar gsungs pa'i thig gdab pas/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i thig la yang / /ye shes thig skud rab tu gdab/ /nyi nyi sgogs dang ldan pa yis/ /yid kyis sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ i khaṃ rnams kyis/ /rdul tshon lha yi rnam par sbyor//'bar ba'i lta bas bsgrub par bya/ /gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /spos dang na bza' la sogs pa/ /ji ltar 'byor pa dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje gsol zhing dril bu dgrol/ /rdo rje'i glu sogs kyis bskul te/ /dmar po'i gos gyon gtor ma sbyin/ /'di ltar yang ni lhag mos bya②/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rnam grol byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rnam snang mdzad rgyal bdag byas te/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /tshon rtsi dgye ba brtsam par bya/ /slob dpon gyis ni dang por dgye/ /phyi nas kun du slob mas so/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis—/ /blangs nas dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor/ /'khor lo can rigs rjes mthun pa'i/ /rim par sngags kyis ④rdul tshon bri/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ gsang sngags so/ /phyi nas slob ma mkhas pa yis/ /ji ltar bde bar dgyes par bya/ /yon po ma dag chad sbom po/ /phra mo mtshan ngan spang bar bya/ /sbom pos nad rnams 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phra mos nor rnams 'jig par byed/ /yon pos rnam par 'gras par 'gyur/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma 'chi/ /'di sogs skyon las nges grol ba/ /rdul tshon ri mos shes par 'gyur/ /in+d+ra rtswa la'i rang bzhin dang / /de bzhin gzhan yang 5—382

margata 'dra/ /pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin dang / /ser po 'bar bas shes par bya//kha dog dkar po de bzhin gzhan/ /de ltar rdul tshon rim shes bya/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lho ru ser po 'bar ba yin/ /nub tu rab tu dmar ba ste—/ /byang du ljang gu de bzhin no/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha ru ni/ /kha dog sngon po rab tu brtag /slob dpon 'khor lo'i shar gnas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin ldan/ /hūṃ mdzad la sogs sbyor ba'i bdag /slob dpon bzhi ni sgo bzhir yin/ /zur bzhir gzhag par bya ba ni/ /chos sgogs byed pa bzhi yin no/ /dam tshig nyams pas 'jigs pa'i phyir/ /slob ma min pa gzhug mi bya/ /med na gnyis sam gsum gzung bya/ /mtha' mar yang ni gcig 'dod bya/ /g.yas pa rdo rje gsor bya zhing / /g.yon pas dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /phyag rgya sgyur ①ba'i tsham ngam gtong ②/ /lta stangs phyag rgyas dgra las rgyal/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i stang ①stabs kyis/ /shar gyi gnas ni mnan par bya/ /rim pa 'di nyid kyis ni gzhan/ /sgo gnas dag gis kyang ni mnan/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon dag gis/ /rol dang bcas pas mtha' ru spro/ /cung zad bgrad pa'i sdang mig dang / /bcas pas smin ma rnam par bskyod/ /'gro ba dbang du byed pa'i rgyu/ /mig gi phyag rgyar shes par bya/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang dang / /g.yas brkyang bskum dang g.yon brkyang bskum/ /hūṃ zhes sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /gtso bo'i slob dpon gzhan rjogyi'o/ /pus stabs tsog pu'i rkang stabs dang / /bskor ba'i stabs dang bzlog pa'i stabs/ /oṃ hūṃ phaṭa| shar sgo'i 'o/ /pus reg stabs dang g.yon 'degs stabs/ /5—383

bskor stabs seng ge'i mchong stabs so/ /oṃ hūṃ āḥphaṭa/ lho sgo'i 'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang dang / /sa ga rlum po'i rkang stabs so/ /oṃ hūṃ rmā slo rmā phaṭa/ nub sgo'i 'o/ /mthun pa'i stabs dang mi mthun stabs/ /gcig bsdus g.yon brkyang rkang stabs so①/ /oṃ ha na mā ra duṭ+wān/ ghā ta ya rtswa ta ya a a hūṃ byāḥphaṭa/ byang sgo'i slob dpon kyi stong ②stabs dang sngags ①so//'dod pa'i don grub bya ba dang / /bgegs kyi bar chad zhi bya'i phyir/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas lha la sogs/ /g.yas brkyang bkug la gtor ma sbyin/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs dang ni pad+ma dz+rel/ /ro tsa na dang dkar po brkyang / /dkar po bkug nas 'dren pa ni/ /lha dang lha min grub pa dgug /oṃ ā bā ha ni ma hā bā ha ni pre ta bā ha ni srur+ya tsan+d+ra/ sidha 0mu khi dza ya rā dzī so ma rā dzī/ u ma de be+e gaṅga ⑤ma/ su rū spru tā ra ya/ saṃ snya gra hā na sarbe/ ga ṇa pa ti/ kā ri ti ka ya shrī sa si de bi/ a ga lo pa ga la/ a su rā su rā dza yo/ /puk+ka sī ma hā puk+ka sī/ hūṃ ho ho ā kar+ṣa ya phywakar+ṣa ya/ sa ma yā dhi pe hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dza swā hā/spyan drang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ ba ta li ba ta li dum hā ba ta li hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ—/ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ⑦dzardzu bye phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'dis spyan drang phyag rgya las/ /mdzub bcings se gol gsum brdabs gtang / /mnyes par byed pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dri yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ /me tog dkar po dgram par bya/ /shā li'i bza' ba rgya chen po/ /bu ram zho dang 'bras chan mar/ /mar me sogs mchod rol stabs kyis/ /shar sgo ba yi gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ e ka bī ke ⑧sma shā ṣ+pe pa/ sarba te kan+da ⑨re kṛ te grwa ma pā 5—384
