thabs dang / shes rab rnam par rol pa sgom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas phyag rgya chen po bsgoms nas rnal 'byor gyi gnyid log par cig car du lhan cig skyes pa nyams su stsong ba yin pas rmi lam dang 'dra ba bstan to/ /de nas rmi lam dang sad pa lta bu zhes bya ba la sogs pa la ①phyi rol gyi rig ma ni las dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya ma gnyis so/ /phyag rgya gnyis kyi sbyor ba las byung ba'i phyir sad pa lta bu yin no/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos nyid la mngon du byas pas rang gi lus dang shes rab ma'i lus yod na yang mi dmigs pa'i phyir rmi lam lta bu'o—/ /g.yeng ba'i rgyu yod na yang zhes bya ba la g.yeng ba'i rgyu ni phyag rgya gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rmi lam dang sad pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la g.yeng ba'i rgyu yod na yang brtan pa la mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyir sems 'ong bar mi 'gyur te/ 'on kyang de'i dam tshig ni phyag rgya'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba yin no/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa nyid ni de'i sdom pa'o/ /de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa'i sbyor ba yod pas tha ma thams cad las mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje las kyang / dang po sprin bzhin snang ba ste/ /'grub na sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur/ /cig car du ni rmi lam 'dra/ /rmi lam sad pa tha mi dad/ /tha mi dad pa'i mtshan nyid 'grub/ /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor rab tu 'grub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /shin tu zab pa'i dgyes pa'i rdo rje las zhes bya ba la sogs pa la 'dis ni slob dpon gyi rang bzo yongs su spangs pas bdag gis rab tu byed pa 'di byas pa yin te zhes bya ba dang / bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba bstan pa ste/ de yang go sla'o/ /lhan skyes rnal 'byor dam pa la/ /'grel pa byas nas dge ba gang / /bdag gis 5—545

bsags pa de yis ni/ /'jig rten lhan skyes rtse gcig gyur/ /gang zhig brjod bya rjod byed blo yis spyod yul min/ /gti mug tshogs kyi mtshan mo sel byed nyi ma gang / /rang bdag snang bas phyogs kyi dbye ba yongs bkang ba/ /lhan skyes nam mkha' zla ba rdzogs 'dra de la 'dud/ /mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i 'grel pa snying po rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ o rgyan kyi slob dpon chen po bram ze tha ga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po man+t+ra ka la ku sha'i zhal snga nas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/534 ①mtshan byang 'di 'chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa'i 'grel pa snying po rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ sne〈〈pe 〉stan ṣe ka〈〈snar 〉ra ri ka ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ma/535 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉pas 'dzag pa'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra/na/536 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra/537 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spyong / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉zo'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sdegs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7sku'i/538 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉spa'o/ / ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ṅkapa'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkalhan cig skyes pa'i bdag nyid kyi chos kyi sku las byung ba'i/ ④〈〈pe〉sko' ra 〉7lo/539 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra ba/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ngosa'i/54༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉sko)/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉skorababs/541 ①〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉5)/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sdeg542 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+kung 'dra ba/543 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7la/544 ①〈(pe 〉sko'ar 〉lke/ /5byed546
545 ①〈〈pe〉sko'ar 〉〉la/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (69)5wa 547

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das dargyas pa'i rdo rje'i grub pa'i thabs de go na nyid bzhi'i rim pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān he badz+ra tatwa tsa turbam sā dha rna nā ma/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs de kho na nyid bzhi'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med te ru ka /bdag med lha mo bcas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid thob cing dad dang skal yod par/ /de nyid bzhi yi rim pa bri bar bya/ /snying rje chen bos 'gro la dang por blta/ /gso sbyong dag nas rgyud rnams rim pas sbyangs/ /rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor zhugs shing dbang dag blangs/ /de nyid shes shing bkas gnang gnas bzhi bsgom/ /dur khrod la sogs dbe+en dang nyams dga' bar/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la legs gnas pa/ /bdag dang rnal 'byor gnas gsum bsrung ba ni/ /dang po'i bdud rtsi lnga sogs khrus byas la/ /tshad med bzhi bsgom lha dang bdag nyid blta//5—548

srung ba rak+ṣa brjod nas dra gur bya/ /legs gnas rten la bdud rtsi sgon ma lnga/ /me tog la sogs mchod dang gtor ma btang / /zhing skyes sogs dang legs spyad rig ma dang / /grogs bzang rten dang gcig pu dogs med sgrub/ /bdag nyid snying ga'i sa bon hūṃ nag las/ /'od zer lnga spros bskul sbyangs nam mkha' rten/ /bla ma dgyes rdor 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /'og bzhin legs bsgoms phyag 'tshal la sogs bya/ /rang nyid hūṃ gi spro bsdu phyi dang nang / /gsang ba'i lha mo rnams kyis rim par mchod/ /go rī dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /tso rī dmar mo rang byung me tog thogs/ /be+e tā lī ni ser mo chu phyag ma/ /ghasma rī ljang gsang ba'i sman yang 'dzin/ /puk+ka sī sngo phyag na sha sna tshogs—/ /sha ba rī dkar sna tshogs ro yi phyag /tsaṇ+ḍa lī dmar sgra dang rin chen tshogs/ /nang gi sku gsum bde ba chen pos mchod/ /ḍo bi phyag rgya rang gi sku la 'khyud/ /de kho na nyid mchod pa gnyis su med/ /sdig bshags yi rang bsngo dang lus dbul dang / /lam bstan pa dang gsol ba gdab pa dang / /tshad med bzhi bsgom lha gshegs de rjes la/ /chos rnams sgyu ma rang sems rdul dang bral/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba la ko3haṃ zhes brjod la sngags kyi don de dran pa las bdag gi de kho na nyid gnas par bya'o/ /chos nyid de las ram̐ dang hūṃ/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dra gur dang / /de las ①e las chos 'byung bsgom/ /de nas yo ram̐ oṃ lo dag /sngo dmar dkar ser sa bon dag /gyur nas 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /rang sems kyis bsgyur gzhal yas khang / /thar pa'i grong mchog rnam par snang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi lha mos mchod//dra ba dra phyed twa ra na/ /ka ba brgyad dang rta babs bzhi/ /rgyan dang chos kyi 5—549

'khor lo gdugs/ /sangs rgyas zhing rgyas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /①dur khrod brgyad na shing brgyad sogs/ /ha ra tsu ta a sho ka /a shwan+d+ra dang ka ran dza④//dza li ta ①dang par ti par/ /be+e te bha tra phyogs dang mtshalas/ /zhing skyong phyogs skyong lha dang klu/ /zhing skyong brgyad kyi zhal dang mdog /phyogs skyong brgyad dang mdog de bzhin/ /gri gug thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /gtor len zhing dag legs par skyong / /brgya byin dkar po glang po'i bdag /rdo rje dril bu g.yas dang g.yon/ /gshin rje mthing nag ma te zhon/ /dbyug pa thod pa de bzhin no/ /chu lha dkar po chu srin mnan/ /sbrul zhags g.yas dang pad+ma g.yon/ /gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon/ /dpal 'bras ṣ+pe'u le g.yas dang g.yon/ /'byung po'i bdag po dkar po ni/ /khyu mchog dkar po mdung thod 'dzin/ /me lha dmar po ra la zhon/ /spyi blugs dbyu gu rtse gsum bsnams//srin po kham nag mi ro'i khri/ /gri dang thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /rlung lha dud kha sha ba zhon/ /g.yas na ba dan zhags pa g.yon/ /thams cad rin chen rgyan ldan te/ /srin po rus pas brgyan pa po/ /chung ma bu 'khor phyogs mdog bcas/ /mdog rnams zhi byed chos legs skyong / /steng gi mkha' la lha chen brgyad/ /shar du brgya byin sngon dang 'dra/ /lho ru tshangs pa rjogaser gyi mdog /spyi blugs dbyu gu rtse gsum 'dzin/ /nub tu khyab 'jug dmar po ste//'khor lo g.yas dang g.yon dud dang / /byang du lha chen thal ba'i mdog /rtse gsum thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /dbang ldan gzhon nu drug gi bu/ /dkar po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ /shar lho tshogs bdag dkar po ni/ /g.yas g.yon la phug la du 'dzin/ /bden bral 1 gi ri ti smug / g.yas na mdung 5—550

dang ba dan ①g.yon/ /rlung du legs ldan nag po ni/ / ral gri g.yas na phub ni ②g.yon/ /thams cad lha rgyan dag dang ldan/ /'dod pa'i lha rnams kyis bskor nyi zla gza'/ /'og nas klu brgyad phyogs dang mtshams 'jog po dung skyong rigs ldan dang / /mtha' yas pad chen dga' bo dang / /nor rgyas bu dang pad+ma rnams/ /phyogs skyong mdog dang sbrul zhags g.yas/ /gdengs ka dang ldan pad+ma g.yon/ /sprin brgyad chu brgyad mchod rten brgyad/ /bya dang gcan gzan ro yi tshogs/ /grub dhipa'i mchog thob rnal 'byor bzhugs//gzhal yas nang du pad+ma brgyad/ /rdo rje phreng ba nag pos bskor/ /dkar ser rā ga dmar dang gnag /phyogs dang rtsig pa'i rim par gnas/ /dbus su bdud bzhi nyi mas mnan/ /'dab ma lha brgyad zla bas mnan/ /nyi steng hūṃ dang i nag bsgom/ /de 'og ā li nyis 'gyur las/ /me long zla ba shes rab gzugs—/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis 'byung po la/ /steng du kā li nyis 'gyur las/ /ḍa rte da dha la ya gnyis/ /mnyam nyid nyi ma thabs kyi gzugs/ /dpe byad brgyad cu 'grub par byed/ /thod dkar gri sngon nyi zla dang / /sa bon mtshon dupa so sor rtog /bskul sbyang gcig gyur dhinan tan yin/ /gcig gyur sku ni chos kyi dbyings/ /sku ni mthing nag chen po nyid/ /zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil/ /steng zhal dud mdog mche ba gcigs/ /rus pa'i 'khor lo spyan gsum dmar/ /'og ma g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /dbus zhal gzhan rnams sku yi mdog /spyan dmar gsum gsum mche ba gcigs/ /sna tshogs rdo rje thod pa'i thod/ /rna cha mgul rgyan dpung pa'i rgyan/ /phyag gdub zhabs gdub rus pas brgyan/ /khrag 5—551

'dzag lnga bcu'i phreng ba 'phyang / /stag gi sham thabs thal bas byugs/ /rdo rje dril bu dang po'i phyag /yum la legs par 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas kyi gnyis pas ral gri 'dzin/ /de nas mda' dang 'khor lo gshor①/ /dbyug pa rtse gsum lcags kyu rim/ /g.yon ni rim bzhin pad+ma gzhu/ /kha ṭī thod pa rin po che/ /sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /yum ni sku mdog yab dang mnyam—/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ /rdo rje dril bu yab la 'bud//gnyis ni mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /thod skam lnga bcu'i ②phreng bas brgyan//rgyan rnams rus pa yab dang mnyam/ /gtso bo zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang nas/ /brgya byin tshangs pa nye dbang drag /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mnan pa'i/ /steng nas 'jigs dang sgeg pa gshe/ /bzhad drag snying rje rngam dang zhi/ /gar dgus rnam par gyur par bsgom/ /pad+ma rdo rje byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ pad+ma su khā dha ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ dadha tsa tur ā ①nan da wa gi wa sha /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ katram̐ ku ru ṣ+ṭa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwo ṣa tsa tur ā nan da dā ya ka kha ga mu khe ka ra so nā tha/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kadro ku ru ṣ+ṭa me/ de ni sbyor ba dang po yin/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa de ma thag /lha rnams zhal gzhug snying gar gnas/ /a nu rā ga brjod nas 'byung / /gi rtsa baṃ r+ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ lo ḍo/ brgyad po phyogs dang mtshams rnams su/ /lha yi gdan steng su du'aphros pas/ /mngon byang lnga las lha mo bskyed/ /go dang gri gug las byung ba'i/ /go rī dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' gzhu gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ /shar gyi 'dab mar tshangs pa mnan/ /rtsa dang ḍa ma rus bskyed pa'i/ /tso rī dmar mo phyag bzhi ma/ /'khor lo lcags kyu ḍa ma ru/ /lho yi 'dab mar brgya byin mnan/ / dang rus sbal las grub pa'i/ /beṭ+wā 5—552

dze+e kar phyag bzhi ni/ /chang chu ral gri thod pa bsnams/ /nub kyi pad+mar nye dbang mnan/ /r+ghaṃ dang sbrul las yang dag babyed/ /ghasma rī ljang phyag bzhi ste//me thab dgra sta thod khrag bkang / /mi 'jigs phyag dang drag po'i steng / /byang gi 'dab mar bsgom par bya/ /paṃ dang seng ge dag las byung / /puk+ka sī ser phyag bzhi ma/ /dpag bsam lcug ma thod shas bkang / /rin po che dang mchog sbyin phyag /gshin rje mnan pa byang shar bsgom/ /shaṃ dang dge slong las skyes pa'i/ /sha ba rī dkar phyag bzhi ma/ /kha ṭī thod pa rdo rje zhags/ /gnod sbyin mnan pa shar lhor bsgom/ /lo dang 'khor lo bskyed pa yi/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lbo sngon phyag bzhi ni/ /rlung ras ba dan thod pa dkar/ /srin po mnan pa lho nub bsgom/ /ḍi dang rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /ḍo bi rī sngo phyag bzhi na①/ /thod pa gshol dang ba dan dang / /mdung rtse gsum pa lha ma yin/ /mnan pa nub byang pad+mar bsgom/ /sgo bzhir ⑤dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri sngo zhing mngon byang las/ /rta gdong phag gdong khyi seng gdong / /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ro yi gdan/ /g.yas ser g.yon dmar dang po sngo—/ /steng zhal rta gdong ljang khur gnas/ /phyag gnyis gling bu gzhan gnyis ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas sngon g.yon dmar dang po ser—/ /steng zhal phag gdong dmar por gnas/ /phyag gnyis pi wang gzhan gnyis ni/ /rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dkar dbus ma dmar/ /steng zhal khyi gdong ser por gnas/ /phyag gnyis rnga chen gzhan gnyis ni/ /pad+ma dang ni lcags sgog 'dzin/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dkar dbus ma ljang / /steng zhal seng gdong dkar por gnas/ /phyag gnyis rdza rnga de 5—553

bzhin gnyis/ /ral gri gsang ba 'dzin par mdzad/ /shar sgo la sogs rim par ni/ /pad+ma nyi ro'i steng du bsgom/ /thams cad spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum—/ /dbu skra dmar ser byen du 'bar/ /gcer bu rked la stag lpags dkris—/ /rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan/ /mgo bo skom po'i phreng ba 'phyang / /g.yon brkyang sgog dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / phyogs mabyedas rang rang gdan la bzhugs/ /yi ge la zhugs gtso bo zhu/ /nyi ma'i steng na hūṃ dang zhi /bde ba'i thig le dbyibs su gnas/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha mo rnams/ /rang rang gtso bo ma mthong nas/ /yid che cher gdungs rdo rje glus/ /bzhengs par bzhed nas gtso bo bskul/ /rje btsun thugs rje'i thugs kyis bzhengs/ /bdag ①la bde ba chen por sbyor/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin spangs nas su/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /byed mi bzhugs na bdag 'gum pas/ /thugs rje rgyun chad ma mdzad bzhengs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin ci ste bzhugs/ /sha ba rī 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /gtum mo bdag ni gsol 'debs ni①/ /bcom ldan rdo rje rdo rje bzhengs/ /bdag gis byed kyi thugs 'byed kyis①/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba byed bzhengs shig /ḍo bi bdag ni dran nyams par/ /snying rje chen po chad mdzad bzhengs/ /rmi lam lta bu sgra gsan nas/ /bcom ldan sngar bzhin dgyes rdor bzhengs/ /sku mdog la sogs sngar bzhin bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor rnams la legs par blta/ /lha rnams thugs kar pad nyi zla/ /rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon bsgom/ /de ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ /5—554

shar gyi dur khrod nam mkhar bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba legs mchod la/ /go rī la sogs lha mo bzhis/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing / /dgyes pa bskyed nas gnyis med bsgom/ /mig la sogs pa'i dbang po drug /mngon shes bskyed phyir sbyang bar bya/ /mo r+ghaṃ rna ro i rna dag /dkar nag ser dmar ljang gu nag /pad zla sa bon gri gug las/ /gti mug zhe sdang ser sna rnams/ /'dod chags phrag dog bdag med ma/ /rdo rje'i ming can lha mo drug /bskul sbyangs byas nas lha mor bsgom/ /phyag rgya lnga dang gri gug thod//thams cad g.yon brkyang bsgom par bya/ /mtshog ①ma snying ga mgrin pa ru/ /oṃ dkar wabyudamar hūṃ nag las/ /kha dog gsum gyi gri gug las/ /bskul sbyangs sgu gsum byen brlabs las/ /sa spyod mkha' spyod bdag med ma/ /dkar dmar nag po gri gug 'dzin/ /phyag rgya lnga ldan ro yi gdan/ /g.yon brkyang sgeg dang bcas pa bsgom/ /yang ni rang snying sa bon las/ /'od zer lnga spros bskul sbyangs byas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor rgyal ba rnams/ /khro bo rig pa'i lha mor bcas/ /mchod pa gsum byis legs mchod la/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu rmā/ mi bskyod la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /spyan ma la sogs sku las byung / /bdud rtsi bum pa lha dbang bskur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas rgyas gdab pa/ /bdag dang go rī puk+ka sbo/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod legs par bzhugs/ /sha ba rī dang tso rī la/ /rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin bzhugs/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang beṭ+wā lī/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bsgom par bya| /ḍo bi dang ni ghasma rī/ /dbu la snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs/ /de 5byed555

nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ /shar lho dur khrod nam mkha' la/ /sgo ma bzhi yi dbu stengs su/ /rnam par snang mdzad rim bzhin bsgom/ /yo ram̐ i gsum hūṃ nag oṃ/ /mas yar rim pas bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ brjod rang snying hūṃ 'od kyis//hūṃ bskul ma drung dkyil 'khor dang / /mgo bo gsum dang pad+ma brgyad/ /sa bon bcas pa'i thod pa bsgom/ /de bzhin hūṃ 'od yab bskul bas/ /a yi 'od kyis sa bon rnams/ /gyur nas bdud rtsir gyur pas ①ni/ /hūṃ las rnam sprul : las dri/ /dṛ las dkar po i las dmar/ /khaṃ las chur 'gyur phyogs kyi ri—/ /dz+wa las mi sha haṃ las rta/ /dz+wa las glang po ṣe las ni/ /ce srung shaṃ las ba glang sha /hūṃ gi me sbar bdud rtsi bskol/ /a yi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lhung / /hūṃ nyid rdo rjer gyur nas ni/ /lan lngar 'phar zhing dkrugs byas nas//rdo rje hūṃ dang oṃ 'od des/ /ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs 'dres/ /lha rnams ljags la hūṃ nyid las/ /rdo rje sbu gus bdud rtsi myang / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3haṃ/ de nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha la rim bzhin mchod/ /mchod pa'i go rims la sogs pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ rig pa'i lha mo thams cad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha la bstod pa mdzad/ /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor bcom ldan bskor/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo khyod kyis ①thugs/ /sems can kun kyi don mdzad rnams/ /bcom ldan mchog tu dgyes rdo rje/ /zhal gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa grub/ /thugs dgyes mdzod cig dgyes rdo rje/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa dh+wa ba āt+pa ko3haṃ/ brtan par gyur nas 'khor lo bskor/ /lha rnams phyogs phyogs spro bya ste/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug 'gro ba 5—556

rnams—/ /dkyil 'khor lha ru gsal bar bsgom/ /brtan par gyur nas tshur bsdus la/ /rang nyid dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom/ /las kyi rgyal po'i 'khor lo mchog /de ni lha yi de nyid yin/ /bla ma la brnyas dad med sngags la zon//glegs bam mthong bas khengs shing dbang bskur dman/ /de la sgra yi tshig kyang brjod mi bya/ /dad ldan de nyid bzhi thob gus par sgrub la brtson/ /bla ma'i lung thob drin dran bla ma la gus de dag ni/ /de ni ri dbang rtse las lhung gyur pa//lhung bar mi bya snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur/ /sdig bral ye shes rim pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lha'i de kho na nyid kyi rim pa ste dang po'o // //①da ni ye shes kyi de kho na nyid bshad de/ thams cad rang gi sems yin pas①—/ /lha rnams rang la bsdus pa ni/ /ji ltar me long dkyil 'khor la/ /has btab rim pas 'du ba bzhin/ /rta gdong la sogs sgo ma bzhi/ /yan lag bzhi la bsdu bar bya/ /lha mo brgyad ni zhal la bsdu/ /zhal dang phyag rnams rim bzhin te/ /bdag yul zhal re phyag gnyis pa/ /gzhan nas brten pa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ /bsgoms nas 'og nas 'byung ba yi/ /rtags brgyad 'byung ba bsgom pa'am/ /mi dgag rgyud don man ngag yin/ /'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag gis/ /lha yi lung thob dang 'dra bar/ /bar dor phyag rgya chen po 'thob/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma mtshan nyid dang / /sems dang ye shes 'dres gyur pa'i/ /mngon par byang chub rim pa dag /ye shes dbang la nyan par 'tshal/ /byang chub rim pa'i rdo rje can/ /gnas bzhi la ni yang dag brten—/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dag tu/ /bde ba'i stan la gnas nas ni//5—557

'dod chags la sogs rim spangs te/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun la/ /snying rje phan par bsams nas su/ /mnyam pa'i sems ni bskyed par bya/ /'og dang 'og min sgra yi mtha'/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i pad+ma ste/ /cha dang mdog ni sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin du ni gzhan ①dag ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rol pa'o/ /bsdus te gong bu'i sbyor ba yis—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid 'gyur/ /chu dang me yi khams dag ni/ /ro gcig 'gyur bas go 'phang mchog /shes rab thabs dang sbyor ba las /dbang po drug po sangs rgyas nyid/ /yang dag bstan bcos de nyid shes/ /slob dpon lung gis rjes 'gro zhing / /gsang chen de nyid don bsgom pa/ /gcig nas brgyud de de nyid can/ /stong pa de nyid la sogs mtshan/ /thams cad sngon bzhin mtshan byas nas/ /dri ma bkrus pa'i lus kyis ni/ /mngon par byang chub rim pas grol/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zer 'phros pas/ /kun da zla ltar dkar ba'i mdog /zhabs ②gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung ①bcas—/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /phyag gnyis phyag rgya che bcings nas/ /nyid kyi thugs kar bsdams par mdzad/ /gzugs mjos shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /ye shes pad+ma'i gdan du bsam/ /snying ni chu shing me tog 'dra/ /lte ba nas ni 'phyangs te gnas—/ /sngon bzhin pad+ma rgyas par brgyan/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis brgyan pa yi—/ /ge sar dang ni zla ba bcas/ /sa bon yi ge dgod par bya/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar po'i mdog /dri 5—558

chen dbus su bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su rnam shes dang / /ye shes gnyis su med par bsgom/ /sngon du byams pa ldan pa yi/ /shar gyi 'dab mar mi bskyod pa/ /snying rje chen po lho sgo ru/ /rin chen de nyid sa bon no/ /dga' ba nub sgo'i 'dab ma la/ /'od dpag med kyi sa bon dgod/ /btang snyoms byang gi 'dab ma la/ /don yod gtso bo bsam par bya/ / stong pa mtshan nyid med pa las/ /①dbyangs yig shar sogs sa bon ni/ /zla phyed thig ler ldan pa dag /gos dkar ldan pa'i rim bzhin dgod/ /mtshalas kyi 'dab ma bzhi po ru/ /sngon du bstan pa'i ma ning dgod/ /de yi ①dbus su rang gi sems/ /yi ge nyid du bsgom par bya/ /stong pa mtshan nyid med pa las / /ji ltar yi ge bsgom par bya/ /sems ni ya mtshan skye bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan bshad pa ji ltar lags/ /de nas bcom ldan bka' stsal pa/ /ji bzhin de nyid rdo rje nyon/ /stong pa'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa las/ /chu shing me tog bdud rtsi bzhin/ /snying po med pa'i snying por 'gyur/ /dbus kyi rnam shes ye shes te/ /ye shes rang bzhin gzugs med cing / /mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /dri ma med pa'i ye shes sku/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /kha dog gzugs dang yi ge med/ /gzugs dang stong pa'i dbus dag tu/ /rnal 'byor can gyis de nyid gzung / /mnyam pa nyid kyi sems kyis ni/ /mtshan nyid ji bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de yi rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam/ /bla ma nyid kyi lung bzhin du/ /da ni myur du mthong bar 'gyur/ /rnam shes ye shes gzugs dag ni/ /bstan bcos las ni mtshan nyid bstan/ /de nyid kho na dpa' bos bshad/ /'od zer dkar pos brgyan pa dag /'di 5—559

ni rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /sgeg pa lnga yi mchod rten la/ /bdud rtsi sa bon bsams nas ni/ /'od zer dkar po gsal ba'i mdangs/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni 'dzag pa las/ /snying ga'i pad+ma'i ge sar la/ /mthe bong tsam gyi rlum po la/ /de yi dbus su sa bon ni/ /ā li kā li dag las btung / /mdog dkar de ni shin tu mjos/ /zla ba'i 'od zer kun du 'phro/ /de yi dbus kyi sgo rnams la/ /thig le bsgom pa rab tu grags/ /skra yi rtse mo brgya yi cha/ /rdul phran gzugs su rtag tu gnas/ /rnam par shes pa'i dngos po yi/ /mtshan nyid mtshon pa'i ye shes can/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid mi shes pas/ /thig le gnas kyi go 'phang blta/ /snying dang tshangs pa'i sgo dang ni/ /thigs pa lam kyi sgo dag tu/ /bla ma'i lung la gus pa yis/ /rnam shes ye shes gzung bar bya/ /phyi rol pa yi lam dag dang / /bstan bcos las ni mi rnyed cing / /bstan pa yang ni rnyed slar te/ /de sbyor bas ni rnyed par dka'/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur gus pa yis①/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi ②lam gyis ni/ /mkhas pas 'di ni bsgom par bya/ /mi g.yo 'tshe ba med pa ru//mnyam par gzhag ①ste dngos po bsgom/ /chos kyi sngon 'gro yid yin te/ /yid kyis 'jug cing yid kyis dhi'adag /yid kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin byis/ /smra ba dag ni byed pa 'byung / /de bas thams cad yid rang bzhin/ /blo ldan yid las byung zhes bya/ /gal te bzla 'dod rnal 'byor pa/ /snying gi bsam dang bsgom pa ste/ /sdom dang rgyud 'gyur sa bon ni/ /de nyid kho na gzugs med do/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sa bon ni/ /ye shes de nyid mthong ba med/ /gzugs sogs srid pa'i 'dod spyod la/ /sa bon lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /kun 5—560

nas kun du 'jug pa dang / /'gro dang 'gro min yang dag gnas/ /rtag tu rtsa ba gzer bar bya/ /ye shes rnam shes sa bon ni/ /thig le'i sgra dang yang dag ldan/ /srid pa'i longs spyod 'dod pa yis/ /ngag gi yi ge spangs nas ni//yid kyis bzlas dang yang dag ldan/ /rtag pa chos kyi dbyengs nyid kyi/ /mi g.yo go 'phang rgyun du gnas/ /rtag tu 'phang zhing gos med pas/ /ye shes la ①ni rnam shes thim/ /rnam shes ye shes nyid 'gyur na/ /byang chub rim pa mthong 'gyur zhes/ /mar me lta bu thams cad la/ /snang 'gyur mtshan ma dang po ste/ /srin bu me khyer lta bu dang / /rdul mthong mtshan ma gnyis pa yin/ /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i mtshan nyid gdags/ /rdul phran dkar po'i rnam par ni—/ /phyogs su de bzhin mthong 'gyur ba/ /rtags ni gsum pa yin par shes / /'dod pa lha yi longs spyod rnams/ /sems kyis mthong ba bzhi pa ste//gzugs kyi lha mthong lnga pa yin/ /gzugs med spyod yul drug pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa bdun/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu brgyad pa ste/ /rnal 'byor pas ni ma yengs bsgom/ /snying rje ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rtse gcig bsgoms na ④mchog thob 'gyur/ /ye shes bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gang du 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ /bla ma'i brgyud pa ④yod la blang / /'chi ba rnam rtog mkha' spyod 'gro/ /gang zhig dad med brtson med blun po shes rab med—/ /bla ma'i skyon blta nyes brjod g.yo sgyus bla ma bslus/ /tshogs su mi blta sgog tu brnyas byed 'dzum dutshig smra/ /bu dang rgyal po dge slong rigs bzang yin yang spang / /skyon rnams spangs pa'i gzugs spyod dum yin la/ /bla ma la gus snying rje gzhan phan shes rab thabs dang ldan/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir mi 5—561

yengs bsgom la brtson zhing rim par ston/ /de lta bu la sngags kyi de nyid legs par bstan par bya/ /ye shes kyi de nyid kyi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas sngags kyi mtshan nyid bshad/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams rtag tu bzla//sngags dang yi ge tha mi dad/ /gnyis med rtag tu bzla ba ni/ /gal te bzla 'dod rnal 'byor pas/ /snying gis bsam dang bsgom pa ste/ /rdo rje rgyu gyur sa bon ni/ /de kho na ni ①gzugs med do/ /rang gi snying gar sa bon la/ /bsam gtan sngags kyis bskor la bzla/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/snying po'o/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa snen nā ya/ dzi ga usnyo ke sha bat+pa ①ṣ+pe/ tsa tubo sha ti de dutā ya/ sngo ḍa sdesha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṭa jo mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā khā ṣ+pe kā dzñā ༷ri ṇi/ āsgrota ku ra ci ya/ arten+d+ra rda: ⑦ṇi/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gadz+dza ya gadz+dza ya/ tadz+dza ya tadz+dza ⑧ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/sap+ta sā ga rā na/ brnya brnya/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kān/ kṛsna kṛsna⑨/ sarba duspyo sha hūṃ—/ ha hā hi tī hu snu he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ghu dzu ṅga ta pa ra ma lo ke shwa ⑩re ka pā la/ mā la ⑪dha ri ṇi ru ⑫dhi ra thra ye na pa si hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ go rī'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi shā ⑫ri kha ṭī gi ma hā badz+ra ka pā la mā la ku ho/ ā kardzu/ sarba dujo ④j-i da ya/ ā kazu ⑫bhu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tso rī'o⑩/ /oṃ badz+ra beṭ+wā lbo kha kha ⑩khā tī sarba duṣ+ṭi be+e ka ṭa/ be she ⑫ta ri ni bi kṛ ta ā lo kā ra zla ⑪ṣi ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ pi ⑥lo ba sa ma nu smra ⑪ra/ pra sha ya maspyo ⑫la ma te/ u ta pa ya sarba hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ be+eṭ+wā lī'o⑫/ /oṃ badz+ra ma he shwa ri haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ ru lu bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ pa khra yo 5—562

sarba duṣ+ṭa rmā ①nirma tha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ghasma rī'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ha bha ba ti badz+ra gu dza sha ra ba hūṃ/ pi tsi ta bi shi ta ri na/ sarba ta thā ga tā dzus sa ma ya ma nu smra ②ra ha na ha na/ ram̐ ga ram̐ ga ya/ sgru ra sgru sner ya/ ā be sha sarba byu ④tai ta/ na dha na dha sa ta ya/ ha ha ha ha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ puk+ka sī'i 'o//oṃ pi ⑤shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba ma ri ram̐ pra sha ma ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ mo ha pu ta ri hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ri khrod sī'i du'o/ /oṃ badz+ra su lo ni nyin+da sarba duspya z-i ⑦da ya/k+ṣiṃkar+ṣa ya/ k+ṣiṃskekar+ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ nirma tha ra ya bi lo ba/sa ma ya ma nu smra ⑨ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī'o⑩/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ra ma ghu dze+e ka sa la bi khyu ⑪ṣi ta sarba duspya mo ha ni thra ⑫ye/ dz+re hi ga pa ti badz+ra zla dze ⑫sa ri bha hūṃ—/ baṃ baṃ ba sa pa ri ni sarba du:④/ tso ni ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍo bi nī⑫/ oṃ badz+ra ba ḍa ⑩ba mu khaṃ yo gi shwa ri nyi nyi nyi hi dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rta gdong ma'i 'o /dzi ta ba ra/ oṃ badz+ra rda yu pā rā ⑩ha mu khā+e tram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phag gdong ma'i 'o—/ /oṃ badz+ra sā dhu saṃ dze li ⑫ni ma hā yak+ṣa ni k+ṣa ni rū pa ni ma hā pha la ya nir na te—/ kā ma ru ⑪pa ti tai tra da ho hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ khyi gdong mā'i 'o/ /oṃ tsan+d+ra srur+ya hūṃ tā dus ni dzi ha ni rte sau ha ba ga te/ saṃ he ⑪ni tai tai tai baṃ baṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/seng ge gdong la sogs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ saṃ swā hā/ bdag med ma'i 'o/ /oṃ i ⑫swā hā/ go rī⑫/ oṃ slo swā hā/ tso rī'i 'o/ /oṃ ā+o swā hā/ beṭ+wā lī'i 'o/ /oṃ oṃ swā hā/ ghasma rī'i 'o/ /oṃ khru swā hā/ puk+ka sī'i 'o/ / oṃ ṛ swā hā/ sha wa rī'i 'o/ /④oṃ rī oṃ swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i 'o/ /oṃ oṃ ④swā hā/ḍo bi nī'i ⑩'o/ /rtsa ba'i 'o/ /oṃ gya gri ba hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rta gdong ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sru ⑦ra gri ba hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phag gdong ma'i 'o/ /oṃ ku ku ra ⑫gri ba hūṃ 5—563

phaṭa swā hā/ khyi gdong ma'i 'o/ /①oṃ badz+ra sirnya gri ba hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ seng gdong ma la sogs pa'i snying po ring po'o/ /rnal 'byor zlos la brtson pa yis/ /gnas la phyag 'tshal yi ge lnga/ /zhi ba'i thig le dbyibs mdog brlan/ /bde ba mi rtog stong pa nyid/ /mi rtog stong pa gnyis su med/ /bla ma'i man ngag sa la bzla/ /bla ma tha mal par mthong dug sel bdud rtsi spong / /rigs dang bsnyen bkur gyis khengs 'jig rten chos brgyad tshol/ /de 'dra'i slob ma 'ong ba snying rjes dge ba de yang bzung / /dal 'jam brtson zhing ②bka' sgrub thos bsam sgom pa pos/ /rigs gnas 'byor pa dgos kyang de ni gzung sbyang bya/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad sngags dang gdams ngag bstan par 'os/ /sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi rim pa ste gsum pa'o // //sned ni bdag gi de kho na nyid bshad/ /de nyid shes pas mnyam gzhag med//dngos po rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rnam dag de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyi nas re re dbye ba yis/ /lha rnams rnam par dag par bya/ /mi shes sgrib g.yogs rnam sbyangs nas/ /lus can phung po khams skye mched/ /rigs lnga yum lnga rdo rje ma/ /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga dang bcu/ /brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba dag /grangs med sku yi gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /gsung dang thugs kyi gnyis med bsam mi khyab/ /rnal 'byor rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /lus med rdo rje can de nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /khams gsum 'di dag thams cad ni/ /rmi lam sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ /chos brgyad rtog rjopa ring du dor/ /gnyis med mi rtog nges par bya/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa 5—564

yis| /sangs rgyas dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /sems can mi rtog sgyu mas byas| /chos kyi dbyengs la bdag spyod pas/ /grogs po med par gcig pur rgyu/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya//ji ltar bdud rtsi don gnyer ba/ /snying po blangs nas tshigs ①ma 'dor/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi lnga rnyed nas/ /rtog pa thams cad spangs nas su/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bstan pa bzhin/ /rtog med ting 'dzin longs spyod bya/ /rgyud rnams kun nas rgyal bas bstan/ /rtog pas dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur zhing //'gro drug rgya mtsho 'khor bar 'gro/ /rtog pa med na grol bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas su 'gro/ /de bas rnal 'byor bdag nyid ni/ /de ni yang dag don rig pas/ /snying rje 'gro don bsam pa can/ /dmigs pa med par brtan par dpyad/ /dogs med seng ge bzhin du rgyu/ /'on kyang slob dpon smad mi bya/ /rdo rje spun la mi mgu ②min/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams/ /gtan med sgyu mas spang bya zhing / /de nyid bcu shes bskyed rdzogs kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po sna tshogs ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su brgyan/ /la las nyon mongs zhi byed lam bzang lam can lus ngag yid sgrub 'bras bu ni/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za'i grong 'dra ting 'dzin dag la blo gnas pas/ /'dod chags la sogs nad can ye shes sgyu ma'i sman gyis bdag gzhan gso bar bya/ /bdag byin brlab pa man ngag dag /gang gis ①bla ma las ma bsgrubs/ /rtag dang chad pa la dmigs pas/ /mi de phyir log gyur pa yin/ /mchod pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni thob 5—565

par 'gyur/ /bla med thob pa'i slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas pas/ /de yis bsod nams ma byas shing / /bka' thub ma bsnyen gang zhig yod/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pa yis/ /shin tu dga' ba gang dang gang //shin tu khyad par can de nyid/ /de dang de nyid bla mas byin/ /bla ma yis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel/ /slob dpon kyis ni sdug bsngal byi/ /rgya mtsho 'jigs las pha rol sgol/ /gang zhig nga rgyal gyis khengs shing / /yang dag min pa sun 'byen dang / /de nyid chos brnyes ①bcas pa la/ /de la de nyid bstan pa min/ /bla ma la gus bden par smra/ /rnam par mkhas shing rgyud gcig la/ /dam tshig spyod pa bsrung ba dag /rim pa de la bstan par bya/ /bdag gi de kho na nyid kyi rim pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de nyid bzhi bsgom rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sgrib sbyang bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshogs bsags mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i phyir/ /chos skyong mkha' 'gro gtor ma byin//shar gyi dur khrod nam mkha' la/ /chos 'byung sum brtsegs ②bar ma ni/ /lte bar me las sa yi lha/ /gser mdog bum pa 'dzin byed ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyes rnam par brgyan/ /pad zla'i gdan la legs bzhugs ma/ /mkha' yi yi dwags tshogs kyis bskor/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang mtshalas/ /dur khrod bstan pa phyogs skyong 'khor/ /steng gi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /baṃ las tshangs pa gdong bzhi gser gyi mdog /g.yas na mi 'jigs 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /g.yon na spyi blugs rtse gsum 'dzin/ /gzugs khams lha yis bskor nas bzhugs—/ /paṃ las pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /phu las pad+ma dkar po dkar/ /gdengs ka sbrul zhags pad+ma 'dzin/ /phyogs mtshalas klu chen brgyad po ni/ /5—566

kun+d+ra ru paṣ+ṭa i/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta nyin+da bādz+dza ①a i/ zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i grus so/ /yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ phyi nang 'thor 'thung byen la/oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi sdephyo me bha ba—/ su tostso me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su pokhyo me bha ba/ sarba sernyim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsi.ā+oṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/bha ga bān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badzī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ/ rang nyid lhar bsgoms lag gnyis kyis/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya bskor bar bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gsum brjod dril bu dkrol/ /rdor dril thal mo thugs kar sbyar/ /snying rje chen po bskyed nas ni/ /rdo rje glu blang smon lam gdab/ /mchog gsum sdog dang sgrib med cing / /'dod chags la sogs skyon dang bral//gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur mdzes/ /gnyis spros gnyis sbyang gnyis su med/ /lus can don du sgyu mas ①spyad/ /dngos po bral ba dubadag phyag 'tshal/ /sems can thams cad sdig med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cigasangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur cig /lam de nyid nas zhugs nas kyang / /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams grol bar shog /rnal 'byor chos dang dam tshig la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar gzhag /phyag g.yas brkyang ste gshegs gsol ba/ /sarba gha ṭa 2 kṛt+na kṛsna hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ t+pahūṃ muḥ bsam gtan mi spyor nyal mi nus/ /thabs dang shes rab ⑤pha rol phyin/ /ldang tshe lha mo'i glus bskul zhing / /langs nas khrus byed dbang bskur bsam/ /gtor ma maṇ+ḍal mchod sogs 5—568

rnams—/ /bskur ba bcas pas bya ba yin/ /bza' ba phud dbul bdud rtsi myang / /spyod lam rnam bzhir ci spyod pa/ /de nyid bzhi yi rim pas spyad/ /rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ /dgyes rdor rim pa bzhi yi sgrub thabs byas/ /'di las dri med dge ba gang bsags pas/ /'gro kun dgyes pa'i rdo rje 'grub par shog /slob dpon kaspa las mdzad pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid bzhi'i rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta dang lo tsā ba glan dar ma ①blo gros kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/548 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i rdo rje thab pa'i thabs bzhugs/549 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ras/55 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7 yis/ /tshogs kyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉ngadzi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tsho ti/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra ga551 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉ngal gri g.yas na phub ni/ / ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rayas pa bo dbyug pa dag / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈shar 〉〉sgrub/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉glotshan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉tu/ 〈〈snar 〉7gyur/552 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rgar/ sde〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mico lnga'i/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rat+ta tsa turā/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+ku/553 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉rna/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7zhi/554 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉radan/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉5)/555 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thatshog556 ①〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉mi/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉tha/557 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉mu / ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉te/5—569
568 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉state tsa badz+dza/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stadro/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bar/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/569 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉dha /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (70)

༄ga /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i grub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar mdzad cing / /bdag med ma dang gnyis med gzugs/ /bde chen de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de nyid rnyed dka' de bas kyang / /bla ma'i bka' ston shin tu dka'/ /bdag gzhan don 'byung sngags kyi tshul/ /'gro phan lam la brten par gyis/ /yon tan brgyad ldan sngags pa yis/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug ste/ /sems nyid rang gi snying gar bsam/ /'od kyis bdag dang sems can sbyangs②/ /de la chos 'byung yangs la blta/ /mi 'gyur ba nyid yongs gyur las/ /dpal ldan rdo rje he ru ka /zhal gcig phyag gnyis nag po che/ /gar gyi zhabs kyis nyi ma mnan/ /phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa ste/ /rdo rje thod pa g.yas g.yon 5—572

'chang / /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa yi/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud//spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /bde bas gang ba'i rang bzhin du/ /bdag nyid rnam par bsgom par bya/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /'od kyis grub pa'i lha bkug ste/ /mchod pa la sogs byas pa'i mthar/ /bdag dang gnyis su med par bsam/ /de nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab/ /yang na mchod pas mnyes bya ste/ /dbang po gnyis kyis sbyor ba yis/ /dang po sangs rgyas mchod par bya/ /bde chen dam pa de blangs nas/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar ngal bso te/ /bdud rtsi btung bar bya ba nyid/ /de yi lus ni rnam dag 'byung ①/ /lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī 'bar bas/ /bde bar gshegs pa lnga bsregs te//spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te/ /bsregs pa haṃ sdelas ri bong 'dzag /thog ma tha ma dbus med cing / /'khor ba'i mya ngan 'das pa min/ /bdag dang gzhan yang yod min pa/ /'od ①ni mchog tu bde chen po/ /de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dang po nyid du bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod de—/ /gnas dang yul du rgyu ba'o/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig ces brjod la/ mthar yang / ye shes 'od ni shin tu zab—/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar rjoster zhi ba ste/ /nga yi pha ni nga nyid do/ /'dir ni rigs skyes dam tshig ldan/ /rjes su chags par dgyes rdor 'chang / /bla ma la gus snying rje can/ /skye zhing skye bar bdag gyur cig /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos 'di 'don pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu bas mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /de nas gtor ma btang nas su/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ /bde 5—573

bar gshegs pa'i sngags bzlas shing / /lha yi sbyor bas rgyu bar bya/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag tu dam chos bshad par bya/ /sems can thams cad rtag tu bskyang / /he ru ka dpal rtag tu mchod/ /sā tsha sbyin sreg mchod sbyin bya/ /chu sbyin rang gi sbyin pas bya/ /bla ma bde gshegs mdun ①bdar te//maṇ+ḍal byi dor byas nas su/ /mchod cing bstod de gshegs gsol bgyi②/ /gling bzhi nyi ma re re bya/ /de bzhin thun mtshalas gzhan la yang / /bdag la byin gyis brlab par bya/ /skyil krung bcas nas dmigs ④brtan te/ /sna rtser bsams pa mi g.yo bas/ /byel kyang skad cig skabs bshol la/ /khrim pa yis kyang bsgom par bya/ /spyod lam dag la bab na yang / /sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur bsgom/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i yid kyis nyal/ /sems can don la chags pas ldang / /glo bur nyid du dran bya zhing / /glo bur byed du rnal 'byor spyod/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i bya bzhin du/ /sngags pas chags pa med par gnas/ /gzhan du g.yeng bas chags sems rjodang / /gnyid kyi zil gnon ma gyur cigasgrub pa'i thabs 'di rin po che/ /rnal 'byor pa yang skal ba bzang / /bzang po nga yis mdor bsdus pas/ /dge can gang yin rol par shog /dpal te ru ka zhal gcig pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //5—574

bsdur mchan/572 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉sa / /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉gzung /573 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉75gyur/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lham/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thar/574 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bdun/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanag du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsogs/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (71)5—575

0145༄ga /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/dpal kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang / /sgo bzhir gnas pa'i go ②rī sogs/ /mtshams kyi sgul byed ma bzhi la/ /sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal te/ /rnal 'byor blo zhan don du ni/ /bdag gis dgyes pa'i rdo rje yi/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgrub thabs 'di/ /mi nus bzhin du brtsam par bya/ /slob dpon de nyid thos pa dang / /dbang rnams tshul bzhin mnos pa dang / /bsgom dang cho ga mkhas pa dang / /bka' yi gnang ba thob pa yis/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i sems kyis su/ /dur khrod dang ni lha rten dang / /rang gi khyim dang chu 'gram du—/ /'jigs pa'i sems med bsam gtan bya/ /dran thar rnam pa bdun dag gis/ /lus sogs bdun po dag nas ni/ /skad cig ma yi rnal 'byor 5—576

mas—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lus byas te/ /snying gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsgom//de steng nyi nyudakyil hūṃ bsam ④ste/ /'bar ba me yis rab bsregs pas/ /ye shes mig dang ldan bya ste/ /sngon du dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang / /lha mo brgyad dag mngon par mthong / /phyi dang nang dang bla med pa'i/ /mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag mchod/ /sngon 'gro rjes su phyag byas te/ /sdig pa byas pa bshags pa dang / /phyis mi byed par sdom pa gzung / /dge ba byas byed )yi rang bya/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang / /de gsungs pa yi chos rnams dang / /ma brgyad lha mo dge 'dun la/ /bdag ni dang bas skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag gis bskyed/ /theg pa chen po la gnas bgyi/ /kun gyi don ni bdag nyid dbul/ /de yang rgya cher bsngo bar bgyi/ /dang po byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa snying rje bye brag bsgom/ /gsum pa dga' ba bsgom pa ste/ /kun gyi tha mar btang snyoms so/ /dang po stong pa'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon 'dus/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs rdzogs te/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ /de 'og stong pa'i byang chub ni/ /phyi dang nang med stong smon no/ /bsams nas de nyid kho na yi/ /lus su yang dag bsgom par bya / /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra sa bhā ba at+pa ko3haṃ/ sngon gyi smon lam rjes dran na—/ /de kho na nyid las langs nas/ /'og phyogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /de steng nyi ma hūṃ bsams pas/ /hūṃ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ /de steng bgegs skrad hūṃ bsams pa'i/ /rak+ṣa sgra dang ldan pa yis/ /tshogs kyi bgegs rnams sel bar byed/ /be+er 'dus rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ /bla re yang ni bsgom par bya/ /steng 'og phyogs med rdo rje'i dbyings/ /sgo yi dbyibs 5—577

'dra nyid du bsgom/ /e gzugs bdag med ma 'dra bar/ /bsams te de las 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas de dbyibs ni/ /gru gsum gyen dkar yang dag ldan/ /de yi dbus su bsam pa ni/ /oṃ dang ram̐ dang baṃ dang lo/ /de steng bdag nyid rnam shes ni/ /oṃ nyid ni yang dag gnas/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gzhal yas khang du gyur pa ste/ /thog gcig pa ru bsam par bya/ /ngos bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad dang yang dag ldan—/ /rta babs bzhis kyang rnam par mdzes/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa//lha mo brgyad kyi 'od kyis kyang / /gsal bar lha yi rnam pas byas①/ /de nas pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /kha dog dmar po nyi ma gnas/ /de steng bdud bzhi rnam par brgyan/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /shar sgo la sogs bzhir gnas pa/ /tshangs pa dang ni dbang po dang / /nye dbang dang ni drag po ste/ /rim pa bzhin du gnas pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi por ni shes bya ba/ /gshin rje dang ni nor bdag dang / /bden bral dang ni thags bzangs ris/ /puk+ka sī sogs gdan du brtagasne /de ltar pho brang bye brag rdzogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba yi/ /nga rgyal 'di yis bya ba ste/ /nga 'am bdag ①tu bsam par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophohaṃ/ dbus kyi gzhi steng phywali ni/ /bcu drug rim pa gnyis shes bya/ /de 'gyur zla ba gnyis pa ni//me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de steng yang dag bsam pa ④ni/ /kā li bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur las/ /rta bdun pa ru gyur pa ste/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de dbus hūṃ las byung ba ni/ /rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ /lte ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa ste—/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od 'phros sems can don/ /5—578

byas te bzhi po nyid la bstem/ / 'od kyi ①gong bur gyur pa ni/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes so/ /de las thig le brgyad chad de/ /go dang rtsa dang dang r+ghaṃ/ /paṃ dang si dang lo dang ḍi/ /zla ba nyi ma yang dag ldan/ /sa bon brgyad las gyur pa ni/ /gri dang rnge'u chung rus sbal sgrul/ /seng ge dge slong 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje la sogs rim par skyes/ /go rī shar rmi sgo na gnas/ /tso rī lho yi sgo na gnas/ /nub kyi sgo ru beṭ+wā lī/ /byang gi sgo ru ghasma rī/ /puk+ka sī ni dbang ldan du/ /ri khrod ma ni byin za'i grwar/ /gtum mo bden bral la gnas te/ /g.yung mo 'di ru rlung na gnas/ /lha mo bskyed pa rdzogs nas su/ /gtso bo 'od kyi gong bu la/ /lha mos bdag po med mthong nas/ /gong bu mchog la gsol ba gdab/ /snying rje yid kyis bcom ldan bzhengs/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i ting 'dzin spangs nas ni/ /bdag la 'dod pa'i bde ba mdzod/ /khyod mi bzhugs na bdag 'gum pas/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin yangs spangs te/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par ni/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /'jig rten phyir smon 'dod pa'i gtso/ /ci phyir stong pa nyid la bzhugs/ /khyod mi bzhugs na phyogs mi khums/ /gtum mo bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yung mo bdag ni yid rmongs pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad par/ /khyod kyi bdag ni thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul lta bur khyod bzhengs shig /bskul ba'i glu'o/ /bskul bas sngon gyi byang chub ni/ /smon lam rjes su dran te bzhengs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis nag po che/ /gcer bu spyan gsum mche ba gatshigs/ /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor gnas/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /g.yon pa na ni 5—579

thod pa 'dzin/ /zhabs kyis bdud bzhi rnam par mnan/ /brkyang bskum tshul du gnas pa'o/ /go rī kha dog nag mo ste/ /tso rī kha dog btsod dang mtshungs—/ /ro langs ma ni gser bsregs mdog /za phod ma ni margata mtshungs—/ /sbos mo'i mdog ni sngon mo'o/ /ri khrod ma ni zla nor 'od/ /gtum mo nam mkha' ljang gu ste/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs pa ru 'dod/ /go rī g.yas na gri gug ste/ /g.yon na nya ni de bzhin no/ /chom rkun g.yas na ḍa ma ru—/ /g.yon pa na ni phag pa'o/ /ro langs g.yas na rus sbal te/ /g.yon pa na ni pad+ma'i snod/ /za phod ma yi g.yas na sgrul/ /g.yon pa'i lag na thod pa'o—/ /sbos mo g.yas na seng ge ste/ /g.yon gyi phyag na dgra sta 'dzin/ /rngon pa ma g.yas dge slong ste/ /g.yon pa na ni gsil byed do/ /gtum mo g.yas na 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pa na ni thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yung mo g.yas na rdo rje ste/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /go rī la sogs phyag gnyis shes/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du yin//phyag rgya lngas ni shin tu mdzes/ /tshangs pa la sogs gdan la bzhugs/ /de ltar sku rnams rdzogs pa dang / /rang gi snying gar pad+ma bsam/ /de dbus nyi ma hūṃ las bsam/ /de las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /de las hūṃ gis mtshan pa ste/ /de 'gyur ye shes sems dpa' bsam/ /de nyid pad nyir hūṃ rdo rje/ /ye shes sems dpa' rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar rim pa kun la yang / /de ltar nang du shes par bya/ /de las 'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbaka' lung gis/ /go rī la sogs rnams kyis ni/ /spyan drangs nas ni de bstems nas—/ /ye shes 'khor lo chen po 'bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems 5—580

dpa' ni/ /bsgrubs te gzhan na yod ma yin/ /mi las gti mug rdo rje ma/ /ḍi las zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /mi las ser sna rdo rje ma/ /ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /i las phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /rna las bdag med rdo rje ma/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /lus yid rim bzhin de ltar dgod/ /phyag gnyis zhal gcig ro yi gdan/ /gri gug thod pa phyag na bsnams/ /i las mkha' spyod mar shes bya/ /a las sa spyod ma ru 'dod/ /hūṃ las zhabs bskyed 'og nas bsam/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs de yang / /rnal 'byor ma ni rigs gsum 'dod/ /rang snying sa bon khyad par spro/ /lcags kyu'i gzugs kyi 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas spyan drangs mdun du mchod/ /dbang bskur ba ni blang ba ste/ /mgon po de bzhin gshegs thams cad/ /khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa khro bo dang / /lha rnams kyis ni mdun bdar nas/ /bum pas de la dbang bskur bas/ /bi tsi ta/ pi pa ka/bi marta/ bi la/ skad cig bzhi la'o/ /ā nan da/ pa ra mā nan da dang /bi ra mā nan da dang / sa ma dzā nan da'o/ /dga' ba bzhi'o/ /dgod pa dang / blta ba dang / lag bcangs dang / 'khyud pa ni slob dpon dang /gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes dang / bde ba chen po'i de kho na nyid do/ /mtha' ru dbang rnams 'bras bu ni/ /rtsa bar mi bskyod pas brgyan pa'o/ /sems dang phan pa rin chen dang / /'od dpag med pas brgyan pa'o/ /go rī tso rī bertswa lī/ /ghasma rī rnams brgyan pa'o/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas rin chen dang / /tshe dpag med kyis brgyan pa ni/ /sbos mo rngon ma ①gtum mo dang / /g.yung mo la sogs brgyad pa'o/ /oṃ a sgyi ṣiñtsa tu rmā sarba ta thā ga ta 5—581

ho—/ 'bud dang 'bar dang thod pa dang / /'dzin pa lnga dang 'bras bu lnga/ /de 'gyur bdud rtsi ro myang ba/ /rdo rje nas kyi 'bru bsam ste/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje de bklag go/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da ①na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophohaṃ/lha mo brgyad rnams spros nas ni/ /mchod pa brgyad kyis sngon bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo nyid la mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta phu dza badz+ra swa bhā ba ā ko3haṃ—/ rnal 'byor ma rnams de dag gis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo la bstod la//khyod ni rnal 'byor brgyad kyis bskor/ /nyid kyi thugs kyi khyod dgongs 'grub/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu mas sgrub pa'i yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tir ①badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ de yan chad bsnyen pa dang nye ba'i bsnyen pa bshad nas/ sgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen po bshad par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor lha rnams lus la bsdu/ /lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī sbar la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te/ /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te/ /bsregs pas haṃ las ri bong ④'byung / /dang po sprin dang 'dra ba mthong / /gnyis su du ba 'dra ba mthong / /gsum pa glog gi rnam pa ste/ /bzhi pa mar me 'dra ba dang / /lnga pa thams cad snang ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba ste/ /phyis ni sgyu ma'i rnam pa mtshungs/ /rmi lam rnam pa skad cig go/ /rang gi snying ga 'di nyid du//spros dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /spros med bsgom pa'i sbyor ba ste/ /thog ma mtha' dbus med pa chab/ /'khor med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /de ltar ma yin dmigs ma yin/ /zhes mar me'i rtse mo'i bar du'o/ /bar chod bgegs kyis mi tshugs phyir/ /gtor ma rgyun tu sbyin par bya/ /oṃ in+da dza ma dza la/5—582

yak+ṣa bhū ta/ ba: ba u/ rāk+ṣa tsan+da/ sru dz+dza/ mā da babe+e/ ta le ①pā tā la/aṣ+ṭa ②sabe+e/ i rda/ ba bo/ hūṃ ①dza/ dzi gha/ put+pa/ byu pa/ rmā sa/dzi gha/ saṃ bha saza/ kadz+dza sā dha/ kharnyi khu ni phe ḍa rjogā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā r+ghaṃ/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tā ta/ oṃ ā hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tre lokyā k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /bsam gtan mi nus rnal 'byor gang / /de ni dag pa rjes su dran/ /snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste/ /yan lag nag po byams pa yin/ /phyag rgya lnga ni sangs rgyas yin/ /khros pas gdug pa 'dul ba yin/ /spyan gsum pa ni sku gsum mo/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po rdo rje ma/ /tshor ba gsang ba'i go rī ma/ /'du shes phung po chu ma'o/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam par shes pa bdag med ma/ /don dam la ni phung po med/ /skye mched drug ni dag pa ni/ /mig ni gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /sa ni puk+ka sbo ru bshad/ /chu yi khams ni rngon pa ma/ /drod ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /gzugs ni go rīr yang dag brjod/ /sgra ni chom rkun ma rab brjod/ /dri ni ro langs ma ru bshad/ /ro yi tshul ni za phod ma/ /reg bya sa spyod ma zhes bya/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mkha' spyod ma/ /de ltar dag pas rjes dran bya/ /bdag gi sgrub thabs rim pa 'di/ /blo zhan don du bdag gis brtsams/ /de yi dge ba gang yin pas/ /sems can 'khor ba las grol shog /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabasaske/ slob dpon chen po bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma tsan+d+ra dang / lo tsā ba dharma tsan+d+ras rang 'gyur du bu5—583

bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// // bsdur mchan/576 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/577 ①〈〈pe 〉〉nyid/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsams/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rjes/578 ①〈〈snar 〉〉bya/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉btags/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtag du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgya/579 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉'og gi/581 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉mo/582 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga dza/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉staṅge/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabs/583 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉skamaṣ+ṭha/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉gu/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bo'agyur du/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (72)5wa 584

ba — —las ran chan 'bar ba zhas bya —ba' sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na dzā la sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog pas brtags pa'i gnas don ji snyed la/ /khyab par bzhugs nas de dag sdud mdzad pa/ /shes rab thabs gnyis dga' bzhi thig le bzhi/ /sku bzhi spros pas 'gro don mdzad la 'dud/ /ha cang rgyas dang ha cang bsdus pa yis/ /'jigs pa bdag dang de 'dra rnams kyi phyir/ /kye yi rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam/ /rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya'i sgrub thabs brtsam//rnal 'byor pa gang nyan thos dang / /byang chub sngags spyod rim par gus/ /dal zhing zab la rig kun mkhas/ /sngags rgyud sbyor bas bde byed cing / /rdo rje dril bu'i ye shes dang / /lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /sngags dang rdul tshon gtor ma dang / /dbang bskur de nyid bcu rig pas/ /dur 5—585

khrod chu 'gram shing gcig ①dang / /ri dang tshang tshing bya skyibs sogs/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs rgyan par/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang dris byugs nas/ /sgrub pa'i sngon du bsnyen pa ①bya/ /de med na ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /las kyi cho ga gang dag la/ /nye bar bsnyen pas 'grub ④'gyur ba'o/ /dngos dang dngos bral kun ngo bo/ /kye yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor ldan par thun bzhir bsgom/ /thun mtshalas bzlas pa 'bum mam khri/ /yang na mtshan bzang mthong ba ste/ /tshogs 'phel bgegs zhi don grub pa'o/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las bsnyen pa'i bya ba ste dang po'o// //mkhas pas grong dang grong khyer dang / /ri bo'am sa phyogs nyams dga' ba'am—/ /me tog tshal dang dben gnas dang / /rgyal sras khyim mam dkyil 'khor sar/ /dkyil 'khor mchog 'di bri ba'i phyir/ /dang por sa ni legs par brtag /chu ni g.yas 'khor shar dang byang / /dma' ba dkar sogs gru dubazhi sogs/ /brkos nas slar bkang lhag gyur pa/ /khru phyed brkos nas chu yis dgang / /gom pa brgyar ni 'gro bar bya/ /myur 'ongs de ltar nyid nas bsngags—/ /u dusmra ra n+ya gro dha/ / a shwad+ma dang pā la sha /rjob ku la dang ardzu nar/ /bcas pa rus sbal rgyab 'dra spang / /rang bdag sbyor bas gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas sa ni basbang bar bya/ /sa phyogs 'dir bdag che ge mo/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po kye rdo rje/ /bzhengs kyis 'di na gnas pa'i bgegs/ /'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /dgun zla ra ba sogs brtsams te/ /zla ba gsum gsum lto 'phye'i mgo/ /lho dang nub dang byang dang shar/ /bltas te 5—586

g.yon pa'i zur gyis nyal/ /pus mo lte ba rked tsam du/ /dngos grub rjes mthun lto nas brko/ /phub ma gseg ma rdo ba dang / /shing bu sol ba la sogs dor—/ /rin chen 'bru sman nang du gzhug /de nas shin tu 'thas par brdung / /gal te de ltar ma nus na/ /mkhar bsams lag mnan sngags 'di bzla—/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhu khaṃ hūṃ/ sa nam mkhar byin byis brlab pa'o/ /mchod dang gtor mar ldan par ni/ /rim bzhin bsgoms te mtshan ma brtag /bkra mi shis na spong ba 'am/ /drag po'i sbyin sreg zhi ba'ang byaske/ /de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /bgegs dgra tshar bcad bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje ra ba bla re gur/ /hūṃ las gsal bar bsgom par bya/ / der ni 'khor lo ser po 'bar/ /rtsibs bcu : las bsgom par bya/ /①der ni hūṃ bcu'i sbyor ba las/ /khro bo bcu ni rim par dgod/ /gshin rje mthar byed shes rab mthar/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ /ṭak+ki khro bo dbyug pa bzhin/ /stobs chen mi g.yo mgon po dang ②/ /gtsug tor gdugs ni dkar po dang / /rdo rje zhabs 'og gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje khro bo skyes bu che/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /snying gar g.yon pa'i khu tshur mdzub—/ /g.yas na rang gi mtshon cha 'chang ①/ /gshin rje gsod pa'i dbyig tho ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje dbyig /rta mgrin la ni dbang mchog dmar//mi phyed bdud rtsi thab rjosbyor la'o/ /ṭak+ki rgyal po lcags kyu ste/ /dbyeg sngon can la rang gi ming / /stobs kyi rgyal po rtse gsum pa/ /mi g.yo mgon po rdo rje ste/ /tsha skyob dkar po rgyal po yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /gtun shing rdo rje rkang 'og la'o/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /5—587

dbang po sngon po'i rnam pa ltar/ /mthar byed rnam par bsgom par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje ni/ /'jigs byed zla ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /pad+ma'i khro bo dmar po che/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdag nyid gnag /mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing / /spyi bor rdo rje 'chang ba 'dzin/ /gshin rje rnam snang nyid kyis te—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbyig pa can/ /pad+ma'i khro bo rnams ①gzigs rjes//rdo rje sems dpas thal sbyor la'o/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje nyi ma bsgom par bya/ /'og tu pad+ma'i gdan bsams nas/ /khro bo bcu rnams bsgom par bya/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo gzi brjid che/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba ste/ /'khor zhing rab tu mi g.yo bar/ /dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam mobu/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ①swā hā/ dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las sa'i cho ga'i bya ba ste gnyis pa'o// //blo ldan 'khor lo'i sa dbus su/ /legs ldan sngon 'gro nas brtsams te//mchod bstod bar gyi ④sbyor ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba gdab//ma lus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i/ /mgon po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge mo/ /bdag ni kye yi rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor mchog 'di 'bri bar byed/ /bdag gi bsgrub bya bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthu chen ldan pa khyed rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril 'dzin la/ /slob ma'am 'khor sprul gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa ⑤yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan 5—588

nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba chos mchog las byung ba/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam spyod mdzad/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /langs te mkha' bzhugs rgyal phyag bya/ /sangs rgyas kun spyor nga rgyal bskyed/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' bdag /rdo rje nyi ma'ang bdag nyid de/ /don yod rdo rje chos bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid yin/ /de nas kye rdor khros bltas nas/ /'khor lo mkha' la gdegs par bya/ /yi ge ma ṭas nyi zla'i mig/phyogs dus thams cad sbar ba dang / /blo ldan 'gro la bltas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i sa ni yongs su bskor/ /rkang 'og rdo rje 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje gsor bar shin tu brtson/ /rol pa'i rdo rje 'gros kyi gar/ /mche ba gcigs bcas hūṃ sgogs pas/ /me tog snyim pa'i sbyor bas bya/ /spos la yal ga'i sbyor ba nyid/ /mar me mdze+e bong brtan par bya/ /byug pa de yi rnam pa yang / /lag pas mig dang de bzhin rna/ /rkang pa zur gyi g.yas phyogs su/ /pheg rdob pa yi sbyor bas bya/ /de bzhin du yang g.yon du bskor/ /rgyun gyi gar byas de 'og tu/ /bskyod pa'i gar byas de yi rjes/ /myur bskor de bzhin gar byas te/ /'khor lo bzhin du 'khor bar bya/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang ba/ /mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang / rdo rje'i rkang stabs dang /dkyil 'khor dang / sna tshogs thams cad dang / rus sbal gyi rkang stabs 5—589

dang / bung ba'i dra ba dang / rgya mtsho bskyod pa dang / ri bo'i mchog dang /mdzes pa'i gom pa dang / khro bo'i gom pa ste rkang stabs kyi bkod pa'o/ /ral gri lugs dang / 'khor lo'i tshul dang / rin po che'i tshul dang /pad+ma'i lag pa dang / ral gri'i lag pa dang / mdung gi tshul dang / gzhu'i tshul dang / dbyig pa'i tshul dang / dbyig tho'i tshul dang / gtun shing gi tshul dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i tshul dang / kha bcu pa'i tshul dang / ral gri bu mo'i tshul dang / sna tshogs dbyeg pa'i tshul dang / mdung gi tshul dang /gong bu skyong ba'i tshul dang / 'phan gnyis pa dang / 'phan gsum pa dang /me tog gi tshul dang / bdug spos kyi tshul dang / mar me'i tshul dang /dri'i tshul dang / lā gye'i lag pa dang / phreng ba'i lag pa dang / glu'i lag pa dang / gar kyi lag pa dang / gling bu'i lag pa dang / pi wang gi lag pa dang / rdza rnga'i lag pa dang / ku mu ta'i lag pa ste/ lag pa'i bkod pa'o//rdo rje'i ①skyil krung dang / sems dpa'i byas krung dang /sde pad+ma'i 'dug stangs dang / bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang / skyil krung phyed pa dang /bkra shis kyi 'dug stangs te/ 'dug stangs kyi dgod pa'o/ /sgeg pa'i ro dang / dpa' bo'i ro dang / mi sdug pa'i ro dang / rgod pa'i ro dang /drag po'i ro dang / 'jigs su rung ba'i ro dang / zhi ba'i ro dang / rngam pa'i ro dang / snying rje'i ro dang / drug gis rjes su bskyed pa'i glu dang /drang srong gi rjes kyi glu dang / dri za'i rjes kyi glu dang /① bar ma'i rjes kyi gru dang / lnga pa'i rjes kyi glu dang / blo gsal gyi rjes kyi glu dang / 'khor nyan pa'i glu'o/ /nyung ngu'i dbye ba dang / sgol ba'i dbye ba dang / 'jigs 5—590

pa'i dbye ba dang / gang ba dang / dbye ba byed phyi ba dang / rnam par 'dre ba dang / 'dod chags gnyis mtshungs par byed pa dang / dkyus gsum len par byed pa dang / ①sgog ma nyed pa dang / rkan ②nyed pa dang / lce nyed pa dang / so nyed pa ste glu'i dgod pa'o/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung dus su yang //dam tshig 'di ni rab bskul ba/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /'di ni dam tshig rim pa mchog /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams thams cad nyon/ /nga ni snying rje'i stobs dpal ldan/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje yis ni gsal ba'i lus/ /sku gsum las ni skyes pa spro/ /gal te las ①la 'da' byed na/ /'jig par 'di la the tshom med//lus srul po dang kha cig gang / /bde chen ye shes 'byung ba dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin skyes/ /zur cig bgegs ni chen po rnams/ /na maḥs marnya budhe bh+yo na mo badz+ra kro dh+wa ya/ ma hā rdasbyo ta ka ṭa ste ra wā ya badz+ra sasdo ha dar+pā ya/ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba'am/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāka ④tsit+ta badz+ra na ma⑤/ na mo badz+ra kro dh+wa ya/ ma hā rdasbyo ta ka ra bye ra bā duya/a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu sha kṛ hi ta hastu ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/bi sbo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba badz+ra bisne/ bi nā ya kān/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ dzi pi ta an+ta ⑦ka rā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar sa ni yongs bzung la/ /bgegs med phyir ni phur bu gdab/ /stod du bgegs 'joms khro bo la/ /smad du rtse gcig bsams nas gdab/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/dzaṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ grisnro ⑧pa ya kṛ2 ⑨pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān/ bibyā rā 5—591

dzā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ tī la ya ①tī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya phaṭa/ badz+ra dha rod ②ādzñā pa ya te kā ya bāka byu badz+ra dz+wa tī la ①hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs med sa ni phyogs bcings nas—/ /de nas lhag par gnas par bya/ /mchod gtor rgya chen bshams nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor dbus su dris byugs nas/ /lha mo bskyed de mchod byas la/ /lhag par gnas te gshegs su gsol/ /kye yi rdo rje khros mchod pa'i//ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /che ge mo bdag dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /lha yi gnas su nges pa der/ /ba yi lnga dang dri zhim sogs/ /sa byugs me tog tshom bu dgram/ /mkhas pas lha yi gnas de la//dkyil 'khor rang sngags yi ges rjosprul/ /spyan drangs mchod bstod bar du bya//de nas slob ldan pus btsugs te/ /lag par spos thogs gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan kye yi rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni ⑤'dri bar bgyid/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang //gang yang 'byung po mthu can dang / /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /kye yi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'dri na/ /deng ⑦bdag slob 5—592

mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /dkyil 'khor du ni tshogs pa kun/ /byin rmis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /bum pa lhag par gnas par bya/ /bum pa nag po ra ri ①med—/ /mgrin pa ring ba lto che ba/ /dkar pos byugs te mtshan mas gdab//kha rnams yal ga gos rgyan du/ /til dang gro dang sran ma dang / /nas dang 'bras ni 'tha lnga'o/ /ha sa de ba ka pi re②/ /kri ta dze+e li bri ha pa la/ /ka: ka ni sman lnga yin/ /gser dngul mu tig byu ru dang / /nor bu rin chen rin chen lnga/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi mngar/ /lan tshwa spos dang dri bzangs gzhug/hūṃ bdun bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar⑧/ /me tog phreng btags rdo rje ni/ /dri chur bcug pa steng du gzhag /bum par lha bskyed mchod dunas ni/ /phreng ba'i mgo nas lag bzung la/ /nyin re bzhin du thun gsum du/ /gtor ma byin zhing bzlas par bya/ /de nas bum pa so sor gzhag /las kun byed pa byang shar du'o/ /slob ma yan lag kun rdzogs shing / /shin tu dul dang spyod pa zhi/ /chos gsum la ni mngon dga' zhing / /theg pa che la dga' ba'i blo//sngags dang rgyud la ⑤sbyor ba dang / /bzo sogs thams cad rtog rjo'adod cing //sbyor dang bsam gtan dga' ba dang / /nyan dang klog la brtson pa dang / /rtag tu bla ma gus 'dod dang / /sbyin pa la sogs dge la dga'/ /de bzhin 'dod la mi dga' ba/ /longs spyod la ni mi gnas pa/ /nga rgyal khro ba med pa gzung / /gang zhig tshul khrims 'chal ba dang / /slob dpon dang ni rgan pa'i lha/ /sems can kun la smod pa dang / /ngan pa'i bdag nyid gdug sems dang / /rtag tu sdig pa'i blo ngan dang / /tshig rkyal ngag rtsub smra ba 5—593

rnams—/ /'di dag 'dra ba spang bar bya/ /gal te bde gshegs dgongs pa ni—/ /sgrub pa don gnyer brtson ldan na/ /gzugs ngan yon tan med pa 'am—/ /dman pa'am lhag gnas bya bar rigs/ /ston pas de la 'di skad brjod—/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la//'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /de phyir 'bras bu mchog 'dod bya/ /de skad brjod nas slob ma de/ /rtag par bsams la gsol ba gdab/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa pas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal ①du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la sprul/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de skad lan gsum brjod par bya/ /de nas dpa' bos slob ma yi/ /yon tan dmigs byas tshig 'di brjod/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas//dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes//gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yi/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun 5—594

mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / da ltar slob ma la gdams nas/ /'di skad ces kyang brjod du gzhug /①bdag gis thog ma med dus nas/ /log rtog dbang gis sdig bgyis pas/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams kyi/ /spyan sngar bshags bgyid ④slan chad sdom/ /rgyal dang de yi sras rnams dang / /'gro ba'i bsod nams ma lus pa/ /de la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub dam par bsngo bar bgyi/ /gang dang gang gis 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de dang de yi skur ston pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs nor ji lta bu'i—/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ /kun rtog ma lus dag gyur pa//rang rig yang dag ye shes bskyed/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la'ang skyabs su mchi/ /go rims ji bzhin dbang bskur thob/ /ma log lam 'di nges gnas dang / /sras mchog 'khor 'dus tshogs mchog la//rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /yang dag ye shes me bo che/ /gti mug mun pa bsal ba dang / /sgrib pa ma lus sbyang ba'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi lam/ /spyod pa dpag yas gang yin dang / /ma bcos ji bzhin gnas lam la/ /da ni yang dag gnas par bgye/ /de nas bla mas byang chub sems/ /ma skyes pa ni bskyed par bya//bskyed pa slar yang dran du gzhug /las kun byed pas bsrungs nas ni/ /snying ga sgog ma spyi bo ru/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo dag /hūṃ āḥ.oṃ las de dag dgod—/ /spos chu rdo rje khu tshur dag /snying ga sgog ma spyi bor gtug /de bzhin hūṃ yasa.oṃ brjod bya/ /oṃ yasahūṃ brjod/ me tog la sogs rim bzhin byin—/ /spyi bor me tog mdun du spos/ /mar me dri ni snying ga ru/ /kun 5—595

byed bzlas nas gus pa yi/ /slob ma rnams la sbyin par bya/ /a shwata u dum bā ra yi/ /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /ma yo ma gas srog chags med/ /rtse mo me tog bcas pa byen/ /shar ram byang du kha bltas gzhag /bcas nas ltos pa med par ni/ /ba ko tsam du byugs par dor/ /zhi ba la sogs dngos grub bstan/ /'thor 'thung skyor chu lan gsum blud/ /oṃ ā dzi hwa saṃ badzha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ so shing la ①bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ byā bi shu’ sarba dharmā ②sarba pā paṃ nirtse ①phye sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ 'thor 'thung blud pa'i sngags so/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i/ /srung skud dpung pa g.yas par btags/ /ku sha'i snying po rtse ma nyams/ /dhi las byung ba bsam par bya/ /dang por spyi bor gcig gzung bya/ /gzhan dag sngas dang stan phyir byen—/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum bā ra'i me tog bzhin//brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa de/ /gang zhig mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sdig pa byas par gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra bar/ /mthong bas 'byang bar 'gyur ba ste/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod bupa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /de dag gis ⑤ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu 'chang / /bdag nyid chen po dzad rnams kyis//rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag 5—596

nyid chen po kun gyis ①ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg ②can la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal ba chen pa④//'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur//don bshad srung ba byas nas ni/ /ku sha'i stan la nyal du gzhug /rmi lam gang dag ci mthong ba/ /de kun dang por nga la smros/ /rmi lam bzang ngan dris nas ni/ /mi dge thab rjosbyor dag gis gzhom/ /dpal kye rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa las/ sta gon bya ba ste gsum pa'o// //mkhas pas mnyam zhing yid 'ong bar/ /ba yi lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /dri zhim chu yi legs byug pa/ /phyi yi rgya ni khru bdun pa/ /nang gi khru gsum mthe bong gsum/ /dkyil 'khor thig ni gdab par bya/ /thig skud gsar pa mjos par ldan/ /rigs lnga'i sa bon de mdog byung / /ye shes lnga ldan srad bu gang / /lnga phrag lnga ni rnam phye ba/ /nyi zla'i 'bar mig lcags kyus dgug /las kun byed pa'i srad bu yang / /gtsang mas legs bkal dri zhim dang / /bdud rtsis spang zhing yi ge gsum/ /zig 'dzin grogs dang bsgril bar bya/ /rjodz+dza yis btang zhing rang yang zlo/ /khu tshur g.yon pas lte bar gzung / /nub dang shar nas blo ldan kyis/ /mkha' dang 'og gi thig gdab bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ nam mkha' gang ba'i bde gshegs rnams/ /khyed kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /zig gi sgra yis bskul nas ni/ /de rnams 5—597

'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /ltas ngan gyis ni dngos mi 'grub/ /thig skud chad na slob dpon 'chi/ /ring thung khyer na nad kyis thebs/ /phyogs 'khrul ba yis slob ma dang / /slob dpon la yang nyes par gsungs/ /slob dpon slob ma shar nub tu/ /bltas te tshangs pa'i thig gdab bya/ /'phel 'grib med pa'i shing shun sogs/ /phyed dang phyed du bgos byas la/ /phyed kyi phyed na lho byang du/ /bya rog rjes btsal tshangs thig gdab/ /de nas dkyil 'khor phyed tshad kyi/ /g.yas dang g.yon du rgya gram bya/ /shar nub phyogs dang lho phyogs thig /byang lho shar nub bltas pas gdab/ /mer gnas rlung bltas bden bral nas/ /dbang ldan bltas te tshangs thig gdab/ /phyed la phyed phyed phyed du bgo/ /tshangs thig ngos rer brgyad brgyad 'gyur/ /dang po phyed rgyab de nang phyed/ /sngar byas sgo khyud phyed nyid dkyil/ /gnyis pa phyed phyed dang po la/ /phyed phyed byas pa logs zhes bya/ /de rgyab me tog chun 'phyang ste//de rgyab rta babs ka ba yin/ /gsum pa'i phyed rgyab de phyed nang / /rdor phreng bzhi pa lha snam yin/ /lnga pa'i byed phyed dang po la/ /phyed phyed byas pa tshon lnga'i gnas/ /bar gnyis 'dod yon mthar lngar byas/ /sgo 'gram rin chen pha gu'ang de/ /drug pa'i phyed nang mu tig phreng / /de rgyab phyed nang phyed phyed byas—/ /ya phubs tha ma rdo rje gdung / /bdun pa rta babs dag tu 'gyur//brgyad pa pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs/ /de rgyab nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rdo rje rwa/ /me 'od rim bzhin bskor bar bya/ /de nas mkhas pas tshon rnams la/ / : oṃ j-i ①khaṃ hūṃ rnams kyis/ /rdul tshon lha yi rnam par sbyor—/ /'bar ba'i blta bya ye shes sbar/ /yang dag gzi bskyed sngags 5—598

bzlas mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste//sems can khams ni dag par byed/ /kye yi rdo rje rgyal chen byi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/ /bla mas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni nag po nyid/ /mnyam zhing g.yas bskor rgyun ma chad①/ /ma yo bar ni tshon rtsi dgye/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha ru ni/ /ri mo mnyam par dgye bar bya//sbom por skye bas ⑤nad kyis 'debs/ /phra mos nor ni rnam par 'jig /yon pos rnam 'gras chad pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni slob ma 'chi/ /g.yas bskor min par skye ba yis/ /tshon ni phur bus btab par 'gyur/ /dkar po rdo rje rtse rang bzhin/ /gnyis pa gser las dmigs pa ste/ /pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin rtse/ /de bzhin gzhan dag margad yin/ /nag po nang du shes bya ste//'di ni tshon gyi rim par bshad/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha la dmar po ste/ /byang ni ljang gu yang dag ldan//dbus kyi sa gzhi'i cha dag ni/ /in+d+ra ni la'i 'od gsal bar/ /brtag par bdag nyid shes rab thabs/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag legs par bri/ /ri mo bar ni nas gang gis/ /ma reg par ni zi bar bya/ /kha sbyor gcig pa sgo bzhi pa—/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag khyab/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan//rdo rje thig gis rnam par brgyan/ /ri mo lnga dang nges par ldan/ /der ni bum pa brgyad zi bya/ /rin chen lnga phyed rang bzhin nam/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pa'o/ /dur khrod so phag dag gis sam/ /de bzhin dur khrod sol bas sorka/ /de dbus pad+ma 'dab ma ni/ /brgyad pa ge sar ldan pa bri/ /de 5—599

dbus thod pa dkar po ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa zi/ /dbang ldan du ni seng ge ste/ /me yi mtshalas ni dge slong ngo / /bden bral du ni 'khor lo ste//rlung du rdo rje bri bar bya/ /shar gyi sgor ni gri gug bri/ /lhor ni cang te'u bri bar bya/ /nub tu rus sbal bri bya ste/ /de bzhin sbrul ni byang du'o/ /lha mo'i kha dog dbye ba yis/ /phyag mtshan brgyad du rab tu grags/ /bla re rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs sogs/ /bla rgyan 'og rgyan bri bar bya/ /mchod gtor rgya cher bshams bkram la/ /'bar mig la sogs gong lta bur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyems byas la/ /rkang pa g.yas pa brgyang byas te/ /phyag gnyis kye rdor rnal 'byor gyis/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya/ /lus bkrus gtsang sbra dri zhim dang / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ sgra yis nga rgyal byed/ /hi hi sgra yis 'jigs par byed/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor/ /ma dag ma tshang skyon rnams bsal/ /de nas slob dpon rang lha yi/ /sbyor tshogs gtso bo'i bdag nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa rdul tshon dang / /gnyis med mkhar gnas kyang der gzhug /byin gyis brlab dang dbang bskur gyi/ /bar rdzogs byas nas 'chad pa yi/ /cho gas dkyil 'khor rab tu mchod/ /rang lces rdo rje bdud rtsi skyang / /phyi rol 'byung pos gtor ma sbyin/ /snga gro rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ /ma dag la sogs nyes pa rnams—/ /rgyal ba rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'i rim pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas slob dpon rang lha yi/ /sbyor gnas dkyil 'khor legs bltas la//5—600

mchod dang bstod pa la sogs bya/ /phyi nang sbyin sreg dag gis kyang / /'khor lo mchod de bdag nyid kyang / /slob ma'i rim bzhin dbang blangs la//gzugs brnyan lta bu'i 'khor lo ru/ /slob ma gzhug phyir bden pa bsgrags//nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /kye yi rdo rje deng 'grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis 'grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpas ①bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher ston pa/ /rdo rje bsnyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun kyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs①/ /sems can kun kyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'o/ /bden pa dag gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor ni①/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyed kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ / rgyu dang las la kun du 'byung / /de bzhin nyid la nges par skyes/ /dubaden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun byis dri ma med mthong shog /de ltar bstod cing phyag 5—601

babyis nas/ /'di ltar yang ni gsol ba gdab/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /slob ma rab tu gzhug par bgyi/ /sems can don du bdag gsol 'debs/ /bzod pa mdzad de dgongs su gsol/ /de nas slob mas slob dpon gyi/ /zhabs la gtugs la 'di skad brjod/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'jug go/ /slob dpon gyis bsgo ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /blo chen gyis ni gzung bar bya//byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos ①khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la—/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang mi 1 nus bya/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di/ /phas 5—602
