pham pas na rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i 1nga ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams 'gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur//khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod la bog par mi spyad cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol ①kun gyi rtsa ba yi—/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can gdul phyir ma gtogs pa//bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nges par bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa kun bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyong / /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yang mi spang / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags—/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing //phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /slob mas brjod pa/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags//'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung ①/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bkyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro 5—603

la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / zhes lan gsum bzlas la/ slar yang /① sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bkyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i④—/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis babyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis so sor brtan por gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba//pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar babyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don byi phyir/ /bdag gis snesdom pa ma lus bzung ④/ /ma bsgral ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi—/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 5—604

'das la dgod/ /zhes lan gsum bzlas so/ /de nas slob mas gos dmar pos—/ /gdong g.yogs me tog phreng gzung ①la/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bum pa'i chus/ /bsrung zhing sku gsung thugs sbyangs la/ /bu sdug khyod su ci la dga'—/ /slob dpon gyis ni gzhug phyir dri/ /skal bzang bde chen bdag dga' zhes/ /slob ma blo chen gyis smra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems bskyed phyir/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da yā mi/ brjod nas de yi snying gar ni/ /rdo rje bzhag cing bsams nas kyang / /su ra te sa ma ya ste ho/ sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ—/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlab par 'gyur rmis/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /go rī la sogs rang sngags kyis//dam pas dgug dang gzhug par bya/ /yi ge lnga yang de bzhin du/ /brjod de dam tshig mchog 'dzin gzhug /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob nas/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ te ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi//snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs/ /pad gnas ②yi ge gsum byis sbar/ /mi 'chi lnga pa 'thung du gzhug /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg 5—605

par 'gyur/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ brjod da ka /ṭha ṭha ṭha/ dam bcas brtan par bya ba'i phyir—/ /'di skad brjod do/ /deng phyin chad khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis—/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de yang bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar rtsang bar gyur ta re zhes brjod la/ de nas slob ma la 'di skad ces brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/dpal he ru ka bdag la 'bab par gyur cig /ces spros shig ces bsgo'o/ /de skad brjod nas de'i snying gar/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor mtshalas su ni/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa kha dog ser/ /lo las byung bar hūṃ bsgom bya/ /4 byung chu ni kha dog dkar/ /bum pas mtshan cing yongs su rlum/ /yo las byung ba g.yo ba'i rlung / /ba dan sngon pos mtshan gzhu'i dbyebs/ /de la sku gsum ha a bsgom—/ rkang 'og sgro①ཿni rab 'bar ba/ /rlung las sna byung gru gsum par//gnas par sbar la slob ma dbab/ /de nas 'jigs su rung ba yi/ /rdo rje glu dang gar bya'o/ /phywabe sha ya snyi bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya/ hūṃ a te ④snaḥlce la a ni dmar po zhig /bsams te babs la slar yang bsgo/ /'dod chags rdo rje de gnas pa/ /sgos shig rdo rje dge mi dge/ /bsam pa de ni brtan bya ba/ /de la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ /me tog phreng ba 'khor lo dor/ /pra ti ts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod do/ / gal te bzang por mi lhung na/ /lan gnyis bar du dor bar bya/ /①de ni spyi bor bcing bar bya/ /pra ti kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ i rma satwa ma hā ba la/ blangs pa 'am ma blangs pa gnyis ni/ /mtshan ma 'am 5—606

mtshan ma nye bar ni/ /babs sam dad kyang de'i sbyor ba/ /mig tu 'bar bcas oṃ bsams la/ /nye ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad dbyed par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /de la bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la da lta nyid//dad pa'i shugs kyis blta bar bya/ /khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs las skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /sngon ma byung ba mthong ba'o/ /slob ma yon dang bcas pa yis/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ /de nas 'di skad brjod par bya/ /oṃ rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gis de ring mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /de nas gtso bo nas brtsams nas/ /dkyil 'khor mtha' yi bar du bstan/ / dkyil 'khor shar du khru gnyis dor/ /①nang gi dkyil 'khor phyed tshad tsam/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor ni//dkyil 'khor de la khru do bar/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis par slob ma gzhag /mchod yon zhabs bsel la sogs sbyin/ /bag chags sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /slob ma shis par 'dod pa yis/ /bla mas bkra shis glu blang bya/ /phun sum tshogs 'dzin gser gye ri bo lta bu'i mdog /'jig rten gsum mgon dri ma gsum ni rab tu spangs/ /sangs rgyas chu skyes 'dab rgyas lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba//bkra shis des ni deng 'dir byed la zhi byed shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum du grags pa lha dang mis mchod pa//dam chos rab mchog skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'jig rten bkra shis gnyis 5—607

pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dam pa'i chos dang ldan zhing thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /dge 'dun lha dang lha ma yin dang mis mchod pa/ /ngo tsha dpal gnas tshogs kyi nang na rab kyi mchog /'jig rten bkra shis gsum pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dga' ldan lha yi gnas kyi dkyil nas 'gro don du/ /sngon byi dus su brgya byen lha dang bcas pa yi/ /'khor gyi tshogs bcas gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa'i/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /lum pa'i tshal du mgon po sku ni 'khrungs gyur cing / /srid mthar mdzad tshe me tog ge sar bcas pa dag /rab 'bar 'bab pa lha mang gis mthong bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /nyes pa sna tshogs rnam par gzhom par bya ba'i phyir/ /mtshan phyed dka' thub tshal du mngon par dgyes bcas pas/ /brgya byin ltar ①bcas rjes 'brang gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram du yon chab mar mes yongs bskor te/ /zhi phyir ngo mtshar rab bskyed srid pa dag byed pa/ /lto 'phye'i rgyal pos legs par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /grong khyer rab mchog ser skya zhes ni bya ba der/ /lha chen khyab 'jug la sogs rnams kyis stod ②byed pa/ /bde gshegs thog mtha' med par dge ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /sems can thams cad la ni phan phyir byang chub pa/ /rin chen chos mdzod thub pa las ni gang byung ba/ /sems can don grub nus pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /gser gyi 'od ltar shin tu 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba/ /be+e 5—608

drur+ya ①mdog 'dra ba'i rtswa bkram pa la bzhugs/ /skyil krung legs bcas mi g.yo'i sku mnga'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir byed la zhi byed shog /sa dang mkha' las sna tshogs dbye ba kun 'byung ba/ /byams pa'i stobs kyis ⑤bdud kyi bde ④las rnam par rgyal/ /shing gi rgyal po'i rtsa bar bcom ldan bkra shis pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir byed la zhi byed shog /bā rā ṇa sbor bzhugs nas bde bar gshegs ston pas/ /sa dang mkha' la shin tu ngo mtshar gsal byung ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa rab bskor bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir byed la zhi byed shog /bsod nams las byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon brten pa/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ges ma lus gsungs pa yi/ /phan byed dam pa bzang po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir byed la zhi byed shog /dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje gsor//glu dang ldan pa'i bkra shis so/ /gser la sogs pa'i stan gnas pa/ /der ni de ni dbang bskur bya/ /slob ma nges par byed du gzhug /de bzhin de bzhin dbang bskur la/ /lha yi sbyor ba gang yin pa/ /de yi phyag rgyas 'phrag nas rnam/ /dang po chu yi dbang yin te/ /gnyis pa dbu rgyan dbang yin no//gsum pa rdo rje'i dbang yin no/ /bzhi pa rang bzhin dhidabang yin te/ /lnga pa ming gi dbang bskur bya/ /drug pa yang dag sangs rgyas brjod/ /bdun pa bum pa'i dbang yin te/ /brgyad pa gsang ba'i dbang nyid do/ /dgu pa shes rab dbang gis te/ /de nyid rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /brtul zhugs dang ni lung bstan pa/ /'di dag rim par sbyin par bya/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu'i chus—/ /bum pa brgyad po thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje 'chang bsams dbang 5—609

bskur bya/ /rdo rje thugs su bsgoms pas so/ /oṃ badz+ra a rnyi shilca mi spyo/ rdo rje nyi ma rnam bsams nas/ /de la dbu rgyan sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na ka badz+ra sha li ho/ thams cad snga ma bzhin bsgoms la/ /rdo rje'i tshigs bcad rab tu sbyor/ /rdo rje chen po rtsa dgu pa/ /rang gi lag pas snying gar bya/ /slob ma 'jig rten dbang phyug gzugs/ /rdo rje sems zhes dbang bskur bya//sangs rgyas rdo rje dbang gis ni/ /di ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /shin tu 'grub phyir rdo rje long / /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti hūṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi ①tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ slob ma rta mchog bsam byas la/ /lha mo sgol mas sku la 'khyud/ /rdo rje'i bdag pos dbang bskur bya/ /lag pas rdo rje dril bu dkrol/ /oṃ badzā dhi pa ti spyo/ a rnyi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya ste/ slob ma rnam par snang mdzad bsam/ /ming gi dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa a rnyi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje/ /gang gang snang ba de kun dang dze+e/ /rang 'dod lha la sogs pa de/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i dri med chos/ /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams—/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung / /rdo rje snying po brtul zhugs brtan—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ste/ dha ra yā mi nyi nyi hi hi hūṃ/ bdag gis bcom ldan tshigs bcad ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bsdu bar bya/ /bde ba can na bcom ldan 'das/ /nyid kyis gang tshe chos bstan pa/ /de tshe gsang ba'i dbang pos zhus/ /mi rnams ji ltar dbang bskur bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dgod pa dag la slob 5—610

dpon te/ /de bzhin blta ba gsang ba'i dbang / /lag pas reg pa shes rab ste/ /de nyid gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa yi/ /dbang bskur ma 'ongs pa yin no / /bla ma'i zhal nas gsal bar 'gyur/ /'di ni dbang bskur drug yin no—/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mdun 'dug ste/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad 'dis/ /slob ma bla ma la gsol gdab/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang stsol cig /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dag /mgon pos bdag la bka' stsol cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /gsang ba'i sdom pa'i mchog rnams dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyidhi/ /de ltar slob mas gsol btab nas/ /bla mas skad cig ting 'dzin la/ /gnas nas de dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mchog spro bya/ /nye 'khor ba dan rgyal mtshan sogs/ /glu dang rnga sogs sa ru ni/ /gdugs dang bla re byes nas su/ /'dug ste 'di ltar brjod par bya/ /rin po che yi dbang 'di ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi②/ /gnas las byung ba nga yis sbyin/ /dang po bum pa'i dbang yin te—/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te//bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /thams cad thabs kyi cho ga dang ①/ /bla med mchod pas mchod par bya/ /de nas lag nas lag tu ni/ /slob ma rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin/ /sems dpa' thog ma tha ma med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po bdag /shes rab pha rol phyin ma las/ /byung ba'i dril bu'ang de la sbyin//5—611

sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rdo rje dril bu'i ming nyid do/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis①/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bstan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/ 'di'i don ni/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung ②cig rdo rje rab gnas pa/ /deng khyod rdo rje slob dpon te/ /khyod kyis ①slob ma gzung bar gyis/ /mkha' 'gro lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /dam tshig lnga rnams yongs gang ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs dang ldan/ /slob ma rdo rje 'chang dbang bskur/ /dkyil 'khor pad+ma zhes su brjod/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor mchog yin te/ /gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ste/ /sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags/ /de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ste/ /tshad ma mnyam por gyur pa'o—/ /byams pa la sogs sems ni gang / /thig skud bzhir ni brjod pa'o//thig gdab yang dag gang bshad pa/ /chos kyi dran pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /lta ba thams cad rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig skud dag tu brjod/ /rgyan rnams dhiyang dag gang bshad pa/ /tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa mchog /dad dbang la sogs sems gnyis na⑤/ /rwa ba lngar ni byung ba nyid/ /gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni/ /rnam thar bzhi yi dbye ba'o/ /rta babs ka ba bzhi po narjo/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod/ /ya phubs bzhi po gang yin pa/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ /sgo khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi zhes bya/ /me tog phreng bas brgyan byas pa/ /byang chub sems ni yan lag bdun—/ /ka ba rnam pa brgyad po ni/ /'phags pa'i lam ni yan lag brgyad//rnga yab ces ni gang grags pa/ /lam gyi bye brag ye shes brjod/ /dran par 5—612

yang dag gang bshad pa/ /nyon mongs 'joms pas dra ba ste/ /yang dag 'gog pa'i rang bzhin gyi'o/ /'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni rnal 'byor ro/ /nyon mongs byed ni 'joms pas na/ /dra ba phyed par brjod ①pa'o/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid do/ /phung po lnga ni mdor bsdus na/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags/ /rdo rje skye mched nges par ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes kun du brjod/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma tī/ /gos dkar mo dang sgol ma ni/ /drod dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas/ /gti mug zad pa gshin rje gshed/ /des na phung po mthar byed dang / /de bzhin shes rab mthar byed pa'o/ /nyes pas nyes pa longs spyod pa/ /nyes zad shes rab mthar byed de/ /des na sems ni mthar byed dang / /des na nyon mongs mthar byed yin/ /'dod chags 'dod chags longs spyod pas/ /pad+ma mthar byed 'dod chags zad/ /des na gsung gi mthar byed yin/ /de bzhin sbyor ba mthar byed do/ /nyon mongs thams cad zad pa dang / /de bzhin las kun zad pa dang / /sgrib pa kun zad ye shes ni/ /bgegs ni mthar byed ces brjod do/ /'di ni lha'i de ②kho na nyid do/ /phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /de nas slob mas bla ma la/ /legs bslabs bzhin bzangs mig dkyus ring / /gzugs dang lang tshos rgyan byas ma/ /phul la 'di skad brjod par bya/ /bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed ①pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya rab sgrub byed/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor yang dag 'byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /gtso bo bdag la yang de 5—613

mdzod—/ /'khor ba 'dam byi tshogs su ni/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag skyob mdzod—/ /mi bskyod sbyor ba btang byas te/ /rtag pa'i sbyor bas rjes dran bya//slob ma drung du gzhag byas la/ /de yi rjes su bla ma yis/ /gos la sogs pas mig bkab nas/ /brtags pa'i stan la gzhag par bya/ /shes rab ldan pa rab tu 'jug /rdo rje sa bon rab sbyor bas/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor gyis—/ /slob ma rtag par bsams byas la/ /'dzag pa'i rigs zhes bya ba ni//ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis①/ /byang chub sems rnams dbang bskur ltar—/ /nga yis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /rgyun gyis khyod la dbang bskur ro—/ /zad med de ni zad dogs na/ /nya phyis la sogs zhen pa spangs/ /dag pa'i lce yi rtse mo yis/ /gnyis ka las byung blang bar bya/ /'di ni de nyid bla na med/ /gnyis med ye shes brjod mi nus/ /chos dbyings rnam pa lta bur ni/ /zhi ba'i bde bas yang dag myang / /g.yas pa mchog sbyin khu tshur gyis—/ /snying gar chos gos grwa nas gzung / /lag pas dril bu mgul du bsdam—/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang ba yis/ /dbugs 'byung thams cad yang dag blangs—/ /shākya thub pa nyid gyur pas/ /slob ma chen po lung bstan byed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas the tshom med/ /skye dang rgas dang 'chi mi 'gyur/ /'jigs dang mya ngan nad mi 'byung / /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /bu khyod nga yis lung bstan te/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan khyod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /kye rang 'dod lha mi ②de bzhin gshegs/ /sa bla sa 'og sa steng 'grub—/ /'di ni gsang ba'i dbang las lung bstan pa'o / /①byang chub rdo 5—614

rje sangs rgyas kyis/ /chen po'i chen pos ji ltar byin/ /bdag kyang bsgral ba'i don du ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes bdag la stsol/ /rig ma dang po'am yang na gzhan/ /rgyud gzhan las gsungs rim pa yis/ /tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor sbyin/ /phyag rgya bzang mo rab brtags pa/ /lha mo thar byed dga' ster ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can brtser ldan ma/ /zung shig zung shig sems dpa' che/ /bzung bar byas nas mchod par gyis/ /de nas chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /dam tshig sdom pa 'di skad ston/ /nus sam khyod ci rdo rje can/ /dri chen dri chu bza' btung yin/ /rak+ta rmā sa ga bur dang / /bud med mos par dad nus sam/ /bha ga 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /ltos shig rdo rje bde ba can/ /de nas de yis ①rdo rje can/ /rab tu dgod cing 'di skad smra/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi thig /ga bur rmā sa bdag 'tshal gyis/ /shes rab yang dag dad par bgyi/ /de nas lha mo gcer phyung nas/ /bdag nyid pad+ma ltar gzhug go//rmad byung nga yi pad+ma yin/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu rim bzhin 'di la spyod/ /'di dag nam yang mi 'bral lo/ /chos dbyengs 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rnam par grol/ /bde chen rgyal po 'di nyid ni/ /rang bzhin thams cad la mdun nas/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la//pad+ma la bzhugs bar du gsungs/ /bha ga nang du nam mkha' bzhin/ /'byung ba lnga po rgyan bzhin 'chang / /lte ba la ni ge sar bcas/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /der gnas nas ni bsgom par bya/ /mi 'chi lha yi gzugs su ni/ /'di la rtag tu 'joms pa yin/ /shes rab kyis ②ni de ltar gsungs—/ /badz+ra mok+ṣa hoḥ/ de nas sngags pa rdo rje can/ /de yi rgyu yi sa 5—615

dbang la/ /bha ga'i nang gi rtsa las ni/ /'bad pa las ni rnyed pa la/ /bslab pa bla ma'i dam tshig gis/ /mdzub mos rab tu brud nas ni/ /lce yi yang yang rol mo mdzad/ /des ni rab tu rgyas par 'ong / /de ltar rol mo mdzad tsam na/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu rgyas/ /rtag pa'i bde ba rab tu byung / /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa dang / /stobs rnams dang ni dbang rnams dang / /sa bcu po ni las 'das pas/ /rdo rje mtshan mar de 'byur ro/ /rdo rje bcing ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /rdo rje sems ni des phyung nas/ /rdo rje lce yis bza' bar bya/ /mnyam par 'byung ba'i cho ga yis//dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya/ /ting 'dzin las skyes sbyin sreg ste/ /de nas dbugs dbyung sbyin par bya/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la/ /rab zhugs dam pa mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol bar/ /deng khyod yang dag gnas par 'gyur/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur ma ①yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas/ /sus kyang mi tshugs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /shin tu srid pa grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin//'di ni khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung / /grub pa'i dam tshig sdom pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mnyam par gsungs/ /dam pa rtag pa'i bka' lung yin/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / /bde gshegs bka' la 'gom mi bya/ /rdo rje spun la smad pa ni/ /nam yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams dman min/ /skal min de kho na gtam min/ /skal ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /bdag gi lus 'di mi smad cing / /dam pa'i chos ni tshad mi 5—616

gzung / /gzhan gyi chos la'ang brnyas mi bya/ /byang chub snying po'i mthar thug tu—/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya//rdo rje dril bu gzung bya zhing / /dbu rgyan rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor rtag tu zi ba ste/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po chen po'i gtor ma byin/ /de la sogs pa dbugs dbyung rgyas/ /shes rab kyi dbang la brjod par bya'o/ /ston pas gsungs pa sems dpa' che/ /yang dag dam par dga' thob pa/ /sna tshogs spangs pa'i skad cig la/ /bde ba chen po gzung ①bar bya/ /de ni thog ma dbus mtha' med—/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa min/ /'di ni dam pa'i bde chen te/ /gzhan med bdag kyang med pa'o②/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra ste/ /snying po rdo rje mkha' lta bu/ /rdul bral zhi ba thar pa ste/ /khyod rang yang ni pha de'o/ /'di nyid ye shes chen po ste/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /gnyis su med dang gnyis kyi gzugs/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo nges thob nas/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs dang mtshungs par spang ④//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs gang gis/ /rtag tu nges par 'gyur ba nyid//shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi rjes la de skad brjod do/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas ni/ /bzhi pa shes par bya ba yin/ /slob ma'i bya ba rdzogs rjes su/ /dkyil 'khor mchod bstod legs byas la/ /oṃ khyed kyis busems can don kun mdzad—/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub spyod/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /be+er yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /brjod de lha yi 'khor lo gshegs/ /dman pa chu bo chen por dor/ /oṃ gi li gi li hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/5—617

rdul tshon bsdu ba dang dor ba'i sngags so/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las/ slob ma dbang bskur bar bya ba'i rim pa ste lnga pa'o// //de nas slob ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /babyed pa'i rim la legs gnas phyir//sa phyogs nyams dga' yid 'ong bar/ /dri zhim byug cing me tog dgram/ /bde ba'i stan la rab ①gnas la/ /paṃ pad re skyes gzhom med las/ /lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal ba spyan drangs mkha' la bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis/ /bla ma rdo rje mchod par bya/ /bshags dang yi rang bsngo ba dang / /skyabs 'gro mchog sems lam gnas bya/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /gdol pa'i khang pa mes bsregs la/ /bram ze rgyal rigs sogs gnas bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ paṃ pad re pha gsal byed de/ /sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ de las/ /ra ba bla re gur nang du/ /khro bo bcus kyang bsrung bar bya/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nam mkha' yo ram̐ baṃ lo las/ /rlung me chu sa dkyil 'khor du/ /hūṃ las 'khor lo de steng du/ /srid pa bar ma'i bag chags bsam/ /de dag las gyur pho brang ni/ /zur bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ /dra ba dra phyed ka ba brgyad/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan—/ /der ni mtsho skyes snang byed kyi/ /steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan bsam mo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ni ④la ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ā ko3haṃ/ uli zla ba me long dang / /kā li nyi ma mnyam nyid ldan/ /oṃ hūṃ rdo rje gri gug dang //so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te/ /thams cad gcig gyur bya nan tan/ /gzugs 5—618

brnyan rdzogs pa chos dbyings so/ /de las byung bas kun du bzang / /zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi bcu drug phyag /rtsa zhal zla 'dra g.yas dang g.yon/ /sngon po dmar po lhag ma gnag /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /skyes pa seng ge bye la g.yas—/ /sa chu rlung me zla nyi dang / /mthar byed nor sbyin g.yon na'o/ /lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gnag /gri gug thod pa g.yas g.yon na'o/ /oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā ra kha su khaṃ da dha tsa tur/ ā ①nan da bha ga bi swa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kādro ku ru ṣ+ṭa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dz+wa ṣa tsa tur ā ④nan da dā ya/ ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so nā tha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ katram̐ ku ru 6 me/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā ba a kolhahaṃ/ gnyis gnyis sgras bskul sa bon las/ /gzugs sgra dri ro'i rang bzhin dang / /sa chu me rlung rnam dag pa/ /lha mo brgyad rnams rim pas bkod/ /dbang po tshangs steng go ri gnag /phyag gnyis gri gug ro nyi ta//gshin rjer rkun ma dbang po'i steng / /dmar po cang te'u phag pa can/ /chu bdag nye dbang ro langs ma/ /dmar ser rus sbal thod pa bsnams/ /lus ngan drag por za phod mo/ /lngang gu sbrul dang pad snod can/ /dbang ldan gshin rje puk+ka sī/ /dbang sngon seng g.yas dgra sta g.yon/ /byin zar ri khrod nor sbyin steng / /dkar mo dge slong 'khar gsel 'dzin/ /bden bral de steng gtum mo sngo/ /g.yas na 'khor lo thod pa g.yon/ /rlung mtshams g.yung mo lha min te/ /rdo rje sdogs mdzub sna tshogs mdog /yang na sbyor sgras oṃ aXhūṃ—/ /hoḥganyis dbus gnas sbyor ba yis/ /rig ma dang bcas zhu ba las//puk+ka sī sogs glu yis bskul/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis rje btsun bzhengs/ /puk+ka sī bdag ③skyabs mdzod cig /stong pa'i rang bzhin spangs nas ni/ /5—619

bdag la bde chen rnal 'byor mdzod/ /khyod dang bral na bdag 'gum mo/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin spongs mdzod la/ /ri khrod ma ni bdag don sgrubs/ /'jig rten mgron gnyer 'dod pa'i gtso/ /stong pa nyid la ci phyir bzhugs/ /gtum mo bdag ni zhu bar bgyid/ /khyod ma lags na phyogs ma 'tshal/ /bdag gis nyid kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /dbang po'i dri ldan khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas//thugs rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /bskul bas smon lam rjes dran nas/ /hūṃ dang oṃ las rab bzhengs pa/ /rnam thar bsdu dngos stong rnams dag /zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi bcu drug phyag /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing spyan//gsum gsum lhag ma bung ba mtshungs/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskumaske/ /lhag mar gar gyi tshul gyis bzhengs/ /g.yas par glang sogs nad rnams sdud/ /g.yon pas ①sa sogs dbang phyug brgyad/ /thod pa skam rlon do shal thod/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan bdud bzhi mnan/ /rnam shes dag pa bdag med gnag /g.yas na gri gug thod pa g.yon/ /skra ser spyan gsum rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /yab yum 'khor bcas thugs kar ni/ /pad nyir sa bon phyag mtshan las/ /ye shes sems dpa' bskyed par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'grub 'gyur bas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drang bya/ /ṅgā rī la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dgyes pa bskyed/ /oṃ badz+ra go rī ā kaste ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tso rī pra be+e sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be+e tā ④lī spo ṭa ya baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī ba shi ku ru hoḥ /mig dang rna ba sna lce lus/ /yid kyi skye mched rnam dag pa/ /gti mug zhe sdang ser sna dang / /'dod chags phrag dog rdo rje 5—620

ma—/ /bdag med ma rnams rang gnas dgod/ /lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag pa/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod sa 'og ma/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su'o//'od zer gyis bskul dpa' bo'i tshogs/ /mchod byas gsol btab dbang bskur mtha'①/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbu la brgyan/ /zhe sdang gti mug ser sna dang / /'dod chags rdo rje go rī sogs/ /gnyis gnyis rim bzhin phyag rgyas gdab/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/rlung me'i steng du thod par ni/ /rgyu rmā j-i ⑤khaṃ hūṃ dang ni/ /go ku da ha na las ni—/ /bdud rtsi rdo rje lce yis myang / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3haṃ/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spros pas/ /zla nyi chus smin rdo rje ro/ /cang te'u sgra dang 'khyud pa ste/ /gtso bo nas brtsams rim bzhin mchod—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophohaṃ/ 'gro ba dug can mi bzad pas/ /khyab par bzhugs nas te ru kas/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /sman mchog dpa' bo khyod la 'dud/ / oṃ sarba tā thā ④ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophohaṃ/ de ltar bde bar gshegs drug gis/ /bsam gtan rab tu 'bad pas bya/ /bsam gtan mi nus rnal 'byor gang / /de ni dag pa rjes su dran/ /de nas mkhas pas sngags bzlas te/ /yab yum zhal nas mgal me yi/ /'khor lo bzhin du bskor bar bya/ /kha dog las kyi dbye bas dbye/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa rjon nā ya/ dzi gor dh+wa ⑤ke sha wa ṣ+pe/ tsa tur dzi sha ti ṣ+pe rjotā ya/ kho ḍa sha byu dzā ya/ kṛṇ+ḍa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ṣ+pe ka dha ri ṇi/ ā ta hrū ra tsit+ta ⑦ya/ asnyon+d+ra ⑧rdaṣ+ṭi ṇi/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/5—621

sap+ta sā ga rān/ bharnya bharnya/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa ka nā/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ sha hūṃ/ ha hā hi tī hu snu he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje'i glu dang smon lam dang / /langs nas dngos grub lhar bsam spyad/ /①dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las bskyed pa'i rim pa'i bya ba ste drug pa'o// //bskyed pas blo sbyangs rnal 'byor pas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim la ②gnas pas ①bya—/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs nas//spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs pas/ /bsregs pas haṃ las ri bong 'dzag /sgong skyes gnas su chu skyes ni/ /'dab brgyad ge sar bcas de la/ /yab lnga yum bzhi kun gyi dngos/ /kun nas mi 'chi rgyun gyis mchod/ /snying dbus zla bar gzhom med ni/ /sna tshogs 'od ldan de rdo rje/ /rdo rje bdag med mkha' 'gro ma/ /cho gas bskul ba bsgom par bya/ /mkha' 'gro sna rtser yungs kar tsam—/ /mchog dga'i tshul du thams cad bsdu/ /rang 'dod lha yi rim rdzogs nas/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer las/ /ā li kā li'i dkyil 'khor dag /spros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag /gnyis gnyis sgra yis rim bzhin du/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i nyi zlar gyur/ /'od zer bye ba brgya stong nas//ma lus bzhugs pas byin gyis zlob/ /de nas zla nyi nyi rang la/ /zer yang spu rtsa de 'bum cha/ /'bum cha'ang mi dmigs tshul de nyid/ /dga' ba chen po bsgom par bya/ /rdor dril yid 'ong mtshan ldan pa/ /g.yas kyis gsor zhing g.yon gyis dkrol/ /bcu drug cha la yang dag rdzogs/ /thams cad thams cad bdag nyid la/ /chu bo rgyun du 'bab pa dang / /mar me rgyun du 'bar ba 5—622

ltar—/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /nyin dang mtshan du gnas par bya/rdo rje pad+ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /der ni sa ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gsher ba'i rnam pa byang chub sems/ /chu yi khams ni 'byung ba'o/ /bsrubs ①pas me no skye ba ste/ /'gro ba rlung du rab tu grags/ /bde ba nam mkha' yi ni khams//gang phyir 'byung chen bde ba yis/ /lnga rnams yongs su bskor ba ste②/ /de phyir bde ba de nyid min/ /lha ④gcig skyes gnyis gang skyes pa/ /de ni lhan skyes zhes su brjod/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes bya/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /thugs rje thabs yin rnal 'byor pa'i/ /phyag rgya rgyu dang bral ba nyid/ /snying rje stong pa tha dad med/ /'di ni byang chub sems zhes brjod//sngags 'dzab dka' thub sbyin sreg byed/ /dkyil 'khor can dang dkyil 'khor de—/ /sngags bzlas dka' thub sbyin sreg de/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor dang dkyil 'khor de/ /mdo ru bsdus na sems nyid de/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin no/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /nye bar thob par gyur pa'i rtags—/ /dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba nyid/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa dang / /bzhi pa mar me nye 'bar ba/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ /phyi nas sgyu ma'i rnam pa ltar//rmi lam rnam par skad cig 'gyur/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bya ba ste bdun pa'o// //mkhas pa sngags kyi mthar phyin cing / /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs 5—623

med pas/ /'jig rten tha snyad rjes 'brangs te/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bya//lus bkrus dris bsgos gos gtsang bgos/ /do shal rkang gdub dpung rgyan dang //rna cha gdu bu sor gdub sogs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan byas te/ /zla ba dag dang tshes grangs dang / /gza' dang skar ma bzang po la/ /gnas ni yid 'ong 'du 'dzi sogs/ /skyon spangs rnam mdzes bla gab can/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri zhim byugs/ /me tog sil ma sna tshogs dgram/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan la sogs/ /bla re mchog ni bre bya zhing / /bkra shis rnams kyis brgyan pa yi/ /bum pa rin chen sogs gang dang / /pi wang gling bu 'khar rnga sogs—/ /glu gar dga' ston cher bya'i phyir/ /ci 'byor mchod pa legs bshams nas/ /gong ma'i cho gas bsrung bar bya/ /de nas gtor ma legs byin nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma gang / /sku gzugs glegs bam mchod rten sogs/ /dang po nyes pa bkru ba'i phyir/ /ba yi lci ba chu dang zho//'o ma mar gyis bkrus 'og tu/ /'bru mar gyis kyang byug par bya/ /'bru mar shun lpags lngas bsal bya'o/ /u dum bā ra shi ri ṣa/ /a shwat+tha dang n+ya gro dha//par ka ta yi ①shun pags te/ /de nas dri lngas khrus gsol ba/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang gur gum dang / /la gu dran ti ka lnga'o/ /phyi dro sku gzugs 'du byas pa//'og nas 'byung ba'i rim nyid kyis/ /lhag par gnas bya bum pa yang snga ma'i cho ga bzhin du'o/ /lha gnas phyogs char khrus sa ni/ /zur bzhi khru bzhi khru do dpangs/ /yid 'ong mdzes bcas gdan steng bzhugs/ /bkra shis rol mor bcas khrus gsol/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa de/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus 5—624

gsol lo/ /khyod ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chus/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong ba ①dri yis rjes bsgos pa/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud / /khyod ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chus/ /khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos pa/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyod ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chus/ /zhe sdang dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /byams pa'i dri yis legs bsgos pa/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyod ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chus/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos pa/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyod ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chus/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /ting 'dzin dri yis legs bsgos pa/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyod ni shes rab rang bzhin chus/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /ye shes dri yis legs bsgos la②/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chu bo drug gis khrus mdzad cing / /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas de la thar don du/ /dad pas bdag ni khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ṣ+pe swā hā/ ba'i rnam lnga'i 'o/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wā s+thāḥmar khu'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe she ①ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūṃ swā hā—/ sku khrus gsol ba'i sngags so/ /de nas mkhas pas bkra shis kyi/ /tshigs bcad 'di yang brjod par bya/ /nyin mo bkra shis mtshan bkra shis/ /nyi ma'i gung la gnas bkra shis/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis pa/ /sangs 5—625

rgyas rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /nyin mo bkra shis mtshan bkra shis/ /nyi ma'i gung la gnas bkra shis/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis pa/ /dam chos rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /de ltar kun la sbyar/ dge 'dun rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /phyogs skyong rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /srung ma'i tshogs kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /de ltar khrus gsol de 'og tu/ /gos kyi phyi bzhin dri lngas byug /sku la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bsrung bar bya/ /de nas sku sogs mi dmigs la/ /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya ste/ /de la sku sogs rdzogs pa la//spyan drangs mchod pa la sogs bya/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad dag /dga' ldan du ni gnas nas su/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums gshegs pa/ /de bzhin 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra go rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ/ oṃ brjo ①tso rī pra be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be+e tā ②lī brnya baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ /'dir ni rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang / /brtse bas rjes su gzung ba dang //byang chub sems no rab 'phel phyir/ /brtan par 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol//oṃ badz+ra dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ marnyo mar+bha/ badz+ra byeka a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/oṃ sa shwa pa ra ma sa shwa ta/ e bye hi dzi na dzika a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya ta mo bi dha ma na ①sa ma ya ste haṃ rat+na j-ika a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā sa ma ya tsū hu lu hu lu ā ro '-ika rjo.a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ phu ཿphuḥphuḥ⑤hi hi nyi/ pradzñā dzhaka a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/oṃ mo ha ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ dwo ṣa ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ rā ga ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/oṃ badz+ra ra ti a dhi nyiṣ+ṭha/ de nas mig sogs gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum rgo gnas gsum dgod/ /dbang ni rang gi rigs nyid kyis/ /rang nyid 5—626

gnas su ye shes bsam/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis/ /mchod pa'i rim pa dbul bar bya/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i cho ga yis/ /rgya cher rab tu mchod nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas bstod pa bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che//rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med—/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /der ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /sbyin sreg gtor ma'ang rgyas par bya/ /mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu dag /phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i ①lam las rab tu gnas pa'i bya ba ste brgyad pa'o// //blo ldan khrus byas rgyan rnams brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub dus gnas nang du/ /sbyin sreg de nyid la gnas te/ /las kun sgrub byed sbyin sreg bya//sngags pas byang du mngon bltas te/ /zhi ba'i las ni yang dag brtsam/ /shar du rgyas pa mngon spyod lhor/ /dbang dang dgug pa nub tu'o/ /zhi ba dgongs ka bya ba ste/ /rgyas pa nang par bya ba yin/ /dbang dang dgug pa nyi phyed la//5—627

mtshan phyed gsad dang zhe sdang ngo / /phan pa gnyis kyis zhi ba ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyas pa'o/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang zhes bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ①gsad pa'o//zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen char sprin rab bskor bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dgug pa'i las ni yang dag brtsam/ /gdug pa'i sems kyis gsad pa ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /zhi ba'i thab khung klum po steske/ /rgyas pa la ni gru bzhi'o/ /dbang ni zla ba byed pa 'dra/ /dgug pa la ni lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /gsad dang zhe sdang las la ni/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa'o/ /khru gang ba dang khru phyed par/ /rgya dang zabs ni zhi ba ste/ /khru do pa dang khru gang pa④/ /rgya dang zabs ni rgyas pa yin/ /dbang dang dgug pa'ang khru gang pa/ /khru phyed rgya dang zabs su bstan/ /sor mo nyi shu de yi phyed/ /rgya zabs gsad dang zhe sdang la'o/ /zhi ba'i kha khyer sor bzhi ste/ /rgyas pa la ni sor mo brgyad/ /dbang dang dgug la sor bzhi bzhi//gsad dang sdang la sor gsum gsum/ /phyed ma dkar pos zhi ba la/ /de bzhin rgyas pa ser po ste/ /dbang dang dgug la dmar por grags/ /gsod dang zhe sdang nag po'o/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri rdo rje ci rigs dgod/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor kyis/ /las kun pa yi ①sbyin sreg ste/ /tshad dang dbyibs dang kha dog dag /zhi ba dang mthun shar blta'o//dgang gzar dbye ba bshad par bya/ /gser sogs nim pa mchod sbyin zhing / /yu ba khru do mchu sor brgyad/ /zheng zabs rdo rje sor bzhi'orjo/ /kha ni pad+ma'i rnam pa mtshungs/ /ska rags gru bzhi mdzes pa ste/ /'og tu pad+ma legs par bya//5—628

rin chen sor gnyis yu ba'i mgor/ /tha mar rdo rje sor drug pa/ /de ni dgang gzar mtshan nyid do/ /blugs gzar yu ba khru gang ste/ /mchur ni sor drug zheng dang zabs/ /rdo rje sor gsum pad 'dab mtshungs/ /rin chen sor gcig gsum rdo rje/ /gzhan yang dgang gzar blugs gzar gyi/ /yu ba khru gang bya ba ste/ /'og tu rdo rje rin chen bya/ /de yi dgang gzar rgyar sor bzhi / /zabs su sor bzhi nang rdo rje/ /sor bzhi'i mthar ni rdo rje ste/ /bar du pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs/ /blugs gzar pad dbyibs sor gnyis te//zabs su sor gcig nang rdo rje/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar kha rang gi/ /lha yi sa bon rab 'bar bsam/ /re pha'ang de yi khar dgod bya/ /yang na sor mo lnga dang gsum/ /bcer bas kyang ni bya bar gsungs/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /de bzhin dri yi dung sogs g.yas/ /g.yon du sngags kyi mchod yon snod/ /mdun du snod ni gzhag par bya/ /mchod sbyin shing sogs yal ga las/ /rtse mo mchog ni ma nyams pa/ /bzang po lo ma gnyis ldan pa//las kyi dbye bas dbye bar bya/ /rgyas pa la ni sor bcu bzhi/ /zhi ba sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /dbang la sor bcu sdang ba dang / /gsad pa la yang sor mo brgyad—/ /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /rgun 'brum a mra sgrul 'jigs dang //kha 'dzag skye ma rtse ba ①ni/ /'bras bu rnams kyis ②sbyin sreg bya/ /tsam pa a shwa ka dang glu/ /ka tang pa dang srid sgrub nyid/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bzlas byas nas / /me tog 'dis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /yid kyis mar khu bsam pa dang //'bras so chag med 'bras dang ni/ /'bru dang zho yi zan dang ni/ /til dang de bzhin mnyam pa'i ①shing / /drur ba rab tu gzhon pa nyid/ /bsam gtan 5—629

rdo rjes sbyin sreg bya/ /me tog la sogs rdzas rnams ni/ /las kyi dbye bas kha dog dbye/ /dkar po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /ser po rgyas pa sgrub thabs la//dbang dang dgug par dmar po che/ /tha ma'i las la nag po'o/ /til gyi zhi ba rgyas pa zho/ /tsher mas de bzhin gsad pa la/ /zhe sdang sogs la'ang tsher mar brjod/ /dbang dang dgug la ut+pa la'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil sngags yungs kar bzla/ /khu tshur gnyis kyis 'dod lha la/ /rang gi bskor bas rab bskor bya①/ /gnyis kyi bar du sbyar bar bya/ /cig car khu tshur gnyis dag gis—/ /g.yas su bskor bar yang bya'o/ /sngon bzhin yungs kar me snod la//sbyang bar bya phyir gzhug par bya/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra sahūṃ su sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ sbyang ba'o/ /ye shes rnam shes nang bkug ste/ /snyim pas chu ni blang byas nas/ /bskor te sbyang phyir me ru yang / /nyungs kar bzhin du gzhug par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ ta ṭi ⑤phaṭa nye reg go/ /de nas yo shing la sogs rdzas//gsang la sbyang phyir sngags 'di 'don/ /oṃ shrī swā hā/ mar sbyang ba'i sngags so//oṃ ④/swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra swā hā/ 'bru sbyang ba'i sngags so—/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas gzhan sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a swā hā/yo shing sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /sbyin sreg yan lag las byung zhing / /thab khung bas thung thab khung gzhug /ting nge 'dzin gyis me sbar la/ /yid kyis mar gyi sreg blugs sbyin/ /de ni so sor snang ba ste/ /bsam gtan las byung sku lnga pa//de la zhabs bsil zhal bsil dang / /mchod yon 'thor 'thung rim bzhin dbul—/ /ha cang ring min rtse ma nyams/ /g.yas skor shar nas ku sha dgram//rtse mo phyogs gcig bstan bya te/ /stegs bu'i steng du gzhag par bya/ /tsan+dan 5—630

a ka ru shing ngam/ /gzhan yang dri yi shing dag gis/ /sbyin sreg bya phyir rlung yab kyis/ /me sbar gzi babyed mtshan ma brtag /kha dog dri dang rtse mo 'khyil//gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa yi/ /dge dang mi dge bar gyur te/ /zhi ba kha dog dkar 'bar ba/ /rgyas pa ser po'i rnam pa ste/ /dbang dang mngon spyod dag la ni/ /dmar dang gnag pa'i me ni bsngags/ /brgya byin bzang po'i gzhu 'dra ste/ /g.yas su 'khyil bas mchog yin no/ /ngang pa'i sgra ltar snyan pa dang / /me lce snun zhing rtse mo can/ /sreg blugs bsres pas yon bdag phyir—/ /me ni khong du chud phyir brtag /me stag rnam 'phro du ba mang / /rim gyis 'bar zhing khad kyis 'phro/ /mtha' mar rang 'bar gzi byin can//tsha zhing 'od zer 'phro ba dang / /rtse gsum zhib ma 'dra nyid dang / /de bzhin ba lang 'gro 'dra ba/ /de la sogs pa'i mtshan ngan pa/ /mi dge rnams kyang brtag par bya/ /me yi dbus su bsgom bya ba/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la//spyan gsum zhal bzhi phyag bzhi'i lha/ /gsus chen ral pa'i thor tshugs can//g.yas pa mchog sbyin phreng ba ste/ /g.yon na dbyug pa spyi drugs so/ /las dang rjes mthun kha dog can/ /ra yi skye gnas las byung bsgom/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa—/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ e bye nyi ma hā bhū ①ta de ba ṛ ②ṣi dī dza satwa ma kṛ nyi twa dze+e.a hu ti a ha ra asmi sam+bi hi to bha ba/ mchod ④pa'i tshogs mchod byas la/ /spos khang yongs su bzung byas te/ /'dod don 5—631

dngos grub rtogs bya'i phyir/ /dam tshig yang dag brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā byu ①ta dzā la ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭa ②hūṃ phaṭa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya ste a haṃ/ dam tshig sbyin pa'o/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar bzang po yi /rdo rjes ④mtshan par sa bon bsgom/ /lag pa g.yas pas gzung byas te/ /pus mo'i bar du gnas byas nas/ /ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs rdzas/ /me yi lha la sreg blugs dbul/ /oṃ asna ye swā hā/ mar gye'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya dubadz+ra satwa sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ til nag gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras ma chag pa'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ /zho dang zas mchog gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā be+e gā ya swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā ⑤ya swā hā/ mon sran dre'u'i du'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ gro'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ drur ba gzhon nu'i 'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ ku sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/u dum bā ra'i 'o/ /e bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ byang chub kyi shing gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra la tā ya swā hā/ pa lak+ṣa'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ku be rā ya swā hā/ n+ya gro dha'i 'o//oṃ sa ha ka rā ya swā hā/ a mra'i 'o/ /mthar ni swā hā zhi ba ste/ /rgyas pa'i dus su bo ṣaṭa/ /mthar ni hūṃ phaṭa gsad pa la/ /dgug dang dbang la dzaḥdang byāḥ/ /ci 'byor mchod nas me yi lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas bstod par bya//'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras//me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyang ba'i phyir/ /5—632

thugs rje dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs//rig sngags gsung zhing bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi bcud ldan gudhe bsnams//chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsel/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa bzla/ /bsang gtor bya ste me lha yi/ /thugs kar rang lha bskyed byas la/ /spyan drang ①mchod bstod la sogs bya/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar dag par ②khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun byi don be+ed du/ /bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus 'joms mdzad cing / /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e bye hi bha ga wān ni bha ga tai sa ma ye na tsa ar+ghaṃ lta saṃ pra tīts+tsha sgo rdzu tsar+ya pra se da me/ mchod yon phul te dgug sogs bya/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur legs rdzogs nas/ /mchod dang bstod pa ①nyer spyod sogs/ /sngar bzhin phul nas ye shes me/ /mnyes byas 'dod pa'i don blangs te/ /yi ge brgya pas gshegs su gsol/ /lhag pa'i sdas kyi dgang blugs kyis/ /me lha mchod de gshegs su gsol/ /bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byen za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin du ni duslar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /5—633

oṃ kṛ tā wa sarba satāze ṅga dhir dat+ta ya thā nu gāts+tsha ①tsā burnya bi ṣa ya pu na ya ②muḥ/sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim/ /chim par gyur nas dngos grub ster/ /gsang sngags lhag chad gang yin pa/ /thams cad sbyin sreg dag gis bskong //de phyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro yis/ /sbyin sreg rab tu bsngags par mdzod/ /'dis ni rdo rje mnyes par gyur④/ /ye shes me ni rab dgyes bya④/ /rgyal ba phan pa mnyes pa dang / /gser gyi mnga' bdag mnyes pa dang / /pad+ma gar dbang mnyes pa dang / /lcags mchog rgyal po mnyes pa dang / /tshangs pa brgya byin dbang chen dang / /khyab 'jug rlung dang me chen dang / /thod ldan nyid dang 'dod lha dang / /zla ba nyi ma gdon gzhan dang / /sa ni zhags pas 'dzin pa dang / /lus ngan de bzhin mtshalas skyong dang / /chos rgyal dang ni klu dang ni//dri za lha min mi 'am ci/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa'i lha/ /'og min du ni gnas pa dang / /gang zhig rgyal chen gnas pa dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang bsgyur nyid dang ni/ /'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang / /gang zhig dag pa'i gnas son dang / /'od zer 'jig rten khams gnas dang / /mi mjed khams su gnas pa dang / /gling bzhir gnas pa'i sems can dang / /gang zhig khams gsum gnas pa dang / /snod ldan sems can 'jig rten dang / /lcug ma tshogs dang rtswa sogs dang / /gang dag rab dga'i sar gnas dang / /pha rol dri med gang phyir dang / /'od 'phro ⑤can du gnas pa dang / /mi g.yo'i gnas su byas pa dang / /gang zhig chos sprin rjes son pa/ /gang zhig sbyang dkar song ba dang / /gang zhig ring song thob pa dang / /'od byed du ni gnas pa ste ④/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po dang / /'phags pa'i gang 5—634

zag brgyad po dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos nyid/ /rwa ni ral gri gzugs can dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ /sbyin sreg cho gas dgyes pa nyid/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las sbyin sreg gi bya ba ste dgu pa'o// //sngags tshul rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /yid 'ong srog chags med pa'i gnas—/ /legs sbyar dri zhim chus byugs nas/ /dus dang sbyar te ro ho brtsam—/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bzlas pa yi/ /dri zhim chu yis dang por bkru//de nas rang lha'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rnam snang mdzad du de bsams nas/ /rdo rje sdom pa byin nas kyang / /bum pa'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /mig la sogs la gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor bas/ /sbyin sreg rim pas sbyang bar bya/ /nyi ma dag ni gsum pa na//rus pa'i phreng ba bsdu bar bya/ /'o ma dri bzangs bsang gtor nas/ /de yi mchod rten yang dag brtsam/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las ro hom gyi bya ba ste bcu pa'o// //blo dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /rnal 'byor pho mo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /khyad par can gyi longs spyod kyis/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bsod nams 'dod pa'i sbyin bdag gis/ /dkyil 'khor dri dang me tog bcas//dri yi thig le'ang dbul bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /dam tshig gsol ba ①gzhan gyis kyang / /zhi ba la sogs rab tu bskul/ /snga bar 5—635

dge 'dun chos ston bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas yang mnyes bya/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul bya/ /de yi rjes la tshogs kun la'o/ /gnas der 'tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dbyug sngon can la gsol btab nas/ /skal ldan skal min shes 'gyur bas/ /dang por lung ①dang ngag gi brda/ /lung gis 'dir ni shes par bya/ /gang zhig spun dang sring mo yang / /the tshom med par rnam par shes / /gang gis sor mo gcig ston pa/ /'ongs sam zhes ni 'dri ba yin//gnyis ni legs par 'ongs pa yin/ /mthe bong g.yon pa bcangs pa ni/ /bde ba'i phyag rgyar shes par bya/ /gang zhig ming med ston pa la/ /de yis mthe chung sbyin par bya/ /gang zhig dbus ma ston pa la/ /de yis mdzub mo sbyin par bya/ /gang zhig ming med ston pa la/ /de la mgrin pa rab bstan bya//gang zhig gos ni ston pa la/ /de la rtse gsum rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig nu ma ston pa la/ /de la mtshalas ni rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig sa ni ston pa la/ /de la 'khor lo rab tu bstan/ /gang zhig khro gnyer ston pa la/ /gtsug phud dgrol bar mngon par brjod/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa la/ /de la rgyab ni rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig rkang mthil ston pa la/ /pho long rtse bar rol par bya/ /phyag rgya so so'i phyag rgya'o/ /dam tshig la yang dbye bar bya/ /de tshe rnal 'byor mas smras pa/ /e ma bu ni snying rje che/ /gal te phreng ba'i lag ston na—/ /'du bar bya zhes brjod pa yin/ /phreng bas mngon par gshegs byas la—/ /dam tshig brtul zhugs shin tu mnos/ /ma da na chang ba la sha /ma la ya dza de bzhin du/ /'gro ba khe ṭa ro shra pa/ /rus pa'i rgyan ni ni rang shu//bye kha na shog ces rab can/ kṛ bi ②ta ni cang te'u 'dod/ /du du ra ni skal 5—636

med brjod/ /skal ldan ka lo ①dza ram̐ 'dod/ /reg min din ni saṃ zhes bya//thod pa pad+ma ban dza ②nam/ /zan ni tri pi tri ka re/ /tshod ma ma la ti rda rna//bshang ba tsa tur sa me brjod/ /kastu ri ni gci bar 'dod/ /sih+la rang byung ①shes par bya/ /ka bu ra ni khu bar shes/ /sha chen sha li dza zhes brjod/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor kun du ru/ /bo la rdo rje bshad pa ste/ /kasko la ni pad+mar shes—/ /rigs kyi dbye ba'i dbye ba yis/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga zhes bshad//brda yi skad ni 'di dag la/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya rigs lnga yin/ /g.yung mo rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /gar ma pad+ma'i rigs su 'dod/ /rin chen rigs nyid rang 'tshed ma/ /skye gnyis de bzhin gshegs mar shes/ /las kyi rigs nyid rang 'tshed ma/ /phyag rgya 'di dag dngos grub ster/ /de yi khu ba rdo rje yin / /mchod byas brtul zhugs can gyis btud/ /rdo rje snying po sems dpa' che/ /khyod la nga yis bshad pa gang / /rmad du byung ba brda yi tshig /de dag thams cad dad pas gzung / /kye rdo rje las dbang bskur gang / /brda yi skad ni mi smra na/ /de yi dam tshig nyams par ni/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /yams dang 'tshe ba rkun ma dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyang / /brda yi skad ni mi smra na/ /gal te sangs rgyas yin yang 'chi—/ /rang gi dam tshig shes snyed la/ /gal te tshig 'di mi smra na/ /de la gnas bzhir skyes pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma ni khro bar byed/ /sgrub dus bkra shis dga' ston dang / /dam tshig gso ba'i cho ga sogs/ /yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /tshes brgyad kyi ni dus dag la/ /dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang / /de bzhin mi ma yin gyi gnas/ /yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar//5—637

ston mo 'di dag brtsam par bya/ /der ni rtag tu brtag par bya/ /dung chen dgu dang ro yi gzugs/ /yang na stag gi pags pa dang / /de bzhin dur khrod ras dbus su/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha dmigs nas/ /bzang po rgyan kyis rnam par brgyan/ /thams cad 'byor ba'am dmigs nas ni/ /be+ems po'i gnas su sreg blugs bya/ /shar lho byang dang dag phyogs su/ /phyogs gnas rnams ni dga' bar bya/ /phyogs bral rnams su lha mo rnams/ /dam pa'i tshe yis mchod par bya/ /lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /rgyal mtshan mtshon bsnun bdun 'khor dang / /rgyal po shā li la sogs rdzas/ /ji bzhin byin brlab ①rim pa ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas mchod par byasde/ /der ni ma dang sring mo dang / /sring mo'i bu mo sgyug mo ste/ /de nas rgyas par mchod byas nas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'grub par 'gyur/ /thod pa chen po cha gcig pa/ /chang ni bzang pos bkang byas te/ /bla ma la dbul skal ldan ma/ /phyag btsal nas ni bdag btud bya//pad+ma'i lag pas blang bar bya/ /lag pa de nyid kyis ni dbul/ /der ni sgrub pa po yis ④phyag /yang dang yang du bya ba'o/ /gru gar dngos grub rgyur gsungs pas/ /de dag gis kyang mchod par bya/ /kasko lar gnas bo la ste//muṣ+ṭha ni kye kak+ko la/ /kye khyod kri pi ta brdung ba/ /snying rje ku co dumi byed do//der ni ba la bza' bar bya/ /bsdams par ⑤ma da na btung ngo / /kye ka li dza ni gzhug par bya/ /du du ra ni spang bar bya/ /tsa u sa ma ka sbra ri/ /ga bur sih+las byug par bya/ /shā li ma la ti rda rna/ /der ni rkang pa bza' bar bya//phreng ba khan dang khe ta byed/ /dag dang ma dag mi blta'o/ /ni re su yis yan 5—638

lag brgyan/ /der ni shra pa rnam par gzhug /ma la dza ni kun du ru/ / din rda ①me ni der mi spang ④/ /he ru ka yi gzugs kyis gar/ /dran pa ma yengs rnal 'byor bya'o/ /bsgom par zhen pa'i sems kyis bya/ /chags dang ldan zhing goms pa'i sems/ /rdo rje chos dang sangs rgyas te/ rnal 'byor ma yis mi mo yi / /glu dang gar ni 'di dag ste/ /mchog tu glu blang gar bya'o//'di nyid kyis ni 'khor bsrung zhing / /de bzhin bdag kyang bsrung ba ste/ /'di yis 'jig rten dbang du byed/ /'di nyid sngags kyi bzlas pa ste/ /gang du dad pas glu blang dang / /gang du dad pas gar bya ba/ /tshogs kyi bdag pos sngon byas te/ /de la dri ni brtag par bya/ /dang por sgog pa la sogs dri//de nas yang ni bya rgod dri/ /de rjes ga pur ma la dza/ /glu yis byin rlabs mchan nyid do/ /ngang pa'i skad dang bung ba'i skad/ /glu yis rjes su thos 'gyur te/ /ce spyang gi ④ni skad dag dang / /phyi rol tshal du brtag par bya//sgrub pa po dang rnal 'byor mas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ston mo ni/ /gang du zos na dngos grub ni/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub byed pa'o/ /de ltar glu gar bkra shis dang / /spyon lam cho ga kun rdzogs nas/ /yan lag rgyan rnams kyis brgyan te/ /rdo rje dril bu blangs nas ni/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor legs ldan pas—/ /phud dang lhag ma kun bsres la/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor gtor ma gtang rjo/ /de rjes sbyor ldan bde bar gnas/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las tshogs kyi mchod pa'i bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //mkhas pas gnas dang dus kun du/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed 5—639

dang / /bgegs ni zad cing zhi bya'i phyir/ / gtor ma rgyun du sbyin par bya/ /①rlung me thod pa la gnas pa/ /lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /'bar dang sgod pa la sogs bsgrub②/ /de nas phyogs gnas rnams dang ni/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /g.yas pas rdo rje gsor bya zhing / /g.yon pas dril bu dkrol bya zhing / /phyag rgya sgyur ba'i rigs pas sgod①/ /lta stangs dang ni dgra bgegs sgod/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i stang rjostabs kyis/ /shar gyi gnas ni mnan par bya/ /rim pa 'di nyid kyis ni gzhan/ /sgo nas dag gis kyang ni mnan/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon dag gis/ /rol dang bcas pas mtha' sogs spro/ /cung zad bskyod ⑤pa'i sdigs mig dang / /bcas pas smin ma rnam par bskyod/ /'gro ba dbang du byed pa'i rgya/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang ba/ /g.yas bskum pa dang g.yon bskum pa'o/ /slob dpon gtso bo rdor 'chang gis/ /sbyor ba can sngags phyag rgya ste/ /pus stabs gtso bo rkang stabs dang / /bskor ba'i stabs dang zlog pa'i stabs/ /oṃ hūṃ phaṭa shar sgo'i 'o/ /pus reg stabs dang g.yon 'debs rjostabs/ /bskor stabs seng ge'i mchongs stabs so/ /oṃ hūṃ stosaphaṭa/ lho sgo yi'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang dang / /sa ga rlum po'i stang ⑦stabs so/ /oṃ hūṃ e saṃ saṃ phaṭa/ nub sgo yi'o/ /mthun pa'i stabs dang mi mthun stabs//gcig bsdus g.yon bcang ④rkang stabs mchog /oṃ ha na mā ra duṣ+ṭi ghā ta ya/ābyuhūṃ s+thāḥhūṃ phaṭa/ byang gi sgo yi'o/ /dri yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ /me tog dkar sogs mchod byas te/ /dri dang 'bras mar ⑨kha ra zho/ /sbrang rtsi mar ldan shar sgor sbyin/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rgyab dang rgyab 5—640

tu sbyar byas te/ /mthe chung lu gu rgyud bcings nas/ /zhags pa'i tshul sbyar mdzub gnyis stel/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya 'di/ /lha rnams dgug par byed pa'o/ /oṃ ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ ā rgyu mo ①dang ni rgyu chen mo/ /nyin dang zla ba dngos grub bzhin/ /lta ④rgyal mo dang zla rgyal mo/ /lha mo u ma gang gā dang ①/ /gzugs mdzes skar ma 'dus pa dang //gza' tshogs kun dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /karti ka dang dpal ldan mo/ /lha mo ri bong can 'dzin ma/ /a ka la dang u pa gal/ /lha min lha yi rgyal po rnams//sbos mo dang ni sbos chen mo/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /hūṃ he hoḥ.ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya sa ma ya dhi be hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dgug pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid sdigs mdzub gnyis dkrol ba/ /tshim par byed pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /se gol gsum brdabs sngags 'dis btang / /oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha rdzu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de dag ni lha'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /nub tu dri yi dkyil 'khor la/ /me tog ser dang dkar pos mchod/ /'o ma khrag bsres mngar gsum dang / /'o mas bkang ba'i gser snod dbul/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang / /sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya/ /oṃ ba ta la mi hā ta la ba rjohūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no//lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che⑤/ / dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /dube con chen po hu yin dang / /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang //dpal gyi 'od dang 'od chen po/ /rjes su 'od dang mdzes pa dang / /mdzes 5—641

chen po dang sbrul bzangs dang / /stobs po che dang tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po pa rnams dag /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya ma hā nā gā dhi pa ti sarba bhu ra bhu ①bye phu swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /mthe bong mthe chung bgreng bar bya/ /lag pa g.yas ni bar phye ste//sgrul gyi gdugs kyi tshul du sbyar/ /oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha rdzu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/klu rnams dga' byed sngags phyag rgya/ /se gol gsum gtogs gtor bar bya//de dag ni klu'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /byang du dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ /tsan+dan dmar po la sogs bya/ /me tog dmar sogs nye bar brgyan/ /sā lu'i 'bras chan sbrang rtsi zho/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan snod bdun gzhag /'dod rgyal phyag rgya sngags 'dis dgug /oṃ nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / /bde ba bzang dang rgyal ba bzang / /dga' ba'i phur bu phur bu che/ /phur bu bzang dang pad+ma'i gtsug /dung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni/ /gar chen ②dang ni 'be+egs byed ma/ /gcod byed ma dang rdzogs byed ma/ /nor dang nor kun nor bzang mo/ /gzugs bzang rol dang rol chen mo/ /bzhad dang rtse dang rnam par bskyod/ /dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug bka' 'di yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi bha dru ya swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dru ya swā hā/ oṃ da na bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ be+e shra ba ④ṇa ya swā hā/ oṃ pi dzi rjokuṇ+ḍa li ṣ+pe swā hā/oṃ ki li mi li ni ya swā hā/ oṃ mun ke tra ya ⑤swā hā/ oṃ dza rjolen+d+ra ye swā hā/nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / /nor sbyin bdag dang rnam thos sras/ /rgyal ba bzang po rol mo'i phreng / /bzhin gyi dbang po 'gro ba'i dbang / /de dag la sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma sbyin pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs//5—642

gnod sbyin ①gnod sbyin mo spyan 'dren/ /hūṃ te hoḥ①ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya sa ma ya ti be hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje bcings bskor snying gar gzhag /sngags 'dis mnyes par byas la btang / /oṃ da na ti ba ti ba ti la bye ④swā hā/ de la gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /rdo rje stabs kyis dulhor gnas te/ /tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pas/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas⑤/ /der ni me tog dmar po dgram/ /nya skam dang ni sha skam dang / /sgog pa'i bi khu khrag gi snod/ /til gyi tshwa mig khu ba rnams/ /khyad par du ni bdud rtsi lnga//rnam pa sna tshogs bza' ba dang / /sran ma lnga dang sran chan gyis/ /gang ba'i snod ni mdun du gzhag /'dod rgyal phyag rgya sngags 'dis dgug /oṃ ba ta li ma hā ba ta li/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dab dang lam dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khyim stong dang / /snod dang thang dang sa steng dang / /khyad par gdol pa'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ / lha sbyin dhimanyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po 'jigs byed 'jigs byed pa/ /dga' ba las 'das bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang dbu mar bstod/ /rgyal mo rnam par rgyal mo dang / /thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ⑦ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo ④dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag mo sdang ba lam ba ki/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo gzugs chen ma dang ni/ /mche ba gtsigs pa thod chen ma'o/ /thod phreng ba dang kha ṭī ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu 5—643

lag dang / /lha yi dbang phyug ma rnams dang / /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid dang //las kun rjes sgrub byed pa yi/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /rdul med sbyor ba skye med ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'ong bar byos/ /oṃ kak+ka bhā na bharnya ①na/ /ba khā ②da na sarba duṣ+ṭi①/ ha na ha na ghā ta ya che ge mo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ khams gsum rnam rgyal rgya bcings te/ /mdzub gnyis lu gu rgyud byas la/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha rjohūṃ hūṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di yis bya/ /se gol gsum gyis gtang bar bya'o/ /de dag ni 'byung po'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /'byung po chen po'i gtor ma ni/ /lung gis rim par bshad par bya/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi nang gnas pa/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsgom par bya/ /shar gyi 'dab mar brgya byin bsam—/ /lhor ni mthar byed dgod par bya/ /chu bdag nub kyi 'dab ma la//de bzhin byang du nor sbyin dgod/ /me yi mtshams la me chen po/ /bden bral du ni srin po'o/ /nub byang mtshams su rlung lha ste/ /dbang ldan mtshams su 'byung po'i bdag /zla ba nyi ma tshangs la sogs/ /dam pa tshangs ris rnams dang ni/ /tshangs pa mdun na 'don pa dang / /dga' ldan dang ni 'tshe ma dang / /yang dag par byung rgyal chen ⑤dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang ni byed pa dang / /'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang / /gtsang ma'i gnas la gnas pa dang / /bde chen yang dag gnas pa dang / /mi chung bar ni gnas pa dang / /'od zer can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa rnams—/ /de dag thams cad steng du dgod/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas nang 5—644

gnas pa/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /mtha' yas nor rgyas de bzhin te/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan dang / /pad chen shin du pad+ma dang //lha min dmyal ba sems can rnams/ /chos 'byung smad ①du bsam par bya/ /yi ge oṃ las tshangs la sogs/ /brgya byin la sogs hūṃ yig las/ /stobs kyi rgyu sogs a yig ste/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa'o/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po ste/ /dbang po la sogs nag po'i mdog /stobs kyi rgyu sogs dmar po che/ /rang mdog rig mas yan lag 'khyud/ /lag na rdo rje dril bu bcas—/ /stan la g.yas brkyang yang dag gnas/ /tshangs sogs rtag pa'i phyag rgyas gdab/ /brgya byin la sogs rdo rje yis/ /gar dbang gis ni stobs rgyu sogs/ /thams cad rigs gsum las skyes pa/ /go rī yis ni dgug byas la—/ /chom rkun mas ni zhags pas bcing / /ro langs mas ni lcags sgrog sdom—/ /za phod mas ni dril bus dbang / /de nas mchod yon zhabs bsel sbyin / /cho gas gtor ma bsgrub par bya/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor la//a las byung ba'i pad snod bsam/ /'bar ba dang ni khros pa yis/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bsgrub par bya/ /chu yi rang bzhin 'di bsgoms nas/ /oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs la btang / oṃ an+da ②dza ma dza la dzak+ṣa bhū ④ta baji/ ba u rak+ṣarjo/tsan+da sudz+dza mā da pathra ta la bā tā dul aṣ+ṭa sa pa swā hā⑥/ i rda ba bo bhu dza dzi gha ⑦phul+la dhuthra sgermā sa dzi gha am+bha saspa ⑨kadz+dza sā dha kharnyi khya ṇi phe ḍa gha ta ⑫oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā shā ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ oṃhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rab tu mchod de bstod nas ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgo nas kyang / /de nas dgyes byas gshegs gsol ba/ /yi ge brgya pa bya ba ste/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/5—645

badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ phyo me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/ sha shwa to me bha ba①/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ z-i da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sirnyim+bi pra yats+tsha—/ sarba karma su tsa me tsita haṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān mā me muñtsa badz+re bha ba ②ma hā sa ma ya satwa umuḥ mkhas pas gtor mas mchod byas nas/ /lha mnyes 'byung po kun legs byed/ /'khor ba legs 'gyur bde rnyog med/ /zhi rgyas dbang sogs las rnams 'grub/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las gtor ma'i bya ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //mkhas pas gong du gsungs pa yi/ /gtor ma la sogs dus dag tu/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yi/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod par bya/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri yi dung sogs g.yas su gzhag /g.yon du mchod yon mdun ①du snod/ /bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs la dbul/ /dang por chu gtsang nyid kyis ni/ /bsang gtor rab tu dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ/ gnyis pa dri yi chu yis ni/ /zhabs bsil dag ni dbul bar bya—/ /oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ khaṃ/ gsum pa la ni 'o ma mngar/ /zhal bsel du ni dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe bibye t+pahūṃ swā hā/ bzhi par mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis ni/ /me tog dag ni dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pu྾ uhūṃ/ dri med dag cing yid 'ong bar/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag ni dad pas dbul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ ma hā ā m+bi ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas 5—646

bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu྾ sgo dzā me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri yi bdug spos rnams—/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pa pū dzā ①me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa/ /dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lo ke pū dzā sdeme gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gadhe pū ①dzā me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan ni/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta/ sel snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs//dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta④/ sarba budha k+ṣe tra prarnye rjopā ra mi tā rjonā da swa bhā be de badz+ra dharmā/ z-i da ya ni sarnyo ṣa ni phri hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ thod pa rdzas kyis rab bkang ba/ /rlung me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /thabs dang shes rab ye shes lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rab bsgrubs te/ / sbom po ⑦mtha' ltag rtse sbyar la/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /mthe bo'i thor mas so sor dbul/ /de yi dbus nas blangs nas ni/ /rang gis ④bdud 5—647

rtsi'i ro myang bya/ /oṃ 〉byuhūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a thra ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolha①haṃ—/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rked pa'i mtshalas su gzhag par bya//khro bo sgeg dang bzhad pa dang / lus ni dgug pa gsum ltar gzhag /me tog bskyur ba'i tshul gyis dang / / spos la yal ga'i sbyor ba dang / /②sdong bus mar me mchod pa dang / /byug pa'i lus kyis rjes su dris/ /sgeg mo lag dze+epas sgeg mos te/ /phreng ba phreng ba'i mkha' 'gre ma/ /glu yi hūṃ gi dam tshig hūṃ/ /brla bskum pas ni gar nyid do/ /pi wang tshul gyis steng dhib dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis bud pa dang / /bud pa'i tshul gyis bud pa dang / /ṅgal snyan tshul gyis dkrol ba dang / /brdab pa'i tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / / gar byi ⑤tshul byis yan lag bskyod/ /rlung yab tshul rmis g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis ⑦bsgreng ba dang / /bla re'i tshul byis bre ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang / /gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang / /cang te'u tshul gyis dkrol ba dang / /'khar rnga'i tshul gyis brdung ba dang / /bzhad pa'i tshul kyis 'dzum pa dang / /khro ba'i tshul gyis khro ba dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /bsgying ba'i tshul gyis bsgyings pa dang / /'da' 'dren nu ma 'khyud pa dang / /rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang ni/ /phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa'o/ /gau rī ri bong can 'dzin cing / /chom rkun ma ni nyi ma'i snod//ro langs ma ni lag na chu/ /za phod ma ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje ste—/ /ri khrod ma ni ro yi sdod/ /gtum mos cang te'u brdung bar bya/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mo phrag nas 'khyud pa'o/ /de rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /de ltar rgya cher mchod nas no/ /blo dang ldan 5—648

pas bstod pa bya/ /bcom ldan yon tan rab brjod pas/ /'di'ang mchod pa'i yan lag yin/ /mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag nyid/ /dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen chen por rab tu grags / /ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya//de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags nyid/ /rdo rje chos ni de bzhin gshegs/ /reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod 'bras bu stsol pa'o/ /glu ni rdo rje can la dbul—/ /gar ni sangs rgyas rnams la dbul/ /nyi ra mchog la de bzhin dri//'jig rten mchog la bza' dang bca'/ /gos kyi mchod pa rta mchog la/ /'di rnams mchod pa dam pa ste/ /rdo rje mchod pa byas pa yis/ /rdo rje can kun mnyes par byed/ /a ka ru nag kye rdo rje/ /phan pa la ni tsan+dan dkar/ /dmar po 'jig rten rje la dbul/ /gur kum rdo rje snang ba la/ /bdun gyi rgyal po thams cad de/ /hūṃ rdo rje las byung ba'i dri/ /'di rnams dri yis rab sbyor bas/ /dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob po/ /kha dang tsha ①ba rdo rjer dbul// mngar ba rdo rje rtag la dbul/ /①skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lan tshwa 5—649

'jig rten dbang / /rta yi rgyal po thams cad dam/ /bska ba yang ni rab brtag bya/ /kye yi rdo rje rdor can gyikho/ /me tog mdog nag rkang thung 'byung / /mal+li ka dang mi ②la ti/ /kun da sangs rgyas rtag tu dbul/ /shing gi dbang mchog dri med mchog /snang byed la ni sbyor bar bya①/ /dbang mchog dmar po'i chu skyes dang / /ban+d+ra dmar po pa ta lo/ /pad+ma gar kyi dbang la dbul//rta mchog rdo rje can la dbul/ /rdo rje theg pas mnyes byed pa/ /'di ni don dam mchod pa yin/ /gang gi rnam rtog rnam spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgoms shing rjo/ /lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa/ /de yi mchod pa bla na med/ /sems can gang gis dbu ma yi/ /theg pa bsgom pa ma bsgoms na//theg pa dman la lhag mos pas/ /de yi mchod pa kun rdzob yin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin du/ /bzlas dang bsgom la mngon dga' zhing / /rtag tu 'khor lo'i pha rol 'gro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed pas/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam las mchod pa'i bya ba ste bcu gsum pa'o// //sa gsum gang yin dri bcas de yi phyir/ /de las 'das pa dam pa'i yid brtan nas/ /shes rab thabs ldan rgyal ba'i lam gcig nyid/ /zab cing rgya che rtog ge'i yul ma yin/ /de phyir bla ma'i man ngag brgyud rim gyis/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po bdud rtsi bcud kyi mdzod/ /sngags tshud rgya mtsho'i lam ni mdor bsdus pa/ /kye yi rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam/ gang zhig rten cing 'byel pa'i chos 'di dag /rgyu rkyen tshogs las 'bras bu tha dad pa/ /chos nyid kyis thob nus pa bsam las 'das/ /de 'dra'i kun rdzob chud son mi byed cing / /de 5—650

ltar rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba'i phyir/ /dam pa'i don du rang bzhin med rtogs pa'i—/ /shes rab nor gyis ma pham de dag la/ /rin chen 'bar 'dis brgyan pa mdzes 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig kun rdzob rgyu 'bras chud son ①cing / /don dam tshul la mi mkhas rmongs gyur pa/ /shes rab nor med dbul po de dag la/ /mdzes par mi 'gyur mi ro brgyan pa 'dra/ /mkhas pa bdag 'dzin zhen pa'i mdud bkrol te/ /bdag gzhan bla med byang chub bsgral ba'i phyir/ /snying rje'i go bgos shes rab thabs ldan pas/ /lus ngag yid kyis mi bya yod ma yin//de phyir dam pa'i grogs kyis gsol btab pas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi lam srol rnyil ba nas/ /shes rab mig dang rigs ⑧pa'i rkang pa yis/ /legs brtags bgrod ④la nyes pa'i 'jigs bral 'di/ /byas la bsod nams thob pa gang yod des/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs lam 'di nas/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho myur brgal te/ /kye yi rdo rje'i go 'phang myur thob shog /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam ④rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //slob dpon mkhas pa chen po pradzñā in+t+ra ru ci'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so—/ / //rgya gar gye mkhan po de nyid dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //5—651

〈〈snar 〉〉sna ta/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wa.aṣ+ṭa sa pa swā hā/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉nyam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mosab spa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snga'i da/646 ①〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉mi sha shwa to me bha ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wabadzi bha ba/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉kayon/647 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mdza/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ka pu dza/ ①〈〈pe 〉sngagarnya ku/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gad+dha pu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ṇa pra ra ṇa saṃ pra ra ṇa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pradzñā/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbos mo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stago/648 ①〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉wahwa/ ②〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉waspos la yal ga'i sbyor ba dang / / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pags/rjo〈〈co 〉gsang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ringal gri'i/ du〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉wagayob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan gyis/649 ①〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉〉tswa/ ②〈〈pe 〉posnar 〉〉wamangar ba rdo rje rtag la dbul/ /65 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉44 ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stab/ ③〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉byed/ bu〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉gig651 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagason/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rig ①〈〈pe 〉〉brtags/ 〈〈snar 〉〉par brtags/ me〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉las/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (73)5wa 655

0147༄ga /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra e ka dṛsbyi ②bī ra sā ①dha rgo/bod skad du/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang goms ro ni myangs tsam gyis/ /srid pa yi ni 'ching ba 'di/ /rab tu spong ba'i yon tan rnams/ /'gugs byed he ru ka la 'dud/ /snga dro'i dus su mal nas langs te/ snying gar re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bltas la④—/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid dri ma med par byas la/rjo oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrungs la/ bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs te/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ zhes pas maṇ+ḍal der lag pa gzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra me di ni badzi bha ba brtse hūṃ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab po/ /oṃ tshihūṃ zhes brjod de dbus su me tog gtor ro/ /shar du 5—656

gi go rī na maḥzhes pas me tog gtor ro/ /lho ru rtsa tso rī na maḥ①/ nub tu baṃ beṭ+wā li ②na maḥ/ byang du hūṃ ghasma rī na maḥ①/ dbang ldan du paṃ puk+ka sī nā dumaḥ/ byin zar shaṃ sha ba rī nā maḥ/ bden bral du lo tsaṇ+ḍa lī nā ⑤maḥ/rlung du ḍi ḍom+bi ⑦nī nā maḥ/ zhes bya ba de rnams kyis me tog gtor ro/ /de nas yang oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das ⑦mchod la/ oṃ a ā i sde⑧/ u khru ṛ dzā ⑨lo shā e i o au e aḥ⑩swā hā/zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das la mchod do/ /de nas rkang pa brgyad kyis kyang mchod de/ oṃ aṣ+ṭha ⑪na nā ya na maḥ/ oṃ dzi gon+d+ra ke sha wakhyu ⑫ṣ+pe na maḥ/ oṃ tsa tubo sha ti ṣ+pe ⑫tā ya na maḥ/ oṃ kho ḍa sha byu ④dzā ya na maḥ/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa dz+re mū ta wa pu ṣe na maḥ/ oṃ ka pā la mā lā ṣ+pe/ ka dha ⑫ri ṇi na maḥ/ oṃ asgro ta hrū ra byu ya na maḥ/ oṃ a: n+d+ra rdat+tha ṇi na maḥ/ de nas yang / oṃ badz+ra pu྾ ā hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra byu྾ āXhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe āXhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe ā hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe byu ti ⑩āXhūṃ—/ zhes pas mngon par bsngags pa'i me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas phyag byas te gtor ma phul la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes bya bas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa tshad med pa bzhi cung zad bsgoms nas/ chos thams cad blos dmigs te/ so sor brtags nas rang bzhin med cing / 'od gsal bar bsgoms la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kolhahaṃ/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab po/ /de'i mthar re las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ a dang ⑩hūṃ gnyis bltas nas/ de'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams mtha' gtugs pa na gnas pa'i sems 5—657
