pa byas pa'i steng du ril bu ste/ kun du bsten pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa dang po'i chos kyi sku nyid do/ /de'i steng du ril bu gzhan ni chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid do/ /de nas zhi ba la sogs pa'i las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog gi ①ril bu tsan+dan la sogs pa rnams kyis bsgo bar bya'o/ /kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i sngags bzla bas ni bdud rtsi lnga dang sgon ma lnga yis sbyangs te—/ myur bar lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i ngo bor bsgoms nas / a yig las skyes pa'i nyi mas de byin gyis brlab po/ /g.yon pa'i sor mo pad+ma'i 'dam ma'i rnam par gsal ba la/ dang po'i dbyangs yongs su gyur pa las ri dwags mtshan pa ste/ des byin gyis brlab cing / so sor shes rab dang / thabs kyi rang bzhin de dag gi dbus su/ bgrang phreng bzung nas—/ kye rdo rje'i gzugs kyi ②bar ma chad par mngon par 'dod pa'i lha'i ngo bor ram/ thams cad ril bur bsgom par bya'o/ /ak+ṣa ru kā ra rgya tu a so hi a man+ta bi sa ru ga ni sne.a saṃ kha a li sedz+dza i ta tu bi sa ru oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dzñā na sarba budha ma han+dha be ta hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.ā swā hā/ zhes pas byen gyis brlabs la/ brgyad lhag pa'i brgyar bsgyur ba'i sngags bzlas pas kyang byin gyis brlab bo zhes pa rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de'i rjes su stong pa nyid dang snying rje dag dbyer med par lhag par mos pas/ g.yas pa'i lag pas zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi las rnams la/ grangs ji lta bar sdigs mdzub dang / gung mo dang / ming med dang / mthe'u chung rnams su bgrang phreng gi phreng ba gzhag ④pa yang / mthe bong gi rtse mo rdo rje lcags kyu'i ngo bor bsgoms te/ lha dgug pa'i bsam pas drang bar byas nas sngags bzlas 5—1271

par bya ste/ myur du 'grub par byed do/ /dam tshig dag ni bsten pa dang / /rnal 'byor sgom ①par byed pa dang / /sngags bzlas pa la sogs pa yis/ /myur du 'bras bu ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes pas/ dam tshig 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ sems can rnams la snying brtse ba dor bar mi bya ba dang / gzhan la tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa med par gleng bar mi bya ba dang / mngon spyod kyi las mi bya ba dang / 'jigs pa dang zhum pa dang khro ba la sogs pa yongs su spang ba dang / rnyed pa dang bkur ste la sogs pa'i don du bdag gi yon tan bsgrags par mi bya ba dang / phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor dang sngags rnams rang gi rtog pa tsam kyis mi bya ba dang / bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i sna tshogs pa'i sngags dang lha rnams kyang dbye ba med par gzung bar bya zhing /yul gang du/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams las be+er chos dang cho ga thob par bya ba dang / bza' bya dang /bza' bya ma yin pa la sogs pa rnams rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag par mos par bya ba dang / 'jig rten la gnod pa rnams rjes su bsrung ba la 'jug par goms par bya ba dang / bya ba ngan par spyod pa rnams drangs te/ bdag gi nang gi nang du thob par bya ba dang / sgom pa po bdag rnal 'byor pa dang /rnal 'byor ma'i bdag nyid du the tshom za ba de rnams kyi ①mthong bar 'gyur ba'i don sgong ba dang / brda rnams la bdag goms par ⑦bya ba dang / ji ltar tshogs pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dag pas bsten par bya ba dang / bud med rnams gdung bar mi bya zhing khyad par du phyag rgya'i gzungs ma la tshig ngan dumi bya ba dang / mtshan ma'i rnam pa dang / bza' ba 5—1272

rnams la 'gom par mi bya ba dang / chom rkun gyi ①grogs spang bar bya ba dang /bdud rtsi lnga dang sgon ma lnga nag po'i tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la ril bur byas nas grib ma la bskams te/ thod pa'i snod kha sbyor du gzhag cing ji lta bar bdud rtsir byas nas nyi ma so sor bsten par bya ba dang / rtsa ba'i rtsang ba bcu bzhi dang / sbom po'i ltung ba brgyad rnams 'bad pas spang bar bya ste/ de rnams ni rab tu grags pa nyid yin pas ma bris so/ /de rnams dang gzhan yang dam tshig gi khyad par rmad du byung ba rnam pa mang po de dang de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis ②rgyud rnams su gsungs pa rnams grub pa rnams kyis kyang rab tu spros so—/ /de ltar rtogs par byas nas 'gom par mi bya zhing / dam tshig smra bar yang mi bya'o zhes pa'o/ /brtag pa gnyis pa la sogs rgyud rnams su/ de yi thabs ni rnam pa du ma zhig /mthong nas rnam pa sna tshogs mngon rtogs dang / /sgrub pa'i thabs rnams gzhan yang 'bad par byas/ /srog dang 'dra ba'i bla med bla ma dang / /don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang / /cung zad dag ni bskul bar gyur pa las/ /'di ni bdag gis rab tu bkod pa yin/ /rang nyid gzugs brnyan 'dra yang bskul ba las/ /thub pa'i dgongs pa cung zad 'chad pa gang / /de ni ngan pa'i spyod pa nyid yin te/ /ltung ba dang bcas dmyal ba rnams su 'gyur/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i thig le 'di byas la//bdag gis dge ba nye bar bsgrubs ①pa gang / /de yis myur du dpal ldan kye rdo rje'i/ /rnal 'byor snod du bdag dang 'jig rten gyur// //rnam par grags pa'i mkhas pa gnas brtan shākya srung ④ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i thig le 'di rdzogs so// //5—1273

lung rigs kyi dbang phyug skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug gi nor bu/ dpal ldan byang chub rtse mo'i bka' drin las/ brda sprod pa'i tshul la blo'i snang ba cung zad thob pa shākya'i btsun pa skyob pa dpal bzang po zhes bya bas bsgyur ba'o// //rgyud rgyal rin chen 'byung gnas bsrubs pa las/ /'byung ba'i nor bu rim gnyis 'od dkar can/ /gang 'dis bod yul gdul bya'i ku mud tshal/ /rgyas par bya phyir skyob pa dpal bzang pos/ /bsgyur las byung ba'i dge ba rab dkar ba/ /de yis 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /paṇ+ḍi ta la ma gtugs pa dang / rgya dpe gnyis pa'ang ma rnyed pas nongs pa'i cha mchis pa rnams mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas sbar bcos shing nyes pa'i cha rnams 'dor bar bya'o①// //bsdur mchan/1216 tūmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+ku'i rdo rje'i mngon rtog thig le bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉smugams/1217 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra sa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skab ma/1218 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ṅkabadag ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gipa/ rjo〈〈pe〉sko' ra 〉sko〈co 〉7la/1219 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zo'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉thaskyed/122༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rigi/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉sko〈co 〉'a/1221 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mis/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉tha/ ①〈〈pe 〉skortesnar 〉mgo1222 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rinyid/ ④〈〈pe 〉riskyed/ 〈〈snar 〉miskyad/ ①〈〈pe 〉ṅkanag 〈'ar 〉lngan/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa dag ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉lkegs/1223 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)sa/5—1274

1269 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rta/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskor/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉7) yang / 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stan/⑤me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wadang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanag127 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dbab/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brgyas/1271 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagos/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag1272 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapar/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhin/1273 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrung /1274 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mnu'o/brtsar 'bras re'u migargyud/ (99)5—1277

༄ga /chos spyod mdor bsdus pa'i bya ba bzhugs so//①༄4/ /dpal dgyes pa'i snerdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di'i lam du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas dang por lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba'i ngang du nyal nas—/ nang par tho rangs khar tshad med pa'i lha mo bzhis tshad med pa'i glus bskul nas langs te khrus byas nas nang du gnas te/ bdud rtsi dang ba'i rnam lngas sems dang bas maṇ+ḍal legs par byas te byug pa bya zhing / ngag tu badz+ra re khe ①hūṃ zhes byas pas sa gzhi byen gyis brlabs nas/ de nas me tog gcig maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su gzhag /srung 0ba'i phur bu stod khro bo smad phur pa gcig tu bsams la bsrung ngo / /me tog gcig rang gi mgor bzhag nas lus bsrungs pa dudang / de nas lag pa bkrus nas/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes pas me tog gcig dbus su bzhag pas gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ shar du go rī na maḥzhes pas me tog gcig gzhag /de bzhin du lho dang nub dang 5—1278

byang dang shar lho lho nub nub byang dang byang shar mtshams su rim pa bzhin du/tso rī na maḥ/ be tā ①lī na maḥ/ ghasma rī na maḥ/ puk+ka sī na maḥ/ sha ba rī na maḥ/ tsaṇ+ḍa byā na maḥ/ ḍom+bi smi na maḥ/ zhes pas me tog dgram pa dang /der lha mo re re mos pa tsam kyis bskyed de/ mchod pa ②rim pa bzhin du bshams nas/ bris sku la sogs pa legs par bkram nas/ stan bde ba la sogs par 'dug ste/ rang nyid mos pa'i lhar bsams pa'i snying gar/ paṃ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po bsams la/ lus kyis rdo rje dril bu gzung / ngag tu oṃ he badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes brjod pas sems kyis hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / dra ba dang / ra ba dang / gur du bsams la oṃ he badz+ra la gong gi sngags rak+ṣa la sogs pa sbyar/ bsam pas lus thams cad rdo rje'i rnam par bya ba dang / oṃ badz+ra badz+ra la dzi hwa la sogs pa sbyor bas ngag rdo rjer bsams pa dang / oṃ he badz+ra yo ga rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/sems rdo rje'i rnam par song bar bsams ①pa ni sems srung ba'o/ /de nas mchod pa thams cad la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra pu྾ t+pahūṃ zhes pa la sogs pa gang du brjod cing me tog dang spos dang mar me dang dri chab dang lha bshos rnams so so'i rdzas bsnams par byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod yon la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥṭ+wā hā—/ zhabs bsel la ni ri ti khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas tshogs kyi lha spyan drang ba ni/ lus kyis rdo rje dril bu gzung nas/ ngag tu/spyod ni rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje mi phyed ci bzhed pa//mchog tu dgyes par gshegs nas kyang / /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol//5—1279

zhes brjod la bsam pas snying ga'i pad+ma'i hūṃ las 'od ①'phros pas/ 'od kyis bla ma dang kye'i rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ de la mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dang / gdan rnams phul la maṇ+ḍal byu steng du bzhugs su gsol/de nas dang po'i bla ma'i byun mtshams su shes pa gtad la bla ma la phyag bya ba dang /mchod pa bya ba'o/ /de nas yid kyis gtso bo'i zhabs la spyi bos gtugs la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dag par bsam pa dang / lus kyis phyag bya gsung /tshig brjod cing phyag bya'o/ /de nas mchod par dbul ba ni/ dang po mi'i mchod pa rdzas rim par bshams pa yod na de dbul/ med na rang gi snying ga nas phyi'i mchod pa'i lha mo sprul la dbul/ ngag tu brjod pa ni/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ /gus pa mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ hūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i bdug spos 'di/ /gus pas mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ hūṃ/ gdon rnams rab 'joms shis pa yi/ /dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di/ /gus pas mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ hūṃ/ nags tshal chu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /dri zhim chu yi ①lha yi chu/ /gus pas mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ hūṃ/ sman rnams bcud ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /gus pas mchog gis bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wi bye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pas mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /da ni nang gi mchod pa ni ④rang gi snying ga nas/ lha mo brgyad 5—1280

spros pa ni/ go rī byang chub sems dkar po thogs pa/ tso rī byang chub sems dmar po thogs pa/ be tā ①lī dri chu thogs pa/ ghasma rī sha lnga 'dzin pa/tsaṇ+ḍa lī cang te'u brdung ba spros la mchod par ④bya'o/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa ni rang gi snying ga nas lha mo ḍom+bi nī ①spros nas/ yum bdag med ma dang gnyis med du bstem 0la mchod do/ /de'i dus su ngag tu 'di skad brjod do/ /go rī ma ni ri bong 'dzin/ /tso rī ma ni nyi ma 'dzin/ / be+e tā rjolī ni rdo rje chu/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /sbos mo tsan+dan sdong bu 'dzin/ /ri khrod ma ni sbrang rtsi 'dzin/ /gtum mo cang te'u sgra brdung zhing / /g.yung mo mgul pa dag la 'khyud/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa/ /skyes bu bzhin du byed par shog /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba gsum/ /'di dag gsum gyis gtso bo mchod—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu draspa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā hūṃdu/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gi ⑦sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bgyid stsal gang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyan snga ④'dir/ /thams cad ma lus so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang //'phags pa rang rgyal nyan thos dang / /so so skye bo'i tshogs rnams la/ /gus pas rjes su yi rang ngo / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /de yis gsungs pa'i dam chos dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin pa la sogs pa/ /pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa/ /rdo rje ⑨theg pa bla med pa'i/ /lam ni yang dag bsten par bgyi—/ /bdag gi dge ba 'di dag kun/ /bla med byang chub yang dag rdzogs//sems can kun don phan pa'i phyir/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /5—1281

bdag gi dge ba 'di dag kun/ /yongs su rdzogs par gyur nas ni/ /sems can kun dang thun mong du/ /yongs su byun cing rdzogs par shog /ces brjod la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bdag nyid lus dbul te①/ bdag dus thams cad dang rnam pa thams cad du bzhes su gsol/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mgon bo dngo rnams kyis/ dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub byed du gsol—/ de nas sdom pa bzung nas bstod pa nyi shu pas bstod la/ bzod pa gsol nas sdeni/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o—/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas smon lam gdab pa ni④/ rigs su skye zhing dam tshig can/ /sgo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan—/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ /oṃ byed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub byedarjo/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /be+er yang byon ⑤par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /mdor bsdus pa'i bya ba rdzogs so// //5—1282

dag /sāts+tsha'i cho ga bzhugs go//①༄4/ /sāts+tsha ④bya ba'i rim pa yang / /sa las ④'jim pa byas nas ni/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'jim pa rin chen sna lngar bsam/ /de nas sems can thams cad la/ /byams dang snying rje bskyed bya zhing du/ /rigs gsum lha yang dran par byasadu/ /chos sku'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs pa dang / /de yang sems can don du'o/ /de nas 'jim pa dag la ni/ /sngags ni nyi shu rtsa cig gdab/ /na mo bha ga ba te/ bai ro tsa na/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/samyak+shi budh+wa dhiya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ susgre khye sa ma ya ⑦sa ma ye/ shādhe dādhe⑧/ a sa ma ro pe a na lam+bi⑨/ ta re be+e ya sho ba ti ma hā te dza ni ra ku le niṭ+wā ṇi⑫/sarba ta thā ga ta/ a dhibyu na a dhiṣ+ṭi te swā hā/ rten 'grel dag gi sngags dag gis—/ /rab tu gnas pa bya ba yin/ /rdzogs so// //5—1284

༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid ye shes rgyus skyes pa'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku phyag 'tshal nas/ /shin tu bsdus par gyur pa yi/ /bung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /dang po kho nar khams gsum thams cad sems tsam du shes par byas la/ de nas bdag nyid dpal te ru ka'i gzugs chu skyes dmar po dang 'dra ba skad cig gis rdzogs par byas te/ rang gi snyeng gar bcu drug phyed kyi pad+ma shin tu dmar ba bsams la—/ de yi lte ba la ā li yang dag par bsdus pa'i gzugs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rjes su chags pa'i yi ge e ④dang hūṃ yang dag par yid kyis bris te/ de nas hūṃ dang e ①las byung ba shin tu dmar ba'i 'od zer yid bzo bar byed pa spros te/ gur gum lta bu'i 'od zer de phyogs thams cad khyab steske/ sems can thams cad rang gi gzugs su byas la de'i sku gsung thugs 5—1286

lhan cig tu bkug ste/ hūṃ dang i gnyis kyi thig le la gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin bung ba'i gzugs—/ rin po che lta bu'i snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin me tog gi ro 'thungs pas brgyal ba/ hūṃ gi ngo bo'i sgra rtag ring du sgog pa/ bdag med ma dang he ru ka'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de'i snying gar tshon dmar po—/ ko ba'i chu lta bu'i thig le phra mo e dang hūṃ gi yi ger bltas te/ de nas thabs dang shes rab kyi bung ba srog gi rlung la zhon te/ sna'i bu ga nas phyung la/khams gsum na gnas pa sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag par byas te bsdu'o/ /yang dbugs kyi rlung la brten nas ji lta bar bya ste/ rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma'i lte ba la rab tu rnam par dag pa la gzhug par bya ste/gzhan gyi sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi sku gsung thugs gcig tu mnyam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar yang dang yang du ji srid skad cig gis ①mthong gi bar du/ dbugs la brten pa'i gzugs bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar goms pa'i rting la skyes pa dang bud med kyi skad cig pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa rnam par bsams dze+el/ de'i ro bung ba srog dang rtsol ba la brten nas snga ma bzhin du byung ste/ bdag nyid kyi snying gi me tog ④lte ba la gzhug par bya ste/skyes pa'i sna'i bu gar zhugs te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gzugs/ snying ga'i pad+ma'i lte ba la 'dug ste de'i snying ga'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma la lus kyi ④rang bzhin gyi rdul yod pa bdag nyid kyi lus bsgom/ ngag gi rang bzhin pad+ma 'thungs⑤—/ /sems kyi rang bzhin pad+ma'i snying po zos te/ de nas sgrub pa pos rang gi dbugs kyi rlung bkug ste/ skyes pa'i sna'i bu ga nas phyung la/5—1287

bdag nyid sna'i bu ga nas snying gi pad+ma'i ge sar la gzhug go/ /de ltar lus sprugs der lus kyang rang bzhin gyi chu skyes kyi rdul gnyis gcig tu byas/ ngag gi rang bzhin gyi me tog gi khu ba gnyis gcig tu byas/ sems kyi rang bzhin pad+ma'i snying po gnyis gcig tu byas par bsam par bya'o/ /de yang de ltar spyos pa dang / de ltar gzhug pa dang / de ltar bstems te/ yang dag par bsam par bya'o/ /de yang dang yang du ji srid du ①rjes su chags pa mthong ba dang / ji ltar bsgom pa bzhin du shes nas byed de/ ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa grub par byed do/ /'dir bsgom pa 'di byas na/ bud med dga' ba'i sems kyis chags par byed pa dang / 'dod pas brgyal ba'i lus kyis/sgrub pa po'i sems bde bar byed cing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nyes pa yod par mthong na/ ji ltar bstan par mi bya'o/ /gal te byas na chen po'i sdig par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na sngon du yul dang yul ma yin pa shes par byas la/ de shes pa dang / ji ltar bstan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /bung ba ④'dod pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnam par bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'dir ni 'khor ba'i skye bo rnams/ /dpal gyi snying rje thob par shog /rdzogs so// //grub pa brnyes pa'i rat+na tsan+d+ras mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba khu dngos grub po// //5—1288

bsdur mchan/1286 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉྾〈co 〉〉star bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉mos/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉gag1287 ①〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉 ma/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsam/ du〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉negi/ 0〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pad+ma/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sna)sa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉torathung /1288 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉rjes su chags kyi bar du bya'o// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bas/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1༷2)5wa 1289

༄ga /gtor ma'i de kho na nyid brngus pa/①༄ ༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba bo tatwa saṃ gra ha/ bod skad du/gtor ma'i de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ ye shes ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas la sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen dang / /grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal te/ /gtor ma'i de nyid bshad par bya/ /bskyed rim lha yi dran pa bskyed/ /mdun du nam mkha'i dbus gnas par/ /chos 'byung e yi dbyibs 'dra la②/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsam pa ni/ /steng 'og dbus kyi lha yi gdan/ /ji ltar rigs par rim pa gsum/ /kha dog dbye ba so so yi/ /steng 'og phyogs skyong brgyad nyid do/ /spyi bo snying ga mgrin pa ru/ /yi ge gsum ni so sor dgod/ /de las 'od ni dkar po 'byung / /gzugs med srid pa'i lha sogs nas/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams ni/ /'od kyis bsdus nas gcig tu byas/ /de la yi ge nyid du 'gyur/ /yi ge las 5—1290

ni mtshan mar ro/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ /sku yi rdo rje ngo bo nyid/ /sku mdog dkar zhing g.yas brkyang ba'i/ /g.yas na rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /lha mo spyan dang bzhugs pa'o/ /sngar gyi thugs ka'i yi ge las/ /sngags kyi yi ge phyung nas ni/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang pha ma rnams/ /bsdus te 'od kyi gong bur ro/ /de las rang gi sa bon nyid/ /mtshan mar yang dag blta ba'o/ /de nyid las ni lha yi gzugs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje sku mdog sngo/ /phyag mtshan sku yi rdo rje mtshungs/ /g.yas brkyang pad+ma'i gdan la ni/ /mā ma kri dang lhan cig bzhugs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab 'dra ba'o/ /sa stengs ①mi dang sa 'og klu//byol song yi dwags dmyal ba rnams/ /a las 'od zer byung nas ni/ /gcig tu gyur pas chos 'byung bsam/ /sku mdog dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ /phyag mtshan badz+ra gharnye ②bsnams/ /gos dkar mo dang gnyis med sbyor/ /pad+ma gar dbang bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar sems can thams cad ni/ /chos 'byung nang du rigs gsum dngos/ /bsams la bdag gi mgrin sogs nas/ /yi ge hūṃ sogs so so la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs lcags kyu la/ /sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi po yis//rtag pa la sogs rigs gsum byi/ /sangs rgyas bkug ste gzugs brnyan la/ /bstems pas chu la chu blugs bzhin/ /tha dad med de gcig tu gyur/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer las/ /lha mo phyung ste de rnams las/ /spyi bor bum pas dbang bskur bas/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po la/ /rtag pa yi ①ni dbu rgyan ④byas—/ /dbus kyi lha la thugs phyag rgya/ /'og gi lha la gsung phyag rgya/ /de ltar rigs gsum dngos bsams la/ /rang nyid sa bon khyad par las/ /'od zer las ni lha yi tshogs/ /phyung ste zhabs bsel zhal bsil dbul/ /de 5—1291

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha wa ②saṃ ga bi dhiḥ/ bod skad du/ ro sreg pa'i ①cho ga /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde chen po/ /dri med yid kyis btud byas te/ /rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la sogs—/ /brten te dgyes pa rdo rje yidu/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ro sreg ⑤cho ga bshad par bya/ /dur khrod dang rjoni chu bo'i 'gram/ /nags tshal 'bab chu dgon pa ru/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan ni/ /brtan zhing zab mo'i chos dang ldan/ /rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas/ /rtsa ba'i rtsang ba rab 'joms pa/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sngags/ /sgrub pa po la 'grub po kye/ /de la dang por bsnyen pa yis/ /cho ga bzhin du shes byas te/ /lha dang ro yi dbye ba yis/ /rnam pa gnyis su sbyar bar bya/ /de la lha yi cho ga yang / /bla ma rdo rje can mchod cing / /bdun po rnam par dag par bya/ /5—1294

byang chub tu ni sems bskyed de/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam par bsgom/ /de la sangs rgyas gnas bsams ①te/ /byang chub rnam lnga bsgom par bya/ /dang po skyes bu bsams de nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo spro/ /dri za rab tu zhugs pa ni/ /lhung ste zhu ba rjes dran pa/ /mtshams kyi lha mos bskul bar bya//bskul nas 'bras bu bzhengs pa la/ /mig sogs gnyi mug rdo rje sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /ye shes dngos po rab bcug la/ /rig ma brgyad kyis ②dbang bskur bya/ /bdud rtsi yang ni myang bya zhing / /lha mo brgyad rnams kyis mchod dang / /'khor lo'i 'dren pa la bstod bya/ /de ltar yan lag drug po ni/ /sngags drug gis ni nga rgyal bya/ /de nas kyang ni yud tsam bsam—/ /de la mtshan ma mtshon par bya/ /de nas ro yi cho ga yang / /slob dpon 'das pa'i dus na ni/ /rmongs pa rnams ni shi zhes zer/ /shi ba zhes pa rnam rtog de/ /dag pa'i gnas su gshegs pa'o/ /yang na bde ba can du'am—/ /dag pa'i gnas su skye 'gyur ba/ /ro sreg ①'di yis rnam par 'byed—/ /lus mtha' nas ni lus mthar skyel/ /dman pa'i sems can thams cad kyang / /bde 'gro nas ni bde 'gror 'gro/ /de la cho ga dang por ni/ /chu gtsang dri zhim sbyar bas bkru/ /sna tshogs dri yis byugs pa dang //tshul bzhin rgyan gyis gnas byas te/ /bgegs bskrad lhar bskyed cho ga dang / /skye mched gnas gsum byin gyis brlabasadu/ /rnam shes a yi gzugs kyis gzhug /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs tshul bzhin du/ /bzlas pas sdig sgrib thams cad bcom/ /byang chub sems su zhu byas la/ /slar yang bskyed cing tshul bzhin ldang / /gtor ma mchod pa rgya chen bya/ /smon lam gdab cing bsrung 5—1295

la gnas/ /yi ge brgya pa ci mang du/ /bzlas brjod bya ba bsngags ①pa yin/ /de ltar thun gsum bar du ni/ /bzlas brjod 'bum kyi tshad du bya/ /de ni sngon kyi cho ga'o/ /de rjes sa yi cho ga sogs/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga tshul bzhin bya⑤—/ /rdo rje slob dpon dag la ni/ /rdo rje dril bu lag par sbyin/ /mgo bor dbu rgyan bskon par①bya/ /rdo rje sdom pa rnams byen te/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug tshul bzhin bya/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur rnams byin la/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor gyis/ /'du byed rab tu bya bar bstan/ /sgrub pa po yang de ltar bya/ /sems can phal pa thams cad kyisarjo/ /'jug cing dbang bskur spang bar bya/ /sbyin sreg cho ga 'ba' zhig gis/ /sbyang ba dag ni rab tu bya/ /de la sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gcig tu sreg khang brtsig par bya ste/ ji tsam lhogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas la/ de'i dbus su zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po khru gang bar bya'o/ /khru phyed thur du brko/ sor bzhi phyir bskyed/ kha khyer sor bzhis dubaskor/ de'i phyi rim gyi sor bzhi bor la/ pad+ma'i phreng ba zi/thab khung gi nang du gtso bo'i phyag mtshan bzhag pa ni dbus su rdo rje/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri/ zheng sor brgyad par bya'o/ /kha dog dkar pos byugs pa der/ shing gang duji ltar rigs par brtsigs te/ ro de dkyil 'khor la kha mngon du phyogs par gzhug go//mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas gzhag ⑦pa'i rim pa ni/ sngags mkhan gyi g.yon du yon chab kyi snod gser la sogs pa chab kyis bkang ba dang / zhabs bsil gyi snod gzhag go⑧/ /g.yas phyogs su zangs gzhong cig gi nang du dris bkang la/ku sha bcug pa thrak+ṣa ṇa'i snod gzhag /de bzhin du me tog dang / bdug spos 5—1296

dang / dri'i dung la sogs pa'i snod du gzhag ⑨bo/ /mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i bzed zhal gzhag ②par bya ste/ de ltar/me tog bdug spos de bzhin dri①/ /dri yi dung sogs g.yas gnas te/ /g.yon du sngags kyi mchod yon snod/ /mdun du bzed snod bzhag byas la/ /zhabs bsel sngon du 'gro bas dbul/ /me tog spos sogs go rims bzhin/ /sgeg sogs mchod pas mchod byas na/ /skal ba chen por gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang sreg rdzas gzhag dupa'i rim pa yang / mdun du dgang gzar dang blugs gzar dang / khyad par gyi rjordzas til dang / thun mong gi rdzas kyi gtso bo mar gzhag rjopar bya'o/ /rdzas gzhan g.yas phyogs su maṇ+ḍal la ji ltar 'byor par gzhag ⑦par bya'o/ /de ltar yang / dgang gzar blugs dugazar khyad par rdzas/ /thun mong rdzas kyi gtso bo rnams/ /sngags mkhan mdun du bzhag byas la/ /rdzas gzhan g.yas su ci 'byor pa/ /go rims bzhin du gzhag ⑨par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bdag nyid khrus byas la rgyan byis brgyan te/ mchod pa la sogs pa kun hūṃ gis bsangs la lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje bzung la/ snod kun gyi steng du gtug cing / oṃ t+pahūṃ/zhes sngags pas 'jig rten pa'i rtog pa kun bsal nas/ rdzas de nyid bzang zhing dri ma med par bsam mo/ /yam shing dang bud shing yang zhi ba la ji ltar bsngags pa ltar gzung ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyis yan lag drug dang ldan pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs par bya/ sngar gyis ⑩gsal na ma byas kyang rung /de nas gtsubs pa la sogs pa'i me blangs te/ rlung g.yab kyis me sbar ro/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ me sbar ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa ā yu ṣe swā hā/5—1297

ku sha dgram pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ la hūṃ/ bsang gtor gyi sngags so/ /de nas thab tu sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa cig bsgoms la/ der he ru ka yab yum byang chub pa lngas bskyed la/ de nyid 'dod chags chen po dngul chu bzhin du zhu nas gnas pa las①/ yi ge re sbrel mar gyur nas/ yi ge gnyis gyur pa las me lha yab yum zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i dbu rgyan can/ mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas na gudhe dang mchod dzuphyir thogs/ g.yon na bum pa dang bgrang phreng thogs pa ③sku mdog dkar por bsams la/ thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du me gru gsum/ lce la re dmar po dhibasam mo/ /de ltar ram̐ zhu ba las dam tshig sems dpa'i me lhar bsgom pa ste/de yang rang gi lhag pa'i lhar dmigs te/ bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam par khyebargyan pa'i me lha phun sum rjotshogs pa ⑦kun dmigs la/ lto ba'i gnas su sreg blugs bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la ⑧bsang gtor dang / yon chab dang / phyag byas la/ oṃ asna ye ma hā te dzā sarba karma sā dha ka /kā ru ② kṛ twa satārba ⑨asmid+ma: hi twa bha ba/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis spyan drangs la/ gnyis su med par bstems⑩/ de nas brok+ṣa ṇi la sogs pa bya'o/ /gzar bu la rang gi lha'i sa bon bsams la/ gru mo gnyis sprad la gzar bu bdun ⑪dbul/ sngags ni/ oṃ asna ye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya badz+ra satwa su sarba pā paṃ da ha na ⑫swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be+e gā ya ⑫swā hā/ oṃ 5—1298

ma hā ba lā ya ①swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye ②swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badzā lnga ①ya swā hārjo/ oṃ badz+ra bo dhi thrak+ṣu ⑤ya swā hā/ oṃ pa ta lā rjoya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba ka rā ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya sarba pā paṃ da ha nā ya ⑦swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis sreg rdzas rnams go rims ⑧bzhin dbul lo/ /de nas mar kyi dgang blugs brgya'am stong dbul bar bya'o/ /yang bsang gtor byas nas/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ re zhes pas ar+ghaṃ ⑨dbul lo/ /oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ zhes zhal bsel dbul lo⑫/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra ghar+bhe ā:/ zhes pas dril bu gzung ngo ⑪/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ zhes bya bas rdo rje gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas me lha la bstod pa bya ba dang / don chen po'i gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas thab khyang lan gsum du bsangs ⑫ la—/ me lha'i thugs kar so so'i snying po las dkyil 'khor bsams la de nas ye shes sems dpa' ci rigs par spyan drangs la bzhugs su gsol lo/ /yang bsang gtor la sogs pa byas la/ gnas khang du ba'i lci bas byugs la maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i stegs bu brtsigs te/ re khā dkar pos gru ⑫nyis rim du byas la/ dbus su gtor ma cha gcig bzhag /mchod pa lnga yang bshams/tshogs kyi kha zas snod chen po gcig tu spyi dpungs su gzhag④ /chang yang snod chen po gcig bkang / de mi 'degs par bzhag nas/ de nas mar gzar bu nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rdzas lhag ma rnams rang gi sngags sam/ lha'i sngags kyis rim bzhin du phul la/ tha mar yang mar gyi sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad du dbul/ yang bsang ba dang mchod pa la sogs pa 5—1299

rdzogs par byas la/ de yang sbyang bar 'os pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyar ba ni/rdo rje sgrub pa tha ma ①slob dpon la/ /yi ge ram̐ lha'i shig sgrib kun/ /brgya pa'i gsang sngags bsreg ②pa rnams/ /brgya'am stong du bzlas par bya/ /rdo rje rang lha'i sdig pa ①ni/ /gzugs kyi gzugs ni yongs ④bsgoms la/ /sbyang ba'i cho ga'i man ngag ste/ /brgyud pa'i thabs kyis shes par bya/ /de nas gar gyis ⑤dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag byas la/ oṃ byedahūṃ muḥs gshegs su gsol zhing smon lam gdab po/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas nas rdzas kyi lhag ma ci 'byor pas me lha mchod par bya'o/ /de nas bsangs la/ mchod pa dang / bstod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas yang me dubasangs la gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bdag gi don dang gzhan byi don/ /bsgrubs kyis byin za khyed gshegs shig /de ltar dus bzhin sbar gshegs nas/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad mdzod/ /ces gshegs su gsol lo/ /dam tshig pa ⑦mi dmigs par bsam mo/ /de nas rus bu bsdus la/ shi ba la phan btags pa'i phyir ⑤mchod rten bya'o/ /de ltar nyi ma gsum ni lon pa dang / /rus pa'i phreng ba bsdus byas la/ /dri dang 'o mas bran nas ni/ /de yis mchod rten dag tu ⑨bya'o—/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ba'i/ /sbyin sreg cho ga 'di byas pas/ /bdag gi bsod nams phung po 'dis/ /nyam thag rnams ni rgyal gyur shog /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po ye shes snying po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ ro sreg ⑩pa'i dbang du bya ba rdzogs so// //5—1300
bsdur 'azas re'u mig da/ (1 4)5wa 1302

༄ga /dpa' bo gcig pa dpal nye ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ e ka bī ra s+thā te ru ka kho ḍa sha byu dza sā dha rmā nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpa' bo gcig pa dpal he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por rang nyid thun mong dang khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pas bgegs dang 'tshe ba la sogs pa med par rjes su bumathun pa'i gnas su zhugs te/ bya ba'i rim pa ni maṇ+ḍal dang ras ris la sogs pa dgod pa dang / mchod pa nye bar bshams te/ khrus sngon du song bas lhar mos shing / stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ oṃ badz+ra pu྾ oṃ ā hūṃ zhes pa la sogs pas ①mchod pa lnga byin byis brlabs ④pa dang / mchod pa gzhan dag kyang oṃ ā hūṃ zhes so/ /de nas rang gi snying gar re yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma la hūṃ bsam ste⑤/ de'i 'od zer bdag gnas pa'i khang pa la phog pas rdo rjes gtams dupar mos shing / oṃ he 5—1303

badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭhasta ta na ①rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas gnas bsrung ba dang / de bzhin du bdag dang ①srog dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba la yang sbyar te/oṃ āt+pa dzi ba yo ga zhes pa dag gis so/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsod nams tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ mngon sum lta bur gsal bar dmigs te/ chu dang thang las ①skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ /gus pa mchog gis bdag 'bul dun/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pu྾ pū dza me gha sa mu draspa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/de la sogs pa thun mong gi mchod pa byas la/ yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las lha mo brgyad phyung ste mchod de⑤/ de yang go rī ma ni ri bong 'dzin/ /tso rī ma ni nyi ma'o/ /ro langs ma ni 'bab chu 'dzin/ /ghasma rī ni stobs 'dzin pa'o—/ /sbos mo tsan+dan sdong bu 'dzin/ /ri khrod ma ni sbrang rtsi'o/ /gtum mo 6cang te'u sgra brdung zhing / /g.yung mo mgul pa la sbyor ba'o/ /skyes bu bzhin du byed par bshad/ /de nas bshags pa bya ste/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bgyis pa dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar ni//thams cad ma lus so sor bshags/ /de nas rjes su yi rang ba byas te/sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal dang //so so skye bo'i bsod nams de/ /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas bsngo ba bya ste/ bdag gi dge ba 'di dag kun/ /bla med byang chub yang dag rdzogs/ /sems can kun dang thun mong du/ /yongs su smin cing rdzogs par bgyi/ /de nas skyabs su gsol te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /de yis gsungs pa'i dam chos dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la/ /byang 5—1304

chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /de nas smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/bdag gis bla med byang chub tu/ /yang dag rdzogs par gyur nas ni/ /sems can kun don phan pa'i phyir/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /de nas 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ bdag gi ①sbyin pa la sogs pa/ /pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla med pa'i/ /lam ni yang dag bsten ②par bya/ /de nas sngar gyi hūṃ las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba sems can thams cad bkug nas/ bshes dang 'brel pa ①lta bur gsal bar dmigs nas/ tshad med pa bzhi brtse gdung gi rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya ba dang / thabs thob pas dga' ba dang / mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sngags 'di dag brjod pas—/ stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudhaḥdharmā/ te swa bhā ba shurnyo3haṃ/ zhes pa des ni/ chos kun rnam par dag pas na/ /bdag kyang rang bzhin rnam par dag /ces par bsgrubs na/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ zhes pa des ni/ stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin nga'am bdag yin no/ /zhes pa de la gnas par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid skad cig tsam kyis ni/ /ye shes dang ldan lha ru mos pa re/ /de yi mdun na nam mkha' re pha las/ /gyur pa nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjeye shes lnga ldan bsam/ /de yi lte bar hūṃ las 'od du'aphros pas/ /bgegs bsregs ra ba dang ni gur yang bsam/ /de yi steng du pad+ma nyi ma la/ /rang gi sems nyid ye shes rnam pa yis/ /hūṃ gi de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar yi ge hūṃ/ /yang narjo/ de yi 'od zer gyis ni khams gsum gyi/ /5—1305

sems can rnam par sbyangs te 'od zer bsdu/ /de rjes rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las—/ /he ru ka dpal zla ba chu shel 'od/ /zhal brgyad nyi shu rtsa bzhi spyan gyis che/ /bcu drug phyag ldan zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan/ /rang snang mos pa tsam ste dngos su min/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs shing ral pa dang / /thod pa'i dbu rgyan thod pa'i phreng ba dang / /spyi gtsug 'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga/ /brkyang bskum byas krung phyed pa gar mos bya/ /de tshe rang gi snying gar nyi ma la/ /hūṃ gi rnam pa bdud rtsi thig ler bcas/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i sbyor bas 'od zer 'phro/ /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni ①ci nus pas bzla bar ④bya ste/ de rjes de yang smin par bya ba'i phyir/ /shing 'bras tshos pa ltar gyur 'bras bu yi/ /ste ru ka dpal phyag mtshan zhal sogs ni//sngar sogs mig sman bcag pa lta bu'i mdog /de rjes de yang rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /rang gi snying ga'i nyi steng sa bon las/ /rdo rje sa bon dang bcas yongs gyur pa/ /ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra'i snying ga ru/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' mtshan ma sa bon bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis ye shes bdag po bsdu/ /de brjod dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstem/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas las gzhan du yang ma yin/ /brtan ①par bya phyir skye mched drug po dang / /sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs dbang bskur bya/ /dbang gi sngags rnams dag ni brjod kyang rung //mchod nas bstod dang bdud rtsi myang ba'ang bya/ /de dag sngags brjod pa yang 'di yin te/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta prastu te badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophohaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3haṃ/ da ni rdzogs rim la 'jug pa/ shes bya'i gtso mo 5—1306

gtum mo sbar/ /yang ni srog dang rtsol sbyar bas/ /ye shes rlung dang me sbar bas—/ /haṃ las bdud rtsi'i thig le bab/ /ngal so dbugs dbyung dbyer med 'gyur/ /de la sems brtan rtse gcig bya/ /nyams chen gtso bo'i rnam pa ni—/ /dga' dang skad cig rigs ①gsum las/ /mtshan nyid bral ba'i lhan skyes bsgom/ /sems brtan pa yi mtshan ma ni/ /gzung 'dzin bral zhing ye shes nyid/ /rtags ni smig rgyu du ba dang / /mar me sprin med nam mkha' 'dra//nges par chos nyid mngon sum ④byed/ /de ltar ci nus bsgom bya ste/ /skyo bar gyur na sngags bzlas bya/ /bdag nyid rim gnyis tshogs pa gcig /bskyed rim 'bras bu he ru ka /mig sman chag pa lta bur mos/ /phyag mtshan zhal sogs sngar bzhin no/ /rdzogs rim bde la mi rtog cing / /mi dmigs pa ru mos pas bzlas/ /zla ba lta bu'i bsam gtan dang / /chu zla lta bu'i rnam pa ste/ /brag ca lta bu'i bzlas pa ni/ /oṃ aṭ+wā na nā ya/ piṅga lodzñā ①ke sha waṭ+wā ṣ+pe④/ tsa tubo sha ti ṣ+pe tā ya/ kho ḍa sha zu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṭa dzī mū ta ba pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā no kā d+mā ⑤ri ṇi/ an+d+ra ta ku ra ci ya/ asgon+tu burda: ṇi⑦/ mā ra ya mā ra ya—/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ⑧ga rān/ brnya brnya/ nā gāṣ+ṭa ⑨kān/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ sarba sha hūṃ rna/ ha hā hi tī hu snu te hai ho ho haṃ haḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dag ⑩ni bzlas byas nas/ /'byung po kun gyi gtor ma'am/ /mtshan phyed yin na tshogs 'khor bya/ /de nas cung zad mchod byas la/ /oṃ uhūṃ muḥyis ni/ /yeshes bdag po gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig rang gi thugs kar bsdu/ /spyod lam lhag par mos pa yis/ /bskyed rim lha yi nga rgyal dang / /rdzogs 5—1307
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (105)5wa 1309

༄ga /sprun dbye ba'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tista bi byeḥ/ bod skad du/ spyan dbye ba'i cho ga /rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis rab tu gnas pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/ cho ga gang gis gang la rab tu gnas pa de'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya'o/ /de yang thams cad la 'thad cing dgos pa ma yin te/ skye ba med pa la gang zhig rab tu gnas par bya/ kun rdzob gtso bor spyod pas kyang / /de nyid byin rlabs yin shes na/ /rab gnas cho ga mi 'thad do/ /sems can dang po'i las can rmis/ /rgyud rnams yang dag smin phyir byas/ /de yang slob dpon mthu thob pa dang / ma thob ④pa'i bye brag gis cho ga bsnyus pa dang / rgyas pa'i bye brag gis ci rigs par bla ma'i man ngag la brten pa rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /de la cho ga rgyas pa ni dang po bsnyen pa gtso bo'i 'bum mam/ 'khor rmi khrir/ de ltar grangs sam/5—1310

mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa byas la/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga dag tshul bzhin du byas la/ khrus sa'i stegs bu brtsigs la/ bum pa rnams bkod la/ bzlas brjod kyi cho ga ni rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i sbyor bas/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum nga las/ /thams cad chu las kham phor du/ /cung zad blugs te rnam rgyal gyi/ /bum pa paṃ las skyes pa yi/ /rin po che yi steng du gzhag① /der ni dkyil 'khor bskyed bya ste/ /dam tshig bdag nyid rdzogs pa dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas①/ /zhal bsel la sogs rim par dbul/ /dam tshig lhan cig bcug byas te/ /mchod pa rnams kyis tshim byas la/ /me togo spos sogs rol mo yis/ /'bad pa yis kyang mchod par bya/ /dril bu dag ni dkrol ba dang / /bstod pa gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis—/ /de bzhin bdag gis bkru bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi she ka sa ma ya shri ye ①hūṃ/ 'di ni khrus sngags so/ /ras sogs rang rang gsang sngags kyis/ /mnyam par gzhag dupas dbul bar bya/ /yang na rang gi sngags kyis dbul/ /bzlas te phyag 'tshal gtso bo la/ /oṃ badz+ra bā sa se swā hā/me tog la sogs pa'i sngags su yang 'gyur ro/ /gser la sogs pas snod byas te—/ /sbrang rtsi mar sar dubyugs pa yi/ /gser gyi thur ma yis ni mig /dbye ba'am yang na bsam gtan gyis/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan yang dag rab bzhugs nas/ /ji ltar lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums/ /de bzhin 'dir gnas bzhugs byas la/ /'dir ni rgyun du zhugs gyur nas/ /mgon po me tog la sogs 'di/ /byang chub sems kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ /che ge mo yi don du bzhes/ /lha rnams 5—1311

brtan ①par 'dod pa yis/ /mgo bo snying ga gsang gnas ②su/ /rdo rje yis ni bskor byas nas/ /lan gsum bskor te rab gnas bya/ /chad pa'am ni lhag pas kyang / /bdag gis brjod nas gang bgyis ①pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs mdzad pa/ /mgon po khyod kyis bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed pa dang ma shes pa/ /ma lus par yang bzod par mdzod/ /nyungs pa'am gzhan du bkyis pa gang / /de dag bzod par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes pas bzod par gsol la don lam gdab po/ /mchod rten glegs bam la sogs la/ /kye yi rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /rab tu gnas par ④bya ba dang ⑤/ /rnam pa dag ni ci rigs par/ /de nas slob ma rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du bcug la/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par bkyisadu/ /zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas gtor ma dang sbyin sreg gi las bya ste⑦/ de rnams kyi cho ga ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /mchod pa dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ ye shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de ni cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon nus dang ldan pas ni/ /nyin gcig gi ⑧rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bya ste/ rang gi lha bskyed pa'i rim pa byas la/ rang gi lha'i sngags brgya'am/ stong du bzlas brjod byas te/ rab tu gnas pa'i rten sbyang ba dang / brten pa'i ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa byas la/ yid kyis ⑨mchod pas mchod la bzlas brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /rdzogs so// //⑩5—1312

bsdur mchan/131 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉can dbye ba'i cho ga bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torathob/1311 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉te/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉waye/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑤〈〈co 〉〉ser/1312 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉brten/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skog gnas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sgog nas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bgyid/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ste/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgyas te/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stagos/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷6)5—1313

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba ②lo bi rnyiḥ/ bod skad du/ gtor ma'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro la/ /btud de dang bas phyag 'tshal nas/ /sems can thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bri bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skad cig tsam gyis stong par bsgoms la/ de nas hūṃ zhes brjod de—/ hūṃ las skad cig tsam rmis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / ra ba dang dra ba'i nang du khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa la lha'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed la/ bdag nyid kyang de'i mdun du te ru ka'i gzugs su bsams la/ yi ge 'bru drug dang / 'bru gsum dang / cod pan gyi lha dran par ①bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas 'og tu yi ram̐ las rlung dang me bskyed la/ a las thod pa bskyed/ de'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsam/5—1314

de'i steng gi bar snang la hūṃ las zla ba'i steng du rdo rje bskyed/ rlung gis me sbar mes bdud rtsi bskol ba'i 'od kyis zla ①ba dang rdo rje yang thim nas lha'i bdud rtsir gyur te/ de'i steng du oṃ bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste bstems la/ yi ge 'bru gsum byi sngags lan gsum bzlas pas/byen gyis brlab po/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi ①lha spyan drangs nas/ oṃ shrī te ru ka ma hā badz+ra ā gats+tsha a a a gha ta sne.a/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ brnya ya brnya ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sazla badz+ra ḍā ki nī rna j-i da ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod la/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la bstems la/yang yid las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod do/ /de nas lha rnams dang dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag po rnams kyi 0lce hūṃ las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam bsams la—/ de'i rtse mor hūṃ bsgoms te/ de'i 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi drangs nas/gsol bas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob par bsam mo/ /sngags ni oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra pra tīts+tsha me ba lo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ burnya ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha rjo4 ba lo oṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha me ba bo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki bhā pra tīts+tsha oṃ ba lo hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha me ba dulo a phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha me ba lo hūṃ phaṭa⑦—/ oṃ sarba yo gi nī pra tīts+tsha oṃ ba lo hūṃ ha ha he ⑧hoḥ/ de nas de nyid lnga pas bstod pa ni/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis ⑨ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo//rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos gnyis ⑩5—1315

dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las ①kun du byung ②/ /ngo bo nyid kyis sneganas pa med/ /de ltar chos 'di shes nas kyang / /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /oṃ ā hūṃ yul che ge mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i k+ṣe tra pā la i rda ba lo kṛt+na ④ma ma sa pa ri wā rān sarba satwañdza pā paṃ bya ti bispyo shārnyi ku ru dha na dha na/ ā yu ar+ghaṃ ⑤ā di puṣ+ṭi ku ru sarba pra yats+tsha rak+ṣa dhiku ru swā hā/ sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur pa'i/ /lam de nyid la 'gro bar shog /ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang / /ma brgal ba rnams sgol byed cing / /rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas pa ni/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /de'i 'og tu yi ge 'bru gsum gyis zhi ba la sogs pa'i las bcol lo/ /de nas oṃ 26hūṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod/ se gol lan gsum brdabs te gshegs su gsol lo/ /rdzogs so// //5—1316

bsdur mchan/1314 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/1315 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzla/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dha/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉〉rmu 0〈〈snar 〉stab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉〉te/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉rta/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7)/⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉nyid/1316 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torabyung / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉 grosna/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thug r+ghaṃ hā/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉rak+ṣa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (107)5—1317

༄ga /gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs/①༄4/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po thod pa'am snod gang rung ba'i nang du/ gtor ma'i phud bkros la/ bsang nan dang bcas pa blugs la/ de nas bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms la/ gtor ma'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la hūṃ mthing ga gcig bsam/ de zhu ste gtor ma la thim pas/ gtor ma'i rdzas kyi dngos po sbyangs par bsam mo/ /de nas yang pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng / a dmar po gcig bsam—/ de ②'od du zhu ste thim pas/ kha dog dmar po ①la dngas ④shing dag la dri ma med pa/ ro mchog dang ldan par bsgom/ de nas yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor byi steng du/ oṃ dkar po gcig bsgom/ de 'od du zhu ste thim pas—/ dkar la dang ba ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas bdud rtsi las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin 5—1318

gshegs pa'i thugs mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / lha yul na yod pa'i bdud rtsi bkug ste/ de la thim par bsam/ de nas bdud rtsi de nyid las yang 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dam pa dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / phyi nang gi chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa nam mkha' la bkug la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ saza dhas+thā hūṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas gtor ma las 'od 'phros pas so so'i lce la reg pas/bdud rtsi'i bde ba chen po'i ro stobs ①shing stsong bar bsam mo/ /de nas chos bshad par bya ste/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bya/mkha' 'gro ma rnams la ci 'dod pa'i las bcol lo/ /bzod gsol byas la gshegs su gsol/ rdzogs so// //5—1319

bsdur mchan/1318 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈0sdo 〉sko〈co 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉de'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapo rjo⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉stanadang /1319 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bltar/bsdur 'bras ze'u migargyud/ (108)5wa 1320

༄ga /dpal kye rdo rje'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra ba lo bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal kye khrurdo rje'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can/ /yi ge gnyis las yang dag 'byung / /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang phyug gtso/ /te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /de nas dpal kye ①rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang / sbyin sreg dang / cho ga chomachod pa dang / sgrub pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pas phan gdags pa dang /tshar gcad rjopa'i phyir 'di brtsams so/ /de la gtor ma'i dgos pa yang gang zhig ce na/ gzhung las/ bgegs rnams zhi bar bya ba dang / /lha rnams dgod par bya ba dang / /dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba'i phyir/ /gtor ma'i las ni ci nus rtsomadu/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /yang rgyud las/ 'byung po kun la gtor ma 'di dag gis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mchod pa legs byas na⑦/ /dus 5—1321

kun rnyed pa bde bar gyur pa dang / /lha rnams dga' zhing 'gro ba 'byor bar 'gyur—/ /①'byung po'i ②tshogs la gtor ma cig byin na/ /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra yi sde 'joms shing / /dgar dang bsad dang lkugs par byed pa dang / /zhi zhing bde bar rgyas par byed pa yin/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /yang slob dpon kha cig gis/ 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /dngos grub mchog 'dod ①thams cad la/ /dpal ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /gtor ma'i las ni shin tu bsngags/ /zhes 'byung bas gtor ma'i las 'di shin tu phan yon che'o/ /de la thog mar sngags pas 'byung po nyi shu rtsa bzhi la gtor ma sbyin dgos te/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /klu chen brgyad dang phyogs skyong brgyad/ /'khor du gtogs pa brgyad rnams la/ /rgyun du'am yang na zla ba'am/ /de bzhin lo gcig khyud 'khor rjodang / /dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg bzlas pa dang / /de bzhin gnod pa byung dus su/ /ji ltar 'os shing rigs pa dang / /rang gis ci 'byor rjes mthun par/ /nan tan du ni gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de la gtor ma'i rdzas kyang gang zhe na/ me tog bdug spos mar me byug pa dang / /sman rnams dang ni dri dang lha bshos dang / /chang sbyar 'bru dang sna tshogs chang la sogs/ /u lo pi dang la du khur ba dang / /zan dron dang ni drug cu par byas pa/ /phye la sogs pa dang bcas bsres nas ni/ /'bras chan 'bras kyi phye ma 'bru bdun dang / /khrag dang sha 'dres nya sha rjol sogs parjo/ /btsos dang rjen dang rnying dang bcas pa rnams/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres nas ni/ /de dag kun rmis snod ni bkang nas kyang / /bum pa chus bkang ba yi steng du gzhag /5—1322

khyar ba'am zas ngan mar me steng du bltam/ /mtshan mo'i dus su de dag la yang dbul/ /zhes 'byung bas de dag gi steng du zhi ba'i gtor ma ni zho dang /bu ram dang / 'o thug la sogs pa bsre'o/ /drag po la ni bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan steng du gzhag ①go/ /de la rigs kyi bu dag tshe ring bar 'dod nga/ dang / nad nyung bar 'dod pa dang / gnod pa zhi bar 'dod pa dang /dpal dang grags pa 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / bu lon lan chags bral bar 'dod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba bzlog par 'dod pa dang / longs spyod 'byor pa 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcad par 'dod pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thob par 'dod pa'i mkhas pas gtor ma'i las la brtson par bya'o/ /de la bdag nyid sku phyag rgya chen po gsal bar bsgoms la/ thog mar nam mkha' lta bu la yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor yi gis ②mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor re gyis mtshan pa/ de las a/ a las thod pa'i nang du lcags kyu lnga dang /sa bon lnga las bdud rtsi lngar bskyed do/ /hūṃ las rdo rje a las zla ba de'i steng du/oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir sbyang / nywabyus gzi byin bskyed/ hūṃ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / dam tshig gi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma byin kyis brlabs te 'di brjod do/ /bdag gi khrubasod nams stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs dudang / /gsang sngags rig sngags mthu dag dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs kyis su/ /sems can kun la phan 'dod pas/ /don rnams yang dag bsam ⑤pa kun/ /sems can khams ni ma lus par/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ / thog ma rjomed 5—1323

par 'byung gyur cig /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍi ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ tshihūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod do/ /de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas—/ gtor ma'i mgron spyan drang ba'i ①phyir/ te ru ka'i phyag rgyas yab yum bcings te sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ a ral+li hoḥ②dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki rī sa ma ya ste dṛ byu hoḥ.oṃ chasahūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod la 'byung po nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa 'khor sde brgyad mdun du bsams te/ mchod pa lnga yang dbul/lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ①ma lus dang //yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug rnams/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la sprul/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungasarjo/ /dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang //5—1324

yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /de nas pad+ma'i lag pa gyen du kha bye ste/gtor ma la gtad de/ sngags 'dis bsngo'o/ /oṃ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/dzak+ṣa—/ byu ta/ ba:/ bā u/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ pabe+e/ta la pā tā le/ aji①/ sabe+e swā hā/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ i rda ba lo/ bhuspru/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhūthra/ rmā sa/ dzi gha/ e bha/ sathra/kadz+dza—/ sā da④/ kharnyi/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha/rmā hūṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ t+pahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa brjod do/ /rigs lnga la bstod pa bya/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ phrin las gzhol/ smon lam gdab/phan gdags pa'i gtor ma'o/ /sngags pa gang zhig dgra dang bgegs la sogs pa tshar gcod pa'i las byed pa rnams kyis gong du smos pa'i gtor ma'i rdzas mdun du bzhag ste/ dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i ①rū pa yang dugator ma'i nang du dmigs la/ 'byung po nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa spyan drangs la gtor ma gtang / las gzhol ba ni/ lha chen brgyad po zhes pa nas/ /mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /de la sogs pa gnod sbyin tshogs/ /drag cing gtum pa'i 'byung po spyon/ /ma rungs sems can 'di dag la/ /drag cing snying rje med pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma dang ma mo dang / /mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin sha za dang / /lto 'phye dang ni srin po dang / /gzhan yang sha za khrag za ba'i/ /bye dang khra dang kang ka dang / /'ol ba bya rgod la sogs pa'i/ /gzugs can thams cad 'dir spyon cig /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs kyi/ /chung ma nor dang srog dang ni/ /gnod pa rnams nophrogs par mdzod/ /rang gi yul nas dbyung ba dang / /dgar ba dang ni 5—1325

bskrad par byis/ /bdag gi dpung ni stobs med la/ /dgra bgegs stobs ldan kho na ste/ /'di ni khyod kyis bza' ba'i phyir/ /sha dang khrag dang zhag dang rkang / /bza' ba btung dang bcas par ①mdzod/ /gnod byed gso'/ la de mdangs phrog② /rang gi rnal 'byor ci rigs par/ /long la bza' ba nyid du gyis/ /thams cad tshim par bzhes par mdzod/ /gang gis bdag la mi tshugs shing / /dgra bgegs thams cad choms par mdzod/ /bdag la las kyi dngos grub ni/ /rgya chen yongs su byed nas kyang / /nyid kyi gnas dang yul du gshegs/ /ci nus 'byor pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas byed la gsol ba ni/ /btsun mo dang ni sras dang g.yog tu bcas—/ /gsan zhing 'dir gshegs bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /yang gtor ma'i sngags brjod/ de nas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang / snying la sogs pa dang / gtor ma'i zas rnams gcig tu bsdus nas/ gnod sbyin la sogs pa mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ grangs med pas zos shing 'thungs par bsams la gtang / gtong ba'i dus su rol mo dang dril bu dang rnge chung gi sgra dkrol zhing gtang ngo / /de nas nang du zhugs la rang ci 'dod pa'i bzlas pa bya/gtor ma gtong ba'i dus su rang gang 'dod pa'i bskul tshig dang / dmod bcol dang / 'o dod bod/ su ba bya/ mā ra ya dang bcas pas①gtor ma gtang / dpal kye'i rdo rje'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //5—1326

bsdur mchan/1321 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanapal kye'i rdo rje gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ②③①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉kye'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wachog rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thacad/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉thartsam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ras/1322 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉gal te/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉po/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉cho ga du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉skabor/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉bosha 0〈〈pe〉po〈snar 〉〉wapa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉8nga /1322 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagos/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlabs/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsams/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thogs pa/1324 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉drangs pa'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉nga li rtswa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sga li ha/ ⑧〈'dir 〉〉warnams/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/1325 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ aṣ+ṭha/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉smon/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi sha ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/1326 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bca' bar/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉phrogs/ ni〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wapas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷9)5—1327

༄ga /kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ te badz+ra ba bo ta bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga /kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' kun du rgyu grub pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro rnams la rab tu 'dud/ /de dang de yi bya ba ni/ /gtor ma'i cho ga cung zhig bshad/ /de la gtor ma rnams gsum ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha rnams dang / /de sprul mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /mgron gyur ②phyogs skyong rnams la'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha la ni/ /re zhig byin kyis brlab pa yang / /bdag nyid 'dod pa'i lhar mos pas/ /snod dag mchog tu gyur pa ru/ /gtor ma'i rdzas ni bdud rtsir bsam—/ /de bstan de nyid gsum sngags brjod/ /yang na 'dod yon lngar gyur par/ /bsam zhing byin gyis brlabs ①sngags brjod/ /de rjes mdunadu dkyil 'khor ba'i/ /lha rnams skad cig rdor 'dzin bsam/ /de rnams 5—1328

dbul ba'i rim pa ni/ /oṃ ma hā bhū ta khā hi/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa bhuñdza bhuñdza kha kha khā ti/i rda ba dzi ta khā nyi/ a mṛ ta rā sa khā nyi/ kā ma gu ṇi sa mā ra sa khā nyi①/zhes gru blang so so'i mtshan dang sbyar ba ni/ oṃ te badz+ra ṣ+pe ②ra āt+pa ta i rda ma hā ba lo ta khā nyi/ de bzhin du oṃ badz+ra go dze+erī i rda ma hā ba dzi ta khā hi/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ /de ltar tshim zhing mnyes gyur nas/ /bdag nyid bsgrub pa rkyen sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gtor ma ni/ /re zhig byin brlabs sngags dang mtshungs/ /dbul thabs bdag nyid 'dod lha yi/ /mdun du dam tshig rjes dran nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams skad cig gis/ /tha snyad tshul du rab gyur nas/ /gtor ma'i longs spyod bya phyir dang / /las dang sgrub rjol rab bskul la/ /de rnams dbul ba'i rim pa ni/ /lhag ma bsnyus pa'i rim pa las/ /sngags 'di glu ru bcas pa brjod/ /oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba dzi ta badz+ra ḍā ki nī saṃ pa ni na/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nīrjo/i de u tsiṣ+ṭa ba dzi ta kha kha khā hi/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ bhuñdza bhuñdza/ pra tīts+tsha khā nyi/karma se snyi saṃ pa ni na swā hā/ de nas las dang dngos grub stsol/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ /mgron gyur ④'byung po'i gtor ma ni/ /mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum las/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag tu/ /chu skyes 'dab brgyad rim bzhin bsam/ /steng du sa bon oṃ gyur las/ /zla nyi nas gzung tshangs sogs par/ /mdog dkar rdo rje dril 'dzin pa/ /dbu la sku yi mtshan ma dag /rang 'dra'i tshogs pa brgyad du bsam/ /bar gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /ma yi lhar gyur phyogs skyong brgyad/ /sa bon brgyad gyur mdog spon po/ /rdo rje dril 'chang rang 'drar ldan/ /dbu la thugs kyis mtshan par 5—1329

bsam—/ /'og tu klu brgyad sa las byung / /mdog dmar rdo rje dril 'dzin zhing / /dbu la gsung gi rdo rjes mtshan/ /rang 'dra dang ni ldan par bsgom/ /de nas re zhig byin brlabs pa/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi'i snod bcas pa/ /rlung dang me sogs smin byed pa/ /de rjes bdud rtsi dang bsres la/ /gong du brjod pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /'od zer sbu gu lha rnams lces①/ /longs spyod pas ni tshim par byed/ /de tshe ze'u 'bru rnam gsum la/ /tshangs dang 'dod lha sa yi lha/ /rim pa bzhin du bsam par bya/ /de yi sngags brjod bskul bcas pa/ /rdo rje dril bu gsel gsor bya/ /oṃ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/dzak+ṣaske/ bhū ta/ bāsgo①/ ba u/ rak+ṣa①/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ pabe+e/ta la pā tā la/ aṣ+ṭa④/ sathra swā hā/ i rda ba lo⑤/ bhuñdza/ dzi gha/phul+la—/ dhūbe+e/ rmā sa/ dzi gha/ i bha/ sathrarjo/ kadz+dza/ sā da④/kharnyi—/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sat+tha dharmā hūṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da dutāta—/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phan yon sngon du bsngo ba ni/ /res 'ga' gtor ma btang ba dang / /rgyun du btang ba'i phan yon ni/ /rgyud du gsungs pa bzhin brjod do/ /bla ma dam pa'i rjes 'brang yid brtan zhing / /'phral la mngon du byed cing byen rlob pa/ /dam pa 'ga' yis gsol btab nas—/ /man ngag gzhung bzhin mthun par bris pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga'i rim pa rdzogs so// //5—1330

bsdur mchan/1328 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉tha' rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skoragyur/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlab/1329 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉khā nyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pyob/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉〉〉bi shwa ḍā ki gli/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉toragyur/133༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tses/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gla sna/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ringak+ṣa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snamaṣ+ṭha/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉〉ta/ 0〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉babra/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉gu hā/ ⑧〈'dir 〉snadutā / bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (110)5—1331

༄ga /phyag mtshan gyi phan yon bzhugs so//①༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye'i rdo rje bdag med ldan/ /mkha' 'gro brgyad kyis yongs skor ②la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni phyag mtshan rnams/ /bsnams pa'i phan yon rim bzhin brjod/ /glang po la sogs bsnams pa ni/ /nad rnams zhi bar mdzad pa ste/ /glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khrag skyug mdze nad 'brum bu dang / /mcher pa mchin pa'i rang bzhin no/ /glang pa ①la sogs rim zhes grags/ /sa la sogs pa brgyad rnams rjopa/ /phyug po thams cad 'grub pa'o/ /nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug po/ /gcod phyir gri gug g.yas pas te/ /dngos dang dngos med rtog pa la—/ /g.yon pa na ni pad snod do/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i dug chu dulas/ /nya 'dra'i 'gro ba 'don phyir dang / /bkra shis 'dzin pa ro hi ta/ /nyon mongs rgya 'dra gri gug g.yas/ /gti mug gis ni rab rmongs la/ /phag dang 5—1332

'dra ba'i sems can rnams/ /gti mug gnyid las ①bslang ba'i phyir/ /g.yas na cang te'u'i ①sgra sgogs pa/ /'dod chags kyis gdungs rus sbal ni/ /'gro ba'i nad rnams bsal phyir dang / /chags chen bdud rtsis tshim bya'i phyir//rus sbal dang ni pad snod bsnams/ /zhe sdang dgra yis pham byas pa/ /sbrul dang 'dra ba'i sems can rnams/ /zhe sdang chen pos tshim bya'i phyir/ /phyag na sbrul dang thod pa'o/ /ngan rtog pa yi ri dwags rnams/ /skrag par bya phyir seng ge'am/ /seng 'dra nga rgyal gzhom phyir ram/ /seng ge dang ni dgra sta bsnams—/ /bdag tu lta ba ①sogs pa yi/ /lta ba po yi gnyis pa'o/ /bdag tu lta ba'i mdud pa dang / /ser sna dgrol bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dge slong dang ni 'khar gsil lo/ /dper na thod pa lta bu yi/ /chos ni 'khor lo bsko ra ba yis/ /nyon mongs tha ba rlog pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo dang ni thod pa bsnams—/ /rnam par rtog pa'i ri brnyil zhing / /gdug pa tshar gcad dhibya ba'i phyir/ /g.yas pa sdigs mdzub bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka /ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /phyag mtshan bsnams pa'i yo/na tan rnams/ /ci nus brjod thob yon tan rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab gru chen dang / /brten nas mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal te/ /thar pa'i skam sar gnas par shog /phyag mtshan gyi phan yon rdzogs so// //5—1333

bsdur mchan/1332 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈0sdo 〉sko〈co 〉〉sgyur bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bskor/⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉྾〈co 〉〉po du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brnams/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stabatsho drug cu/1333 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉te/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bas/ rjo〈〈co 〉stanacod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (111)5wa 1334

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ti la ka kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/thig le chen po'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin gnyis bral gser 'dra yon tan 'phungs pa'i gzhi/ /'jug par bya ba'i rgyud nyid rang gi mngon du byed/ /rang nyams dpa' bo'i dpa' bo brtan g.yo'i skad cig bdag /mtha' gnas nam mkha' rtog bral bya ba ma lus rdzogs//rgya mtsho mtshon cha tshig gis mya ngan ye nas 'das/ /rang nyams shugs kyis dbang sgyur de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'byed sogs gsum gnyis thabs kyis ④rjes ma 'brangs/ /bya ba mdzub mo don gdon mi byed pas/ /skal mang nges med ngo peston 'dir dad gang / /nyi 'od gsal byed de phyir thabs man ngag /de bas sreg me blugs rjochu ma rgyud la/ /skal med rang gis 'brel pa'i skyes bu la/ /chu bos mtshon pa'i ming tshogs cung zad pa/ /rmongs pa bdag 'dra'i don phyir 5—1335

dbye bar bya/ /bstan bcos dang po'i rang bzhin ni/ /sa gser lta bur gdod nas dag /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ /rang bzhin ma skyes stong pa'ang min/ /rmi lam 'dod pa tshim bzhin pa①/ /'khrul pas rang don grub par byed/ /gzhi med snang ba'ang gser shing bzhin/ /mi 'gog de don shes bya ba/ /gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba de nyid dkar mor brjod/ /'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes bdag med ngo bo bas/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das shes bya/ /gzugs dkar sgra la chom rkun ma/ /dri ni ②ro langs ghasma rī/ /reg la mkha' spyod sa spyod ma/ /rtag par chos su rang gnas pas/ /longs spyod mya ngan 'das pa rdzogs/ /mi bskyod chu de ①rnam snang mdzad④/ /nyi ma'i 'byung ldan mtha' yas sems/ /don yod pas duni gtso bo lnga/ /gti mug la dusogs dbang po lnga/ /rang bzhin ye nas ma byas pa/ /rnam dag ngang gis 'ching ba med/ /de nas rang bzhin sdom pa dang / /nang gi sa bcu rim shes bya/ /gnas dang nye gnas zhing de bzhin/ /dur khrod tshajo 'du ba sogs/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba'i sku—/ /phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin/ /de bzhin gsang bar shes par bya/ /rkang pa bskyod pa mdor drod shes/ /'du ba rtag tu chur bstan pas/ /stong du dbyibs kyis bzhir shes bya/ /'khor lo bde ba de bzhin gnas/ /bha ga nam mkha' yin pa'o/ /bshang lam drag gtum dur khrod che/ /gsang gnas dbyibs can de bzhin du/ /rna ba rgod dang g.yer khar brjod/ /kha ni tshang tshing 'bar ba snang / /mi bzad ⑦dmyal tshogs mig tu bstan/ /shi ri shing gi dngos po ste/ /me tog 'bras bu dbang por bcas/ /ka ba gcig dang sgo 5—1336

dgur ldan/ /bdag med he ru ka bde ba/ /thabs dang shes rab ye nas 'brel—/ /nyi zla g.yas dang g.yon gyi stan①/ /gnyis med 'drel ba rtag tu phra/ /ma tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /mi phyed phra mo rdo rje ma/ /dkar mo g.yon pa brtse ba ma/ /thung ngu rus sbal chur shes bya/ /bsgom dbang rdo rje mkha' 'gror bstan/ /skyon ldan mjug ma puk+ka sī/ /ri khrod ma mo mtshan ma yin/ /tsha dang bsil ④la gdol ba mo/ /g.yung mo gzhol dang rangs byed ma/ /dkar mo sgo skyong gzugs spyi nyid/ /rgyu sbyin sbyor bral tshom rkun ma/ /sdu snegu grub ma ro langs ma/ /yid bzangs tshad ma ghasma rī/ /sum sgor 'dod ma sa spyod ma/ /mkha' spyod khyer ma gtum mor bstan/ /mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor byas pa med/ /sku dang phyag rgya yum gyi tshogs/ /'bras bu bde ba skad cig dag /rang bzhin nyid du rtag rjopar bya/ /bzhi gnyis nas brtsams drug cu'i bar/ /de sogs stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /de las rgyas par brjod mi lang / /rang bzhin sprul par rgyal bas megasungs/ /gsang ba'ang de bzhin shes par bya/ /'byung ba rim ldan rjobha gar gnas/ /bu gu 'dus pas sa nyid de—/ /bde ba mang pos mar shes bya/ /sku gsum rang bzhin gdod nas ldan//rang bzhin rnam dag 'jig rten na/ /gang yang bcings pa yod ma yin/ /dman pa'i bsal bya ji snyed pa/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis de lta'o/ /dpal thig le chen po'i rim pa las rang bzhin gyes gnas pa'i rim pa ste dang po'o// //'jug byed bskyed par shes bya ba/ /thabs dang bcas pas dman pa'i don—/ /lha dag sgra don las byung ba/ /yang dag sdom pa'ang der shes bya/ /5—1337

'khor lo dag la rnam sbyong zhing / /rang gi bde bas rang za bas/ /rnam rtog las grol sa bcu sbyong / /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgur shes bya/ /kun rdzob brjod pa ma yin te/ /lte ba mtha' zad shes rab la/ /thabs ni ze 'bru'i rtser shes bya//rtsa bar 'dab ma drug cu bzhi/ /sde tshan brgyad kyis mtha' stong pa/ /ma skyes pa yi snying po can/ /der ni dbus kyi gdan shes bya/ /'bar g.yo las su rnam brtags pas/ /las kyi dang por shes par bya/ /sa dbus chos su bstan pa ste/ /sngon la ①brgyad cha gcig yod pa/ /rtsa bzhi nang gi ma mo bzhi/ /gzhan dag rgyud las nges par gsungs/ /bcud ni phung po 'byung bar bshad/ /rtag par chos su 'di bstan te/ /snying po chos kyi skur shes bya/ /de nyid ye shes snying po yin/ /'di ni 'khor lo nam mkha'i khams/ /thams cad kun la khyab chen po/ /de nyid ④stong du longs spyod de/ /'byung ba bar bzhi stong pa bas—/ /ye shes lnga yi snying po can/ /chags pas rtag tu rang 'ching ba/ /log lta rtag tu grol bar dka'/ /'byung 'jug thogs med thar par 'gyur/ /pad+ma mtshan ldan bde ba che/ /rtag par gzhom med dbyings mtha' can/ /rang bzhin chos skur yongs shes par①/ /'di la sgo drug yod shes bya/ /ting 'dzin goms pa'i ye shes kyis/ /sa gnas kun du bde ba che/ /ye shes skye ba nges pa med/ /dkyil 'khor yan lag bcas sprul sku/ /de nyid bde bas bde byas te/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa kye'i rdo rje/ /las kyi lam la ④gzhan bzhin zhugs—/ /oṃ tra gnad kyi sgo phye dang / /phyogs kyi ye shes bdag gis byas/ /'bar 'dzin dang po'i sgor zhugs te/ /bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i lam dbus su/ /ting 'dzin rtsal gyis drang por byed/ /rnyed nas longs spyod mya ngan 'das/ /5—1338

sku gsum bzhi yang ma dmigs te/ /sems nyid bde la gang gnas pa/ /goms pas 'od kyang mi dmigs shing / /skra yi rtse mo brgya shas kyang / /mthar ni dmigs par mi byed na/ /bde ba yid kyis mi myong zhing / /mtha' rnams ci la'ang ①mi gnas te/ /spyod lam longs spyod der shes bya/ /'gro don 'dod pa'i sku gnyis kyang ②/ /sgra yi tshul las thogs ①pa med/ /rang bzhin snang ba ye shes ni/ /snang stong gnyis su ma yin pas/ /rtag tu thig le chen ngo/ra gsungs/ /dpal thig le ④chen po'i rim pa las ye shes chen po la 'jug pa'i rim pa ste ⑤gnyis pa'o// //rang nyams gnas 'dod blo ldan pas/ /yul du shes bya dka' dub ni/ /rang rigs 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma can/ /brgya dang bcu dang drug gnyis dang / /dkar nag phyed dang dkar nag min/ /skra nag mig ring lte ba zab/ /phra sbom ring thung gnyis spangs pa/ /sna drangs rked phra smad zheng che/ /'dab ma che zhing nang zab pa/ /nu sra nad nyung ga bur mang / /se la rab tu ldan pa dang / /phyi nang chu lus rlung dri zhim/ /'jam des dad ldan mi g.yo ba/ /lha yi rigs kyang brtag par bya/ /rnyed nas bstan bcos rim par sbyin/ /rgyal po'i bu mo'i dze+echos zhes bya/ /dam tshig rim dang zas sogs pa/ /rtog pa med par de shes nas/ /khu ba legs par sbyin byas te/ /rnam bzhi rlung yang shes pa/ra bya/ /mtshan dang mtshan mnyes rab bskul bas/ /pho brang bde ba skyed ⑧par byed/ /gnas dang rim pa ⑨shes bya ba/ /sprul pa chos dang bde ba che/ /dga' bde gnas par shes par bya/ /dga' ba mchog bral lhan cig skyes/ /5—1339

bstan bcos ngo bor de shes bya/ /skad cig de skad thang cig yud/ /rlung gi las kyis go phye ba'o/ /sna tshogs nyid dang nyin mtshan bral/ /las kyi rim pa nyid du gsungs/ /snang ba mched dang thob pa dang / /yang dag dri med 'od las byung / /nyin mtshan bar dang gnyi ka min/ /dngos po rnam gnyis phrad pa'i ming / /sde pa phyag rgya 'byung ba'i yum/ /mchog la sogs pa'ang skabs ming gsungs/ /rkyang ma ro ma kun 'dar ma/ /rigs gsum gnas pa'ang bde ba'i lam/ /nyi zla thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /rang gi dgos pa'ang des len te/ /kun rdzob pa yang gnyis su snang / /yongs grags srog nad de bdag nyid/ /mdud pa'i mtshan nyid nang du ste/ /dga' ba char yang ston pas gsungs/ /rtse mo sor mo bcu gnyis thig /de zhabs longs spyod shes par bya/ /brgyad brgyad rim pa ngo bor sbyor/ /de ni rang bzhin don du bstan//snang bas bde ba dga' ba yin/ /phyi rol reg bya gnyis par gsungs/ /phrad pas bde ba bral ba ste/ /gnas su lhan cig skyes pa 'byung / /thun mong rim par de shes bya/ /'khor lo rim par rim gnas pa/ /phyi rol don de nang yang yin/ /ba gam nang du 'bru gsum gnyis/ /rtse mor bar med de bzhin rim—/ /nor bu'i nang du de shes nas/ /de ni ze 'bru'i rim bcu drug /bdag gi thig le mthar gnas pa'o/ /blo yi yul du de shes nas/ /gnas sogs nang gi sa shes bya/ /gsang ba'i sa rim dga' ba'i mthar thabs dang shes rab sangs rgyas sa/ /pa shang mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin/ /snang ba gnyis las rnam par 'das/ /de ltar sa las rim shes nas/ /dper na me yis tshig pa'i lus/ /me nyid kyis ni gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes 5—1340

tshig pa/ /chags pa nyid kyis rab tu sel/ /skye bo mi bzad pa yi ①las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /log lta nyan thos skal med skur/ /des na thar pa ring bar gsungs/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab sbyor bas/ /sra bas sprul pa sa ru bshad/ /gsher ba'i grangs chos mā ma tī/ /bskyod pas gos dkar longs spyod rdzogs/ /'gugs pa sgrol ma bde ba che/ /hūṃ phaṭa rang gi rlung mthu yis/ /mchog gi mtha' nas brtag par bya/ /dngos po 'dus pas sdegang shes pa/ /'dus pa ma yin bral ba'ang min/ /nyi zla'i sems dang bcas pa'i dngos/ /dngos po lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /1nga ba med par gang 'dres pa/ /de bde thabs las thams cad rig /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes bya/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dga' yin phyir/ /dgyes pa chen por de brjod do/ /chos thams cad kyi sdom cig ①pas/ /sdom pa'ang thig le chen por brjod/ /sdom pa che la su gnas pa/ /bsrung ba med de 'da' ba'ang med/ /thabs dang shes rab yod min pas/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu ma'ang dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /yo ga saṃ pu ṭa yar bshad/ /gtan tshigs zhib par gsal byed pa/ /de nyid rang gi sems rtog yin/ /bla ma'i dus thabs phyag rgya dang / /rang gi bsod nams las shes 'gyur/ /sngon gyi ye shes de rnyed nas/ /las kyi lus nyid mi snang ste/ /thabs shes dngos po 'dres par 'gyur/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs byang chub/ /'di las rim pa yod ma yin/ /gal te dag par mi 'gyur yang / /a nu yo ga'i dmigs pa yis—/ /rtag tu rang nyams 'jug par ldan/ /brtul zhugs zad par mi 5—1341

dgos na/ /mi gang mun sel rnyed pa bzhin/ /bzhi yi phyag rgya spangs kyang rung / /bde ba nyams par yongs mi 'gyur/ /mthar phyin bya ba med par 'grub—/ /yon tan spros pa brjod mi lang / /dpal thig le chen po'i rim pa las rang nyams ye shes chen po'i rim pa ste gsum pa'o// //ye shes mthar phyin rnal 'byor pa/ /rang bzhin ye shes de rnyed pas/ /rang bzhin du ma gcig mthar bral/ /yod med dbus las 'das pa'i sku/ /bdag med gzhan med der shes med/ /dman pa 'bring dang mchog dag dang / /gzhan dang gang rnams de rnams kyang / /bdag tu ro mnyam gcig tu shes/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las/ /brtan g.yo'i rang bzhin gzhan mi mthong / /ji ltar byas pa de nyid yin/ /kha dog dbyibs dang stong bsgoms pas/ /don 'di nam yang rnyed mi nus/ /las kyi rim par gsungs pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya chen po rgyu dang bral/ /rang rig gsal ba'i ye shes ni/ /cis kyang stong pa ma yin pas/ /bsgrub bya'i rnam grangs ci rnyed pa/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub ces gsungs/ /nor bu rin chen yon tan bzhin/ /rtag tu cir yang dga' ba ①med/ /yul du snang ba ma yin pas①/ /dus gsum ma 'gags ye shes mchog /sbyin sreg slob sogs las grol ba/ /rang nyams rig la gnas par rnyed—/ /de nyid ston pas yang gsungs pa/ /rig pa skyes bu grub pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa de ni thams cad spangs shing thams cad du gnas pa yin/ bya ba thams cad spangs pa/ byed pa gang yang mi 'gog pa/ ci yang ma yin pa/yon tan gang yang mtshungs pa ①med pa/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ gar yang mi 5—1342

gnas—/ thog ma dang tha ma la sogs pa rnam par spangs pa/ bsnyen pa'i yan lag gsum du snang ba/ thams cad du gshegs pa/ thams cad du mkhyen pa/ thams cad pa/ thams cad kyi don/ thams cad kyi sems la gnas pa/ ngan song thams cad las rnam par grol ba/ yon tan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ kha dog dang dbyibs thams cad pa/ thams cad la phan pa/ dge ba mtshungs pa med pa/ lan cig ma yin par 'byung ba/mgon po skyob ①pa/ kun du rtog sdepa spangs pa/ kha dog dang dbyebs thams cad dang bral ba/ zab pa'i phyir skye bo'i yul ma yin pa/ thams cad kyi bdag po'i phyir rgyal po/ dbye bar dka' ba'i phyir rdo rje/ nyon mongs pa'i nye bar gdung ba las grol ba'i phyir zla ba/ thams cad snang ba'i phyir nyi ma/dogs pa med pa'i phyir seng ge/ gnying dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ chu'i phung po chen po/ thams cad kyi gzhi'i phyir nam mkha' thams cad/ lhun byis grub pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /dpal thig le chen po'i rim pa las mthar phyin pa'i don la gnas pa'i rim pa ste bzhi pa'o// //kye'i rdo rje'i rgya mtsho rgyud chen las/ /rang bzhin 'jug nyams 'bras bu lo thog ①bzhin/ /mtha' 'khob rgyal 'dra gzu lums don mdzad pa/ /ngang pa'i chu bzhi phreng bas mthar phyin shog/ /dpal thig le chen bo'i rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i man ngag /rgya gar kyi mkhan po bla ma sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5—1343

bsdur mchan/1335 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉thig le chen po'i rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉stedon/ 〈〈co 〉〉de/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgrug1336 ①〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉du/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉ro/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉skasto/ ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉bshad/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉mig ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zad/1337 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skastong / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasil/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sdug du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtag⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mis pas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstan/1338 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stananyis/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉3/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas lam/1339 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gra/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉thog du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wathigale/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉boste/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dkur/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉stab/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉sku da/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉par/1341 ①〈〈snar 〉stonas/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanacig1342 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragag pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapa/1343 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉smoskyab/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa thugabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (112)5wa 1344

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje'i grub pa'i thabs mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa don rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān he badz+ra sā dha ā+oṃ a rnyi sa ma ya kra mārja pra sa na ②nā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa don rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi ye shes me lta bus/ /rnam rtog ma lus sreg ①mdzad cing / /snying rje chu yis sdud dumadzad pa/ /kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal te/ /bdag pas blo dman rnams don du/ /sgrub thabs don rab gsal ba brtsam⑤/ /de la rnal 'byor pas dang po dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bdag nyid kye'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las pad+ma/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros pas sna bug g.yas nas byung bas kye'i rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 5—1345
