rdzus skyes dang chos mthun par bskyed par bya ste/ de yang zhu ste gong bu gnyis su gyur te/ gong bu gcig ni steng 'og gi nyi zla gnyis dang / bar du sa bon hūṃ las rdo rjer gyur/ de las sa bon gyis mtshan/ de las 'od zer rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs spros bsdus pa las gcig tu gyur pa las sku mdog nag po la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid du gyur to/ /de bzhin du bdag med ma la yang oṃ dang gri gug la sogs pa byang chub pa lnga las gyur to/ /de ma thag tu zhabs rnams kyi stang hu stabs la sogs pa gyur pa'i rjes la/ dbus kyi gnas su dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por gyur to/ /de nas yang 'khor rnams kyi sku mdog dang / mtshan ma la sogs pa gsal bar byas pa dang / sems dpa' sum brtsegs bya ste/ de la dpa' bo'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje'o/ /de la snehūṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa las bskyed pa'i ye shes pa rang dang 'dra ba'o/ /de'i yang thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūṃ yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan dag la yang hūṃ dang rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs bya ba nyid do/ /de nas gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te gsal ba de ④las byung ba'i yid kyis mchod pas mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu dha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje glu dang phyag rgyar bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra go rī badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra tso rī badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be tā rjolī badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ⑤hoḥzhes pas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang durjobyed cing / dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang dbyer med du gyur to/ /de nas dam tshig 5—1404

la ye shes kyi 'khor lo brten ①zhing nus pa bskyed pa'i don du lha kun gyi ④skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sku gsung thugs so/ /de la gtso bo'i mig la mi kyi sa bon no/ /de yang yongs su gyur pa las gti mug rdo rje ma gsal bar bsam zhing / oṃ ①mo ha badzi oṃ t+pahūṃ zhes brjod do/ /rna bar sa bon ḍi las zhe sdang rdo rje ma bsam zhing / rda dwo ṣa badz+re oṃ ā hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /sna la paṃ yongs su gyur pa las ser sna rdo rje ma bsam zhing / paṃ be shu na badzi oṃ lngasahūṃ zhes brjod do/ /kha la ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma bsam zhing / re rā ga badz+re oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod do/ /lus la oṃ yongs su gyur pa las phrag dog rdo rje ma bsam zhing / oṃ i 05 badzi oṃ ā hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /snying gar yid la yang sa bon rna yongs su gyur pa las bdag med par bsam zhing /rja ṣ+pe ra āt+pa badz+re oṃ uhūṃ zhes brjod do/ /de bzhin du gtso bo'i snying ga dang /sgog ma dang / spyi bor oṃ ā hūṃ gi sa bon las/ mkha' spyod sku'i rdo rje ma/sa spyod gsung gi rdo rje ma/ zhabs 'og gnas pa thugs kyi rdo rje mar gsal bar bskyed cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophohaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolhahaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā tā la wa se ni badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes brjod de/ de bzhin du lha kun la yang rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas byung ba'i 'od zer gyis mdun gyi nam mkhar byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la/yang 'od zer rmis mchod cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas mnyes par gyur pa de las/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣiñtsa tu me/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas dang byang 5—1405

chub sems dpa' de dag dpal te ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gyur te/de bzhin gshegs pa lnga zhu ba'i bum pas lha kun la ①dbang bskur nas/ so sor rigs kyi bdag po dbu la bskyed cing / me tog gi char la sogs pa byung ba dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka badz+ra swa bhā ba ā ko3haṃ zhes brjod do//de nas yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon kyi 'od zer las mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs spros nas bdag nyid gtso bo dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo la mchod de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /ces bya ba la sogs pa 'am/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rnams yongs su bskor/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas 'khor gyis gtso bo la bstod par bsam zhing / bdag nyid kyang ②glu blang zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra stu te badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3haṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho ga bya ste/ bdag nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rang gi ye shes kyi snang ba las gyur pa yin pas na rang dang tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas rang gi mdun du 'jig rten pa'i g.yos byed pa'i tshul du shaṃ 3yongs su gyur pa las thod pa gsum dang / yi las rlung ngo / /de nas re yongs su gyur pa'i me'i ④steng du/ a yongs su gyur pa'i thod pa'o/ /nang du bdud rtsi'i ri lu'am bye ma stsos byed dang sbyar ba la/ bi ra shu ma mu dang /go ku da ha na las bdud rtsi lnga dang / sgon ma lnga'i ngo bor gyur to/ /de'i steng du hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rgya gram kha chod lta bur bsam mo/ /de nas rlung gis me bskyod pas thod par bdud rtsi dang sgon ma 'dres shing khol bas rlangs pa lta bu'i 'od zer byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs 5—1406

ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste/ de rdo rje la thim pas zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim zhing 'dres par gyur to/ /oṃ uhūṃ zhes lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun rang gi gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs kar bskyed cing dmigs pa'am/ yang na rang nyid las gyur pa'i 'od zer lta bu'i snang bar bsams te/ rang gi lce la hūṃ las gyur pa'i rdo rje nas 'bru tsam bsam mo/ /de'i 'od zer sbu gus bdud rtsi'i ro myang zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta su satwa na badz+ra swa bhā ba ātā kophohaṃ—/ zhes brjod do/ /de ltar yan lag drug po dag /'khor los sgyur ba drug rnams su/ /mos dang ldan pas bsgoms gyur na/ /myur du byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de yi rtags ni 'di yin te/ /dang po sprin dang 'dra ba ni//sprin med nam mkha'i bar du'o/ /de nas rdzogs ①de kho na nyid/ /gtum mo sngar ba la sogs bya/ /rnal 'byor de yis ngal gyur nas/ /de nyid rjes su dran pa dang / /sngags bzlas gtor ma gtang ba dang / /spyod lam lhag par mos pa bya/ /de dag gi don ni 'di yin te/ yan lag drug po zhes pa ni/ /gzhi dang rjes su chags pa dang / /dbang bskur mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang / /'khor los sgyur drug ces pa ni/ /rtag pa rdo rje 'chang ba dang / /mi bskyod don yod rin chen 'byung / /'od dpag med pa'am ye shes rnams/ /chos ldan bsgom pa zhes pa ni/ /rnam pa de dag bsgom pa'i tshe/ /mos pa sangs rgyas rang bzhin no/ /myur du byang chub 'thob ces pa ni/ mchog tu gyur pa'i rten 'byel mthu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mkhyen phyir ro/ /de'i rtags zhes pa ni/sems brtan de nyid la 'jug dang / /dngos grub 'grub pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /5—1407

dang po sprin dang 'dra zhes pa ni/ dbang stobs lhan skyes bu mo'am/ /las kyi phyag rgya mngon du snang / /sprin med nam mkha'i bar du'o/ /zhes pa ni/sgom dang spyod pa ①'bras bu'i stobs/ /phyag rgya la sogs rim bzhin sbyar/ /rdzogs rim de kho na zhes pa ni/ rim gnyis tshogs pa gcig pa'am/ kharten khya te byin gyis brlab phyir ro/ /gtum mo sbar ba la sogs zhes pa ni/ mtshan ma rnam rtog 'joms pa yis/ /yi ge a ①ma thig le las/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer byung bas so/ /sogs pa rdzogs rim gzhan yang bsgom/ /rnal 'byor de yis ngal zhes pa ni/ rim pa gnyis kyis ngal gyur na/ /dbugs dbyung ba ni rnam pa gsum/ /de nyid rjes su dran zhes pa ni/ bdag nyid lha yi phung po dang / /skye mched la sogs lha mor dran/ /te ru ka yi cha byad ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i rnam dag dran/ /sngags bzlas zhes pa ni/ de la sngags kyi bzlas pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid rim pa gnyis po dag /tshogs pa gcig tu snang byas nas—/ /bdag nyid nam mkha'i ngos gnas pa'i/ /zla ba lta bu'i bsam gtan mos/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid ni/ /chu zla lta bur gyur pa'o—/ /de la sngags kyi bzlas pa yang / /bdag nyid tshogs pa gcig gyur pas—/ /sgra rings gsal ba khri 'bum bzlas/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor pa dag kyang / /sgra brnyan brag ca'i tshul du zlos/ /gtor ma btang zheshā pa ni/ de la gtor ma'i bya ba ste/ /bshad rgyud lung dang man ngag go/ /bdag nyid tshogs pa gcig gyur pas/ /mdun gyi chos 'byung gru gsum du/ /steng 'og pad+ma rim gsum bya/ /steng du tshangs pa la sogs lha/ /oṃ skyes mdog dkar rtag pas mtshan/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yis/ /rang mtshungs rig ma rjodang 5—1408

ldan pa'o/ /bar gyi pad+ma hūṃ las byung / /mdog sngon mi bskyod pa yis mtshan/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yis/ /rang mtshungs rig ma ①dang ldan pa'o/ /'og gi pad+mar a las byung / /mdog dmar 'od dpag med pas mtshan/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yis/ /rang mtshungs rig ma ②dang ldan pa'o/ /yam̐ las rlung dang ram̐ las me/ /a las thod par bdud rtsi bsam/ /bdud rtsi sgon ma'i sa bon las—/ /rim bzhin bskol bas 'od zer byung / /de yis ye shes bkug byas te—/ /de nyid gsum gyi sngags kyis brtan/ /de la sngar kyi mgron rnams kyi/ /lce yi 'od zer sbu gu yis/ /bdud rtsi ro ru gsol bar byed/ /oṃ in+da/ dza ma—/ dza la/ dzak+ṣa/ bhū sneta/ bsno/ ba u/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ma dadu/ pabe+e/ tal pā tā le/ aji rjosabe+e swā hā/ i rda ba bo/ bhuñdza/dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhū pa/ rmā sa/ dzi gha/ sam+bha/ sapas/ kadz+dza/ sā da④/kharnyi—/ khya ṇi⑧/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ⑨/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ t+pahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gal te mtshan phyed tshogs 'khor lo/ /byed na dbugs dbyung bzhi pa ste/ /gnyis 'og gtor ma'i sngon du bya/ /dang por kun gyis khrus la 'jug /bdud rtsi lnga dang dri zhim byugs/ /gos bzang rus sogs rgyan rmis brgyan/ /so so'i mgo la me tog gzhag /yang na me tog phreng bas bcing / /thig gdab le tsher bya ba dang / /rang rang stan la bde bar 'dug /kun rmi rnal 'byor gsal ba ru/ /phyogs dang mtshams su lha ru gsal—/ /de nas karma badz+ra yis/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa lnga/ /rnal 'byor kun la rim bzhin bri/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lha rnams la/ /ba bo chen po'i gtor ma bstab/ /bza' dang btung ba'i phud bsdus la/ /lag tu 5—1409

thogs nas 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra gau rī ga ṇa tsakra a dhijo ①na/ zhes pa'i glu ni drug 'gyur du/ /lha mo brgyad po rim bzhin du/ /de ltar byin gyis brlab byas la/ /karma badz+ras phud de rnams/ /gtor chen bskyed gsum ldan par ni/ /ra mgo lug mgo mi mgo can/ /'phan dang ba dan brgyan pas dbul—/ /oṃ he badzā dhijo na/ ma hā ba bo ta pra tīts+tsha ho/ kha kha khā nyi khā hi/kṛṇ+ḍi greṇ+ḍa/ bhuñdza juñdza pra tīts+tsha hoḥzhes pas glu blang zhing / oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe ra āt+pa/oṃ badz+ra go rī zhes pa'i ming kun dang sbyar zhing dbul lo/ /de nas karma badz+ra yis//rdo rje slob dpon la sogs pa/ /kun gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal bya/ /rdo rje lag kor ②gar bya zhing / /rdo rje glu yis 'di skad brjod/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor dam pa mchog /bde ba chen po'i ros gang ba/ /de yi rkyen du dbul lags kyis/ /dgyes pa'i mdangs kyis bzhes su gsol/ /de nas bza' dang bca' la sogs//khyad par dang ni thun mong du/ /so sor tshim par gyur nas kyang / /rdo rje gar du glu blangs te/ /tshogs kyi bdag pos sngar byas pa'o/ /yang na gzhan dag gis kyang ngo / /oṃ badz+ra go rī hūṃ/ badz+ra pū dza a ④nut+ta ra zhes pa rkang pa gsum gyi 0glus lha mo brgyad car la sbyar bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang skad cig dga' ba'i glu—/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skad cig ma/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod rab tu 'bul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /sgeg dang dpa' la sogs pa rnams/ /rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma/ /mchog dga'i longs spyod rab tu 'bul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /bde ba'i ston mo la sogs pa'i/ /rnam pa med pa'i skad cig ma/ /dga' bral longs spyod rab tu 'bul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /bde 5byed1410

mchog chen po la sogs pa/ /mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig ma/ /lhan skyes longs spyod rab tu 'bul/ /'jig rten ma lus thams cad kyang / /nam mkha' kun gyi ①rnal 'byor gyis/ /nam mkha'i dam tshig la zhugs te/ /thams cad nam mkhar longs spyod pa'o/ /zhes pa yis ni glu blangs la/ /gal te slob ma 'jug 'dod la/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo sngon nyid du/ /cung zad bzlas pa'i rjes la bya/ /de yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /las su bya ba 'di yin te—/ /sngon du grangs dang mtshan ma'o/ /dus kyi bsnyen pas sbyang bar bya /'bum dang khri yis gtso 'khor lo/ /de bzhin zla drug goms pa dang / /sngags kyi rab mthong pha rol son/ /gsal bar nus pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /der ni bsnyen pas mthu bskyed nas②/ /sa yi cho ga brtag pa ni/ /phyi dang nang du shes par bya/ /phyi ni tshwa sgo can la sogs/ /ngan pa'i skyon dag spang byas nas/ /grong khyen byang ngam shar du gzhol/ /mnyam la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /nad ni mtshan ma rmi lam sogs/ /rnal 'byor nus pas rab tu brtag /sbyang ba de bzhin phyi dang nang / /phyi ni 'dom gang lte ba dang / /pus nub tsam du brko byas te/ /'byor pa rab 'bring tha ma yis/ /rdo dang gyo mo sol dum bsal/ /de nas nang gi sbyang ba ni/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /de nas byin gyis brlab bya ste/ /'og gzhi ri rab rtse mo'am/ /shrī dha na la sogs pa yi/ /bde ba can gyi gnas su bsam/ /der gnas pa yi rnal 'byor ni/ /yan lag drug po sngar bzhin bya/ /de nas sa yi lha mo ni/ /bskyed cing spyan drangs bzhugs pa la/ /ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshig gis ④dpang por gsol/ /de rjes rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /5—1411

slob dpon la ni grogs mchog gis/ /phyogs bzhi nas bstod gsol ba gdab/ /de yi dor byas langs te bsrung / /rdo rje lta stangs rdo rje 'gros/ /dengs shig pa dang stang stabs sogs/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i gzhung bzhin bya/ /de yi mtshan mo sta gon ni/ /lha dang bum pa slob ma'o/ /de la lha yi bya ba ni/ /dang por karma badz+ra yis/ /bya ba la ni 'jug pa dang / /tshogs bsags pa dang rnal 'byor ni/ /yan lag drug po sngar bzhin bya/ /de nas bdag nyid phun sum tshogs/ /ldan pa'i ①bla ma la ni 'pho/ /de tshe dri yi thig le dang / /me mar dgu sogs phun tshogs bya/ /de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /gzugs brnyan me tog tshom bu la/ /ting 'dzin sa bon bdag ②gis bskyed/ /ye shes bkug la sum bsreg ①bya/ /de yang rang gi snying ga yi/ /sa bon 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /mdun du ye shes 'khor lo bsdu/ /yid las byung ba'i mchod pa yis/ /ci rigs mchod rjocing sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas go rī la sogs pa'i/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sngags dang ni/ /glur bcas pa yi phyag rgya ni/ /dgug sogs thim pas ye shes 'bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sgrub ste gzhan la yang ma yin/ /skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs/ /byen gyis brlab dang dbang bskur ba/ /sngar bzhin byas te mchod pa'i tshogs/ /'dir ni rab tu rgyas par bya/ /bstod dang bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /sngags dang bcas pa sngar bzhin bya/ /de nas yang ni ⑤'di skad brjod/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can/ /ston pa gtso bo khrag 'thung larjo/ /bdag med ma dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs 5—1412

mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro dang / /rig pa'i lha mo sgyu 'phrul dang / /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la yang phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can dag 'di zhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas lha la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yis/ /bum pa'i bya ba rab ①tu brtsam/ /de yang rgyu dang mtshan nyid dang / /sbyang dang byin brlab bya ba lnga/ /de sdom pa yi tshig yin no/ /de la rgyu zhes pa ni/ gser dngul zangs ma la sogs pa'i/ /rin chen las sam 'jim pa'ang rung / /mtshan nyid ces pa ni/ lto che mgrin pa ring ba dang / /mchu 'phyang la ①sogs ra ri med/ /sbyang zhes pa ni/ legs par bkru zhing dkar pos byug /sa bon yang na mtshan ma dgod/ /yungs kar brdeg dang spos kyis bdug /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsrung / /ras bzang mgul chings kha rgyan la/ /gzungs thag btags pa'i rdo rje gzhag④ /de yi nang du chu bzang po/ /'o ma ldan pa gzhug par bya/ /sman lnga ha sa de ba dang / /daṇ+ḍa ut+pal kaṇ+ḍa kar/ /sha ta thra ha a pa rtsid/ /byang chub lnga ni rten du gzhug /'bru lnga 'bras dang ma sha sran/ /nas dang gro dang til dkar nasarjo/ /lha rnams kyi ni rang bzhin no//rin chen lnga ni gser dang dngul/ /mu tig gam ni mu men te/ /byi ru g.yas su 'khyil pa'i dung / /lha rnams che ba'i bdag nyid do/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi sgon ma dang / /snying po lnga yang nang du gzhug /de nyid gsum dang ming spel ba'i—/ /sngags kyis so so'i rdzas la gdab/ /oṃ kalpa thrak+ṣa lnga hūṃ/ oṃ pañtsa 5—1413

añtsa sgosahūṃ/ oṃ pañtsa ①be sha ā hūṃ/ oṃ pañtsa gasnya ②lngasahūṃ/ oṃ pañtsa rma sa yasahūṃ/oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa ste/ gzhan la yang de nyid gsum tsam brjod//byin brlabs ④zhes pa ni/ bdag nyid lhar gsal snying ga yi/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus bum pa sbyang / /de nas yi ge hūṃ du gyur/ /de las gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /khaṃ gi yi ge dkar po las/ /bum pa'i nang ni stong par bsam /de nas baṃ yig dmar po las/ /lha snam pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /re phas nyi ma'i gdan bsam bya/ /dbus su hūṃ las gtso bo ni/ /rig mar bcas pa gsal bar bskyed/ /shaṃ rtsa baṃ hūṃ bzhi las ni/ /go rī la sogs phyogs su'o/ /paṃ saṃ lo ḍi bzhi po ni/ /yongs gyur mtshams su sbos mo sogs/ /de nas ye shes 'khor lo yang / /bdag nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /'od zer gyis ④ni mdun du dgod/ /de la mchod yon mchod par bya/ /cung zad sngags dang bcas par brjod/ /de nas gau rī la sogs pa/ /dbyer med bstem par bya ba dang / /mchod cing bstod pa sngar bzhin bya/ /bdud rtsi myang ba 'dir mi dgosaske/ /bya ba zhes pa ni/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ste/ /dang po lha mo bzhi yi sngags/ /ru ru spru ru la sogs pas/ /bum nang chu la sogs pa'i rdzas/ /'byung ba bzhi yis bsdus pa kun/ /lha mo bzhi ru byin gyis brlab/ /de nas lha yi bzlas pa yang / /brgya'am stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /de tshe bdag gis bsam rgyud ni/ /snying gar gzung ba'i skud pa nas/ /yi ge hūṃ la lag pa sbyor//de yi 'od kyis pad+ma nas/ /byang sems gyen du drangs gyur te/ /skud pa'i gzugs dukyis rdo rjer thim/ /rdo rje bum nang lha la thim/ /lha kun zhu bas bum pa gang / /de nas rol mor bcas pa yis/ /ras bzang me tog gcal ①5—1414

bkram pa'i/ /steng du byin gyis brlabs la gzhag① /de ltar rnam rgyal bum pa bzhin/ /bum pa gzhan la'ang lha rer zhu/ /ci rigs pa yi tshogs mchod ②byarka/ /de nas bla ma slob dpon gyis/ /slob ma lhag par gnas par bya /sdom ni mtshan nyid bya ba dang / /cho ga smin pa rnam bzhi'o/ /de la mtshan nyid ①ces pa ni/ /nga rgyal med cing dbang dul larjo/ /rigs bzang dge ba bcu dang ldan/ /rgyal po'am rang gi bu med ⑤pa/ /de nas mtshan nyid ldan pa gzhug /bya ba zhes pa ni/ snga bar khrus dang maṇ+ḍal bya/ /de la sems bskyed sdom pa sbyin/ /de yi nyin par slob ma ni/ /bsam pa bzang po ldan bzhin du//rdzas 'di dag ni nyer bsag bya/ /bum pa'i sman la sogs pa dang / /ku sha srung skud la sogs dang / /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rdzas rnams dang / /tshogs kyi longs spyod la sogs pa'o/ /cho ga zhes pa ni/ dang por las kyi rdo rje yis//tshogs bsags pa dang yan lag drug /bdag nyid ldan pa phun sum tshogs/ /sngar bzhin byas nas bla ma la/ /mos pa'i dbang gis 'pho byas la/ /de nas bla ma mos ldan la/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal phyag la sogs/ /byas te gsol ba gdab par bya/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /mgon po chen po tshul bstan pa/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par bgyi/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te//gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da 5—1415

ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mdon nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma rnyed①/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan te ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad rnams/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mdon thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis sdeblo gros 'di byis shig /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lor bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /kun la'ang rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang rnam snang sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid bdag med par gnas pa/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par/ /bdag nyid ④sdom pa'i rjolegs par bzung / /de nas bshags pa la sogs pa/ /gzhan las byung bzhin tshig tu yang / /slob ma dag ni brjod du gzhug /de nas bdag gis tshig bcad 'di/ /rna ru 'bab pa dbyangs su brjod/ /bdag gis sdig pa bgyes pa dang / /bgyid du pa dang yi rang ba sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi//bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams tshogs/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /5—1416

sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mchog la/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /'di nyid ①du ni sems bskyed do/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad brjod/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa gsol/ /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol pa las sdebyung ba'i/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor lor sbyor/ /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong byed che/ /slob dpon bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /rtog pa rnams ni legs par bsdus nas kyang / /shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas ①nyon/ /brjed bungs blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi zlob/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /bla duchen byed kyis gzung bar gyis/ /byang chub sems gang rdo rje de/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar barmi0/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos byed kyis gzung bar gyis/ /las kyi rigs 5—1417

mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ①ci nus kyis/ /gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di dag ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba zhes bshad de/ /kha na ma tho sgom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log par mi spyod cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun byi rtsar gyur pa'i/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can gdul phyir ma gtogs par/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bkur bar bya//lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su spongs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /'gro ba'i don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /khyod kyis brnyas dze+epar mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /khyod kyis kyang ni bsrung bar byis/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad brjod/ /mgon po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma lus bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dus 'di nyid nas sangs rgyas par/ /bla med bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po nas/ /sems can mya ngan las 'das dgod/ /lan gsum du ni brjod par bya/ /de ltar phyi tshul byen brlabs nas/ /man ngag gis ④ni nang byin brlabadu/ /de yang slob mas 'di skad brjod/ /bdag ni dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten mi ring sangs rgyas myur 5—1418

bsgrubs nas/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /bla med byang chub tu ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /yang na 'di skad brjod du gzhug /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' kun gye mchog /'dren pa bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su brjod/ /mtshan min thams cad dag pa yang ①/ /kun du bzang pos sangs rgyas mchog /'dren pa bdag la byen rmis rlobs/ /yang dag sangs rgyas mchog zhi ba/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam par sbyong / /kun du rdo rje gsum 'byung ba/ /'dren pa bdag la byin gyis zlobs/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i dri ma med/ /rnam par snang mdzad cher 'byung ba/ /'dren pa bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /de dag glur bcas sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sbo nya/ sarba ta thā ga tā la yi/badz+ra satwa sa murtse ba haṃ/ ma mā dhi tijo na ya ke/ sarba ka lak+ṣa saṃ pū raḥ/ saṭ+wā lak+ṣa na bi brdzi ④ta/ sa man+ta bha dra budha ba haṃ/ ma mā dhi tijo na ya ka/ shān+ta dharmot+ta lo— ba①/ dzñā na tsa ra bai shodha ④shaṃ/ badz+ra ra le sa mudzha tai/ ma mā a dhi tijo ⑤na ya kai/ sarba satwa ma hā tsir+ghaṃ/ shurnyaḥpra kṛ duti ni rma lodze+e/ ma hā bai ro tsa ṇa bur+ghaṃ⑧/ ma ma a dhi tijo na ya ka/ de skad brjod cing smad lnga gtugs⑨—/ /brkyang phyag btsal te zhus pa dang / /bla mas rang snang rig ma ⑩dang / /snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /slob ma'i sgo gsum dag par sbyang / /slob ma bu ru bya ba'i phyir/ /de nas gsang ba'i gnas su gzhug /ci rigs dbang yang bskur bya ste/ /slar byung lus 'dud spyan sngar ni/ /de la las kyi rdo rje yis/ /dri chab rak+ṣa'i sngags kyis bsrung / /spos su ldan pa'i 5—1419

lag pa yis/ /bye bor reg nas gnas gsum du/ /de nyid gsum gyi gnas kyis brjod/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta u da yā mi/ de ni sngar gyi thun mong la'o /oṃ yo ga tsit+ta gro da yā mi su ra ste/ ya thā su khaṃ/ slob ma kun la de bzhin bya/ /de ltar sems bskyed dang po dang / /khyad par rdo rje 'chang ba'i rigs/ /ji ltar bde las gyur pa de/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang sangs rgyas sras/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi yab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sras/ /bde gshegs sras kyi thu bo'o/ /bde gshegs bka' bzhin byed la sogs/ /sems bskyed yon tan ldan dag la①/ /mgo la me tog sbyin par bya/ /mdun du spos sbyin mar me dang / /dri yi mchod pa snying gar sbyin/ /de bzhin bshos gtsang la sogs pa/ /ci rigs sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ /de nas so shing yid du 'ong / /u dusmra ra a shwat+tha④/ /bha ba ta sogs shing bzang pos mi yo ma chag 'bus ma zos/ /ma rnyings srog chags spangs pa ni/ /sor ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /rtse mor me tog ldan bcings la/ /phyi ba la sogs ba byung lngas/ /sa gzhi byugs pa ba ko tsam/ /maṇ+ḍal de yi drung du ni/ /slob ma langs te 'dug byas nas/ /langs te kha ton ①dag byas nas/ /ltos pa med par thal sbyar gzung / /shar bltas mi dma' lus mi yo/ /phan tshun mi dor mdun drang por/ /dor ba de la mtshan ma brtag /de yang bla ma'i gdams ngag gis//dngos grub phrin las bar chod gsum/ /dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ /dngos grub rab ni shar phyogs dang / /rang la bltas pa las shes bya/ /'bring po gzhan dag tha ma yang / /'og bltas 'dam la me tog zug /de bzhin gnyis po bla ma yi/ /zhal gyi gdams ngag las shes bya'o/ /de nas kha 5—1420

yi nyes bsal ba/ /dri chu lag pa'i khyod mor sbyin/ /oṃ de bi sho dha na dharmā/sarba pā pa nibyu ①saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpa sden ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod hub gsum btung / /de rjes slob mas sems spungs bskyed/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi chos/ /bshad cing bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /me tog u dusmra ra bzhin—/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung / /de srid phrad dka' 'byung ba yi—/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di/ /sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yi—/ /bskal pa grangs med mang por ni/ /sngon du byas pa'i rnam smin gang / /de kun zad par gyur pa ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so /de bzhin gzhan las gsungs pa'ang brjod/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pas/ ku sha byin gyis brlabs byas la/ /sngas dang stan du bya ba'o/ /de nas srung skud gdags pa ni/ /srung skud dkar po'am dmar po'am④/ /rak+ṣa'i sngags brjod mdud pa drug /dpung pa g.yas sam g.yon du bcing / /de nas me yi mchod sbyin te/ /sbyin sreg cho ga'i rim pa ni/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag la brten pa'i/ /yi ger bris pa gzhan du blta'o/ /de nas tshogs mchod sngar bzhin bya'o/ /ba bo chen po'ang de bzhin no/ /gdol pa khyi dang bram ze sogs//mnyam por gsol ba'i lhag ma bsdu/ /phud dang bsres la mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor tshim par bya/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon pad+ma'am/ /'khor lo lta bur bcings byas la/ /rkang pas mnan cing steng du blta/ /gyen du phe gyi sgra sgrogs shing / /spyan drangs dbyangs dang sngags kyis so/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul dang / /grong dang bzhi mdo 5—1421

zhing dang ni/ /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /sems can gnod dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po 'jigs dang 'jigs byed pa/ /bka' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang / /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /nag mo bzang mo drag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag mo sdang mo za ba mo/ /sum cu'i dbang mo 'phrog byed mo/ /mar me 'dzin byed rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs can mo/ /mche ba gabyugs dang thod chen ma/ /thod pa'i phreng can kha ṭī ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta ma/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /de nyid chen mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma//sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin ma ①mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oṃ kak+ka bhā na/ basbarnya na/ khaṣ+ṭha da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭan ha na ha na gha gha ghā ta yakhru/a mu ka shārnyi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa badz+ra swā hā/ de nas ha ho hriḥzhes brjod/ ha yis ①mdangs dang kha dog 'phrog /ho yis dri ni zhim pa bsdus/ /dz+reḥyis pha rol nus pa 'joms/ /kye'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs/ /las 'di dag la brtson par gyis/ /bdag la bde legs sdud pa dang / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /phan dang yid la bde ba dang / /grong dang yul 'khor shis par gyis/ /bu dang tsha bo rnams 'phel te/ /rang rang gnas su legs par 5—1422

sdud—/ /gzhan yang pha rol rgol ba dag /zhi zhing dbang du bya ba'am/ /dgug dang dbye dang bskrad pa dang / /gsad ①pa tshar gcad ②la sogs pa/ /ci rigs pa yis tshar gcod brjod/ /kye'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs/ /dus ni myur ba nyid du brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki bhā/ a ka lo ba se ma sa/ tra yo rat+na ā pa ka ri kho/ sarba sha hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍa greṇ+ḍa hūṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ha na ha na hūṃ—/ mā ra na mā ra na phaṭa/ te te badz+ra ḍā ki rī duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha khā nyi ④zhes pas mngon spyod byas nas bsdu/ /sngags 'dis gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki rī ba lo ta pra tīts+tsha/ kha kha khā hi khā hi bhuñdza bhuñdza dhihoḥ/ de bzhin gzhan yang dusbyar bar bya'o/ /phyogs skyong gtor ma sngar bzhin du/ /btang ste smon lam gdab par bya/ /dge 'dis/ sems can thams cad sdig med cing / /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad 'gyur ba'i/ /lam de nyid nas zhugs nas kyang / /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol rjobar shog /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /de bzhin gzhan la 'di skad brjod/ /dge ba gang thob de dag gis/ /sangs rgyas kun don thams cad ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang de/ /sems can kun gyis thob par shog /byang chub rdo rje bsngags pa yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sems spyod dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub spyod pa dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang / /bdag ni de gnyis spyod par shog /gang dang gang du skye ba der/ /ma nyams kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma lha dang mchog gsum ⑦dang / /zla ba'i rigs la dga' ba dang / /de dang der ni skye gyur cig /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs pa na⑧/ /oṃ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal muḥ/ zhes pa lan gsum 5—1423

brjod bya zhing / /khu tshur g.yon pa snying gar gzhag① /lag pa g.yas pa sa la brkyang / /se gol lan gsum brdabs pa yis/ /phyi rol lha rnams gshegs su gsol—/ /de nas dam tshig bdag la bsdu/ /brten pa'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang / /'byung bzhi de la nam mkha' thim/ /lha mo brgyad ni snying ga'i hūṃ//thim nas lha yi sneng rgyal gnas/ /de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor rmi/ /nang du zhugs la lha rnams mchod/ /phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ /slob ma rnams la sta gon gyi/ /gnas de'am nyal khang gzhan yang rung / /seng ge'i nyal stabs rmi lam brtag /smra brjod gzhan dag mi bya bar/ /dgyes rdor yid la byas te nyal/ /de nas sngar langs maṇ+ḍal bya/ /bla mas dri zhing slob mas brjod/ /bzang ngan rab 'bring tha ma ni/ /bla mas shes par byas pa ste/ /ngan na rtog pa zhi thabs bya/ /bzang na yid dga' spro bskyed do④/ /de dag ni lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas nub gsum pa la 'jug /'jug pa'i yan lag 'jug dngos nyid/ /yan lag dang po thig gdab po/ /slob mar bcas pas sngar langs te/ /zhi ba'am rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ /de yang slob dpon mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag de yi de nyid shes/ /khro ba med cing skyo ba bzod/ /rig bcas phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /lha rnams bdun rjodu nam mkha' la/ /zla ba kha sbyar nang du gzhug /dbyangs yig bcu drug rgya yis gdab—/ /de ltar bar gyi mtshams sbyar nas/ /thig gdab pa yi las brtsam bya—/ /rin la ma rtseg dhiras bal gzung / /shes rab mtshan dang ldan pas bkal—/ /'jur mdud med cing grog rked buspang / /ring thung dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur la/ /sboms su sgo yi nyi shu cha/ /srad bu brkyang ba so sor bsog /5—1424

pad snod dri zhim nang du gzhag① /de nas dang por srad bu ni/ /so sor rang bzhin med par sgom/ /de la hūṃ sdekhaṃ la sogs pa/ /yig 'bru lngar gyur de dag la/ /rigs lnga'i rgyu'am ngo bor bsam/ /de nas rnal 'byor nyi zla'i mig /'bar ba'i lcags kyu'i 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes lha yi thugs ka nas/ /ye shes skud pa gnas pa rnams/ /gtso bo dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang / /lha rnams sngags dang gnyis med bzhugs/ /spyan drangs thim pas ①thig skud bskyed/ /hūṃ dukhaṃ la sogs sa bon lnga/ /oṃ hūṃ sogs kyis sngags brjod la/ /lag par phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ /oṃ a byo t+yā nu ga ta pa ra spa ra sarba dharmā/ a byo sde nu ga ta pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā/ a t+yan+ta a nut+ta ra sarba dharmā zhes pa brjod cing bsgril bar bya'o/ /de nas thig skud mtha' gnyis dbus/ /oṃ t+pahūṃ gsum bkod pa yis/ /byin brlabs nas ni sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ zhes pa'i bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gung mo gnyis sbyar gzung ste bzlas/ /de ltar thig skud bskyed pa dang / /de nas bla mas gtso bor bsam/ /gogs mchog de yi thugs ka nas/ /go rī'am rig ma yum du sprul—/ /de nas bla mas thig skud ni/ /dz+dzadz+dzazhes brjod de la gtad/ /des kyang dz+dzadz+dza⑤brjod blang bar bya/ /de nas gnam thig gdab par bya/ /steng nas bzung zhing gyen du bzlog /tshangs thig dang po zur thig sogs/ /ci rigs pa ru gdab par bya/ /de tshe ngag tu sngar rmi sngags/ /brjod pa'am yang na tshig bcad 'di'o/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la sogs/ /'gro ba'i don du rnam par sprul/ /khyed rnams kyi ni thugs nyid yin/ /zhes pa brjod nas sa thig gdab/ /de rjes dkar pos 5—1425

gzhal ①bya ste/ /tshangs thig dang por gdab pa yang / /slob dpon shar bltas slob ma nub/ /bltas te tshangs thig dang po gdab/ /slob dpon byang bltas tshangs thig gnyis/ /slob dpon shar lho'i mtshalas su gnas/ /slob ma byang shar shar ngos gdab/ /de bzhin bla ma byang nub gnas/ /slob ma lho nub nub ngos gdab/ /bla ma rlung mtshams de nyid gnas/ /slob ma byang shar byang ngos gdab/ /de bzhin skor phyogs rim gyes gdab/ /bla ma shar lho slob ma srin/ /gnas la lho yi ngos thig gdab/ /de bzhin zur thig rim bzhin gdab/ /de la thig gi cha bgo ba/ /skud pas bgo bar mi bya ste/ /'phel 'grib gnyis kyi nyen yod pas/ /shing bu la sogs drang zhing sra/ /kha ti kha yi ri mos gdod/ /phyogs bzhir bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i/ /thig rkang las ni re'u mig go/ /sgo khyud thig gi nang rol du/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par bcas/ /lha yi snam bus ci rigs bskor/ /cha re rdo rje ra ba dang / /me 'od la ni bskor ba'o/ /de yi nang du rta babs dang / /'dod yon snam bu la sogs pas/ /ci rigs par ni bri bar bya/ /de ltar thig zin thig skud mchod—/ /'bar ba'i lta sdebs sgo dbye zhing / /lha rnams bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /de dag ni thig gdab pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas tshon ni rab 'bring tha—/ /rin chen lnga'am 'bras la sogs/ /tshon bsgyur dur khrod so phag gam/ /sol ba rul pa'i phye ma sogs/ /hūṃ ①khaṃ sogs pa'i yig 'bru lnga/ /yongs gyur tshon rtsi lnga ru bsam/ /de nas 'bar ba'i lta 0ba yis/ /dgyes pa rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /spyan drangs mchod pa thim par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ / zhes pa'ang mang du bzlas pas tshon/ /byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa 5—1426

'bul①—/ /shis par bya phyir dbang ldan mtshalas/ /bla mas re khā mdzub gang rang / /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /sngon po nang du mnyam zhing drang / /de mchod me tog ṅgal ma gtor/ /de tshe bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgol mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bya ba'i rim pa ni/ /gzhung las 'di skad 'byung ba ste/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol bas/ /tshon rmi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /slob dpon gyis ni dang por dgye/ /phyi nas kun nas slob mas so/ /zhes pas so/ /re khā drang ba'i rim pa yang / /mnyam dang drang dang ma chad sogs/ /de bzhin rigs pas shes par bya'o/ /de'ang lung las 'di skad du/ /bar chad thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang / mthe bong dang ni mthe'u chung dpangs/ /drang la mtho bar yang dag bri/ /gal te ri mo mi mnyam na/ /yo zhing dma' dang bcas pa dang / /ri mo dma' bas mi 'grub cing / /yon pos sdug bsngal skyed byed la/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma dag/gnyi ga 'chi bar shes par bya/ /zhes pa'o/ /phyogs dang ②sgo yi rim pa yang / /shar du dkar dang lhor ser po/ /nub dmar byang du ljang gu ste/ /dbus sngo rgyud gzhan dag las gsal/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni/ /dmar po gdan dang bcas pa bri/ /'dab ma 'phar ma gcig pa la/ /sgo dang grwa ru ①khyab pa ru/ /lha yi snam bu bri bar bya/ /phyi rol rta babs la sogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan dang thun mong bas/ /gzhan dang 'dra bar ci rigs bya/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bri byas nas/ /'jug pa'i rten du phyag mtshan dgod/ /5—1427

de yang dang por slob dpon gyis/ /dgongs ①mo'i dus su 'chag ②sar 'gro/ /slar log khrus dang byug pa dang / /gos dang rgyan ni dze+elha mos bskyed/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /sta gon zla ba kha 0sbyar te/ /dbyangs yig rgya bkrol nam mkha' nas/ /sngags ni so so'i sngags brjod cing / /de la dbus kyi gdan steng du/ /skyes pa'i thod pa'i rgya gram bri/ /sgo bzhir pad+ma 'dab ma la—/ /gri gug cang te'u rus sbal sbrul/ /sngo dang dmar ser ljang go rims/ /mtshalas bzhi'i pad+ma ⑤'dab ma ru/ /seng ge dge slong 'khor lo rdo rje ni/ /sngo dkar ljang khra rim bzhin dgod/ /de tshe kun la sngags brjod cing / /bkod pas dkyil 'khor nyis bsres 'gyur/ /de nas bla re rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /ba dan rgyan sogs 'phen rjornams bri/ /phyi rol mtshams dang rol mo brdung / /spos dang bcas pas bum pa rnams/ /sta gon gnas nas spyan drangs te/ /chu dang rin chen sman la sogs/ /bsam pa gzhug cing nying 'dzin bskyed/ /rol mor bcas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /lag tu thogs te lan gsum bskor/ /rnam rgyal bum pa gtso bo'i mdun/ /shar sgo'i g.yas su las thams cad/ /gzhan dag sgo dang mtshalas bzhir dgod/ /de nas bskor ba lan gsum rjes/ /me tog phreng ba lha la dbul/ /nang par lhas sbyin me tog phreng / /de nyid dkar bcas mgo la bcings/ /las kyi byed pa'am khang skyong gis/ /dkyil 'khor nye ba'i sa phyogs su/ /chag chag me tog sel ma dkram/ /spos sogs mchod yon thams cad dgod/ /rtag tu bla ma la gsol gdab/ /de nas bla mas nye reg dang / /bdud rtsi ri lu kha ru gzhug /stan der 'dug nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /rig dang bcas pas yan lag drug /bsam rgyud ting 5—1428

'dzin gsal ba dang / /las kyi rdo rjes sngar bzhin du/ /rak+ṣas bsrung ba nas bzung ①nas/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar/ /bdag nyid ldan pa phun sum tshogs/ /bla mas kyang ni sngar bzhin du/ /mos pas 'pho dang ting 'dzin ni/ /gzugs brnyan la brten sa bon nam/ /phyag mtshan tsam kyis lha rnams bskyed/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor sum bsres la/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las/ /'od zer phyung ste lha rnams bsdu/ /de la mchod dgug gzhug la sogs/ /sngar bzhin thim pas ye shes 'bar/ /chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bsgrubs te gzhan du yang ma yin/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi bsres la/ /bla mas mchod dang bstod pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang dang bzlas brjod bya/ /de tshe bla mas bzlas dang bsgom/ /rnal 'byor ldan la slob ma yis/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon 'gro gsol ba gdab—/ /de yi ngor byas bla ma nyid/ /ji ltar slob mas 'jug pa bzhin/ /rim gyis byas te dbang yang yin/ /chu dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa/ /rjes gnang mthar thug rim bzhin no/ /lha yis rjes gnang byin pa yang / /khyod kyis sems can bsdu ba dang / /phan 'dogs dkyil 'khor 'jug pa dang / /dbang bskur dam tshig ldan par gyis/ /zhi sogs las kyis rjes gzung dang / /tshar gcod pa yi sems can kun/ /don rnams ma lus kun byis shig /dman dang mchog gi dngos grub la/ /skal ba bzhin du rim par sbyor/ /de nas sngon du brtags pa yi/ /slob ma mtshan nyid ldan pa yis/ /'jug dang dbang thob bya phyir brjod/ /dga' chen spyod bdag ston pa pos/ /zhes ⑤sogs sngar bzhin brjod pa dang / /bla mas brtse dang ldan pa khyod/ /su yin 5—1429

ci 'dod gang la dga'/ /zhes pa brjod nas slob ma yis/ /skal ldan bdag lags rnam grol 'tshal/ /bde ba che la bdag dga'o/ /zhes brjod yang ni 'di skad brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par gsol/ /zhes pas slob dpon la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /te ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par barmi/ /de nas dkyil 'khor byi lha la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phyag bya ste/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ oṃ na maḥmi hūṃ/ oṃ na mo na ma hūṃ/zhes bya ba dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka cit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra brnya dz+wa ka ro mi—/ zhes pas kyang / sgo gsum gus pas phyag byas la/ /de nas sngar bzhin slob ma yis/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa gsol/ /thub pa nyi ma la sogs brjod/ /de bzhin sdom pa dam tshig ni/ /sta gon gnas pa sngar bzhin bya—/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /deng spyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi nang du zhugs kyi①/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang /rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan gusmos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag gzhug pa ni/ /gal te tshul 5—1430

'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /de nas ka pā la'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i dam tshig gi chu blud pa ni kye'i rdo rje gzi mdangs dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod do/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu①/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis grub/ /oṃ sarba badz+ra pañtsa a bṛ ta u da ka hūṃ/ deng nas brtsams nas khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos te/ da khyod nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig /byas na khyod kyi mi bde ba ma spangs par④/tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar 1nga bar gyur ta re/ de nas 'di skad brjod do//deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyang 'grub par dka' ba ma lags na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes pas yol ba'i nang du drangs te/ ye shes dbab pa bla ma'i man ngag bzhin bya'o/ /de nas mthong ba dri ba dang me tog gi phreng ba thogs te/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba dor ba dang / mig dbye bar bya ste/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi①—/ /mig 'byed pa ni brtson pa ste/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad pas/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /te badz+ra pa sh+ya/ de nyid sngags su brjod pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa swa yi r+ya ya/ tsak+ṣurnya sta ya tat+pa ra/ ut+ta ṭa la ti sar+pākhyobu/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu rā nut+ta rarjo/ he badz+ra pra be sha /de nas gdong g.yogs phud cing 'di skad brjod do/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyed ni rnal 'byor ma rig skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs—/ /'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang 5—1431

brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod pa dang / me tog gang la lhung ba'i lha ngo bstan cing lhag par ①dbog /sngags bslab cing de kho na nyid bshad par bya'o//de la gzhal yas khang gru bzhir byung ba ni tshad med pa'i rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /sgo bzhi ni dran pa nye bar gzhag ②pa bzhi ①rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rta babs bzhi ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /dra ba ni nyon mongs pa chen po rnam par dag pa'o/ /dra ba phyed pa ni nyon mongs pa chung ngu rnam par dag pa'o/ /ka ba brgyad ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad rnam par dag pa'o/ /dar byi pa ti la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams ni tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams ni gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje ra ba ni zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags so/ /me 'od ni phyi rol gyi bgegs la sogs pas mi tshugs pa'i rtags so/ /bum pa brgyad ni che ba'i yon tan gyis rgyas shing thugs rje chen po'i ngos duyongs su gang ba'i rtags so/ /de nas lha'i de kho na nyid bstan te/ de la bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i rdo rje ni rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /go rī ni zhe sdang dang gzugs rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /chom rkun ma ni gti mug dang sgra rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ro langs ma ni nga rgyal dang dri rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ghasma rī ni 'dod chags dang ro rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /puk+ka sī ni zhe sdang dang sa rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no//ri khrod ma ni gti mug dang chu rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gtum mo ni nga rgyal dang me rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /g.yung mo ni 'dod chags 5—1432

dang rlung rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma ni yab dang mthun no/ /de ltar de kho na nyid bshad nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs shing ①yon gyi mchog phul nas dbang bskur ba'i don du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de yang thun mong gi dbang nod pa yin na/'di skad brjod do/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'khor ba 'dam byi tshogs dag tu/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs②/ /mgon po khyod kyi snebaka' drin gyis/ /rig pa'i dbang bskur bdag la gsol/ /zhes pa dang / /khyad par slob dpon gyi dbang yin na 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ te ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba bskyab phyir gzi brjid can/ /ci ltar yon tan 'byung gnas sogs/ /de bzhin bdag la de gsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyisadhi/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas thun mong dang khyad par rmi slob ma rnams tha mal gyi stan dang / khyad par gyi gdan seng ge'i khri'am/pad+mas mtshan pa gzhag dupar bya'o/ /gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang lha rnams ci rigs par mchod nas/ bdud rtsi dang dri'i chu dang nyungs kar lag rjotu thogs nas bdag nyid nga rgyal dang bcas pas 'di skad brjod/ nyon cig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'bar ba'i bdag /gdug pa ma lus 'joms par byed/ /dengs shig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs/ /nga yi ⑦5—1433

bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /ci ste bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdul phran bzhin du rlag par byed/ /ces dang / bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin du gnas pas bskrad pa'am/ rak+ṣa la sogs pa'i sngags brjod cing ra ba dang gur la sogs pas bsrung ba'o/ /de nas slob mas khrus byas shing / /stod g.yogs la sogs gos bzangs ldan/ /drug pa rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbang / /nod phyir snyim pa me tog gis/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi gtso la 'bul①/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes pa'i sngags ②brjod pas so/ /de rjes bla mas me tog blangs/ /slob ma'i mgo la bcings ①byas la/ /oṃ dharmāḥkuṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes brjod par rjoni/ chos kun bsdus shing 'khyil bas ni//lhag pa'i lha yin ⑤de skad du/ /phreng ba yi dam rgyal ba'i dbang / /sgom phyir dbang bskur dam tshig ldan/ /de rjes las kyi rdo rje yis/ /bum pa'i chu rnams bsdus nas ni/ /bzang po rnam rgyal dhibum par bsdus⑦/ /de rjes dung chos nyid du'o/ /de nas rnam rgyal chu rgyun gyis/ /dril bu'i sgra dang dbyangs bcas pas/ /dbang skur ba ni 'di skad bajod/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum pa yis dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chu yi dbang / /deng 'dir khyod la sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun ni rab bsgrub ⑧phyir/ /chu dbang dam pa khyed kyis long / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣidzi mi badz+ra swa bhā ba āX kophohaṃ/ des ni rnam par rtog pa dang / /nyon mongs pa'i dri ma 'khru bar byed do⑨/ /de nas gser la sogs pa'i rin po che dang shing dang ba so la sogs pa'i 'bur mar brkos pa'am/ thang ka'i ri mo'am dbu rgyan du byas te/ hūṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan du bsam zhing dgug 5—1434

pa dang gzhug pa la sogs pas ye shes sems dpa' bstems ①la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dang sngags bzlas pa byas la 'di skad brjod do/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum pa yis ④dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dbu rgyan dbang / /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dag gi ①dbu rgyan dang / /dar dbyangs rjodabang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pa rā ha ka badz+ra a ral+li ⑤hoḥ//de nas yang rdo rje ulas snang ba mtha' yas su bskyed la 'di skad brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /te ru ka dpal rgyal po dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi dbang mchog ni/ /de ring khyod la dbang skur ro/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi ba ti ste a rnyi ṣiñtsa tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya ste/ de nas de nyid brjod pa ni/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces pa ste/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba rjolag pa g.yas par sbyin no/ /de nas dril bu khaṃ las don yod grub par bskyed la 'di skad brjod do/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror ⑦bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung ⑧/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /de yi de nyid bshad pa ni/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /de bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /badz+ra satwa ste a rnyi ṣilnga mi/ zhes pas lag pa g.yon par dung byin la/ de nas ming gi dbang bskur bar bya ste/ hūṃ las rnam par snang mdzad du bsam/sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /zhes pa la sogs pa brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra 5—1435

shrī he ru ka a ①dhi pa ti ste a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ mi/ shrī te ru ka nā ma a nyi ṣe ka ta/zhes brjod cing rdo rje dril bu mgo'i thad kar sbyin no/ /de nas brtul zhugs kyis brtan par bya'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /te ru ka dpal phyag na bsnams/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /rdo rje'i rtse mo nas slob ma 'dzin du bcug la sngags 'di brjod do—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sedha badz+ra sa ma ya ste/ e ṣa ste ②dha ra yā mi hūṃ swā hā ha ha nyi hi zhes brjod la lag par rdo rje rgya gram sbyin no/ /de nas te ru ka dpal gzugs/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor cho gas sbyin/ /rdo rje slob dpon go 'phang thob/ /he ru ka dpal kha ṭī ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭī rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ slob ma de g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas gnas la—/ rdo rje gri gug g.yas su sbyin zhing / dril bu dang ḍa ma ru dang ka pā la g.yon du sbyin zhing / kha ṭī ga g.yas phyogs ①su brten pa sbyin par bya ste/ de lta bu'i che ba'i bdag nyid dag dang ldan par brjod do/ /'dis ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rjes su gnang ba dang / lung bstan pa dang / dbugs dbyung ba dang ldan zhing phrin las kyang rdzogs par 'gyur te/ zhi ba dang /rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / drag po dang / rengs pa dang / bsgrag ④pa dang / pyos par bya ba dang / gsad pa la sogs pa dang / de rnams la thogs pa med par 'grub par bslab par byos shig /dngos grub 'di dag rdzogs par 'gyur te/ mchil lham bgo ba dang / char dbab pa dang / nyi 5—1436

zla gzung ba la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub dang ①/ 'jig rten ②las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par byos shig ces rjes gnang sbyin no//de dag ni bum pa'i dbang ngam/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs pa ste/lus kyi dri ma dag par byed cing byang chub sems dpa' ①tshogs kyi lam mthar phyin pa dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbang bskur ba gnyis pas dhini ngag ⑤dri ma dag par byed pa dang / sbyor ba'i lam gyi nus pa 'jog /dbang bskur gsum pas rjosems kyi dri ma dag cing mthong lam gyi nus pa 'jog /dbang bskur ba bzhi pas ni nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dag bsgom ⑦pa'i lam dang khyad par gyi lam la gnas pa'i nus pa 'jog /dbang bskur ba de dag gis dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni bla ma'i zhal la ltos ⑧par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pas kyang dgongs pa sbas pa yin la/ de bas ni dgongs don nyams pa spang ba'i phyir/ bdag gis kyang 'dir yi ger bkod pa ma yin snyam du dgongs so/ /de dag gis dbang bstan nas/ gang gi tshe rab tu gnas par byed par 'dod na/ de'i don yang 'di yin te/ sdom ni/ shes par bya dang nyams su blang / /'bras bu dang ni rnam pa gsum/ /de la shes par bya ba ni 'di yin te/ rab tu gnas pa thun mong dang khyad par du shes par bya'o/ /mnga' dbul lha ltar mchod pa dang / /slob ma lta bur dbang bskur ba/ /spyan dbye thun mong gser thur gyis/ /tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas par brjod / /khyad par spyan ni dbye ba'o/ /zhal bsro ba ni sbyin sreg gis/ /sgob ma shis par bya phyir dang / /lha rnams tshim pa'i don du'o/ /de'i rjes la nyams su blang ba ni 'di yin te/ sngar bzhin bla mar 'os pa la/ slob dpon 5—1437

mtshan nyid dang ldan pas gsol ba gdab pa dang / bsnyen pa dang / sa cho ga sngar bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor me long gi ngos ltar mnyam pa'i steng du'am/stegs bu gru bzhi'i steng du'o/ /lta gon yo byad thams cad nye bar bsags ①la/de la slob dpon du 'os pa ni 'di yin te/ brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni legs par shes/ /'di ni slob dpon yin zhes bya/ /de yis ②bstan pa'i gsang sngags rnams/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pa ni/ des kyang cho ga chad pa med par phun sum tshogs par bya ste/ 'di skad du/ cho ga nyams par mi bya ste/ /rab gnas rtag tu smad pa dang / /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal chen po dang / /'jig rten gzhan du 'jigs chen 'byung / /de bas dngos grub 'dod pa yis//bdag nyid kyis ni ci nus las/ /de bzhin cho gar gsungs tshul du/ /kun nas rab tu 'bad ①de bya/ /zhes pa dang / de nas dang po slob ma'am/sgrub pa'i grogs po rang nyid rgyan dang byug pa la sogs pa dang / mchod yon byin gyis brlab pa dang / yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du bdag nyid la ldan pa phun sum tshogs pa byas la/ de nas bla mas kyang phun sum tshogs mos pa 'pho ba dang ldan pas rnal 'byor sgrub rjopa'i grogs mchog bzhin du ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa dang / rang bzhin spyan drangs pa gnyis bsres sam gsum bsres byas la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du sngar bzhin byas nas sku gzugs la sogs pa ⑤dag kyang bye dor byas la sngar byi gnas su gzhag go/ /de nas me dang chu nang du yungs kar blugs 5—1438

shing sngags 'di bzlas/ lan gsum bskor zhing gtor bar bya/ /sbyang zhing bsrung ba dag tu bya/ /oṃ te badz+ra a dhi tijo na sarba pā paṃ da ha na he badzā ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'bru mar la drur ba'i pir gyis byug cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas shun lpags lngas dril phyis dang / khrus la sogs pa byas kyang rung / ma byas kyang rung ①sngar gyi de dag gis rten sbyang ba'o/ /bdug spos thogs shing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas sangs rgyas thams cad mdun kyi nam mkha' la dkyil 'khor lha'i rnam par bsdus la 'di skad brjod do/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma la yang brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rab gnas/ /mgon po bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /bdag gi ming brjod 'di zhes pas/ /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di zhes bya/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ni/ /nang par rab gnas bkyid par 'tshal/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse bar ni nyer dgongs nas/ /tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas la/ /byin kyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang / yang na/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /sras bcas 'jig rten rnam grangs dang / /zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba gdab cing snyim pa'i me tog gtor zhing 'di skad do—/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /me tog bzang po ④rin chen char/ /sku la rab tu 'bab 'gyur bas/ /kye kye so sor bzhes su gsol/oṃ pa ra ma su khā sha ya su la li ti ①bi lā sa mi te/ na mā mi bha ga wān dzaḥhūṃ baṃ 5—1439

hoḥhi nyi hi hi/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ku su māñdza li nā tha ho/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan na ni bzhugs pa las/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar—/ /de bzhin gzugs 'dir khyod bzhugs mdzod/ /'dir bzhugs ①rtag tu mgon po ni/ /gyur nas me tog la sogs 'di/ /byang chub sems ni 'phel ba'i phyir/ /bdag cag don du bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod de/de yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang nod pa yin na/ sngar bzhin du lha sta gon du gnas pa nyid byas pa ②ma yin na/ dgon ①po bsdu ba dag tsam kyis bya'o—/ /de bzhin du dbang yin na slob ma lhag gnas la sngar bzhin du bya ba yin la/ ma yin na 'di tsam byis slob ma lhag par gnas par bya ste/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig mnyam pa ru/ /'byung bar bdag nyid the tshom med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las/ /mi ldog par ni bdag gyur dute/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyid rjom dam pa ste/ /bdag gis mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gal te rdul tshon ma bris pa'i lhag gnas yin na shin tu snga bar thig dang tshon la sogs pa sngar bzhin du byas la/ nyi ma bzang po la rab gnas 'di ltar bya ste/ yang slob dpon grogs dang bcas pas cho ga nyams par mi bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pas yo byad thams cad bsog cing bstar ba dang / rgyan thams cad bri ba dang / yang rang nyid grogs dang bcas pas khrus dang byug pa nas gzung ste/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i 5—1440

bar du bdag nyid la ldan pa phun sum tshogs pa sngar bzhin du bya zhing / sku gzugs la sogs byi dor bya ba nas/ shun wags lnga ste/ dzam+bu ka dang / ka ta dang / bil ba dang / a phra dang / pi tsu pu ri las byung ba'i dril phyis bya ba dang / de bzhin du sngar gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / de ring rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ zhes pa bcug la/ deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas ba byung ①rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa'i bum pa'i chu la/ oṃ bi shudhe badz+ra kro dha hūṃ rmā hūṃ j-i ②khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas mngon par bzlas pa'i chus khrus bya zhing / rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad ①brjod par bya'o/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nyi ṣe ka ta dus ma ya shri ye swā hā/ gzhan yang spyan la sogs pa'i sngags/ oṃ ru ru sgu ru la sogs pa ⑤yang brjod cing / bkra shis kyi dutshigs su bcad pa gang yang rung ba cig gis dbyangs su brjod do/ /de nas ras kyis sku phyi bar bya ste/ bde gshegs sku gzugs dpe dang bral gyis kyang / /'gro ba'i don du sku gzugs cir yang gda'—/ /rin chen dbyeg ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral zhing / /'jig rten bsnyen bkur ri mo'i tshul gyes ⑦ni/ /dri med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i—/ /ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyi bas/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa ma lus kun byang nas/ /sku gsum ngang du bdag cag grub par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wan+t+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ tsa tri ⑧gadhe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a rnyi ṣiñtsa ni swā hā/de rab tu gnas pa'i dngos gzhi nyid yin te/ de yang sangs rgyas thams cad 5—1441

gcig bsdus dang / /rab gnas mtshan nyid bzang po nyid/ /ces pa dang /sku gzugs snying gar rab tu gzhug /ces pa dang / bsdu ba'i tshig 'dis shes par bya ste/ ting 'dzin ye shes byin brlabs ①dang / /dbang bskur ba yi rab gnas bzang / /de la dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ sku gzugs sa bon phyag mtshan nam/ /skad cig sogs kyis sdelha yi sku/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams lugs bzhin bskyed/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkhar bhubasdus la mchod cing bstem/ /de nas byin byis brlab pa ni/ /skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs/ /byin gyis brlab pa sngar bzhin bya/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ chu dang dbu rgyan nas gzung ste/ /rjes su gnang ba'i bar du sbyin—/ /gzhan yang rin chen bdun la sogs/ /ci rigs par yang dbang bskur bya/ /mnga' dbul ba yang dbang der gtogs/ /de nas spyan dbye ba'i cho ga bya ste/ gser rmi thur ma la sogs pa mar dang sbrang rtsi la bsres te/spyan dbye zhing 'di skad rjoces brjod do/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /khyod kyis kyang ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /zhes pa dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsagru tsak+ṣu khrubi sho dha ya swā hā/ khyad par du spyan dbye ba ni slob ma la ye shes 'be+ebs pa ltar 'dir bya'o/ /de nas mda' dbul bar bya ste/ dang por gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dbul bar bya ste/ 'di skad do/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'i gzugs brnyan la gdugs phul bas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa ni zhal dro duzhing byin che/ 'gro ba skyob pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa yon kyi bdag po la sogs pa khams gsum gyi sems can 5—1442

thams cad nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis gdungs pa ①sel zhing 'gro ba skyob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu bar ldan/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul gyi①/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsha tram̐ ④shrī sa ma ye hūṃ zhes gsum mam bdun byi bar du brjod do/ /de bzhin du gzhan dag la yang bgre zhing sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal mtshan yang sngar bzhin mdzad nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /bar chod bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul gyirjo/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dh+wa dza ke tu shrī sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas 'phan dang ba dan dbul te/ ji ltar sngon byi sangs rgyas la/ /snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur sgogs/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul gyi⑤/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā ka shrī sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin bla re la sogs pa la yang ngo / /yang khrus byas te mchod pa rnam pa lnga 'bul lo/ /de nas zhal zas 'bul lo/ /de nas mchod pa'i tshig sngar bzhin sbyar la/ sems can thams cad bkres skom dang / mu ge la sogs pa'i bskal pa las thar bar gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ha ra bye dza shrī sa ma ye hūṃrka/ de nas na bza' dbul te/ sems can thams cad gos dang bgo ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral te/ lha'i na bza' pañtsa li ka reg na bde ba gyon pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rjowastu nā nā ⑦shrī sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas zhal bsro bya ste/ de yang sbyin sreg gis bya'o/ /slob ma shis par bya phyir dang / /lha rnams tshim pa'i don du ste/ /de yang sngar bzhin 5—1443

cho ga ltar/ /de nas khyad par du yang nang gi sku gzugs la sogs ①kyi mchod pa dang tsā ru'i ston mo yang bya'o/ /de'i rjes la mchod gnas su gtad pa ni/khyod kyis nga la gsol btab pa/ /sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin rab gnas pa/ /de ni ngas byas byed du bcug /spyod kyis de ni kun rdzogs par/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par byis/ /de nas srung ma bsgo ba ni/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /nag po chen po dgug pa dang //gzhug dang bcing dang dbang du bya/ /de la mchod dang gtor ma sbyin/ /de la bka' lung bsgo bya ba/ /nga yis rab gnas byas pa yi/ /gtsug lag khang la sogs pa 'di/ /ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /bsrung zhing khyod kyis legs par skyongs/ /dkon mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi/ /bka' sprul ⑧khyod kyis bsrung ba dang / /ston pa'i bka' dang slob dpon gyi/ /bka' lung bsgo ba legs par srungs/ /de nas bzod gsol bya ste/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang / /de sras tshangs sogs lha tshogs kun/ /gang zhig cho ga byas pa ni/ /nongs gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /de nas gshegs gsol byed 'dod na/ /'di tsam brjod par bya ba ste/ /sbyin bdag rnams la zhi ba dang / /bde legs chen po kun mdzad par/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la gshegs/ /de nas byin brlabs ④brtan pa brjod/ /gang 'di sku gzugs bskal pa'am/ /bskal pa brgya las lhag gnas shing / /sa dang me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung las lha rnams kun gyis srungasarjo/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa dang / /bu dang tsha bo rnams 'phel te/ /rab dga' yid bder ⑤gyur nas ni/ /rang rjoganas 5byed1444

bzang por rtag ①tu bzhugs/ /rab gnas spyi yi shes byas na/ /gal te glegs bam ras ris sogs/ /yin na gzhan las gsungs pa bzhin/ /yig 'brur sgyur dang khrus la sogs/ /sngags la sogs pa ci rigs bya/ /gzhung mangs dogs nas 'dir ma brjod/ /de rjes gzhung rdzogs tshigs bcad brjod//gang gis 'di rtsom pa yang bdag ming ni/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis thub dka' mi bskyod la②/ /mtha' na rdo rje ldan pas btsas pa'i ming / /ma btsas grags pas ①bsod nams kun la khyab/ /mtha' na rgyal mtshan ldan pas snyan dhipa'i gsung / /gang brtsams gzhung de rab tu grub pa yang / /sgrub pa po yi lag tu bya ba yang / /mtha' ru blang ba ldan pas don kun rdzogs/ /tshigs bcad rkyang ba rnams spras rim pa la/ /mtha' na zhes bya ldan pas grags chen po/ /gang ltar don de rab tu rdzogs pa yang / /mngon rtogs sgrub thabs dbang dang rab gnas yin/ /sgrub thabs dang mthun bla ma'i mngon rtogs la/ /mtha' ru sgrub pa dang ldan dkyil 'khor cho ga rdzogs/ /dri ma dag cing nus 'jog dbang la yang / /mtha' ru rab gnas ldan pas gzhan don rdzogs/ /gang phyir sbyin pa'i 'bras bu rjo'agrub pa yang / /phrin las dngos grub rang gzhan don du yin/ /de las cung zhig go bzlog 'di shes bya/ /bsten pa mngon rtogs rim pa rang don las/ /mtha' nas gzhan don ldan pas sgrub pa'i don//dbang bskur ba las 'byung ba'i dngos grub la/ /phrin las ldan pas rab gnas bzang po yin/ /bod kyi lo tsā bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ /gzhung dag las ni gsungs pa yin mod kyang / /bla mas rang la rang gis gzhan la ste/ /mdzad 5—1445
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (116)

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba dzi bi dhiḥ bod skad du/ gtor ma'i cho ga /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs rnams 'tshe ba zhi bya dang / /las rnams thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'byung po thams cad gtor ma dag /sbyin pa'i cho ga yang dag bri/ /de la dang po rnal 'byor pa stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shusgophohaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di lan gsum du yongs su bzlas te/chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa la lhag par mos par①bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod do①/ /khams gsum po thog ma nas ma skyes shing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba rnam par mi rtog pa/ gnyis su dumed pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam du dmigs la/ nam mkha'i khams rgya chen po'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gi 5—1450

phyag rgya ①gyen du gnas par rnam par bsgom zhing / ②de'i dbus na sna tshogs pad+ma rgya chen po dang / zla ba la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi yi dam gye lha'i rnal 'byor bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ 'gro ba ma lus pa snang bar byas pa sngon du 'gro ba ①can kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i bdag po gzugs na spyod pa tshangs pa la sogs pa dang / dbang bsgyur byi lha'i rgyal po la sogs pa dang / zla ba dang nyi ma dang nye dbang la sogs 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dang / thags bzangs 0ris dang sa'i lha la sogs pa dang /klu la sogs pa sems can yang dag par drangs te/ chos 'byung gi dbus su rnam par bsam mo/ /de la dang por steng gi phyogs kyi/ gzugs kyi khams na gnas pa'i lha/ /ral pa cod pan dag dang dkar/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang / /'od zer dkar po phreng bar ldan/ /'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa yi/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug sogs/ /lha rnams rin chen cod pan 'chang / /sna tshogs rgyan dang 'od ldan pa'o/ /steng gi nyi zla sogs de bzhin—/ /rang rang phyogs kyi ⑦phyogs bdag po/ /rang rang mdog dang phyag mtshan sogs/ /ldan pa go rims bzhin du bsgom/ /thags bzangs ris dang sa la sogs/ /klu yi bdag po brgyad rnams kyang / /rang gi ye shes sems snying ga'i/ /sa bon las byung rigs gsum gyis/ /ye shes rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /gzugs su rim gyis bsgrub par bya/ /de la da ni sems can thams cad yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i cho ga bstan par bya ste/ rang gis ⑥ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las zla ba bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i 5—1451

yi ge oṃ mdog dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ 'od kun nas 'phro ba mgo bo'i steng du rnam par bsams la/ de'i 'od zer gyis tshangs pa la sogs pa gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par bsgrub par bya'o—/ /de'i 'og tu rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ga'i sa bon de nyid las rnal 'byor pa'i yi ge hūṃ nor bu mthon ka'i mdog can la nor bu mthon ka'i 'od 'phro ba/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /de la 'od 'phros rnam bsams te/ /'od zer sprin des bkug nas ni/ /'dod na spyod pa'i lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba sbyang byas te/ /sangs rgyas mi bskyod gzugs dag tu/ /grub par yongs su bsgom par bya/ /de ma thag tu rang gis ①ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka de nyid las yi ge a dmar po 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs rab tu 'phro ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ kun nas spros pa de'i 'od zer dmar po spros pas thags bzangs sderis dang / sa'i lha dang / klu'i rgyal po brgyad yongs su sbyangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam par bsgrub par bya'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad rang gi rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su bsgrub ①pa de la gzugs na spyod pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs so/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams dang /'jig rten durnams ni mi bskyod pa'i rigs so/ /thags bzangs 0ris la sogs pa rnams ni 'od dpag tu med pa'i rigs so/ /de bas na gzugs na spyod pa la sogs pa nas klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyi bar de dag rang rang gi rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su bsgrubs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams 5—1452

cad kyi dbang bsgur bas dbang bskur te/ mgo bo la rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgyar byas la/ de dag gis ①lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas de rnams kyi mdun du bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa'i dngos po ci 'byor ba btsal la/ dang por yi yongs su gyur pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa rnam par bsams la/ de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa'i me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i gzugs can dang / de'i steng du yi ge a yongs su gyur pa'i ka pā la yongs su bsgoms la/ ka pā la de'i dbus su bdud rtsi lnga/ hūṃ sde d+dhāsnekhaṃ hūṃ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sa bon byin gyis brlab par ①bsams la/ de'i 'og tu sbar ba dang dros pa la sogs pa'i tshogs yang dag par bsgrubs la/ yi ge oṃ gyis byen gyis brlabs par blta'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ las grub pa'i rdo rje bsams la/ de nas yi ge oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi drangs nas/ bdud rtsi lnga po de'i steng du rab tu bstems la/ de ma thag tu 'bar ba dang dros pa dang / yi ge oṃ dang rdo rje de nyid du zhu bar gyur par bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ dul sogs pa 'bul zhing / de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus rab tu drangs pas tshim par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu yang dag par blangs te/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags kyis dngos po de dag lan bdun kyi bar du byin gyis brlabs larka/ de nas de rnams la dbul te/ rdo rje myur du gsor byas nas/ /rdo rje sbyor nas kun brtags kyi⑤/ /ri bo thams cad nges bsal bya/ /de nas dril 5—1453

bu gsel byas la/ /rgyal bas stong nyid rtogs 'gyur ba'i/ /mchog tu dgyes pa'i sgra yis ni/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni lan gsum brjod/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni sgrub par byed/ /de la gtor ma byen gyis brlab ①pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ’ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta—/ oṃ oṃhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de kho na nyid kyi sngags 'di lan gsum mam bdun brjod do/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dag ni/ /rjes dran gtor ma byin gyis brlabs④/ /ji ltar bdud rtsi ro dag gis/ /de ltar thams cad tshim par bya/ /yang dag 'thor 'thung byin nas ni/ /bzod bya gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /de la gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ byed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub byed/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ snyahūṃ muḥ/ skye ba med dang 'gag pa med/ /thog ma nas ni rang bzhin dag /'gro kun 'di dag mthong nas ni/ /gshegs chen 'di ni bya ba yin/ /gtor sbyin cho ga legs bris nas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang gnyer bsags/ /des ni 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub snod 'gyur shog /sgo ga lar skyes dge slong ni/ /mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyis/ /bla ma mnyes las thob gyur pa/ /gtor ma 'di nyid rab tu bshad/ /'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga /slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5byed1454

bsdur mchan/145༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉zinator ma'i cho ga bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉to/mos par/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉de/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wasu/1451 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wargya/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nede'i 'og tu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wa'agrob/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉ston/1452 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zangs/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrubs/ me〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉 skyong ba/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zangs/1453 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉byi i dzi/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlabs pa/ me〈〈pe 〉stamar+ha/〈〈snar 〉snamasgo/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nya)sa/1454 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (117)5wa 1455

༄ga /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'gor gyi tsho ga zhes bya ba/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī te badz+ra maṇ+ḍal bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i bsnyen pa 'bum dang khri song bas/ gnas dben par rigs can smin par byas te/ der maṇ+ḍal 'dab brgyad dmar po rdo rjes bskor ba/ khyams dang bcas pa byas nas me tog gi tshom bu dgu dgod do/ /bum pa gnyis la rdzas dang / rgyan cha dang ldan pa'i dbus dang byang shar du bkod nas/ de la bla re dang yol ba la sogs pas brgyan no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir mchod pa lnga tshan bzhi dang /gtor ma lnga dang / tshogs kyi yo byad kyis bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon khrus byas/ stan bde ba la bskyed rdzogs bsgoms nas/ skad cig gis bum pa stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ paṃ las 5byed1456

pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng du/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad/ de'i lte ba la nyi ma dang bdud bzhi'i ro'i steng du cho ga lnga'am/ gsum mam/ skad cig gis he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa bskyed/ pad 'dab brgyad la a las bdag med ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa brgyad bskyed do/ /de nas rang gi hūṃ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ mchod bstod dang yab yum gyi sngags bzhi la bsnyen pa ci 'grub byas nas yang mchod de/ lha rnams bdud rtsir bzhu'o/ /las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed nas/ bsnyen pa byas la des slob ma la khrus bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ gsol ba gdab pa/gnang ba sbyin pa rtog pa bsdu ba/ yan lag lnga bya ba/ sdom pa gzung ba dang /dam pa ①bsgrag pa rnams gzhung bzhin byas la ye shes dbab par bya'o/ /de nas bla ma la dbang bskur zhu ba'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro skyob phyir na gzi brjid can/ /de ltar yon tan 'byung gnas rdzogs/ /de bzhin bdag la deng gsol cig /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar 6) ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir//nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag sprul②/ /ces gsol ba btab pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang nam mkha'i lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dang / gsang ba'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsams nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum las/ /rab tu byung bas sbyin par bya/ /zhes brjod pas bum dbang thob par bsam/ /de bzhin 5—1457

mgrin par gsang dbang / snying gar shes rab ye shes/ lto bar dbang bzhi pa'o—/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig gi dbang ngo / /de nas rang gzhan rnams la rgyun du dbang bzhi bskur ba bshad par bya ste/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las gyur pa'i pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng du/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar nyi ma dang /ro'i steng du cho ga gsum mam/ skad cig la te badz+ra yum med cig bsam/pad+ma 'dab brgyad la nyi ma dang ro'i steng du/ a las bdag med ma bde ba rgyas pa brgyad bsam mo/ /de nas gong bzhin gsol ba btab la/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams las ①'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas/ rang gi lus phyi nang thams cad 'od kyis khyab pa las/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad sangs dag nas/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsam/ des bdag nyid he badz+ra yum med pa cig tu gyur pa ni bum pa'i dbang ngo / /de nas yang gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i lha mo bde ba rgyas nas 'od du 'dus te/ yab la 'khyud nas yab yum gnyis sbyor ba byas pas/ sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar gnyis bde phri li li byung nas lce thog tu babs pas/ bde ba skyes pa ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /lha tshogs la yang gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i yum las bdag med ma cig chad nas byung ste/ rang te badz+ra la 'khyud nas bsrub pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ lus la zag med kyi bde ba chen po skyes pa ni/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /de nas spyi bo'i lha tshogs la mchod pas lha gdan dang bcas pa spyi bor thim nas/ lha sku mnga' bas gsal ba'i gsal stong 'dzin med bde ba chen po la mnyam par gzhag go/ /mdor na snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa/ spros pa 5—1458

thams cad dang bral ba/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig la gzhag par bya'o/ /de ni dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas yam̐ ram̐ rka/ /a las byung ba'i nang du sna tshogs rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar legs par sbyangs nas/ lha tshogs rnams mchod cing / rnal 'byor pa rnams rol par bya'o—/ /gtor ma lnga ni gong bzhin sbyangs la 'byung po thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bla ma dang / dgyes mdzad dang / chos skyong dang / gzhi bdag dang /gnod byed rnams tshim par byas nas/ rdo rje'i gru blang / lha tshogs la mchod bstod dang bshags pa byas nas/ bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /bcom ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje mnyes byas te/ /pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs byas nas/ /'gro kun rdo rje rgyal po thob par shog /ces pa bsngo ba bya'o/ /de nas ①slob dpon dang thams cad mgrin gcig tu smon lam gdab pa ni/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /mnyam med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol//zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i zhu ba mnyam za zhing / /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya zhing bzod gsol bya/ bkra shis brjod/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa spyi bor bsdu/rdo rje slob dpon yon ④gyis mnyes par bya'o/ /dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje ye shes mkha' 'gro ma de nyid dang / lo tsā ba rlan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //5—1459

bsdur mchan/1456 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanapal kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉kye'i rdo rje'i — cho ga bzhugs/1457 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wapa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉gsol/1458 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa/1459 ①〈〈pe 〉losnar 〉ṅkardo rje/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉boyon/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (118)5wa 1460
