—sgrub pa' thabs/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ he badz+ra sngo ḍa sa bhu dza sā dha ni/ bod skad du/kye'i ②rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig goms pa'i ro myong ba/ /tsam kyis dngos por 'dzin pa 'di/ /ring du spong zhing yon tan rnams/ /'od gyur he ru ka de 'dud/ /tho rangs mal nas langs la/snying gar re las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bltas la/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid dri ma med par byas nas/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ gnas dang / bdag nyid dang / rnal 'byor srung ba byas la/ bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs nas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/oṃ badz+ra re khe hri zhes bya bas maṇ+ḍal byas la/ oṃ badz+ra mi di nī badzī bha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ zhes bya bas byin rmis brlabs pa'i dkyil du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes bya ba brjod 5—1461

nas me tog gzhag par bya'o/ /shar du ni gi go rī na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /lhor ni rtsa tso rī na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /nub tu ni baṃ be tā ①lī na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /byang du ni hūṃ ghasma rī na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /dbang ldan du ni paṃ puk+ka sī na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /me'i mtshams su shaṃ sha ba rī na maḥzhes pas ②so//bden bral du ni rtsa tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /rlung mtshalas su ni ḍi ḍom+bi hūṃ ④na maḥzhes bya bas so/ /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par mchod la/ bdag med ma la yang / oṃ a ā/ i yigo sngog ༷༷/ ṛ dzā/ t+pa 'o// e e/ o skyod saṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mchod do/ /yang bcom ldan 'das la/ oṃ aṭ+wān nā ya na maḥ—/ oṃ piṅga udzña ke sha brta ma ṣ+pe na maḥ/ oṃ tsa tur dzi sha ti ṣ+pe tā ya na maḥ/oṃ ṣe ḍa sha ju dzā ya na maḥ/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa rjodzi rū ta wa pu ṣe na maḥ/ oṃ ka pā la mā khā a ṣ+pe ka dha ri ṇi na maḥ/ oṃ ād+dhā ta ku ra ci'i ya na maḥ/ adzñan du durdasbyi ṇi ⑥ na maḥ/ zhes bya ba'i tshig brgyad kyis mchod par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra pu྾ āḥhūṃ—/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghadhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe bi bye āḥhūṃ/zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog la sogs pa phul la/ lan gsum gyi bar du skyabs gsum gyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do/ /yang mchod pa byas nas phyag btsal la/ gtor ma byin nas badz+ra muḥzhes bya bas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o—/ /de'i rjes la sems can thams cad lha'i bde ba la dgod par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad bsal bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang / lha'i bde ba rgyun mi 'chad par nges par 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang /bla na med pa'i lam ④nye bar dgod par 'dod pa'i btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o//5—1462

yang yid kyis chos thams cad la dmigs nas dpyad na stong pa 'od gsal ba'i ngo bor bltas la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba a kophohaṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de ma thag tu re las byung ba'i nyi ma la saṃ dang hūṃ bltas la/ de'i 'od kyis dpag tu med cing mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i sems can rnams yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod nas/ yi ge gnyis po de nyid du yang dag par bsdus nas zhugs par bsams pas/ yud tsam gyis yongs su rdzogs par bcom ldan 'das ma dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das phyag bcu drug pa/ zhal brgyad pa/ phyag rgya lnga 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhis gshegs pa/ bdud bzhi'i snying gar byas krung phyed pa'i gar gyis mnan pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ 'jig pa'i dus kyi sprin sngon po'i mdog gi lus can khro ba dang bcas pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi mnga' ba/ phyag bcu drug na bsnams pa'i thod pa/ g.yas kyi rnams na glang po che dang / rta dang / bong bu dang /glang dang / rnga mo dang / mi dang / sha ra ba dang / byi la rnams gnas pa'o—/ /g.yon pa'i brgyad na/ sa dang / chu dang / rlung dang / me dang /zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / gshin rje dang / nor sbyin rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'phrog pa/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'i bdag med mas 'khyud pa'i bdag nyid can bsgom par bya'o / /de'i rjes snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ bltas la/ bdag med ma'i snying gar yang zla ba la yi ge e blta zhing spyi bor ni yi ge oṃ mo/ /mgrin par ni byeda'o//snying gar yi ge hūṃ bkod la/ mig la gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna ba la zhe sdang rdo 5—1463

rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med ma bkod la/ snying ga'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs nas/ oṃ a rnyi ṣiñtsa tu rmā sarba ta thā ga ta zhes bya bas dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ me tog dang / gur gum gye char yang dbab par bsam/ lha mo rnams kyis kyang bdag nyid la bstod pa bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgoms pas dub par gyur na yang sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /langs pa'i dus su lha mo rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi nang du bsgoms la/ lha'i gzugs kyis gnas par bya'o/ /bsgom pa'i dang por yang gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du a las thod pa'o/ /de'i steng du go ku da ha na/ ma ra mu su bi/zhes bya ba'i rdzas rnams oṃ gyes byin gyis brlabs la bsgoms nas/ ①steng du yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje dkar po ste/ rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pa las me 'bar bas tshos shing khu bar gyur pa de'i 'od kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs mthong ba las/ de dag gi thugs kyi sa bon gyi bdud rtsi bsdus nas/ der chud par byas nas/ oṃ t+pahūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /'di lta bu ni gtor ma la sogs pa'i rdzas dag par bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /nam mkha' las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'am/dpa' bo gcig pu'am/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la dbang po la sogs pa rang rang 5—1464

gi rig mas mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ kha dog nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa bltas la—/ de'i steng du tshangs pa de bzhin du kha dog dkar po/ rnam par snang mdzad cod pan du 'dzin par blta bar bya'o/ /'og tu sa 'og na gnas pa'i klu la sogs pa rnams la/ kha dog dmar po snang ba mtha' yas kyi cod pan byas la blta bar bya'o/ /thams cad kyi lce pad+ma'i 'dab ma la hūṃ las rdo rje dkar por bsgoms la/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i go rī la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis yongs su dag pa'i bdud rtsis dgang bar bya'o/ /de'i sngags ni 'di yin te—/ in+da dza ma dza la dzak+ṣa byu ta bsno ba yu rak+ṣa ①tsan+da srudz+dza mā da ②paspa ①tā le/ a ṭha dusabe+e swā hā/ e rjorda ba bo hūṃ dza dzi rjogha phube+e dhū pa rmā sa dzi gha am+bha sathra ⑦kādz+dza sna dha khārnyi khu ṇi ⑧phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā shā ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ ṣāhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bsang gtor sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ jiḥbi shurtseḥdharmā marba ⑨pā paṃ bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa ⑩na ya hūṃ/zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis so/ /yid kyis mchod pa byas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes bya ba 'dis gshegs su gsol lo/ /zas kyi dus su yang de bzhin du zas kyi rdzas rnams sbyar nas/ bdag nyid kyi lce la hūṃ las rdo rje dkar por byas la/snying gar bcom ldan 'das bltas la de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdus nas/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i mes/kha zas kyi rdzas rnams sbyangs shing sbyin sreg byed do/ /chags pa'i dus su yang shes rab ma bdag med ma'i gzugs su mos pa byas nas/ de'i mgo bo la oṃ/snying gar hūṃ/ pad+ma'i lte ba la t+pabasams nas/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga 5—1465

su khaṃ dat+ta tsa tur ā nan+da bha ga bai shwa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kabye ku ru ṣ+ṭa me zhes bya ba 'dis pad+ma byin gyis brlabs la/ bdag nyid la yi ge gsum bkod la/ hūṃ las rdo rje bsgoms nas/ oṃ las de'i nor bu'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā dī ṣa tsa tur ā nan+da da ya ka kha ga mu khe e ka rā so nā tha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ka tram̐ ku ru ṣ+ṭa me/ zhes bya ba 'dis rdo rje byen gyis brlabs nas/ dzi sau dzi①/ ha ha ha zhes bya bas chags pa brtsam par bya'o/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis skad cig ma mtshon par byas nas/rdzogs pa dang ②bdud rtsi len gyis blangs la bdag nyid tshim par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin du sna tshogs 'dis mos par byas la gnyid log par bya'o/ /byis pa rnams kyis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /ston pa mgon po zhal brgyad pa'i/ /bdag gis ④sgrub thabs byas pa des/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsar+ya kṛṣ+ṭa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5—1466

bsdur mchan/1461 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉brtse ba'i rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtse ba'i/1462 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pesgyu/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉bon bas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉watsā/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyiḍi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉gsashes/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉ni/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉nel/1464 ①〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉nede'i/1465 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rak+ṣa/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ta/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉netā la pa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snamaṣ+ṭha/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stago du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stadro/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsalha sarba/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉marba/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kasgyu pa/1466 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tsā sī sbo/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉bdud rtsi de/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (119)5wa 1467

༄ga /dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gadzhar ma'i rim pa/①༄na / /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra ba lo kra ma/ bod skad du/dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gtor ma'i rim pa/ dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /yi ge gnyis las yang dag 'byung ④/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang phyug gtso/ /te ru ka la phyag 'tshal te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ldan pa'i/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdud rtsi gtor ma dbul ba yi/ /cho ga'i thabs kyi rim pa bshad/ /de la gtor ma'i dgos pa ni/ dpal kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang / sbyin sreg dang mchod pa dang / sgrub pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pas phan gdags pa dang / tshar gcad pa dang / rigs kyi bu dag tshe ring bar 'dod pa dang /yams dang nad med par 'dod pa dang / mu ge zhi bar 'dod pa dang /gnod pa zhi bar 'dod pa dang / dpal dang grags pa 'phel bar 'dod pa 5—1468

dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba zlog ①par 'dod pa dang / longs spyod dang 'byor pa 'dod pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba bzlog par 'dod pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thob par 'dod pa mkhas pas gtor ma'i las la brtson par bya'o/ /de yang gang zhig ce na gzhung las/bgegs rnams zhi bar bya ba dang / /lha rnams 'go bar bya ba dang / /dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba'i phyir/ /gtor ma'i las 'di ci nus brtsam/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /yang kha cig las/ 'byung po kun la gtor ma 'di dag gis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mchod pa legs byas nas/ /dus kun rnyed pas bde bar 'gyur ba dang / /lha rnams dga' zhing 'gro ba 'byor bar 'gyur/ /'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma gcig sbyin ④na/ /sdang dang mngon spyod dgra yi sde 'joms shing / /dgar dang gsad dang dgug par byed pa dang / /zhi zhing bde dang rgyas par byed pa yin/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /yang slob dpon kha cig gis—/ 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /dngos grub cho ga thams cad la/ /dpal ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /gtor ma'i las 'di shin tu bsngags/ /zhes 'byung bas/ gtor ma'i las 'di shin tu phan yon che'o—/ /de la 'dir ni sngags pas 'byung po nyi shu rtsa bzhi la gtor ma sbyin dgos te/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad dang phyogs skyong brgyad/ /'khor du gtogs pa'i brgyad po rnams/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /rgyun du'am ni zla ba'am/ /de bzhin lo gcig rgyun 'khor ram/ /zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / /mar ngo yi ni tshes bcu la/ /dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg bzlas pa dang / /de bzhin gnod byung dus dag gam/ /5—1469

ji ltar 'os shing rigs pa dang / /rang gis ji ltar rjes mthun par/ /ci 'byor pa yi yo byad kyis/ /nan tan du ni gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de la gtor ma'i g.yos kyang ji ltar zhe na/ me tog bdug spos mar me byug pa dang / /sman rnams dang ni dri dang lha bshos dang / /tshod ma dag dang la du khyar ba dang / /zas stidron dang ni drug cu par bcas dang / /phye sogs byas pa bsres nas ni/ /'bras chan ④'bras kyi phyi nang 'bru bdun dang / /zho dang 'bru mar 'o thug sogs pa bsre/ /khrag dang sha dang sran ma nya sha sogs/ /sbyar chang 'bru chang sna tshogs chan la sogs/ /btsos dang rjen dang rnying dang bcas pa rnams/ /ji bzhin bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres byas nas/ /de dag kun gyis snod rnams bkang nas su/ /bum pa chus bkang ba yi steng du gzhag /khur ba zan du mar me steng du bltam①/ /mtshan mo'i dus su de dag la yang dbul—/ /zhes 'byung bas/ drag po la ni dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan steng du gzhag go/ /gtor ma kha dog las kyis bsgyur ro/ /de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa ni/ de dang por bdag nyid lha'i sku phyag rgya chen por gsal bar bsgoms nasarjo/ thog ma nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor yo gis mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor re gyis mtshan pa/de'i steng du a las thod pa/ de'i nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ hūṃ sde d+dhā ⑦khaṃ dang go ku da ha na las/ lcags kyu lnga dang / bdud rtsi lngar bskyed do/ /de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje a las zla ba la byed nub pa'o/ /de'i steng du oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ us gzi brjid bskyed/ hūṃ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / dam tshig gi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de ltar byin gyis 5—1470

brlabs nas mdun du gru gsum chos 'byung nang du pad+ma sum brtsegs bsam ste/dang po pad+ma dkar po'i dbus su dgyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po las lha brgyad oṃ las bskyed pas bskor/ bar du pad+ma sngon po'i dbus su dgyes pa'i rdo rje sngon po la hūṃ las bskyed pa'i phyogs skyong bcu sngon pos bskor/ 'og tu pad+ma dmar po'i dbus su dgyes pa'i rdo rje dmar po la a las bskyed pa'i klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ro/ /mgron spyan drang ba'i phyir rdo rje pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ e a ra li hoḥ/ hri hri hri/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki bhā/ badz+ra dṛ sh+ya hoḥ/badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+ho/ phe gsum brjod pa dang bcas pa las/snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis bkug la/ oṃ 66hūṃ lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /phyogs skyong brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /bka' bzhin 'khor du gtogs pa rnams/ /dam tshig dgongs te gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gzhan yang gru gsum khongs gtogs pa'i/ /zhing skyong tshogs la 'di lta ste/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang bzhi mdo zhing dang ni/ /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /gdol pa'i snod dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni mtsho la gnas/ /ma mo yi ni gnas rnams nas//nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang mi sdug dang / /bka' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed me ①dang drag mo dang / /brjed byed ma dang u ma dang / /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ba dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag mo sdang mo 'chang ba mo/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me mo/ /sum cu ma dang 5—1471

dbang mo dang / /'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo①/ /mche ba gcigs dang thod chen ma/ /thod phreng phreng chen kha ṭī ma/ /sgrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu chen ma②/ /de bzhin chen mo mkha' 'gro lnga/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso//las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /oṃ kak+ka zwa na/ basbarnya na/ khakhru dā na sarba duṣ+ṭa rna ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya/ : ta ya/ he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la sa ba ri wā re bh+yo ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ zhes pas bkug la pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsams la de nas mchod pas mchod de/ oṃ ku ru ku ru a rnyi pa ti tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ/gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig gi lha la thim pa'i rjes su/ lce pad+ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rjer byin byis brlab po/ /de nas pad+ma'i lag pa kha phye ste—/ gtor ma la gtad nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags brjod do/ /oṃ uhūṃḥhoḥbadz+ra bye ra bā ya/ badz+ra bye ra bi ya/ dzo ga dzo gi ni/ sarba lo ki ka lo kot+ta ra/ sarba ḍā ka ḍā ki m+bibya ①bh+yo/ badz+ra go rī/ badz+ra tso rī/ badz+ra be+e tā ④lī/badz+ra ghasma rī/ badz+ra puk+ka sī/ badz+ra sa ba rī/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ badz+ra ḍo bi nī/sa ti ka/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yo/ i rda ba bo/ garnya/ pube+e/ dhū pa/ dri pa/ak+ṣa tai/ da da ma hi te dza/ a kas+t+ya/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yo/ i rda ba lo/kṛṇ+ḍan tu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ saṃḥtribe+edu/ sarba satā ni shārnyi ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru/rak+ṣa haṃ ku ru/ a ba na ku ru/ gubho ka ro du/ kurban+d+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ i 5—1472

ma lus tshogs bcas ji snyed rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol—/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba la—/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la sprul/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis bstong ①grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa zhi bar mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams rgyas shing 'phel bar mdzod/ /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /de la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin tshogs/ /drag cing gtum pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma rungs sems can ming 'di long / /dag cing snying rje med pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma dang ma mo dang / /mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin sha za dang / /lto 'phye dang ni srin po dang / /gzhan yang sha za khrag 'thung ba'i//khyi dang khra dang kai ka dang / /'ol ba bya rgod la sogs pa'i/ /gzugs can thams cad 'dir gshegs shig /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ /gnod par byed pa 'di zhes pa/ /chung ma nor dang srog dang ni/ /'dod pa rnams ni 'phrog par mdzod/ /rang gi yul nas 'byung ba dang / /dgar ba dang ni bskrad par bgyis④/ /bdag gi dpung ni stobs med la/ /dgra ni stobs ldan kho na ste/ /'di nyid khrod kyis bza' ba'i phyir/ /sha dang khrag dang zhag dang rkang / /bza' ba skom dang bcas pa mdzod/ /dgra lus gsol ba dgra 5—1474

mdangs phrogs/ /rang gi rnal 'byor ci rigs par/ /long la za ba nyid du gyis—/ /thams cad tshim par bzhes su gsol/ /gang gis bdag la mi tshugs shing / /dgra 'di thams cad choms par mdzod/ /bdag la las kyi dngos grub ni/ /rgya chen yongs su stsal nas kyang / /nyid kyi gnas dang yul du gshegs/ /ci nus 'byor pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /pus mo lha nga sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyod la gsol ba ni/ /btsun mo dang ni sras dang g.yog tu bcas—/ /gsan cing 'dir gshegs bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /bdag gi bsod nams stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs dang / /gsang sngags rig sngags mthu dag dang / /chos kyi dbyengs kyi stobs kyi mthus//sems can rnams la phan gdags pas/ /don rnams yang dag bsams ①pa kun—/ /sems can khams ni ma lus par/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par—/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /sngags pa gang zhig dgra bgegs tshar gcad par 'dod pa des/ gzugs gtor ma'i steng du bzhag la/gnod sbyin ma la sogs pa mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ pho nya grangs med pas zos 'thungs par bsam zhing / gtor ma bstabs shing 'di skad las bcol lo//oṃ ma lus zhing na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dang / /dpal chen khrag 'thung khro rgyal 'jigs byed tshogs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /gdul dka' drag po'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sgyu ma lta bur cir yang ston mdzad pa/ /gtum chen rab rngam tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo//5—1475

snyigs ma lnga ldan bstan pa 'jig dus 'dis/ /bdud dang mu stegs log par lta ba rnams/ /zhi ba'i las kyis 'dul bar mi 'gyur bas/ / tsham ngam ①drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing / /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /'jigs byed chen po'i bka' bzhin du/ /shin tu gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug chen po dang / /lha yi dbang po 'dod pa'i lha/ /khyab 'jug tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /j-i gi ri ti gzhon nu dang / /dga' byed dbang phyug 'dod lha dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen dang / /m+bin drug la sogs khyung gi mgo /mgyogs pa'i gshog pas gdengs ka byas/ /rdo rje sku yi dam tshig can/ /dkar po rtag pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis te/ /'khor lo dang ni dril bus byel④/ /rig ma dang no mnyam du sbyor/ /'jigs pa'i tshul byis brkyang bskum gnas/ /phyag rgya drug gis lus la brgyan/ /dus mtha'i me chen klong dkyil na/ /hūṃ phaṭa phe phe 'jigs par sgrogs/ /steng gi lha tshogs bcas pa yi/ /nam mkha'i ro zhon khyod kyis ni/ /dam tshig phrin las dus la bab/ /hūṃ te ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /in+d+ra ru dhi ①rak+ta dang / /ye shes dam tshig bdud rtsi dang / /sna tshogs gtor ma 'di long la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma dang / /rdo rje spun dang ming sring la/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs ni/ /sngags rgyud ye shes sun 'byen cing / /slob dpon smod cing spun la 'khu/ /byang chub sems spong dam tshig nyams/ /zhi ba'i las kyis mi 'dul bas/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /rab tu drongs shig 'dir khug la/ /rdul dang thal ba bzhin du lhogs/ /mngon spyod phrin 5—1476

las dus la bab/ /sha dang khrag dang rus pa rol/ /rgyu ma glo snying nang grol drongs—/ /sngon gye dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing / /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /'jigs byed chen po'i bka' bzhin du/ /shin tu gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /brgya byin gshin rje chu bdag dang / /gnod sbyin dbang bdag ①me yi lha/ /srin bo rlung lha la sogs pa/ /srin po'i mgo can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /mgyogs pa'i gshog pas gdengs ka byas/ /rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig can/ /nag po mi bskyod dbu rgyan ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bus byel/ /rig ma dang ni mnyam du sbyor/ /'jigs pa'i tshul gyis brkyang bskum gnas/ /phyag cu ①drug gis lus la brgyan//dus mtha'i me chen klong dkyil na/ /hūṃ phaṭa dze dze 'jigs par sgrogs/ /bar gyi mi tshogs bcas pa yis①/ /bar snang ro zhon khyod kyi ④ni/ /dam tshig phrin las dus la bab/ /hūṃ he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /in+d+ra ru dhi rak+ta dang / /ye shes dam tshig bdud rtsi dang / /sna tshogs gtor ma 'di long la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma dang / /rdo rje spun dang ming sring la/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs ni/ /sngags rgyud ye shes sun 'byin cing / /slob dpon smod cing spun la 'khu/ /byang chub sems spong dam tshig nyams/ /zhi ba'i las kyis mi 'dul bas/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /rab tu drongs shig 'dir khug la/ /rdul dang thal ba bzhin du lhogs/ /mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab/ /sha dang khrag dang rus par rol/ /rgyu ma glo snying nang grol drongs/ /sngon gyi dam las ma 'da' bar/ /5—1477

bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing //bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /'jigs byed chen po'i bka' bzhin du/ /shin tu gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /stobs rgyu dung skyong mtha' yas dang / /nor rgyas bu dang 'jog po dang / /rigs ldan pad+ma chen po dang / /pad+ma la sogs chu srin mgo/ /mgyogs pa'i gshog pas gdengs ka byas/ /rdo rje gsung gi dam tshig can/ /dmar po gar dbang dbu rgyan ldan/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis te/ /pad+ma dang ni dril bus byel/ /rig ma dang ni mnyam du sbyor / /'jigs pa'i tshul gyis brkyang bskum gnas/ /phyag rgya drug gis lus la brgyan/ /dus mtha'i me chen klong dkyil na/ /hūṃ phaṭa phe phe 'jigs par sgogs—/ /'og gi klu tshogs bcas pa yis①/ /sa 'og ro zhon khyod kyi ②ni/ /dam tshig thugs dam dus la bab/ /hūṃ he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /in+d+ra ru dhi rak+ta dang / /ye shes dam tshig bdud rtsi dang / /sna tshogs gtor ma 'di long la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob mar bcas—/ /rdo rje spun dang ming sring la/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs ni—/ /sngags rgyud ye shes sun 'byen cing / /slob dpon smod cing spun la 'khya—/ /byang chub sems spong dam tshig nyams/ /zhi ba'i las kyis mi 'dul bas—/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /rab tu drongs shig 'dir khug la/ /rdul dang thal ba bzhin du lhogs/ /mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab—/ /sha dang khrag dang rus pa rol/ /rgyu ma glo snying nang grol drongs/ /sngon gyi dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing / /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /5—1478

'jigs byed chen po'i bka' bzhin du/ /shin tu gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa①/ /phyi rol dur khrod 'jigs pa na/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ /zhing skyong drag po ro langs dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs tshogs/ /sha za brjed byed srul po dang / /nam gru log 'dren la sogs pa/ /gnod sbyin sa bdag gdug pa'i 'dre/ /la la srin po'i zhal can la/ /mi yi lus can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /la la stag gi mgo can la/ /mi yi lus can rngam pa'i gzugs/ /la la seng ge'i mgo can la/ /srin po'i gzugs can shin tu khro—/ /la la mkha' lding mgo can la/ /klu yi lus can 'jigs pa'i gzugs//de bzhin bya yi mgo can dang / /gcan gzan lus can sna tshogs rnams/ /la la khro zhing la la rngam/ /la la zhi zhing la la gtum/ /la la 'gying zhing la la lding / /la la sha za khrag 'thung brtson/ /la la khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs//la la rab brtson khro gnyer can/ /la la bzhad gad ha ha sgrog /la la 'brug skad bzhin du ldir/ /la la rngam skad dze phe sgogs/ /la la mkha' stong gar gyes 'gengs/ /la la rtsub cing la la gnag /la la dkar zhing rnam par gsal—/ /la la dmar zhing chags pa'i mdog /la la sngo zhing sdang ba'i tshul/ /la la ser po dbyebs mdog rgyas/ /la la khro gnyer smin bu rtsub/ /la la smin bu gyen du 'khyil/ /skra 'khyil nam mkha'i dbyings su khyab/ /zhal gdangs mche gatshigs khrag 'thung ba'i/ /ljags dril mche ba dmar po gtsigs/ /sbyan gsum sdang mig khro gnyer can/ /rus pa'i bstar ②phreng sbrul gyis brgyan/ /khyag zhag tshil gyi tshom bus brgyan/ /glang chen ko rlon rnam par bshal/ /stag gi pags pas sham thabs byas/ /na bza' mi yi lpags don ④gsol/ /la la 5—1479

rdo rje gtun shing dang / /ral gri chu gri la sogs pa'i/ /lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /la la gar gye phyag rgyas sbyor/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir—/ /phyi rol 'byung po'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /sa stengs ro zhon thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig phrin las dus la bab/ /hūṃ he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /in+d+ra ru dhi ①rak+ta dang / /ye shes dam tshig bdud rtsi dang / /sna tshogs gtor ma 'di long la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma dang / /rdo rje spun dang ming sring la/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs ni—/ /sngags rgyud ye shes sun 'byin cing / /slob dpon smod cing spun la 'khu—/ /byang chub sems spong dam tshig nyams/ /zhi ba'i las kyis mi 'dul bas—/ /gdug pa'i sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /rab tu drongs shig 'dir khug la/ /rdul dang thal ba bzhin du lhogs/ /mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab—/ /sha dang khrag dang rus la rol/ /rgyu ma glo snying nang grol drongs/ /sngon gyi dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /de nas gsad pa'i ②las bzhi bya/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu brjod/ de nas chos bshad de/ oṃ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /rgyu dang las las ①kun du 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las dunges par skyes—/ /bden pa 'dis ni dkyil 'khor du/ /kun gyis rjodri ma med mthong shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba der/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /de nas 0na lam gdab pa ni/ /oṃ shī la tsaṇ+ḍa na le pe tai a gabye rjodz+wa pra bha ra ṇa/ po tai ka ku mu ⑦mi tī ra r+ṇa bi ha ra haṃ/budha be+e sha ya/ pu na rā ga ma na ya muḥ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la 5—1480

ya—/ badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ phyo me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su posgo me bha ba/ sarba sidhim+bi pra yats+tsha sarba karma suts+tsha me/tsitrī gre yaḥ/ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me myuñtsa—/ badzī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/ de nas bkra shis brjod/ oṃ spyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas rang bzhin gyi mgron gshegs su gsol lo①/ /dam tshig gi mgron yi ge gsum du byas nas bdag gi snying ga'i sa bon la bsdu'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yi ser sna dang / /dbul ba'i dri ma sbyang ba dang / /dngos grub myur du thob pa dang / /'gro rnams bkod par 'phel phyir byas/ /dge bas 'gro kun byang chub mchog /rin chen gling du myur 'gro shog /dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gtor ma'i cho ga'i rim pa/ slob dpon chen po a la la badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta kasba pa ②ga thā ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba'o// //5—1481
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (120)5wa 1483

༷194༄ga /gtor ma'i las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba dzi karma kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/gtor ma'i las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum po dang / /de yi chos skyong srung ma la/ /bzod gsol don du 'dud pa dang / /rgyu yi phyir kyang phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya ba dang / /snga ma'i lan chags bral ba dang / /'phral gyi bar chad nyer zhi'i phyir/ /gtor ma rgyun du gtang bar bya/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po dang / /phrin las rnam bzhi rtsom pa dang / /dbang bskur chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /gtor ma'i rim pa 'di ltar bya/ /yo byad dang ni bca' thabs dang / /dgod rim dang yang byin rlabs dang / /dbul dang dbang bskur dgye ba bdun/ /las kyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa'o/ /sha dang bdud rtsi zas lnga dang / /gzhan yang bza' btung sna tshogs te/ /gro ga'am 5byed1484

ras sam shing shun la/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs bya/ /mdor na sna tshogs pa yi rdzas/ /sdig pa med cing gnod pa med/ /yo byad dam par 'di bshad do/ /gzhan yang gtor ma chen po ni/ /shin tu che ba'i snod dag tu/ /mchod pa'i bye brag kha zas kyis/ /khengs par bkang ba'i steng dag tu/ /a shwaṅga yi shing dag la/ /gru gsum phyag rgya byas te gzhagasde /gru gsum rtse la mar me+e gsum/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu gtang bar bya/ /de ru 'phan dang rgyal mtshan dang / /gdugs dang phyag rgya sna tshogs gzhag /de yi dbus su zan kham gsum—/ /steng du bharnya ④mtshan bzangs dag /khrag chen dag gis gang ba gzhag① /gzhan yang mdzes pa'i snod dag tu/ /khengs par bkang ba'i steng dag tu/ /'phan dang rgyal mtshan gdugs rnams gzugs/ /mar me gcig kyang rtag tu gtang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang phyogs skyong ni/ /mdzes pa'i snod du rdzas rnams kyis/ /legs par bkang ste gzhag par bya/ /tshogs dang tshogs kyi rol pa yin/ /lhag ma dag la lhag ma bya/ /kun kyang gcan gzan rjes bzhin nam/ /las kyi dbyibs dang sbyar bar bya/ /chang dang khrag dang chu yis sbyang / /gtor chen rtsa ba'i dbus su gzhag /yang na byang shar mtshams su gzhag /lhag ma lho yi phyogs su'o/ /phyogs skyong shar te mkha' 'gro nub/ /shin tu lhag ma mdun nam byang / /yam̐ las rlung dang re las me/ /a las snod kyi nang dag tu/ /e las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de yi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su/ /hūṃ hūṃ sde j-i ༷khaṃ/ na go ku da ha/ dri chu dri chen khrag dang ga bur shel/ /mi dang ba lang khye glang rta/ /de yi steng du yig 'bru bsam/ /de las rigs lnga yab yum bsam/ /de steng oṃ las zla ba ste/ /de steng hūṃ las 5—1485

rdo rje bsam/ /phaṭa kyis bud ①cing 'bar ba dang / /bsros te dros pas yab yum rol/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu dag na gnas pa yi/ /bde gshegs ye shes byang chub sems/ /sems can rnams kyi bkrag gzi mdangs/ /rtsi shing nags tshal bcud bsdus te/ /sbar yang ji bzhin dgug par bya/ /thim nas thams cad 'od du zhu/ /oṃ uhūṃ gis byin gyis brlab/ /las kyi skabs la bab pa dang / /gtor chen bharnya'i nang du ni/ /sgrub thabs gzhung bzhin bsgoms nas su/ /de yi phyi rim bar khyams la/ /lha brgyad 'khor bcas mos pas bsgom/ /gnyis pa la ni phyogs skyong dang / /de bzhin gsum par klu chen brgyad/ /'khor dang bcas pa mos pas so/ /tshogs kyi rdzas rnams drangs pa la/ /bsang gtor byas te byin kyis brlab/ /phud spros snepad+ma'i phyag rgyas blang / /sngags 'di brjod cing dbul bar bya/ /oṃ e bye ti ①badz+ra i rda ba dzi khā nyi/ lha rnams kun la de bzhin dbul/ /bsrung ba'i dbang sngags brjod cing dbul/ /bstod cing rdo rje glu yang blang / /de nas lhag ma'i phud spros rjote/ /gru gsum zla ba'i steng dag tu/ /bdag nyid kye yi rdo rjer bsgom/ /de yi khyams la mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor dang bcas pa mos pas bsam/ /gnyis pa la ni dbang phyug ma/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba ris drug dang / /dmigs kyi ④yul kyi lha 'dre rnams/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas nas su/ /oṃ e bye hi/ sarba yo gi ni/ sarba ḍā ki ni/ prah+ma ṇi/ ru tra ni/ma he shwa ri/ be+eṇ+ḍa be+e/ bā rā hi/ na ya dzi ga /a ya te/ asna ye/ ba ru ṇa ye/ ba ya be+e/ ku mā ri/ ko be ra/ ga ru ṇi/ pasna ki/ bye ༷na ya ki—/ rnyi ⑦pa sa tri/ bhe pra ma ni/ bheska ri/ tsa muṇ+ḍi⑧/ sarba de ba/5—1486

sarba a su ra/ sarba ma nu ṣa/ sarba tir+ya ka /sarba pre ta ka /sarba na ra ka /sarba bhū ta/ pi shā tsa/ ut+pan+da/ a pasma ra ta ya/ mos pa'i tshul du spyan drangs mchod/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgyas blangs la dbul/ /put+pa/ dhū pa/ dī pa/garnya—/ ṣ+pe bi bye/ pañtsa a mṛ te/ ma tha/ drartsa/ ba ta ga te/ tsa tra tsa ma ra/ sa yo tha/ ma tsa ma sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ na na khā nyi/ saṃ purja①/i rda ba lo bye dza ②tha/ kṛt+na tha sa ma ya rak+ṣa tha ma ma sarba a the/ ha sa yo/ku ro tha/ a tra/ sā dha ni/ yi shra traṣ+ṭa shaṃ/ rak+ṣa sabaṃ/ adze+e/ ya dze+e baṃrka/ ya theṣ+ṭi①/ hūṃ dza tha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ pi ba tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba sa pa ri/ sa ta su khaṃ bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ yi duka bha ban+tu/oṃ uhūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rol mo'i sgra dang rdo rje glu blangs te/ lhag ma'i gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid dgyes rdor rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos 'byung nang du 'dab brgyad gsum/ /rim par dkar nag dmar po'o/ /de yang yig 'bru gsum las bsgom/ /lha dang phyogs skyong klu chen brgyad/ /oṃ uhūṃ las pad mdog bzhin/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'chang / /rang gi yum yang de bzhin te/ /brkyang bskum tshul kyis kun kyang gnas/ /sa bon las ni 'od zer spro/ /gzugs dang gzugs med lha brgyad la/ /'dod khams lha mi phyogs skyong ste/ /ngan song gsum dang lha ma yin/ /klu chen brgyad la bstem par bya/ /bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis sku gsung thugs/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs te/ /phyi nang gsang bas mchod bya ste/ /lha dang phyogs skyong klu brgyad la/ /rnam snang mi bskyod mtha' yas kyis/ /rim pa ji bzhin dbang bskur bya/ /de la sngags 5—1487

'dis rab tu 'bul/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgyas blangs nas su/ /oṃ in+da ya ma dza la/yak+ṣa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhyu ta ba:/ bā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+da/ surdza ①mā ta/ pabe+e/ta la/ pā tā la/ a ṭha ②sabe+e swā hā/ i rda ba oṃ hūṃ dza/ dzi gha oṃ sa dhū paṃ pu dī paṃ/ gadhe/ dzi gha/ e ba/ kats+tsha/ kharnyi/ khu ṇi/ phe ṭa/ ga da—/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharmā hūṃ/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta/ oṃ t+pahūṃ swā hā/rdo rje glu dang rol mo'i sgras/ /mchod de nyin mo lan gsum gtang / /yi dam lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchod pa'i rdzas la bsang gtor brlab/ /'dab brgyad dbus kyi lte ba la/ /mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dmigs byas te/ /badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ dzi ①gi ni/ byā gi ni/ rdza bu gi ni/ lu ki ni/ ḍā ki ni/ dī pi ni/ tsu pi ni/ ke po dzi ni/ brjod pa tsam gyis dmigs byas te/ /'dab brgyad la ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /gru chad la ni khams gsum gyi/ /gtso bo thams cad bsam par bya/ /khyams la 'khor rnams thams cad do/ /oṃ uhūṃ/kun kyang sku gsung thugs dang ldan/ /bha ga'i phyag rgya mgo steng bca'/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā r+sha/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta/ spyan drangs bstems la bar chod bgegs/ /'ong ba srung phyir 'di skad do/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra r+ṇa/ na mo badz+ra kro dha ya/ ma hā rdastso ta ga ṭa/ ste ra bā ya/ a si mu shu la par+sha pā sha hastu ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/tidz+re tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ ma tha ma tha/ gardza gardza/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bispyo na dubi nā ya rmā/ ma hā ka bi de/bi bi tan+ta ka rā ya/ sarba go rī u pa tha ba sa ma rna/ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar bdud rtsis mtshams bcad nas/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgyas 5—1488

gtor ma dbul/ ba bo ga tha/ oṃ ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki na maḥs ma ya ste/ dṛ byu hoḥ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba bhū ta/ pre ta rāk+ṣa sa—/ bi shā tsa uṣ+ṭhan+da a pa sma ra/ ḍā ki bye da ya/ i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍan+tu/sarba sernyim+bi pra yats+tshan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ya tha baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭi/ bhuñdza tha/pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba pa ri pu ①ka /ta ta su ka bi sho dha ya ②snga hā/ oṃ a kra bi kre/ sma sha ṣ+pe pa/ papo de/ karnya re/ sgo te gra me/parba phye①/ pa ze/ khe dra/ sor+ṇa ma ka ra/ bi se sa ta ba dza ṣ+pe/ thang la ga te bu mo/ ma lta ga tarjo/ bi se swā hā/ kṛṣ+ṭa ru tra/ ma hā ru tra/ de ba twata tra/ sa ma sred tarjo/ kre na kar la pi pa dzi/ nan ta ti ta/ bi na ya ka /tsa muṇ+ḍi/ go ra pi pa tsi'i/ u ma de bi tu/ sta pa dza yaji / bi dza ya / tsi bu ba/ a tsi ta/ a pa ratsi ta/ dzi ka le/ kā ya bha bān+tu/oṃ snya.oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar phul te gsol ba dang / /se gol brdab cing gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ kṛ to ba sadz+dza satā rba/ sirnyi ma daṭ+wā thā nu ga /gats+tsha tī bud+dhā bi ṣa chag/ pu na ra ga ma na yatshol/ rang rang gnas su yud tsam gyis/ /phyin te rnal 'byor bsgo ba nyan/ /de ltar mtshan mo lan gsum gtang / /yi dam lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /lce la rdo rje bsgom byas te/ /lha'am chos nyid rol bsams na/ /dngos grub rim par 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor jol pa'i lhag ma la/ /shin tu lhag ma'i gtor ma bya/ /lte bar bdag nyid yi dam bsgom/ /pre ta brjod cing zur drug la/ /yi dwags thams cad bsdu bar bya—/ /oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa a bye tiṣ+ṭha bye dza di bi tha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sdug bsngal bral zhing tshim par bsam/ /sgrub pa'i zhag grangs thon pa dang / /slob ma'i mgo steng 5—1489

gtor ma gzhag /rtag tu bsrung zhing skyob pa dang / /phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob bsam/ /sum mdo'am lam ka'i bzhi mdo'am/ /dur khrod yang na chu 'gram du/ /nam phyed na ni gtor ma gtang / /byang shar mtshams su gtor chen bskyal/ /mdor na gnas pa'i go rims kyis/ /skyes ba'i sa ru phyin pa dang / /phyogs phyogs gdon rnams zil mnan phyir/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu kha bltas te/ /rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ /lag pa g.yon nas g.yas su bsgyur—/ /rkang pa g.yon nas g.yas su brdab/ /lag pa brkyang ste 'phyang zhing 'phur①/ /long mo gshibs te 'gying bag gis/ /'gyur zhing g.yon du bgrad cing blta/ /rang sngags gdon cing dgye bar bya'o/ /rdo rje'i glu yang drag tu blang / /rol mo'i sgra yang drag tu brdung / /'di ni mkhas pa rnams kyi gzhung / /rgyud rnams dang ni 'gal ba med/ /gdams ngag rim pa 'di bris pas/ /lhag chad nor ba ci mchis pa/ /dkon mchog bla ma chos skyong dang / /mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /rmongs pa rnams la mig phye bas—/ /las kyi gzhung bsrangs dge rtsa gang / /bdag dang rnal 'byor thams cad dang / /sems can kun gyi don du bsngo/ /slob dpon chen po kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5—1490

bsdur mchan/1484 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanator ma'i las kyi rim pa bzhugs/1485 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brnya/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bar bzhag rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gi sgro/1486 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya) 'bud/ ②〈〈pe 〉skoragros/ 〈〈snar 〉stabakrod/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/hi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkros/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyis/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ste / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngosaṇ+ḍa/1487 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pur rna/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sri lha tsha/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mthoṭaṃ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉tha/1488 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyidz+dza/ ②〈〈pe 〉snamaṣ+ṭha/ 〈〈snar 〉mosaṣ+ṭha/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyasi/ dhi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/na/1489 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spo/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉de pa:/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ti/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbot+ta/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thaṣ+ka/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉barba sa tā ra tha/ si ti du ta ya thā nu ga ga dza ta/ pu rta bi sa ye/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stan ma du/149 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉toraphyong zhing 'bur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (121)5wa 1491

༄ga /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ sarba bhū ta ba dzi bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e waṃ rnam par nges bzhugs pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpar phyag bya ste//rnam 'tshe log 'dren la sogs las①/ /sems can bsrung phyir gtor ma brtsam/ / kye yi rdo rjer ldan pa yi/ /khrurnal 'byor pa yis bsgom bya ba/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas nang du ni/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs la/ /dkar nag dmar po'i oṃ hūṃ t+pa/ /rim par lha chen brgyad dang ni/ /phyogs srung brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ltar bskyed bya ste/ /mdun du dbang phyug chen po bskyed—/ /g.yas su lha yi dbang po bsam/ /rgyab tu tshangs pa bskyed bya ste/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su khyab 'jug go /me ru 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bskyed/ /srin por tshogs kyi bdag po ste/ /: gi ri ti rlung mtshalas su/ /dbang ldan 5—1492

mtshalas su karti ①ka /mdun gyi 'dab mar brgya byin bsam/ /g.yas su mthar byed dgod par bya'o/ /chu lha rgyab kyi 'dab ma la'o/ /de ltar g.yon du nor sbyin dgod/ /me yi mtshams su me lha che/ /bden bral du ni srin po'o//rlung gi mtshalas su rlung lha'o/ /dbang ldan mtshalas su 'byung po'i bdag /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /mtha' yas nor rgyas de bzhin te/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan dang / /pad chen shin tu pad chen po/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis te/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag na 'chang / /rang 'od rig mas yang dag 'khyud/ /gdan la g.yas brkyang ba yis bzhugs/ /rang rang thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas/ /lha chen brgyad la gzugs khams dang / /gzugs med gnas pa'i lha bsdu'o/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi lha dang mi/ /phyogs srung brgyad la rab tu bsdu/ /ngan 'gro gsum dang lha ma yin/ /klu chen brgyad la bsdu bar bya/ /rang bzhin gnas la bzhugs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams spyan drang phyir/ /go rī yis ni dgug byas la/ /tso rī yis ni zhags pas bcings/ / be tā ②lī yis lcags sgog bsdam/ /dril bus mnyes byed ghasma rī/ /rnal 'byor pa yi thugs ka nas/ /'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros nas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dgugasne/de la phyi nang gsang mchod de/ /de rnams kyis ni dbang bskur mthar/ /rang rang bdag pos dbu la brgyan/ /lha chen brgyad la rtag pa yis/ /rdo rje yis ni phyogs skyong brgyad/ /gar dbang gis ni klu chen brgyad/ /de la cho gas gtor ma bsgrub/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor las/ /ulas byung ba'i pad sdod bsam/ /der ni hūṃ sde j-i rjokhaṃ hūṃ/ /go ku da ha na las ni⑤/ /sangs 5—1493

rgyas lnga dang sems can lnga/ /zla ba nyi ma'i bar du bsam/ / nyi dbus hūṃ byung rdo rje ste/ /①'bar ba dang ni spros pa yis/ /'chi med rab tu bsgrub par bya/ / chang gi ④rang bzhin 'di bsgoms nas/ /oṃ oṃhūṃ gis byin brlabs dbul/ /de nas gtor ma gtang ba'i sngags/ /oṃ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+ṣa/bhū ta/ bsna/ ba u/ rak+ṣa①/ tsan+da/ sru dz+dza/ mā ma/ paza/ ta la/pā tā li/ 26gha swā hā/ de ni gtor ma'i mgron no/ /i rda/ ba lo/bhuñdza—/ dzi dugha/ phul+la/ dhū pas/ rmā sa/ baṃ ④gha/ de ni gsol bar zhu ba'o/ /asba sarba kādz+dza sā dha kharnyi khuṇ+ḍi phe ṭa ga da/ de ni don ⑦zhu ba'o/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta/ oṃ uhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de — byen gyis brlabs pa'i sngags so/ /de nas dgyes par byas nas gshegs su gsol—/ yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa two no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ rto me bha ba/ su topyo me bha ba/ a nu ragho me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/ sarba sernyim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma suts+tsha me/tsihaṃ she yaḥ/ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/badzī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa tshi⑧/ gtor ma 'di sbyin zhing rab tu mchod par byed na/ rnal 'byor pa la 'byung po thams cad kyis legs par byed par 'gyur ro—/ /de tshe de la bde ba rnyog pa med pa nyid dang / lha mnyes pa dang / 'khor dge bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'byung po'i tshogs de la gtor ma byin na/ dbang dang mngon spyod dang dgra'i sde gzhig pa dang / bskrad pa dang / dgug pa dang /zhi ba dang / bde ba dang / rgyas par byed par 'gyur ro/ /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis 5—1494

mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o—/ / //bsdur mchan/1492 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉go /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor chog bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/kye yi rdo rjer ldan pa yi//1493 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan ti/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pesgyu/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kun/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gi māṃ dzi/⑤〈〈pe〉lo'ar 〉boni/1494 ①〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉〉wanyi dbus rgyu byung rdo rje ste// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉ca yi/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉ringak+ṣa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉staḥ/ 0〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sga/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngag/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〉du/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉wa.oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma pa// — zug hā sa ma pa/ satwa lhas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (122)5wa 1495

༄ga /kye'i rdo rje'i grub pa'i thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ he badz+ra sā dha no pi ka /bod skad du/kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes gnyis med rgyu dang bral/ /de bzhin tshogs bral gang gi ②gnas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung phyag 'tshal te/ /de bsten cho ga bstan par bya/ /gsang ba'i don ldan sgrub pa pos/ /yang dag don ldan dam tshig dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom pa shes/ /slob dpon gsang dang shes rab dang / /de bzhin bzhi pa'i dbang ldan pas/ /bsgom ①pa'i mchog ni bsgrub par 'gyur/ /shing gcig drung ngam dur khrod du/ /bsgom pa dag ni dge bar gsungs/ /yang na dben zhing dgon pa dang / /ma mo'i gnas la sogs de bzhin/ /yang na bde zhing nyams dga' bar/ /rang gi 'dod pa bsgrub par bya/ /der ni bde zhing rgya che ba'i/ /stan la rnam par 'dug nas ni/ /me tog la sogs bye brag 5—1496

dang / /bdud rtsi yis ni bsang gtor bya/ /rdo rjes mkha' snying dbus gnas par—/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de la hūṃ yig 'bar ba yis /mtshon cha mchog ni spro bar bya/ /mkha' dbyings til gang bzhin rgyas pa'i/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor mchog bkug ste/ /rang snying sa bon mchog skyes pa'i/ /lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /go rī zla ba'i mtshan ma dang / /tso rī nyi ma'i snod 'dzin te/ / be tā ①lī yi lag na chu'o/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin te/ /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'o/ /sa ba rī ni de bzhin bcud/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lbo ni rnge chung 'khrol/ /ḍom+bi chags chen rjes chags pas/ /snying gar yongs su 'khyud pa ste/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /de rjes bsod nams yan lag go/ /gsum gyi skyabs 'gro sogs bya ste/ /'di ltar phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro dang / /sdig bshags bsod nams rjes yi rang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang / /dam bca' bdag lus dbul bar bya/ /de nas dang por byams pa ste/ /de rjes snying rje rnam par bsgom/ /gsum par dga' ba bsgom par bya/ /kun gyi tha mar btang snyoms so/ /de nas ye shes blta ba'i phyir/ /phyi dang nang gi dngos 'di kun/ /rnam dag stong par rnam dpyad de/ /sprin med nam mkha' ltar bsams nas/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+pa ko3haṃ/ sems brtan byed pa'i gsang sngags 'dis/ /stong pa nyid las sems kyi dngos/ /a haṃ o dang ldan pa ni/ /oṃ dbus haṃ gis 'byel pa las/ /ri snel nyi ma bdun bsams te/ /de la hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje des kyang ra ba dang / /dra ba 'ching ba'ang bsgom par bya/ /de dbus mkha' dbyings bdag nyid kyis/ /shes 5—1497

rab e gzugs bsgom par bya/ /de steng sa dang chu dang ni/ /me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /ljang gu dkar po dmar po dang / /du ba'i mdog tu bsam par bya/ /gru bzhi rlum po gru gsum dang / /zla kham dbyibs su rnam par bsam/ /de steng oṃ ldan a haṃ ni/ /bdag nyid ngo bo gnas bsams te/ /e gzugs nas ni a haṃ bar/ /thams cad 'dres gyur 'khor lor 'gyur/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs brgyan pa'o/ /de stengs ①chos dbyings bdag nyid kyi/ /ro ni mkhas pas rab bsgoms te/ /de la ā li kā li las/ /'byung ba nyi ma zla ba bsam/ /de dag rab tu sa bon ni/ /a dang hūṃ las gyur pa yi/ /rdo rje gri gug bsgom par bya/ /de la rang sems bdag nyid kyi/ /a haṃ yongs su zhugs pa ni/ /dam pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin byis②/ /sems dpar 'di de brjod pa'o/ /de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid kyi/ /te ru kar ni rnam par bsgom/ /zla ba me long ye shes te/ /de bzhin nyi ma mnyam pa nyid/ /sa bon las byung mtshan ma ni/ /so sor rtog par gsungs pa'o/ /dbyer med 'dres pa nan tan te/ /skur gyur chos dbyings ye shes yin/ /sku mdog sngo rengs shar ba'i 'od—/ /bin+d+ra dmar po 'dra ba'i spyan/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'khyel/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo snyan cha phyag gdub dang / /mgur chu dang ni ske rags rnams/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni dag pa yis/ /'di rnams phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /lo grangs bcu drug lta bu la/ /rab tu khros pa'i sta stangs can/ /g.yon na rdo rje thod pa dang / /gnyis pa yum gyi 5—1498

bdag nyid kyis①/ /kha ṭī ga yang 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas na rdo rje nag po ste/ /hūṃ gi sgra 'byen bdag nyid can/ /zhe sdang bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /gal te phyag rgya byed 'dod na/ /g.yon gyi dang po ka pā la/ /lha dang lha min khrag gis bkang / /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje ste/ /lhag pa'i phyag gnyis ji lta ba/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i phag mos ②'khyud/ /gzhan yang sngon nyid ji lta ba'o/ /gzhan yang zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni skya rengs 'dra/ /g.yon pa dmar po gcer bu ste/ /g.yon gyi dang po tri shu ①la/ /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis pa dril bu dang / /g.yas pa gnyis pa karta ④rirka/ /lhag mas rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /gri dang thod pa bsnams pas ⑤'khyud/ /gzhan ni sngo bzhin yum de bzhin/ /gzhan yang bsgom par bya ba ni/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /bdud bzhi zhabs kyis rnam par mnan/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam brgyan cing / /nyi ma la bzhugs gar gyis stabs/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'chang / /kha dog nag po 'jigs par byed/ /rang zhal nas ni hūṃ 'phro zhing / /sku la thal bas rnam par byugs/ /bdag med ma dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /dga' ba'i sbyor bas 0snyoms par 'jug /rnam par mi rtog bde ba yi/ /mi rtog rang bzhin bde bar gnas/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po che/ /g.yas pa me tog kun+da 'dra/ /dpa' bo g.yon pa dmar ba che/ /steng gi zhal ni rnam par gcigs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan dang ldan/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba 'dra/ /g.yas kyi 'bar ba'i phyag brgyad na/ /pad+ma bharnya brgyad nang du/ /glang po rta dang bong bu dang / /ba lang rnga mo mi dag dang / /5—1499

byi la dang ni seng ge rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ske/ /zla ba nyi ma de bzhin yang / /gshin rje dang ni gnod sbyin rnams—/ /g.yon byi bharnya brgyad du'o/ /sgeg dang dpa' dang mi sdug dang / /rgod dang khro dang 'jigs par byed/ /snying rje ngo mtshar zhi la sogs/ /'bar ba'i gar dgu nyams dang ldan/ /zhabs kyis sa la brdabs mdzad cing / /lha min lha la bsdigs mdzad pa'i/ /rang gi snying gar ram̐ yig las/ /byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de nas thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /ngo bo nyid kyi hūṃ yig go/ /rdo rje yi ge hūṃ las byung / /kha dog nag po drag po che/ /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus gnas par/ /de nyid hūṃ du bsgom par bya/ /gzhan yang hūṃ yig yongs gyur pa'i/ /zhe sdang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje las byung nag po che/ /'dam skyes sngon po rab 'dra ba'i/ /yang na sngo rengs shar ba 'dra—/ /dad pas nges par bsgom par bya/ /de nas gzhal yas yid 'ong ba'i—/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo bsgom bya ste/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa yi/ /yid 'ong sbyor ba'i dgyes pa las/ /byung ba'i go rī dbang po'i phyogs/ /shar gyi sgor ni rnam par gnas/ /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba las/ /byung ba'i tso rī yang spros te/ /lho phyogs sgo skyong tso rī gnas/ /'jam po 'jug pa sbyor ba las—/ / be tā ①lī yang dbyung bar bya/ /spros nas bdud 'joms nub sgor ro—/ /snyems 'jug sbyor ba chen po las/ /ghasma rī yang dbyung bar bya/ /spros nas byang gi sgo ru ni/ /khro mo'i ⑤gzugs su rnam par gnas/ /gnyis sprad pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /puk+ka sī yang dbyung bar bya/ /spros nas dbang ldan grwa ru ni/ /'khrug pa'i gzugs su rnam par gnas/ /gzhan yang gnyis med 5—1500

sbyor ba las/ /sha ba rī ni me yi grwa /tsaṇ+ḍa lbo ni srin po'i phyogs/ /ḍom+bi rlung gi grwa ru'o/ /go rī g.yas na gri gug ste/ /g.yon pa na ni de bzhin nya/ /tso rī g.yas na rnge'u chung ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na phag pa'o/ / be+e tā ①lī g.yas rus sbal te/ /g.yon na pad+ma bharnya'o/ /ghasma rī ni g.yas na sbrul/ /g.yon pa na ni rnal 'byor snod/ /puk+ka sī g.yas seng ge ste/ /g.yon na de bzhin dgra sta'o/ /sa ba rī g.yas dge slong ste/ /g.yon na de bzhin bsreg shang ngo //tsaṇ+ḍa lī g.yas 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pa na ni de bzhin gshol/ /ḍom+bi g.yas na rdo rje ste/ /g.yon na de bzhin sdigs 'dzub bo/ /go rī la sogs phyag gnyis gsungs/ /skyil krung phyed ma gar gyi stabs/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du bsdes—/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /go rī sku mdog nag por 'gyur//tso rī btsod dang 'dra ba ste/ / be tā sdelī ni gser btso ma/ /ghasma markata lta bu ste/ /puk+ka in+d+ra bhā la 'dra/ /zla 'od lta bu'i sa ba rī/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lbo ni nam mkha'i mdog /ḍom+bi sna tshogs dag tu bshad/ /tshangs dang dbang po nye dbang po/ /drag po gshin rje gnod sbyin dang / /bden bral na ni thags bzangs ris/ /go rī la sogs lha mo yi/ /rim bzhin gdan du shes par bya/ /de rnams sa bon 'di yin no/ /gi rtsa baṃ r+ghaṃ paṃ saṃ lo ḍi/ /bdag pos sa bon 'di dag las/ /de rnams gdon pa nyid du bya/ /de nas rang gi rig ma dang / /rdo rje 'dzin ma 'dod chags ches/ /'od du zhu bar gyur pa las/ /mtshams kyi lha mo bshes gnyen mos/ /sna tshogs glu yis mchod de bskul/ /kye yi rdo rje thugs rjes gzigs te puk+ka bdag la skyobs/ /bde ba chen po ①sbyar ba bdag 'dod stong pa'i rang bzhin bsal te bzhengs su gsol/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin 5—1501

bsal nas sa yi dngos grub dgos don du/ /gal te gson par mchis bzhed kye yi rdo rje bzhengs su gsol/ /tsaṇ+ḍa bdag gis byed med phyogs ma mthong nas gsol 'debs na/ /lha la sogs pa'i 'jig rten bsgral bar ①dam bcas ci sbad bzhugs/ /bdag ni ḍom+bi'i mtshan ma med pa byed kyi sems ni shes pa ste/ /thugs rje med pa de mi rung bas rdzu 'phrul lta bur bzhengs su gsol/ /de dag gsan nas sngon bzhin du/ /t+pahūṃ dag las rdo rje 'dzin/ /chen po 'od du zhu las bzhengs/ /de nas zhe sdang bdag nyid kyi/ /rang snying sa bon las byung ba'i—/ /'bar ba nag po lcags kyu yis/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /spyan drangs ma mo brgyad rnams kyis/ /sngon bzhin mchod de gsol ba gdab/ /bdag nyid chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /bcom ldan rnams kyis dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la dbang bskur rab tu byed/ /oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu rmā sarba badz+ra ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha ①na/ de skad gsol ba btab pa yis/ /bde gshegs de dag thams cad kun/ /ho ru ka yi skur gyur te/ /bde gshegs lnga yi bdag nyid kyi/ /bdud rtsi bum pas dbang bskur te/ /de tshe me tog gur gum char/ /'bab dang rnga yi sgra grag cing / /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma sogs dang / /spyan sogs rdo rje dbyangs rnams kyis/ /dbang bskur rab tu byas pa yis/ /thugs kyi dbang phyug sogs sangs rgyas/ /dbu rgyan du ni gyur par bya/ /mi bskyod rtag dang rin chen dbang / /mtha' yas de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /puk+ka sī sogs mtshams gnas pa/ /rim pa bzhin du rgya yis gdab/ /zhe sdang gti mug ser sna dang / /'dod chags rdo rje ma yis ni/ /sgo gnas kai ri la sogs 5—1502

pa—/ /rim bzhin du ni gdab par bya/ /rgya yis gdab cing mtshan pas na/ /des 'dir rgyas zhes bya ba yin/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gzhug byas te/ /bdud rtsi myang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /de dag tshim pa nyid du bya/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla gam gru gsum kha dog gnyis/ /yi ge yo dang re gyis mtshan/ /ba dan dang ni rdo rjes mdzes/ /de steng bharnya ①a las byung / /der ni ye shes bdud rtsis bkang / /yi ge hūṃ las rab bskyed pa'i/ /rdo rje las byung oṃ gyis mtshan/ /de nyid gsum byis byen brlabs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi lha yi sbyor bas bsang ②/ /mchod dang bstod pa nyid du bya/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin shes par bya/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam shes phung por ni/ /rdo rje ma dang go rī dang / /chu yi lha mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar dag go/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi/ /puk+ka sī la sogs pa'i dngos/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /go rī tso rī be tā ①lī/ /ghasma sa spyod mkha' spyod do/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /lus dang yid kyi dbang po ni/ /gti mug zhe sdang ser sna dang / /'dod chags phrag dog rdo rje dang / /bdag med rnal 'byor mar shes bya/ /'khor lo snyan cha mgur chu dang / /phyag gdub ska rags phyag rgya lnga//mi bskyod mtha' yas rin chen dbang / /snang mdzad don grub bdag nyid do/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab ste/ /phyag bzhi bdud bzhi rnam par dag /phyag drug pha rol phyin drug go/ /bcu drug phyag tu gsungs pa ni/ /stong pa bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /zhal gcig stong pa nyid kyi sgo/ /zhal gsum rnam par thar pa gsum/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /zhabs bzhi 5—1503

bdud bzhi dag pa nyid/ /spyan ni dag pa'i rdo rje gsum/ /dbang po drug dang phung po lnga/ /skye mched drug dang 'byung ba rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam dag pas/ /sna tshogs dag cing rnam par grol/ /gzugs yul la sogs gang gi yang / /rnal 'byor pa yis mig yor tshul/ /thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs so/ /rnam par dag pa byas nas ni//rnal 'byor sdom pa'i bdag nyid dang / /phyi nang bzlas pa brtsam par bya /de la 'di ni sdom pa ste/ /e ①waṃ ma yā'i bdag nyid kyisasde/ /'khor lo bzhi ni lus la gnas/ /'di ltar sprul pa'i chos dang ni/ /longs spyod bde chen 'khor lo rnams/ /lte ba snying ga mgul pa dang / /spyi bor rim bzhin shes par bya/ /'khor lo rnams kyi pad+ma ni/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi de bzhin brgyad/ /bcu drug sum cu gnyis su shes/ /sa bon oṃ ①dang hūṃ dang ni/ /oṃ dang haṃ ste rim bzhin no/ /ā li kā li sprul pa la/ /yongs su bskor bar shes par bya/ /bde gshegs yab yum sa bon gyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo de bzhin bskor/ /yi ge i e 'dren bcas pas/ /longs spyod 'khor lo bskor ba yin/ /sprul pa'i sku dang chos kyi sku/ /de bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /sku gsum yongs su shes pa rnams/ /'khor lo bzhi ru 'dod pa yin/ /'khor lo 'di rnams rang bzhin ni/ /lha mo bzhi dang phyag rgya bzhi/ /yi ge 'bru bzhir 'dod pa ste//sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma tī/ /dkar mo sgrol ma de bzhin du/ /las dang chos dang dam tshig dang / /phyag rgya chen por brjod pa'o/ /yi ge e dang waṃ dag dang / /ma dang yā yang 'di yi dngos/ /de bzhin sku gsung thugs rnams dang / /ā li kā li'ang 'di nyid yin/ /ye shes skad cig bzhir 5—1504

grags pa/ /sna tshogs dang ni rnam smin dang / /rnam par 'joms dang mtshan nyid bral/ /'khyud dang stsong dang spyod pa dang / /ci yang ma yin pa yi sems//'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa yin/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam/ /phung po nyon mongs bzhi 'byin pa/ /bden pa bzhi yang 'di nyid do/ /bdag dang sngags dang lha dang ni/ /ye shes rnams kyi de nyid rnams/ /rang rang yang dag gang yin pa'am/ /'khor lo bzhi yi ngo bo'o/ /dga' dang dam pa'i dga' ba dang / /bral dang rang bzhin dga' ba rnams/ /bde ba'i ye shes cha bzhi ste/ /drod thob pa dang 'phel ba dang / /chags bral bde dang mi gnyis bde/ /de yang 'khor lo bzhi la gnas/ /gnas brtan thams cad yod par smra/ /de bzhin mang pos bkur ba dang / /dge 'dun phal chen sde zhes pa/ /sde pa bzhi yang de nyid yin/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags sdom pa dang / /ye shes sdom pa'ang bstan par bya/ /sme sha lte bar 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs lnga bsregs pa dang / /spyan la sogs pa bsregs pa dang / /haṃ bsregs zla ba 'bab pa'o/ /de ni 'di ltar shes bya ste/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags sdom pa yis/ /bsreg pa'i mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /bsreg pa me dang rlung yin te/ /ye shes me yi snang ba gang / /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yin/ /las kyang bcom ldan shes rab ma'i/ /rlung gi de nyid 'di yin te/ /lte ba'i dbus las 'phro zhing phra/ /chos dang longs spyod bde chen bzhi/ /brtan dang g.yo ba kun gyi bdag /yi ge saṃ gi bdag nyid ni/ /las kyi rlung gi gzhi yin te/ /'di las kun du 'byung ba yin/ /'di dag rgyu ba'i rim pa ni—/ /nyi ma gcig la thun bzhi ste/ /de bzhin chu tshod sum cu gnyis/ /5—1505

rim pa bcu drug de bzhin du/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cha dang ldan/ /zla ba nyi ma zhes bya ba'i/ /ā li kā li'i ngo bo ni/ /sna bug g.yas dang g.yon du rgyu/ /de yang sa dang chu dang ni/ /me dang rlung gi bdag nyid can/ /'byung ba bzhi yi ngo bor 'dod/ /'di rnams dus su rgyu ba ste/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin dus ma yin/ /phyi zhing mkhrang ba sa yi khams/ /thur du rgyu ba dang por 'dod//grang zhing rtsub pa chu yi khams/ /mdun du rgyu ba gnyis pa yin/ /dro zhing 'jam pa me yi khams/ /'di ni phyir la nye bar rgyu/ /yang zhing stobs can rlung gi khams/ /gyen du rgyu bar shes par bya/ /de bzhin chu tshod rim pa dang / /thun zhes bya bar grags pa yang / /'dir ni 'di nyid gzung bya ste/ /g.yas su ji bzhin g.yon de bzhin/ /de nas kyang ni g.yas yin te/ /bar chad yod pa ma yin no/ /dus min rgyu ba gang zhe na/ /gang zhig 'chi ba'i dus nyid dang / /byang chub sems rgyun 'bab pa dang / /nad chen 'byung ba'i snga ltas la—/ /de dag dus gcig 'byung ba ste/ /'di ni nam mkha'i khams su brjod//rlung dang ye shes rnam shes dang / /dug rnams lhan cig rgyu ba ste/ /nams kyang 'bral ba ma yin no/ /reg pa'i rlung zhes bya ba ni/ /lus las nam yang mi 'da' ste/ /gal te 'das na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi de nyid shes pa yis—/ /me yi de nyid bskul bar bya/ /dbugs dang drod kyi khams dag kyang / /tha dad 'jug pa ma yin no/ /de la me yi de nyid ni/ /dbang po gtsubs pa'i sbyor ba las/ /ye shes me ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /ji ltar phyi rol me bzhin no/ /de yang dbang po'i lam nas ni/ /lte ba'i rtsa ru rab tu 'bar/ /'od chen du bar ①bcas pa yis/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni 'bar bar 'gyur/ /ye shes me yi snang ba de/ /5—1506

shin tu 'bar bar gyur pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lor la gnas pa'i/ /bde gshegs lnga dang de bzhin du/ /lha mor bcas pa tshig par 'gyur/ /longs spyod 'khor lo byung nas ni/ /g.yas nas bskor ba lan gsum byas/ /smin phrag mdzod spur byung nas kyang / /de nas rna ba g.yas su byung / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bskul byas nas/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu zhugs par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo la babs te/ /shin tu tshig par gyur pa 'di/ /sngags kyi sdom par 'dod pa yin/ /ye shes sdom pa'i bye brag ni/ /snying gar sangs rgyas bka' bgros nas/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi bsdus byas te/ /sngon gyi lam nas byung nas kyang / /phyogs bcu bdud rtsi bsdu byas te/ /sngon bzhin haṃ la zhugs gyur pas/ /sems kyi zla ba zhu nas ni/ /so yi sbu gu nas byung nas/ /longs spyod 'khor lor babs par gyur/ /der ni cung zad ngal so nas/ /sngon bzhin phyir yang bskor nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lor babs par gyur/ /bde bar gshegs rnams gang bar byas/ /sngon bzhin phyir yang bskor nas ni/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor babs par gyur/ /de bzhin kun du 'gro bar byed/ /skra yi rtse mo 'bum gyi cha/ /ye shes snang ba'i bye brag dag /mig gis mthong ba ma yin no/ /'di ni sdom par brjod pa'o/ /nang gi bzlas pa bstan pa ni/ /'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /gru gsum gnas ni de bzhin me/ /lto ba chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ /de steng dbang chen ri rab bcas/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /rtag pa'i 'khor lo bsgom bya ste/ /de la mi gnyis bdag nyid kyi/ /yi ge a yi sdom pa gzung / /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin 'di/ /lus dang ngag yid gang yang min/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug min/ /kha 5—1507

dog dbyibs sogs ma yin zhing / /khro zhi la sogs rnam par spangs/ /mtshan ma kun dang bral ba yi/ /dbu ma chen po bsgom par bya/ /gzhan ni sdom pa ji lta ba'o/ /'di ni ci yang ma yin phyir/ /ma ning bzlas pa zhes 'dod de/ /bzlas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /gal te skyo bar gyur na ni/ /phyi rol bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer byis①/ /ye shes sems dpa'i gnas nyid dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas rnams nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa spro bar bya/ /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ te badz+ra gyi snying po'o—/ /oṃ tre lokyā k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ②phaṭa swā hā/ phyag gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ①phaṭa swā hā/ phyag bzhi pa'i 'o/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag drug pa'i 'o/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa na nā ye/ dzi gor+bha ke sha brta ma ṣ+pe/tsa tubo sha ti ṣ+pe rjotā ya ṣe ḍa sha bhu dzā ya kṛṣ+ṭa dz+re mū ta wa pu ṣe ka pā lā mā la a ṣ+pe ka dha ri ṇi ān+d+ra ta spyu ra tsit+tha ya/ arten du rdaspri ṇi mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ brnya brnya/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kā na/ greṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ sha hūṃ ha hā hi tī hu snu he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ phyag bcu drug pa'i 'o/ /bzlas pas skyo bar gyur pa na—/ /rdo rje dril bu gsel byas te/ /mchod dang bstod dang smon lam dag /legs par btab ste phyag rgya dgrol/ /dbyings su bsdu dang gshegs gsol ba/ /ji lta ji bzhin bya ba yin/ /de nas rnal 'byor chen po yis/ /spyod lam kun du lha nyid kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin las nyams mi bya/ /'di ltar nyal ba'i tshe na yang / /rdo rje 'dzin chen ting 'dzin gyis/ /chags chen rjes su chags byas te//ye shes me yis lus zhu nas/ /chos sku sems su gyur par nyal/ /gang tshe ldang 5—1508

ba'i tshe na yang / /tshad med bzhi yis bskul ba yis/ /sngon byi smon lam rjes dran nas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /ting 'dzin rim par ldang bar bya/ /gang zhig za ba'i tshe na yang / /sdom pa'i dngos po ji lta ba'i/ /lus ni lha yi dkyil 'khor te/ /zas ni bdud rtsir byin brlab bya/ /zos pas dbyer med tshim par bya/ /yang na sbyin sreg mchod pa bya/ /ra sa ya na ①me yi khams/ /g.yas su 'bar zhing 'phro ba ste/ /ā li'i ngo bor shes par bya/ /la la nā ni rlung gi khams/ /g.yon du gtsubs shing g.yo ba ste/ /kā li'i ngo bor shes par bya/ /de dbus lus kyi bdag nyid la/ /bza' sogs 'o ma'i sbyin sreg bya//gal te 'gro 'chag byed pa na/ /rigs lnga rnams la babe+eng ba dang / /phyag rgya la sogs rgyan rnams dang / /rdo rje thos ②pa'i spyod pa dag /ji skad gsungs pa de bzhin bya/ /'dis ni byang chub rnyed mi dka'/ /gal te gtor ma gtong 'dod na/ /he ru ka yi sbyor ba yis/ /'byung po la ni mngon dmigs te—/ /zas rnams bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ /sngags 'di yis ni tshim par bya/ /oṃ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+ṣa①/ bhū ta/ bsna/ ba u/rak+ṣadu—/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ pabe+e/ pā tā ye/ aṣ+ṭha dusathra swā hā/e do/ ba lo/ hūṃ dza/ dzi gha/ phube+e/ dhūbe+e/ rmā rjos/ dzi gha/adza⑦rka/ kadz+dza/ sā dha/ khārnyi/ khu ṇi/ phe ṭa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro myu khaṃ sarba dharmā shā⑧/ ār+ya nut+pan+da ṭ+wāta/ oṃ phahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gang zhig rtag tu 'du byed pa/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub pa dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams dga' nas ni/ /de la dngos grub myur bar 'gyur/ /las rnams dag gi mjug tu yang / /mchod dang bstod cing smon lam gdab/ /de la smon 5—1509

lam 'di yin te/ /rigs ldan skye zhing blo gros rjes su ldan/ /dam tshig ldan zhing kye yi rdo rje ston/ /snying rje ldan zhing bla ma rnams la gus/ /skye ba kun du 'di ltar skye gyur cig /rdo rje dril bu lag gis 'khrol byed cing / /zab mo'i dam chos rab tu klog pa dang / /dam tshig btsun mo'i khu ba za byed par/ /skye ba kun du 'di ltar skye gyur cig /de nas sprul pa rang la bsdu/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor slar gshegs gsol/ /spyod lam la sogs sngon bzhin du'o/ /slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ he badz+ra'i sgrub thabs he ru ka mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po mdzi shrī dzñā na dang / rong zom dharma bha dras bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1496 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+ku'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ba/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skosgom/1497 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṭhat+na/ khru〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉lke/1498 ①〈〈co 〉steng / ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)/1499 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉sko)/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉〉byul/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉ka ta/ 〈〈snar 〉snga ta/rjo〈'dir 〉zabs/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉rab/15 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra ṭ+wā/ khru〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉shes/15 1 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṭhartswa/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅rtswa/ ①〈rtepe 〉sko'ar 〉skodang /15 2 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgrub par/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉tispyo/15 3 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉tharnya/ khru〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thazang / sne〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅sgyu/5—1510

15 4 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stago ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ste)/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/1506 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/1508 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skom ②③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spyo lhu lhu/ du〈〈co〉〉dro/1509 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ton ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉mdzak+ṣa/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ringak+ṣa/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉spo/ aṣ+ṭha/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉snga/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snamalha/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dha tsā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (123) 5wa 1511

༄ga /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi man ngag①sngag /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra nā ma sā dha no pi ka /bod skad du—/ dpal kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi man ngag /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab thabs dag bdag nyid can/ /kye rdor bdag med ma la yang / /bla mar bcas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rim pa gsum pa'i sgrub thabs brtsam/ /mi nyid rnyed dka' de bas kyang / /bla ma dga' bsten ①rnyed par dka'/ /bdag gzhan don 'byung sngags kyi tshul/ /'gro phan lam la brten par kyis/ /yon tan ldan zhing brtson par ldan/ /bla mar gus shing dad ldan pa/ /rgyal ba'i chos la the tshom med/ /dbang dang dbye ba nges tshig las/ /snod yin phyir na drin sbyin bya/ /chu sogs bum pa'i dbang bskur dang / /rim bzhin gsang ba'i dbang bskur dang / /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur la/ /de srid bla ma'i man ngag mtha'/ /yid du 'ong 5—1512

ba'i sa phyogs su/ /ri dang nags tshal dang ni phug /chu 'gram bzhi mdo mtsho dang ni/ /shing gcig dben pa dur khrod rnams/ /bsam gtan khang pa byas nas ni/ /bdud rtsi sogs kyis byug par bya/ /bris sku sogs mchod dgram byas la/ /nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid/ /phyi rol khrus sogs kun byas la/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug ste/ /sbyong byed dag pa la sogs kyis/ /'dod pa'i lha ni bsgrub par bya/ /bla ma rdo rje can bsams nas/ /sems kyi rin chen las byung ba'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin ni spros byas la/ /de nas rim bzhin dbul bar bya/ /de nas lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ /go rī byang chub sems kyis mchod/ /tso rī rang byung me tog gis/ /mi bskyod 'dzin pa be+e tā ①līrka/ /snang mdzad kyis mchod ghasma rī/ /puk+ka sī yis lcags kyus mchod/ /sā ba rī ni ro 'dzin te/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni nge chung 'dzin/ /ḍom+bis gnyis med sbyor ba byed/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi—/ /kye rdor shes rab bdag nyid can/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi//sdig pa bdag gis gang byas pa/ /bdag gzhan don du ma lus par/ /so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi bgyid pa yi sdom pa nod/ /bde gshegs kun kyi bsod nams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ /yang dag nyid du yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bdag gis de la bskul ba ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob bar du/ /rgyal ba de nyid bzhugs nas ni/ /nam yang mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol bar 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying 5—1513

rje dbyer med la/ /byang chub lam ni ston pa po/ /bsod nams kun gyi 'byung gnas che/ /byang chub rnams kyang de bzhin bskyed/ /lus ngag yid kyi bsod nams ni/ /bgyis sam babyid du stsal ba dang / /rjes su yi rang ci'ang rung / /des na 'jig rten kun mkhyen shog /snying rje rlan gyis nyu brlan sems kyis/ /tshangs pa yi ni gnas bzhi ni/ /dang po byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis par snying rje rnam par bsgom/ /gsum par dga' ba bsgom par bya/ /kun gyi mtha' nas btang snyoms so/ /dngos rnams bdag la bsdu bar bya/ /bdag kyang ye shes sems dpa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' nā da'i bar—/ /de nyid smig rgyu sgyu mar mtshungs/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na ②swa bhā ba āt+pa kolhahaṃ—/ oṃ ā ni mi ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi nyi ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ de nas skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin las/ /skye ba nyid du mos par bya'o/ /ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje sa bon dang ldan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bdud rnams btul nas/ dra ba dang ra ba dang sa gzhir gyur par bsam par bya'o—/ /de'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa dkar po bsams la/de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ khaṃ ①las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa ljang gu/ der baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ de las ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ der yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs 'dra ba nag po/ de la thig le dang ldan par bsams nas/ de rnams gcig tu gyur pas/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi dang / ka ba brgyad dang / dra ba dang dra ba 5—1514

phyed pa dang / rin po che dang 'dod pa'i yon tan la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor der srog song ba dang bcas pas sems las grub par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i lte bar ā li las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ der kā li las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes—/ de'i dbus su hūṃ dang e las rdo rje dang / gri gug sa bon kyis mtshan pa so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes/ thams cad gcig tu gyur pa bya ba nan tan grub pa'i ye shes/ sku rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig ①phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa bsnams pas shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa spyan gsum pa dbu la thod pa lngas brgyan cing / sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa/ thod pa zlon pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhis do shal byas pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /bdag med ma ni gri gug dang thod pa bsnams shing sku la 'khyud pa/ skyes pa'i thod pas do shal byas shing g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs par bsam par bya ste/ gzhan ni thabs dang 'dra/ nang du yang de bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /mig la gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba la zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna la ser sna rdo rje/ lce la 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje/ yid la bdag med ma bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can spros te/ rang bzhin rmi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod nas/dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bcug ste gnyis su med par bsam par bya'o/ /yang khrod zer des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad te ru ka'i gzugs kyis spyan 5—1515

drangs nas/ de la mchod pa la sogs pa bya ste/ bdag la byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur nas①/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam par bya ste/ ji srid du mi skyo'i bar du rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /skyo na bzlas pa bya ste/ rig ma'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su gri gug sa bon dang bcas par bsams la/ de la sngags kyi phreng ba kun da 'dra ba 'od zer dang ldan pa byung nas rang gi zhal du zhugs te/ gsang ba'i rdo rjer byung nas/ lha mo'i pad+mar babs te/ lha mo'i zhal nas rang gi zhal du zhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du yang nas yang du bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā—/ yang na bla ma'i man ngag gis gsang ba'i rdo rje dang pad+mar bzlas pa bya'o//brtag pa bcu drug pa las/ ma phug pas no sbyor bral 'gyur/ /phug pas dga' ba sbyin pa'o/ /de ltar 'khor bar 'dod pa yi/ /yon tan lnga ldan rin chen nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas yang rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bshad par bya ste/ lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa dkar po'i dbus su rang rig pa'i bdag nyid rin po che'i za ma tog gi nang na gnas par bsam mo/ /snying ga'i chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa thig le dang ldan pa/mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa dkar po/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'o/ /mgo bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa dkar po de'i dbus su lhag pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'od dang ldan par bsam par byas nas/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo las 'od zer 'phros nas chos kyi 'khor lo dang longs spyod kyi 'khor lo nas yar song ste/ bde ba chen po la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ mdzod spu nas phyung ste/ sems can thams cad 5—1516

sbyangs nas bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kar zhugs te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi drangs nas/ tshangs pa'i sgor zhugs te gzung 'dzin dang bral nas/ za ma tog tu babs par bsam pa ①ste/ de la rtse gcig tu bya'o/ /mi gsal na yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /yang na bdag med ma rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rang yang hūṃ la bsdu/ de yang thig le 'od dang ldan par bsam par bya ste/ gsang sngags dam pa thig le'i gzugs su ni/ /rang yid 'od dang ldan par yongs su bsgom—/ /dngos kun bdag nyid rang gi sems ngo bo/ ldang ba na yang bdag dang gzhan 'khor lo'am/ tsaṇ+ḍa līr mos par bya ste/ mchod pa la sogs pa yang mi bya'o/ /de yang phyag rgya bcing ba rnam par spangs/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya zhing / /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi 'tshal/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya'o/ /zhes gur las gsungs so/ /mchod rten brtsig par mi bya ste/ /de bzhin mchod sogs mi bya'o/ /gtsug lag dag ni rnyed sla ste/ /de yi dgos pa rnyed par dka'/ /zhes gdan bzhi pa las gsungs so/ /de nas yang lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor bshad par bya'o / /gang tshe ye shes rlung gis ni/ /rang rig dag ni bskyod nas su/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsregs pa yis/ /dga' ba la sogs rim bzhin skye/ /ci 'dra ba ni skye zhe na/ /gzhon nu'i dga' ba ji lta ba/ /lkugs pa'i dga' ba ji lta ba'o/ /gnyis med ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /thog ma tha ma dbus med cing / /'khor min mya ngan 'das pa min/ /bdag nyid gzhan nyid yod ma yin—/ /'di ni mchog tu bde ba yin/ /bdag med ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan nges par rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam skyon bral lhan cig skyes/ /5—1517

thams cad lus la rang bzhin gnas/ /dga' ba dang po 'khor ba'i gzugs/ /de bzhin mchog dga' 'khor ba nyid/ /dga' bral dga' ba 'khor bdag nyid/ /gsum la lhan cig skyes pa med/ /dga' ba dang ni mchog dga' nyid/ /dga' bral dga' ba la sogs pa/ /gsum pa spangs par gyur na ni/ /bzhi pa gang las skye bar 'gyur/ /de bas gsum po thabs byas te/ /bzhi pa bsgom par bya ba yin/ /rtsa ba'i rgyu ni gsum du gyis/ /de yi 'bras bu bzhi pa yin/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum gyis spangs/ /yang na rang gis gsum pa yin/ /dga' ba'i bye brag tu shes bya/ /'khor lo rnams kyi rim pa'o/ /zhes rgyud phyi ma las gsungs so/ /dang po bum pa'i dbang yin te/ /mchog gi dga' ba gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang / /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po yin/ /mnyam par ma bzhag dus su yang / /bya ba gang la 'jug pa na//lhan cig skyes las ma gtogs par/ /gzhan gyi sems kyis mi gnas so/ /de yang brtag pa bcu drug pa las/ /bde ba gnag cing bde ba ser/ /bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar/ /bde ba ljang gu bde ba sngo/ /bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu kun—/ /bde ba thabs dang shes rab ste/ /de bzhin mnyam par gzhag pa ste/ /bde ba dngos po dngos med bde/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas bskyed ①pa'i rim pa la gnas pas/ bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma ni/srung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs par byas nas/ de'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas bsams la/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bsams la/ de'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo sa bon dang ldan pa 5—1518

las ①'od zer 'phros pas/ gzugs med pa dang / gzugs can dang /'dod pa'i lha la sogs pa thams cad 'od zer des sku rdo rjer byas nas/ der bsdus te gcig tu gyur pa las/ sku rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bus shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /shes rab ma yang thabs dang 'dra / bar du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las phyogs skyong thams cad der bsdus nas gcig tu gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje sngon por bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu a las pad+ma des lha ma yin la sogs pa thams cad gsung ②rdo rje sku mdog dmar por bsam par bya'o/ /gzhan sku rdo rje dang 'dra'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la mchod pa la sogs pa byas te gcig tu gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa spyan drangs nas—/ byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur nas/ sku rdo rje la rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ thugs rdo rje la mi bskyod pas/ gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor—/ der a las thod pa de'i nang du/ hūṃ dze+e dzī ①khaṃ hūṃ/ de nas bdud rtsir bsams la/ de nyid kyis mtshan par bsam par bya ste/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje sa bon gyis mtshan par bsams la/ de'i stobs kyis bskol la/ de'i steng du i rjodes ye shes kyi bdud rtsi drangs la/ gcig tu gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /de kho na'i snying po gsum gyis ⑤byin gyis brlab pa byas nas/ 'dis dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ kā 5—1519
