zhal nas de skad gsungs/ /mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /sangs rgyas pa ni de gzung ngo / /nges pa pa dang rjes su dpag /bden pa de las rnyed pa'o / /stong pa nyid ni rnyed pa gang / /de las rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /dngos po yin na nges yod de/ /dngos po las ni rnyed pa yod/ /dngos por mthong ba'i phyir na ni/ /de la stong par ji skad smra/ /stong pa'i ming ni ci yang min / /de skad yin na de la smra/ /stong pa cang min de ltar min/ /thams cad stong pa yin pa po/ /dngos po nyid ni stong pa yin/ /dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rang bzhin gang la yod pa ni/ /de ni mtshan ma yin par bshad//dngos po gcig pu'i ngo bo ste/ /de spangs pa ni stong par bstan/ /ngo bo nyid bral stong pa ste/ /ye shes zhabs kyi rim par 7 yod/ /dngos bo med pa'i dngos po ni/ /thams cad kun la yod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gsungs / /dpal ldan ye shes rgya mtshor gnas/ /ji ltar gla rtsi'i dngos po ni / /gnyis su dgyes snapa yod pa ste/ /sra ba'i dngos po de dang gcig /dri yi dngos bo de dang gnyis/ /sra ba'i dngos po spangs pa gang / /de ni dngos po min par gsungs/ /sra ba'i dngos po med pa la/ /de las dri ni mi rnyed na/ /ci ste de las dri mi rnyed/ /rang gi dpe la bltas pa yis/ /ji ltar dri med phra ba'i ras/ /bdug byas de la bag chags yod/ /gla rtsi gzhan ma'i gnas su gzhag4 /de la dri yod yin nam min/ /de skad dngos po med pa la/ /dngos po thams cad yod pa'o/ /de bzhin rgyu mtshan med pa la/ /bden pa'i 'bras bu yod pa'o/ /ji ltar chu sbyin bu ga las/ /rdo rje me ni gsal bar skyes/ /de bzhin gzugs min la gzugs yod/ /de bzhin dngos min 5—/770

dngos po yi/ /'khrul pa'i dngos po'i gzugs yin na/ /de la nyes skyon ci yang med/ /'khrul pa la yang yon tan yod/ /'khrul gzhan de yis med par byed—/ /sngags dang sgom pa byed pa pos/ /dug la dug med mtshan ma na/ /dug gi 'khrul pa med pa 'di/ /dug med 'khrul pa bstan ①pas so/ /bla ma yi ni bla ma yis/ /de ni bsgom pa'i rim las gsungs/ /rtog pa'i sems ni 'byung ba gang / /rtog pa yis ni dag par byed/ /de bzhin kye yi rdo rje'i rgyud//rdo rje snying po las 'di gsungs/ /gang 'di dug gi dum bu yis/ /sems can thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug de yi ni de nyid kyi/ /dug gis dug ni med par byed/ /ji ltar me yis tshig pa la/ /me yis yang dang yang bsro ②bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes bsregs la/ /'dod chags me yis yang bsreg ④bya/ /ji ltar rna bar chu song la/ /phyi ma'i chu yis gdab par bya/ /de bzhin chos can rtog pa ni/ /dngos po yis ni dag par byed/ /dngos po bag chags bzung ④bas ni/ /chos can bag chags med par byed/ /goms pa yis ni kun med de//phyi nas de yang med pa'o/ /de nas dri med ye shes ni/ /'bad mi dgos par gsal ba'o/ /rang las skyu ru ra ltar mthong / /dpal ldan ye shes rgyud las gsungasaske/ /ji ltar 'di yi dpe yis ni/ /shing gi yal ga'i zla ba ltar/ /mdzub mo gang gis mchod byed pa/ /de las de ni skye 'gyur ram/ /mdzub mo la sogs bya ba tsam/ /de yis de ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar mun pa'i mu tig gcig /mar me med na mthong mi 'gyur/ /mar mes de ni mthong ba las/ /mar me las ni me skye'o/ /mar me yis ni blta ba las/ /mar me de la sgom mi byed / /de yi de ni rigs pas rdzogs/ /rnyed 'gyur de la sgom mi byed/ /5—1771

de nas thar 'dod pa la 'di/ /lam rab shin tu gsal bar bya/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gsang ngos sam/ /yang na dur khrod mchog dang ni/ /yang na dgyes pa'i ri phug dang / /thams cad bdag nyid dgon chen por/ /yang dag rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /mgon po te ru ka mnyes bya/ /langs nas dang po rnal 'byor pas/ /snying rje'i rlan gyis brlan sems kyis/ /tshangs pa yi ni gnas bzhi ni/ /dga' ba yod pa bsgom par bya/ /de nas rang snying ga pad la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de dbus sems kyi sa bon ni/ /sna tshogs 'od dang ldan pa bsgom/ /de yi 'od rnams snang ba las/ /bla ma dang ni sangs rgyas dang / /rang lha nam mkha' khyab mthong ba/ /chu zla ①lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ /sna tshogs mchod pa dbul ba ni/ /byas nas skyabs su 'gro bar bya—/ /dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes dag /de yi bsod nams kyi ni tshogs/ /yang dag par ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ye shes tshogs ni 'phel don du/ /stong pa nyid ni bdag nyid yin/ /thams cad mi lam lta bur blta/ /skad cig ma yi sgyu 'phrul can/ /ji ltar chu zla lta bu dang //dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'o/ /gcig dang du mas rnam dpyad na/ /spyor ba med pas mtshan nyid med/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs med/ /da ltar yang na ②de bzhin no/ /'das pa de ni 'gags pa yin/ /ma 'ongs pa ni ma byung ste/ /da ltar mi gnas khab rtse la/ /nam yang gnas pa med pa'o/ /de lta bur ni thams cad bsam/ /de nas 'di ni dpyad par bya/ /stong pa las ni thams cad 'byung / /stong pa'i ngang du thams cad nub/ /dag pa'i ngo bo stong pa ste/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin du ni bstan/ /dag pa sku ru brjod pa ste/ /gsung ni stong 5—1772

pa'i ngo bo yin/ /rang bzhin thugs su bshad pa ste/ /de ni rnal 'byor pa yis bsam/ /sprin med nam mkha'i dngos po la/ /sems ni mi g.yo bar ni gzhag /de yis don byed yang dag pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya—/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shurnyaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa kolhahaṃ/ de yis ye shes kyi ni tshogs/ /sku gsung thugs ni rnam par dag /tshogs chen gnyis ni rdzogs pa yis/ /skad cig gcig gis byang chub thob/ /bsod nams de ni mchog yin te/ /de bzhin ye shes chad pa'o/ /de gnyis dbus su byang chub ni/ /rang bzhin ye shes mtshan nyid do/ /de nas paṃ byung pad+ma dang / /ram̐ las byung ba'i nyi dkyil du/ /hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rje ni/ /spro ba'i bdag nyid can gyis bsam/ /dang po'i sum+bha ni sum+bha①/ /greṇ+ḍa greṇ+ḍa de bzhin no/ /kṛsnra pa ya gnyis su bya/ /ā na ya ho de bzhin te/ /bha ga wān badz+ra bit+yā rā dza ste/ /'di yis phyogs ni bcing bar bya/ /oṃ dang hūṃ gnyis ming spel la/ /mthar yang hūṃ phaṭa sbyor bar bya/ /sum+bha'i sku bdag sngags pa yis/ /shar la sogs par sngags gdab bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi ni/ /hūṃ las 'phro bar bsam par bya/ /de yi 'od zer gsal ba yis/ /rtsig pa dang ni bla bye'o/ /steng gi mda' yi dra ba ni/ /rdo rje me lce 'bar ba'o/ /dang po yi ni bzhi pa gnyis/ /ghā ⑤ta ya ni gnyis par bya/ /sarba duṣ+ṭi de nas gdab//tī la ya ni gnyis bya ste/ /sarba pā paṃ de nas ni/ /badz+ra tī la de nas dran/ /de nas badz+ra dha ra gdab/ /adzñā pa ya de bya'o/ /kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra ste/ /tī la ya ①ni de nas dran/ /badz+ra muṅga badz+ra dang / /tī la ku ha de nas so/ /oṃ yig dang ni hūṃ phaṭa mthar/ /dbus su hūṃ gis ldan par bya/ /mi shigs pa yi 5—1773

rdo rje'i gur/ /de yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i gur byi dbus su ni/ /chos dbyings phyag rgya bha ga dngos/ /de ni ①dbus su bsgom bya ste/ /rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /de yi steng du ye shes me/ /hūṃ gi ②dngos po'i bdag nyid bsam/ /rlung sogs yongs su gyur pa las/ /mchog gi gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /gru bzhi pa la sogs ldan ni/ /dpal ldan te ru ka yi gnas/ /gtum drag dur khrod la sogs ni/ /de yi phyi rol bskor ba'o/ /pa ta pu ta ri sogs kyi/ /shing rnams kyis ni rab tu brgyan/ /khwa gzugs la sogs dpa' bo ni/ /shing rnams la gnas byin gyis rlob/ /sna ①dang kha gnas la sogs ni//nang ni dur khrod phyi rol lo/ /gsang ba'i nang ngam yang na lus/ /dbugs byed phyi rol na dur khrod/ /mthus byed ma rnams kyi ni rtsi/ /pa ta la sogs shing yin no—/ /dur khrod nang du pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /lte ba'i nang gi phyag rgya ni/ /gru gsum bha ga'i gzugs can no/ /rdor mtsho ma dang legs dgyes rdor/ /de bzhin rdo rje glang chen ma/ /gru gsum la ni bsgom bya ste//nang du ma yin phyi rol min/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i steng / /snang ba dang ni snang ba mched/ /dbyangs yig dpe byad las byung ba/ /sems can zhu ba'i rang bzhin can/ /de yi hūṃ bye mthong ba ni/ /dpal rdor sems dpa'i bdag nyid do/ /'od kyi rigs dang ldan pa yi/ /rang bzhin gyis dag yongs su gyur/ /de nas smon lam gzhan don du/ /bya yi rnal 'byor rang don min/ /de ltar shes pas lha mo yi/ /bstod par shes las yang dag 'byung / /bde chen legs dgyes mgon po bzhengs/ /rdo rje legs dgyes bdag dga' mdzod//mgon po spyod min bdag ro 'dra/ /thugs rje ro yis bdag skye mdzod/ / kye 5—1774

ma mgon po stong pa'i mtshan/ /rdo rje mtsho ma bdag dga' mdzod①/ /pad+ma kha phyi rol cig snerol/ /mgon po stong pa'i rang bzhin min/ /a la la la a la la la/ /a la la la legs dgyes mgon/ /rdo rje glang chen ma dga' mdzod//spyod rang gis gsungs bdag min na/ /sangs rgyas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /glu 'di yis ni ngor mdzad nas/ /spro hūṃ snang las yang dag 'phros/ /de las rdo rje gri gug ni/ /yongs su gyur pas de nas nyid/ /dpal ldan he ru che mgon po/ /lha mos 'khyud par gyur pa'o/ /bung ba'i mdog la phyag bcu drug /zhal bcu drug la spyan gsum pa/ /sngo dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /zhal bzhi g.yon nas bskor ba'o/ /gzhan ni sku mdog de dang 'dra/ /steng gi zhal ni 'jigs par ldan/ /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan/ /zla phyed dbu rgyan gyis mtshan pa/ /thod rlon phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /nyi ma'i gdan la khro tshul ldan/ /phyag rgya drug gis yan lag brgyan/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs—/ /g.yas brkyang steng 'og zhabs mnga' ba/ /gar dgu dang ni ldan pa'oske/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /bdud bzhi yi ni steng na bzhugs—/ /gshin rje pags pa'i sham thabs la/ /thod pa'i dum bu'i ske rags bcings—/ /phyag ni 'khyud pa'i g.yas pa dang / /rdo rje dang ni dril bu g.yon/ /phyag gnyis brkyang bas tshangs pa'i pags①/ /gzhan gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o/ /'khor lo rin chen ral gri dang / /rtse gsum nyi ma g.yas na bsnams—/ /ḍa ma ru dang sta re zla/ /thod pa'i snod dang kha ṭī ga /ye shes mkha' 'gro dbang phyug gi/ /g.yon du de ni shes par bya/ /legs dgyes dbang mo de dang 'dra/ /yang na phyag ni bzhi dang ldan/ /zhal gcig pa la 5—1775

spyan gsum pa/ /gcer bu dang ni thugs rje che/ /skra ni grol zhing nu ma sra/ /sgeg pa la sogs rgyan dang ldan/ /sdigs mdzub yod ①pa'i gri gug ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'dzin pa mda'/ /kha ṭī ga dang kā pa la/ /khrag gis ②bkang ba g.yon na bsnams/ /'khyud pa'i sgeg pa'i spyor ba yis/ /gzhan ma rdo rje mda' gzhu'o/ /yan lag phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /thod dum ska rags dag gis brgyan/ /byen pa gnyis kyis ④legs 'khyud cing / /bde ba chen po'i gnas na bzhugs/ /gru gsum gnas kyi rnal 'byor ma/ /drug phyed bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhi/ /zhal dang rjes su mthun par bsam/ /ljang gu gcig gis spangs pa'o/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /phyag bzhi pa la 'jigs chen ma/ /phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan pa'o/ /dbu skra ral pa gcer bu dang / /thod pa'i do shal brgyan pa'o/ /ro steng gnas pa 'od 'bar ma/ /la la la sogs dag pa'o/ /rang byung ro dang ga bur dang / /de yis pad snod bkang ba'o/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag na thogs/ /kha ṭī ga ni g.yon na'o/ /bha ga'i phyag rgya'i dbu steng du/ /mdzub mo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i dkyil/ /bde chen dang ni me 'khor lo/ /gnas gcig par ni brda yis mtshon/ /bde ba chu skyes me 'khor lo/ /phyi rol ma yin nang du min/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rigs pas na/ /sprul pa dang ni bde chen po/ /gang na bcom ldan 'das ni bzhugs/ /de ni bde ba chen pos brjod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis ni/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /gang na bde ba bdag nyid bzhugs/ /de ni bde ba chen po'o/ /de yi shar phyogs o ḍān du/ /lha mo 'jigs ma de spyi bor/ /dzā larnya ra byang du steng / /dpa' bo ma ni spyi bo 5—1776

gtsug /nub tu pul+lī ra mā ste/ /chang 'thung ma ni mtshog mar ro/ /lho ru kā ma rū pa ste/ /'jigs byed ma ni smin phrag dbus/ /de ni gnas ni bzhi yin te—/ /nye ba'i gnas kyang de bzhin no/ /me yi phyogs su mā lā ba/ /pho nya ma ni sna rtser ro/ /bden bral phyogs su sen+tu ste/ /stobs ma mig gnyis la ni gnas—/ /rlung gi phyogs su nā gar te/ /rta mgrin ma ni sna ①gnyis su/ /dbang ldan phyogs su ṅgaṅga la/ /rta rna ma ni kha pad du/ /de ni bde chen 'khor lo ste/ /rdo rje gri gug gis ni bskor/ /gnyis pa longs spyod 'khor lo ste/ /dmar po pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor/ /de yi shar phyogs su ma ni/ /glang chen rna ba'i kosko'o/ /byang phyogs de shī ko ṭī ste/ /lto ba ma ni mgrin gling bur/ /nub phyogs pa ni ku lu tā/ /me mar ②rgyab kyi gling bu ro/ /lho phyogs a rbu dar ni ste/ /chu rgyun 'bebs ma 'o ma'i snod/ /de ni zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / /de bzhin tshajo nye tshab/ /me'i phyogs ha ri ka ④la ste/ /zla ba de ni snying gar ro//bden bral phyogs su gu ④ta par/ /nyi 'od ma ni lte bar ro/ /rlung gi phyogs su laspra kar/ /dung rna ma ni gsang bar ro/ /dbang ldan phyogs su kā— ka /dung gtsug ma ni rgyal mtshan dbus/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar dmar te/ /dung steng ma yi rgyal mtshan rtser/ /byang phyogs ji mi kar ste/ /stobs chen ma ni gzhang pad du/ /nub phyogs su ni kung rkan te/ /bya rgod ma ni brla gnyis dran—/ /lho phyogs su ni bin+d+ra ste/ /rgod kha ma ni pus gnyis su/ /me phyogs yi dwags 'dus pa ste/ /hor pa ma ni rje ngar du/ /bden bral phyogs su rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ /hor mig ma ni rkang bol dran/ /rlung phyogs tsa ri tra ni ste/ /'og 'gro ma ni mthe bor ro/ /dbang ldan ku ra ba ra ste/ /mig dmar ma ni 5—1777

sor mor ro/ /'dus pa dang ni nye ba'i 'dus/ /dur khrod de bzhin nye dur khrod//de ni chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ /nag po rdo rje phreng bas bskor/ /de yi shar phyogs kas ma ra/ /skra dmar ma ni lus thams cad/ /byang gi phyogs su ke'u rata ste//rin chen ma ni rkang mthil du/ /nub phyogs su ni ṣ+pe pa la/ /pu ron mo ni lhag par dran/ /lho phyogs kar na ku rtsa ste/ /dmar po mo ni rkang par ro/ /me yi phyogs su sa bla ste/ /nag mo chos 'khor lte bar ro/ /bden bral phyogs su sa stengs te/ /ri bong ma ni lte snying du/ /rlung gi phyogs su sa 'og ste/ /ri dwags ma ni sprul snying por①/ /dbang ldan phyogs su ri rab rtse④/ /ra ma mo ni gsang ①snang ngo / /bi la nye ba'i bi la bar/ /de bzhin sbyor dang nye ba'i sbyor—/ /de ni sprul pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /dkar po 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor//'khor lo bzhir gtogs rnal 'byor ma/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /sdigs mdzub ldan pa'i gri gug ni/ /thams cad kun rmis phyag g.yas bsnams/ /kha ṭī ga dang ka pā la/ /khrag gis bkang ba g.yon na'o/ /phyag gzhan dag ni gnyis gnyis kyis/ /mda' gzhu khengs par 'gengs pa'o/ /gru gsum gtogs pa gzhan ji ltar/ /gnas su gtogs pa de ltar ro/ /ji ltar 'khor lo rnams kyi mdog /rnal 'byor pa yang de ltar ro/ /rdo rje ro langs rdor 'dra ba/ /rdo rje rtse mo rdor zlum ma/ /gnag dang dmar dang ser dang dkar—/ /shar sgo la sogs gnas na bzhugs/ /chu srin nya dang seng ge dang / /'ga' ru ra ni g.yas na thogs/ /ka pā la dang kha ṭī ga /g.yon gyi phyogs su dran pa'o/ /gzhan gnyis rdo rje mda' gzhu ni/ /rna ltag tu ni 'gengs par dran//rdo rje ske rags de pag dubacing / /rdo rje ser po dang ni gnyis/ /rdo rje rgod ma 5—1778

gsum pa ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma bzhi pa'o/ /rnga dang de bzhin gling bu dang / /rgyud mangs dang ni rdza rnga dang / /rdza rnga chung ngu chal chung dang / /lta bu ra dang ka ran to—/ /de rnams phyag ni gnyis gnyis shes/ /mtshams kyi lha mo'i rim par ro /bcom ldan 'das ni mnyes byed gnas/ /gzugs gnyis pa la yid 'phrog ma①//brkyang la sogs pas de rnams ni/ /ji ltar 'jigs pa'i lha mo rnams/ /gnas la sogs pa sar shes bya/ /bdun gnyis kyi ni grangs yin no/ /sa rnams de yi dbang phyug mgon/ /'khor lo'i dngos por rtag tu bzhugs/ /g.yas dang g.yon gnyis bskor ba yi/ /lha mo rnams kyi mchod pa'i rim/ /de lta bu yi 'khor lo che/ /bdag nyid dang ni bcas par bsgom/ /yang na rgyud kyi man ngag bsgom/ /'di ni 'khor lo drug kyang yod/ /bde ba chen po la sogs lnga/ /me yi 'khor lo yod pas so/ /sgo dang mtshams ni mnyam ldan pa/ /de ni rlung 'khor drug pa'o/ /'khor lor gtogs pa'i lha mo kun/ /rtse re rnam par dag pa'o/ /bde chen rnam dag 'khor lo bzhi/ /gzhan ma gnyis ni rang rang ngo / /bde chen 'khor lo kun ka la/ /bskyed pa'i gnas su bstan pa'o/ /de bas bde chen 'khor lo ste/ /'khor lo rnam dag gzhung yin no/ /de nas phung po rnam dag 'di/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtse gcig gis/ /gzugs ni longs spyod rdor shes bya/ /tshor ba ye shes rdo rje ste/ /'du shes snang ba rdo rje dang / /'du byed 'od kyi rdo rje dang / /rnam shes phung po'i ngo bo ni/ /rdo rje sems dpar rtag tu bzhugs/ /mig gnyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rna ba sprin gye rdo rje ma/ /sna la srog gi rdo rje ma/ /kha la ro yi rdo rje ma/ /reg pa dga' ba'i rdo rje ma/ /yid ni ye shes dbang phyug ma/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba 5—1779

yis / /gnyis med pa yi dngos po'i gzugs/ /te ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du bzhugs/ /sa ni dga' ba'i rdo rje ma/ /chu yi khams ni stobs mar bshad/ /me ni 'byung ba rdo rje ma/ /rlung ni lcags sgog rdo rje ma/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pad+ma'i lte ba yin par bshad—/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi/ /dag pa yin par 'di bstan to//rigs chen bshad pa'i rgyud las ni/ /de lta bu yi dag par grags/ /rdor gsum yig gsum ye shes ni/ /dgong mi'i gnas su yi ge yis/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug par bya/ /dam tshig sems dpa' la ni bstem/ /de ni gnyi ga ro gcig bya/ /ji ltar chu la chu gzhag ①bzhin/ /mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud kyi dngos/ /dbus su mthe bos brtan ①par bya/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni rtse sbyar bsgreng / /cung zad tsam ni dgug pa'i dngos/ /srog rlung ji ltar de ltar bzung ①/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga'i steng du'o/ /rkang pa mnan cing gyen du bltaske/ /ha ha yi ni sgra sgogs shing / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus nas ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug par bya/ /phyag rgya de ni rgya chen te/ /ye shes thig le'i rgyud las gsal/ /shes pa tsam rmis ye shes chen/ /the tshom med par rnyed par 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba bī ra dang po ste/ /yo gi rī yang de bzhin no/ /kā ya bā ka ni tsit+ta dang / /badz+ra swa bhā wa de bzhin du/ /āt+pa kolhahaṃ de nas ni//ye shes sems dpa' rnam par dag /phyi rol sngags yig yod pa yi/ / cho ga du'adir ni ma bshad do/ /phung po lnga yi dag pa yis/ /de la go cha dgos ma yin//go cha byang chub sems yin te/ /de yi bsdam pa de ni rab/ /de yi thabs kyi tshig gcig ni/ /cung zad tsam ni bdag gis bshad/ /char yang gnas na 5—1780

srog gi rlung / /shes nas gyen du 'gog par bya/ /rlung ma gnyid ma sbyor ba yis—/ /'byed pa dang ni 'dzums pa des/ /ye shes me ni de yis rtogs/ /rang bde ba ni mchog gi dngos/ /de yis gtum mo 'bar ba yin/ /shes rab rang rig mtshan nyid do/ /mtshan ma'i ye shes bsreg pa ste/ /phung po skye mched sogs 'du shes/ /de nas gyen du 'gro 'gyur te/ /rtog pa med pa'i bde chen gnas—/ /rnam par rtog pa'i sde ye shes/ /rang gi 'od kyis zhu bar byed/ /de la 'di lta bur ni bsam/ /dngos pos min na nam yang min/ /bde ba chen po rnyed 'gyur te/ /de bas dngos po dngos med pa'o/ /'di bcad byam ①nas de nas ni/ /sngar tshig pa ni yang sos bya②/ /brlag dang longs spyod dbang gis ni—/ /thig le gsum ni rab dga' ba/ /'khor lo re rer shes bya ste/ /lte ba'i nang du phyi rol min/ /thig le gsum ni rin chen sker/ /thig le bco lngar de ni dran/ /char yang dga' ba'i bye brag tu/ /ā li thig ler shes par bya—/ /bcu drug pa de logs na med/ /rang bzhin yang ni de ltar ro/ /snang ba gsum dang ldan pa ni/ /rin chen ske ru phyin tsam na/ /'og pad lte ba'i pad+ma ni—/ /'dzums byed sa de'i rang bzhin no/ /gsum po rnams ni spangs pa yis//gzhan ma gang na'ang rang bzhin med/ /gsum po rang yang rang bzhin min/ /dpal ldan thams cad rgyud las gsungs/ /de bzhin char yang shes par bya/ /bcu drug pa ni gang na'ang med/ /bcu drug char yang med pa ste/ /de la tshes ni gang bzung ste/ /yod na yang ni de spang dgos/ /bya ba'i don ni de mi byed/ /kye yi rdo rje'i rgyud las gsungs/ /bdag gis kyang ni de gsal byas/ /'di la bya ba ji skad bstan/ /skye dang 'gag pa'i gzugs yin no/ /skye dang 5—1781

'gag pa med pa yi/ /bcu drug pa la rtog mi byed/ /rang bzhin de las shes par bya/ /skye dang 'gag pa spangs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥdang / sarba dharmā de bzhin yang / /badz+ra shurnyo3haṃ ①zhes te/ go cha de ni sngags rgyal yin/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bum chen po/ /rtsa ②yi kha rgyan dang ldan pa/ /zla ba gang dus rnal 'byor pas/ /bum pa gang ba'i nang du blta/ /srog dang rtsol ba 'gog pa yis—/ /rdo rje sku la dbang bskur bya/ /sngags 'di yis ni rtag tu ni/ /rdo rje skal ba ldan par ni/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chu/ /dag pa yis ni khrus byas so①ske/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhi/ /pad+ma'i snod kyi dbus su ni/ /rin chen lnga ni lha yi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid/ /char yang steng na ye shes me//de yi 'og nas rang dbang rlung / /g.yon skor nas ni me 'bar bya/ /de yi bdud rtsi zhu bya'o/ /rdor gsum ye shes sa bon kyis/ /dkar sbyangs rtogs byas 'bar byas so/ /sngags kyi de nyid byin brlabs kyis/ /rang lce pad+ma'i 'dab mar gzhag /phyi nang bdag nyid can gyi gzugs/ /'khor lo de yis rab tshim bya/ /'khor lo lte ba'i phyi rol du/ /bdud rtsi nam yang spang mi bya/ /dpa' bo'i dpa' bo kha yi nang / /ske yi gnas su gzung bar bya/ / ske yi gnas nas gyen gyi gnas/ /duthur du nam yang gtang mi bya/ /de nas mgon po'i snying po ni/ /snying gar 'phro bar gsal bar ni/ /shel byi yi ge dag pa 'dra—/ /ā li ye shes mtshan nyid can/ /srog dang rtsol ba mgon po yis/ /srog dang rtsol ba bza' bar bya/ /rang 'od rig ma dang ldan pa/ /gnyis kyi 5—1782

rig mar sbyar byas nas/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags rnams kyi/ /sngags 'di yis ni drang bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā kro dhe shwa re dang / /dza ya bi dza ya de bzhin no/ /ṭa ṭa ha sa de nas dran/ /ma hā kālba nāsna ①be+e/ /sa ni yā ya de nas ni—/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ke yang de bzhin/ /tha mar swā hā dang ldan pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po yin/ /oṃ badz+ra te gu dza dang ni/ /dī 1 phaṭa kar dang ldan pa//nye ba'i snying po'i sngags chen po/ /thams cad kun ni dbang du byed/ /oṃ su rata de ni dang po ste/ /sa ma yi shwad de bzhin no/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kar dang ldan/ /tha mar swā hā sbyar ba'o/ /bcom ldan mo yi snying po 'di/ /grangs med pa yi yon tan yod/ /oṃ kṛ sh+lau zlo rkang pa gcig /tha mar phaṭa dang swā hār ldan/ /bcom ldan mo yi nye snying po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /thog mar oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa mtha'/ /bar du ming yang spel bar bya/ /thams cad 'khor lo'i sngags 'di yin/ /mchod pa'i dus su mchod par bya/ /ci tsam nus par bzlas byas te/ /skyo na ngal ni gso bar bya/ /'bum bzlas pa yis 'grub 'gyur te/ /'phral du yid ches byed pa yin/ /de nas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya yod pa yi/ /sngar rdzogs pa yi gzugs kyis ni/ /phyi rol dang ni nang du'o/ /phyi ni bsrung ba'i don du sbyin/ /nang ni yang ni de ltar ro/ /sngar gyi phyag rgya'am yang na 'dis/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgug par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /rgyab dang rgyab ni sbyar bar bya/ /mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud kyi dngos/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni drang por bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyi/ /mdzub mo cung zad dgug par bya/ /oṃ te te sarba yo gi nī/ /sarba ḍā ki nī/ pra ma ni ru dra ni/ ma he shwa ri/ be+eju 5—1783

be+e—/ bā rā tī/ na ra sde gi/ a yi tri/ asna ye/ ba ru ṇi/ bā ya bi/ku mā ri/ ga ru ḍa/ pa na na gi/ bi ṭ+wā ①ya gi/ ba wa swa ste/ bai sra ma ṇi—/ bska ri tsa muṇ+ḍi/ sarba byu ta/ phre ta/ pi shā tsa/ pu྾/ sgru paṃ/dī paṃ/ gar+ghaṃ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma ta twa tsa/ ba ta ga te/ tsa tra tsa ma ra/sa ma yo tai/ ma tsha/ rmā sa/ ma hūṃ rak+ta/ na na ga te/ saṃ purja/ i rda pa lo sa tha sa ma ya/ rak+ṣa tha/ ma ma sarba ta thā ga /sa ha yo ko ra thā/ a dra/sa dha ni/ yi shra dha/ ṣ+ṭaste/ rak+ṣa/ ya dze+e baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭi/ zuspru tha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bha ga'i phyag rgya spyi bor gnas/ /mtshan phyed na ni gtor ma sbyin/ /sngar bshad pa ni kun shes nas/ /de nas rang bzhin la ni gnas/ /rtog pa las ni rtog pa min/ /de ni rang bzhin du ni ngan②/ /thig tshul tshar yang dga' ba rnams/ /de ni rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /tshul tsam rtog pa ma yin te/ /de ni ye shes rang bzhin mkha'/ /mdud pa'i nang gi 'phral ba ni—/ /tshul dang dga' ba'i gzhi yin no/ /de yi steng gi pad+ma ni/ /mgrin pa'i mchog dang thig le'o/ /de yi steng na gtsug tor ni/ /snying gar chad dang char yang ngo / /snying ga'i lte bar ye shes te/ /de ni rang bzhin du ni grags//thig tshul char yang de dga' rnams/ /rtsa gsum nang na rlung dang ldan/ /rlung la zhon nas byang chub sems/ /gsum du dgyes ①nas rtag tu 'bab/ /bzhi pa la ni 'bab ma med/ /rang dbang rtog pa med pa'o/ /gsum ni spangs nas bzhi pa ni/ /nam yang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po rang bzhin dgug byas nas/ /bzhi pa nges par rnyed par 'gyur/ /gsum pa spangs pa'i bzhi pa ni—/ /phra mo'i phra mo skye ba med/ /bla ma yis ni ma gsungs ni0/ /de mi 35—1784

shes par dka' ba yin/ /skye med de ni ga las ①shes/ /de ltar yin na de la'ang brjod/ /skye ba med kyang mi gsal min/ /ma skyes na yang rtag tu shar/ /ji ltar nam mkha' skye med bzhin/ /shin tu gsal bar rtag tu shar/ /dri med gsal ba yin na'ang / /long bas nam yang de mi shes/ /de bzhin tshad ma'i sgrib g.yogs kyis/ /long ba man ngag med pa yis/ /rtag tu shar ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /nam yang de ni shes ma yin/ /thams cad kun du khyab na yang / /thams cad kun nas mthong ma yin/ /de bas skal ldan 'grub don du/ /de ni bdag gis rnyed par bstan/ /pad+ma'i steng nang ye shes ni/ /de ni rang bzhin nges par rnyed/ /pad+ma gru gsum ma yin brjod/ /char yang de ni thig le'i dbus/ /de yi nang du 'gro ba'i sems/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug de byed na—/ /skad cig gcig gis ye shes chen/ /the tshom med par rnyed par 'gyur/ /de ma yin pa'i gsang chen po/ /man ngag de ni gzhan ma med/ /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje yis/ /rgyud thams cad la sbas pa yin/ /de med 'jigs phyir bdag gis 'di/ /dad pa yis ni gsal bar byas/ /gsang ba de nyid gsal ba 'di/ /de bas rnal 'byor ma bzod mdzod/ /da ni yang dag skal ldan rnams—/ /dbang mchog gsum ni yod pa dang / /shin tu dpa' bo dag pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang med pa dang / /dam tshig shes dang bsam gtan gnas/ /bla ma la ni rtse gcig gus/ /ser sna nga rgyal med pa la/ /blo gros chen pos 'di bstan bya/ /gdug dang nad med skrag pa dang / /thos med ser sna khengs rmongs pa/ /nga rgyal phrag dog yod pa dang / /sngags kyi sdom pa mi shes dang / /bla ma nges par mi 'dzin dang / /bsam gtan dam tshig spangs pa la//5—1785

'di yis de nyid gsal byed na/ /dkon mchog gsum ni bsad dang mtshungs/ /de la dngos grub thag ring 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal mang po de la yang ①/ /shi ma thag tu dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas nam yang gsal mi bya/ /'bad de man ngag bsrung bar bya/ /bla ma chen po mchog rnams 'di/ /nges pa'i rmad byung ②bas rmad 'byung ①/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /cung zad tsam ni bdag gsal byas/ /'di yi dri med dge ba yis/ /khams gsum ma lus kun gyis ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sa ni myur du rnyed par shog /dpal rin po che'i char yang zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po chen po dpal shes rab gsang bas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/1767 ⑫mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rapal rin po che'i char yang zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zabs/1768 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mirten/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7la/ rjo〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉thasgom/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra la ba/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thab/1769 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉spom/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉spo/177 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ ske〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yo / ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra)sa/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag1771 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasten/ ②〈〈pe 〉thasrog 〈〈snar 〉thasreg ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasro/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gzung /1772 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sto/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉sgro /1773 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkadang / ②〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉ngo ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ming /1774 1〈〈co 〉yon/ zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rgas/ ①〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉 sa snam/1775 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+ku mgon stong pa'i tshad pa'i mtshan/ /rdo mtsho ma bdag dga' ba mdzod/ ②〈〈pe 〉s+dza rol 5—1786

cig 〈〈snar 〉〉bye ro gcig ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spags/1776 ①〈〈pe 〉〉than/ 〈〈snar 〉stanayon/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ston/ ②〈〈co 〉stanacig gis/1777 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉smon/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stego/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragu/1778 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snosgor/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉rtser/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngags/ bu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanapag1779 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/178༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉྾〈co 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanazung / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan cha/1781 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanapyad byas/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rgyas/1782 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉zhurtse/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉sgyu / ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snana'o/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi ske yi gnas nas gyen gyi gnas//1782 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snamasna/1784 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staspri/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dran/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gyes/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉rna/1785 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/1786 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉'ong / ⑤〈〈snar 〉skarabyung / ②〈〈co 〉〉byung/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (155)5—1787

༄ga /dpal rin chen thigs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī rat+na bin+d+ra nā ma sā dha ā+oṃ no pi ka /bod skad du/ dpal rin chen thigs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen yan lag ma dang ldan/ /rang nyid bde ba chen po yin/ /bde ba chen po'i gnas na bzhugs/ /te ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skal ①ldan rnams kyi grub don du/ /mdor bsdus pa yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /dang por rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /rab tu sbyor ba 'di gnas bya/ /gzhang kha'i pad+mar yig 'bru yo④/ /de las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /gru gsum pad+mar yig 'bru ram̐/ /de las me yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /'dzums ④pa dang ni 'byed pa yis/ /rlung gis me ni bteg par bya/ /bha ga'i pad+ma'i nang du ni/ /yang dag par ni 'bar bar bsgom/ /'bar ba'i me yis lus kun gye/ /rtog pa'i bdag nyid bsreg par bya/ /de yi 'od kyis bde 5—1788

'khor lo/ /kun ni 'od du zhu bar 'gyur/ /'od du zhu ba'i bdud rtsi ni/ /srog gi rtsa ba'i nang nas 'bab/ /rgyun ni mi 'chad pa yis ni/ /sngar tshig pa ni rab tshim bya/ /rang lus ye shes bdag nyid ni/ /mi bskyod pa yi gzugs su mthong / /oṃ swa bhā wa shurtseḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba atā kophohaṃ/ hūṃ gi yig 'brus skad cig 'byung / /'khor lo dang ldan te ru bdag /gru gsum phyag rgya dbus kyi gnas/ /nyi ma'i steng na gar dang ldan/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /chu skyes sngon po'i gzugs dang ldan/ /spyan gsum pa la g.yas brkyang ba/ /legs skyes dbang phyug mas ni 'khyud/ /thod rlon phreng ba'i do shal can/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /mi bskyod pa yis dbu la brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug gis yan lag brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan/ /gtsug tor zla ba phyed pa can/ /gnag dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /g.yon nas bskor ba'i zhal dang ldan/ /'khyud pa'i phyag ni g.yas pa na/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu g.yon/ /nyi ma mda' dang ka pā la/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag na bsnams/ /zla ba gzhu dang kha ṭī ga /g.yon pa yi ni phyag na bsnams/ /legs dgyes dbang mo de dang mthun/ /yang na phyag ni gnyis par dran/ /phyag ni gri gug ka pā la/ /sku smad gnyis ni 'khyud pa yin/ /rang las 'od 'byung mchog gi dngos/ /gnyis su med pa'i gnas na bzhugs/ /legs dgyes ma dang rdor 'tsho ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje glang chen ma/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang mthun/ /gru gsum la ni bsgom bya ste/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /zhal bzhi pa la g.yon brkyang gnas/ /gla rtsi gur kum ga pur gyis/ /bkang ba'i ka pā la rnams ni/ /sgeg pa'i phyag ni gnyis na 5—1789

thogs / /gru gsum phyag rgya spyi bor gzhag /mdzub mo gnyis ni 'og tu'o/ /skra grol ba la gcer bu ste/ /thod rlon do shal gyis brgyan pa/ /ro yi steng na 'jigs 'jigs chen/ /phyag rgya lnga yis yan lag brgyan/ /la la nā sogs dag par ni/ /bsgrub pa'i dbang pos shes par bya/ /de nas bde chen 'khor lo bzhir/ /pad+ma'i sgod kyi nang du ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni lha yi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid/ /char yang steng nas ye shes me/ /de yi 'og gi rlung dang ni/ /gnyis su spyor bas me 'bar ba/ /de yis bdud rtsi zhu byas te / /rdor gsum ye shes sa bon gyis/ /dkar byas rtogs byas 'bar byas so / /sngags kyi byen gyi rlabs kyis ni/ /rang lce pad+ma'i 'dab mar gzhag /phyi nang bdag nyid can kyi gzugs/ /'khor lo de yis rab tshim bya/ /oṃ yo ga a mṛ ta shudhaḥsarba dharma yo ga a mṛ ta shurnyophohaṃ/ de nas mgon po'i snying po ni//thams cad grub pa'i don du bzlas/ /oṃ badz+ra te tso gra hri hri 1hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ glo dṛ zlo phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sā ga ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su ra ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuñdza ri hūṃ phaṭa/ gru gsum gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mchod pa'i dus su mchod par bya/ /de nas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /sems can rnams la bsrung ba'i phyir/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ t+pahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas rnal 'byor ngal bso bya/ /steng dang 'og ni spangs pa yin/ /gnas su gting rings dbus su ni/ /rang rig shes rab ldan pa yin/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi 'dab ma'i nang / /yang dag dri med ma sres 1cha/ /de yi dbus su mchog gi tshul/ /dri med rnam dag gnyis la khyab/ /rang dngos rdzogs pa de ni mthong / /bskyed pa dang ni rdzogs pa med/ /rlabs med pa yi rang bzhin 5—/790

rnam/ /rlabs med pa yi sems kyis ni/ /mchog gi dngos po rnyed pa yin/ /de la cung zad blta ru med/ /de ni dpal me'i zhal snga yi/ /zhal gyi pad+ma mchog las ni/ /u rgyan yul nas bdag gis rnyed/ /phyi nang rang gis dran don du/ /de yi tshig ni bris pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams bzod par mdzod/ /rin chen thigs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1788 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉rapal rin chen thigs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉dpal/ ①〈〈co 〉stasro/ 0〈〈co 〉toradzugs/179 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉gri hri/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉slosngu oṃ/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉skyes/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (156)5—1791

༄ga /dbang rin chen snang ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a rnyi ṣe ka rat+na ā lo ka /bod skad du/dbang rin chen snang ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu gnyis phyed kyi phyed med pa/ /bcu gnyis phyed kyi phyed rang yin/ /bcu drug phyed kyi ro yod pa/ /bcu drug phyed phyed la phyag 'tshal/ /gang 'di sus kyang mi shes pa/ /gang 'di sus kyang gsal ma byas/ /rgyud rgyud na ni gsang ba bzhugs—/ /de yi dbang mchog bdag gis bshad/ /dbang med na ni myur 'grub med/ /rdo rje dbang phyug de skad gsungs/ /yan lag thams cad dbang skal ldan/ /skal ldan min na nam yang min/ /mkhas pas de la sbyin par bya/ /phyag na rdo rjes de skad gsungs/ /thams cad mtshan gyis gang ba dang / /rgyud kun thams cad shes pa dang / /dbang bskur shes dang thugs rje che/ /de ni bla ma rdor rgyal nyid/ /bla ma 'bad de mnyes par bya/ /rgyud 5—1792

las 'byung bzhin mchod bstod bya/ /yon tan phung po brjod mi nus/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gting dpag dka'/ /sku ni rang bzhin dpal dang ldan/ /sems dpa' thams cad kyi ma 'dra/ /ye shes nyi ma bcom ldan 'das/ /gzhan gyi don du khyod ni shar/ /'khor ba ①dran pa'i don du ni/ /dkyil 'khor gsal bar bdag la mdzod/ /de nas yan lag dri zhim bskus te gos bzang brgyan/ /skal ldan gyis ni lhan cig dkyil 'khor bri don du/ /sa la mchod pa rab tu 'bad de rnam par bya/ /rin chen sna tshogs sa 'og gzhug cing gter du sba/ /dpal chen rin chen rgya mtsho yi/ /rgyud las dkyil 'khor tha dad gsum/ /me tog yang na rdul tshon pir/ /yang na ting 'dzin mchog gis bya—/ /rgyal po chom rkun 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /nam yang dkyil 'khor der mi bya/ /skyon ni thams cad bral ba yi/ /gnas su mkhas pas brtsam par bya/ /dang po ji tsam nus kun gyis/ /dad pas bla ma mchod par bya/ /bla ma'i zhabs la mchod byas na/ /the tshom med par dngos grub thob/ /rta dang glang po myu tig rin chen gser dngul dang / /ras la sogs pa sna tshogs ci la dgyes pa dang / /chung ma bu mo sring mo gzugs ni bzang ba dang / /dga' ba'i yid kyis de rnams thams cad dbul bar bya/ /mgon po'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs//khyod ni bdag gi ston chen po/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /thar pa'i lam nyid bdag la stsol/ /pad+ma'i 'byung ba bdag la stsol/ /gsang ba'i mchog ni bdag la stsol/ /thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes nyi 'od la phyag 'tshal/ /thams cad mkhyen sman phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gtso phyag 'tshal/ /skyes bu khyod ni su zhig yin/ /khyod ni ci 'dod bdag 5—1793

la smros/ /dpa' bo chen po bdag skal ldan/ /thog ma'i dbang ni bdag la stsol—/ /de nas de yis mda' yi ras/ /de yi phyi rol yon rnams dbul/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs la bsgom/ /dam tshig sems dpar gzung bar bya//oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra sngags kyis/ /me tog phreng ba mig dgab ras/ /las kyi bum pas gtor bar bya/ /yang na dam tshig chu yis gtor/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sngags kyis ni/ /a ti ho brtan brtul zhugs bzang / /lan gsum arka me tog gis/ /hūṃ phaṭa sngags kyis gdab par bya/ /de nas rdo rje me tog can/ /snying gar cung zad gzung bar bya/ /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya ste/ de bzhin thams cad rnam par byis—/ /ye shes 'bras bu ci 'dod dang / /dngos grub thams cad rnyed par 'gyur—/ /dkyil 'khor ma mthong sngon du ni/ /gang yang smra bar ma byed cig /ma yin khyod kyi dam tshig 'di/ /nyams par 'gyur ba nges pa yin/ /de nas rdo rje spyi bor ni/ /bzung ①la 'di skad smra bar bya/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje yin/ /spyi bor bdag gis gsor bar bya/ /khyod kyis gzhan la 'di smras na/ /skad cig gis ni phung ②nas 'gro/ /gur gum dang ni tsan+dan dang / /sbrang rtsi yod pa'i chu bsres la/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni de dbus blugs/ /de yis dam tshig blud par bya/ /oṃ badz+rad ka ma hā dang / /badz+ra ku ram̐ bi sha na/ /lan bdun bzlas pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /lag pa g.yas su sbyin par bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'ong / /'thungs shig rdo rje bdud rtsi chu/ /de ring phan chad khyod kyis ni/ /phyag na rdo rjer bdag la sgos/ /bdag gis ji ltar bka' stsol dka' ba sbyin/ /de ltar khyod kyi dad pas bya dgos so/ /gang yang nga la mi 5—1794

mos nam mi bya'i/ /de ltar byas na rnam smin dmyal bar 'gro/ /skyes su dri med yid ldan pa'i/ /khyod kyi mig gis ji ltar mthong / /dkar po dag ni mthong gyur na/ /zhi ba'i las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /ser po dag ni mthong gyur na/ /rgyas pa'i las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /dmar po dag ni mthong gyur na—/ /dbang gi las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /nag po dag ni mthong gyur na/ /drag po'i las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /ras kyis mig la bkab gyur nas/ /rtags ni 'di dag mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nas bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /byen gyis brlabs ni smra bar bya/ /ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin 'ong / /lha mo rigs kyi rim pa la/ /ji lta ba yi dngos grub yod/ /rang rang gi ni rigs rigs la/ /me tog babs pa'i bu 'di ni/ /de lta bu yi dngos grub thob/ /mig dgab ras kyi phreng ba las/ /me tog bzang po lag tu sbyin/ /pra tīts+tsha ho rdo rje 'dzin/ /lan gsum brjod la dbul bar bgyi/ /bla mas me tog blta bar bya—/ /dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma ste/ /yan lag rab kyis phyag rgya che'i/ /dngos grub the tshom med par thob①/ /yan lag 'bring gis sngags dngos 'grub/ /yan lag tha mas chung dngos 'grub/ /rang gi lha mo'i dbus gnas su/ /yang na rang dang gzhan gyi bar/ /me tog gang gdan nye de'i yin/ /de yi gnas ni dbus su brlag /dkyil 'khor phyi rol babs na ni/ /cung zad tsam gyi dngos grub 'ong / /pan tsa re khā la babs na/ /phyi nas lan gsum dbul bar byarka/ /yang ni de yi steng babs na/ /nam yang dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /de la chu yi dbang gcig sbyin/ /dbang gzhan dag ni mi sbyin no/ /sgo dang rta babs phyi rol dang / /rdo rje phreng ba'i phyir babs na/ /dngos grub tha ma'ang 5—1795

med gyur na/ /gzhan chen po ni ga la 'grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de ring nyid—/ /khyed ni nan tan mig phye ste/ /bdag gis thams cad mig bye bas/ /rdo rje mig ni mchog gi mchog /de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i don/ /dang po sgo skyong la sogs nas/ /dkyil 'khor ji lta bu yi gnas/ /phyogs mtshams la sogs so sor bstan/ /bcom ldan 'das sku ji lta bur/ /rab gnas khrus kyi cho ga bya/ /de ltar slob ma la 'bad de/ /rtse gcig gis ni khrus bya'o/ /bum pa chos kyi dbyings ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas rin po che yi snod/ /nyi zla ā li kā les 'byung / /de yi nang du bsam par bya/ /lha mo dang ldan mi bskyod pa/ / snying po ①zhu ba'i rang bzhin can/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /las kyi sems dpa' 'ang de yin no/ /byang chub rdo rjes ⑤sangs rgyas la/ /bla ma chen po ji ltar byin①/ /bdag dang 'dra ba'i don du ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la 10/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum gyis ni phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gzhi las 'byung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bdag gis sbyin/ /oṃ hūṃ dpal ni rdo rje'i duchus/ /'khor los sgyur dbang bdag gis bskur/ /chu yi dbang ni bskur ba yis/ /mgo bor mi bskyod rigs ⑤'byung ngo / /de 'bras me long ye shes ni/ /dri med yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas gser sogs gzo rjobyas dang / /yang na ras la bri ba mchog /'jig rten khams ni grangs med na/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni bzhugs pa kun/ /dbu rgyan gzugs su bsgom pa ni/ /mgo bo la ni rdo rje'i gzugs/ /oṃ mu ku ④ṭa a bhi ṣilnga ⑧mi/ 'khor los sgyur las khyad par che/ /dbu rgyan dbang gis mgo bor ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de 'bras 5—1796

mnyam nyid ye shes ni/ /dri med yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sgeg mos bzung ①nas su/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ni brjod nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal ji ltar/ /di ring bdag gis khyod dbang bskur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rab grub phyir ni rdo rje gzung / /slob ma'i snying gar gtugs byas la/ /lag pa g.yas par sbyin par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a rnyi ṣi.ā+oṃ mi/ phyag na rdo rje stobs po che—/ /rdo rje dbang gis mgo bor ni/ /snang ba mtha' yas 'byung bar 'gyur//de 'bras so sor rtogs pa yi/ /ye shes gsal bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdor dril sgyu 'phrul chen po 'di/ /gnyis med dngos po shes rab thabs/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can/ /lag pa g.yon par 'di gzung sdeshig /'khyud nas kun du sbyar nas su/ /rdo rje 'dzin 'dra'i dngos por 'dug /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti ste a rnyi ṣi.ā+oṃ mi nā ya ka /dril bu'i dbang gis mgo bor ni/ /don yod grub pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de 'bras bya ba grub pa ni/ /dri med yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje dang ni rdor dril ni/ /spyi bo'i steng du gzung byas la//oṃ shrī nā ma a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ mi/ dngos po lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /kye dpal rdo rje che ge mo'i/ /sngar gyi rigs kyi rim pa lta'o/ /ming gi dbang gis mgo bor ni//rnam par snang mdzad rigs 'byung ngo / /de 'bras chos dbyings dag pa ni/ /dri ma med pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'di ni dbang bskur lnga yin te/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /rigs lnga'i bdag nyid kyang yin no/ /'byung lnga'i rang bzhin yang yin no/ /dpal 'di yis ni dbang bskur bas/ /thams cad kun la dbang byed 'gyur/ /yan lag lnga ni yod pa'i dbang / /de ni slob dpon gyi yin no/ /yang na lha mo'i dbang du bstan/ /shes rab ma yi las 5—1797

yod phyir/ /kye yi rdo rje rgyud las gsungs/ /ye shes snying po der yang bstan/ /lag pa dag gis 'khyud pa ni/ /bcu drug lon pa'i shes rab 'dzin/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon dbang du gsungs pa'i gzhung / /lha mo'am ni slob dpon dbang / /sdom pa'i mchog ni bzung ①nas su/ /sngar brjod pa yi cho ga yis/ /dam tshig gsum yang zhu bar bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon byi ni dbang / /thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /bdag dang gzhan don bya ba ni/ /khyod kyi bka' drin drin gyis so/ /bcom ldan yang dag dpal bla mas/ /rdo rje de nyid gzung bar bya/ /hūṃ gi dngos po rdo rje mchog /thog ma tha ma med bdag nyid/ /oṃ mchog gi dang po skyes bu ste/ /rdor 'dzin thams cad bdag po yin/ /haṃ hūṃ ho sh+lau hūṃ hūṃ ste/ /'di yis rdo rje byen gyis brlabs—/ /a las rdor dril skyes pa ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi ma/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dze phe ste/ /'di yis dril bu byin gyis brlabs/ /'di ni mchog gi dngos po yin/ /shes rab sgyu mar gsungs pa'o/ /khyod kyis rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /thog ma byang chub rgyal bas gzung / /rdo rje mchog gi ye shes ni/ /mi phyed nam mkha' lta bu'i gzugs/ /ston pa 'di yi tshig gis ni/ /slob ma'i lag tu sbyin par bya/ /de ni sngags ni yod pa'i sa/ /rtse gcig gis ni dkrol bar bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ma hā na de swa rū pe bin+d+ra dzñā na ma ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rang yid brtan pa'i de nyid kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can—/ /rang gi lha yi dngos po ni/ /sku yi phyag rgyas gsal bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi rigs/ /dam tshig gsum ni dpa' bor gzung / /de nas dkyil 'khor de nyid don/ /nang gi mtshan gyis sbyor ba dang / /lha yi rnam 5—1798

dag de kho na/ /mtshan dang 'byung ba smra bar bya/ /rnam snang mdzad mgon ji lta bur—/ /de lta bur ni slob ma gzung / /de la gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas ci mdzad khyod kyis gyis/ /sems can thams cad phan don du/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho lta bur 'dug /thams cad ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /khyod kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'di ni dam tshig 'dul ba yis/ /de nas gnang ba sbyin pa'o—/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /ye shes lnga dngos zhi ba ni/ /ye shes rang bzhin mi phyed la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad phyag byed pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /nyid kyi phyag na ji ltar bsnams/ /rdo ①rgyal brtul zhugs mi shigs pa/ /khyod kyis de ltar bzung ①bar gyis/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rna ṅgadhi sa ma ya badz+ra rna/ sangs rgyas gzugs ni bdag rang nyid/ /mchod sbyin khu tshur ldan pa yis/ /khyod ni bdag gis lung bstan bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdor sems yin/ /sems can thar pa 'grub don du/ /ngan 'gro rnams ni dran par gyis/ /yang dag de bzhin gshegs pa khyod/ /khams gsum gyi ni thub pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /dgra bcom pa ni yang dag pa'i/ /byang chub tu ni khyod lung bstan/ /phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu rab/ /'dis gsungs pas ni khyod kyis rnyed/ /de nas skyabs ni sbyin pa ni/ /gsang ba'i sgra ni yod pa'o/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod pa'i chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis kyang ni yang ma byed/ /dam tshig chen po yod pa ni/ /hūṃ phaṭa kyis ni mnyam pa'o/ /sdig pa thams cad med pa ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pas/ /bde chen theg 5—1799

pa 'di las ni/ /phyi nas shi ba yod med de/ /srid pa yang dag dngos grub kyis—/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das bor ro/ /rdo rje rin chen nang yod pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi rung / /de ni 'byung ba tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya/ /nams kyang bor bar mi bya'o/ /ma rig pa'am gti mug gis/ /phyi nas 'jigs pas bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang spang bar mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /bla ma smad par yong mi bya/ /rang bdag yongs su bor nas ni/ /dka' thub sdug bsngal mi bya'o/ /ji ltar bde bar bde gzung stin//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma 'ongs 'byung / /yan lag bzhi po 'di dag dang / /gnang ba'i sbyin pa phyir mi ldog /dbang ni dbang lnga zin nas ni/ /phyi nas 'bad de sbyin par bya/ /dgongs dang dgongs min bye brag ni/ /slob dpon dbang du shes par bya/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud las ni/ /dbang ni drug tu bshad pa'o/ /phyi ma'i rnal 'byor gsang ba'i dbang / /bdun par gyes pa yod pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes de ltar ni/ /phyi ma'i phyi ma dpal rnal 'byor/ /'di dgu'i dgyes par shes par bya/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i rim pa'o chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang de lnga dang / /rigs gsum dam tshig yod pa ni/ /dbang ni brgyad du gyes pa gsungs/ /brtul shugs ②lung bstan skyabs sbyin ni/ /de dag bcu gcig gcig yin no/ /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa'o/ /yang na so sor shes par bya/ /dbang bskur 'di ni bcu bzhi pa'o/ /slob dpon mdun du rtse gcig gis/ /de nas gus pas zhu bar bya/ /byang 5—1800

chub rdo rje dpal chen po/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni bdag la stsol/ /ye shes bdud rtsi bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje 'byung ba bdag la stsol/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khyod la phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal rmad byung khyod/ /bde chen bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi rigs kyi bu mo rab/ /skyes bu 'di la dgongs pa yin/ /rang gi rigs ni med gyur na//gzhan ma gang yang mtshan ldan rung / /bcu gnyis yang na bcu drug gam/ /med na nyi shu lon pa'ang rung / /de ni nu sra gyes pa dang / /ma btsas pa dang brtan pa dang / /skra gnag mig dkyus ring ba dang / /skad snyan dag tu smra ba'o—/ /ha cang sbom min phra ba min/ /yan lag dkar min gnag pa min/ /ha cang thung min ring ba min/ /longs spyod dag la mkhas pa dang / /rked dbus phra zhing bha ga rub/ /sku smad cha ni rab zheng che/ /khu ba mang zhing snying po chung / /phyi zheng che la sra ba dang / /dri zhim reg bya 'jam pa'i lus/ /'dod chags che la mi dga' min/ /smin ma ring zhing bar ma chad/ /gzhu dngos 'dra zhing 'od 'phro gnag /g.yon byi srin lag rtsa ba la/ /'khor lo yang na pad+ma rin/ /rdo rje ral gri dngos gsal ba/ /su la 'di 'dra'i rtags yod pa/ /phyag rgya de yi gsang ba'i dbang / /don ni 'grub par nus pas so/ /de la ①khrus sogs byug pa bya/ /dad pas bla ma la dbul bya/ /khyad par gyi ni tshig kyang brjod/ /mgon po khyod la 'di 'tshal lo①/ /de nas slob ma phyir gyed bya//nang min ha cang ring ba'ang min/ /rim pas bu mo dbang bskur bya/ /de la gsang chos bshad par bya/ /phyag rgya'i brda dang dbang gi don/ /skad cig rnams kyang de ltar ro/ /de nas gcig tu sbyor ba yis/ /legs dgyes dgyes 5—1801

pa rab bgyed do/ /snang ba reg bya 'dus pa ni/ /ye shes gsum ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yang dag ye shes gsum skyes ni①/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi rung / /spangs na 'gro ba'i gnas su ni/ /bde chen sems ni 'gro bar 'gyur//'gro na de ni chad pa yin/ /shes rab ye shes gsal yin no/ /dpal gsang 'dus pa'i nang nas kyang / /rdo rje nyi nub zhes ni 'byung / /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa yin/ /rim pa lnga pa las kyang gsungs/ /de ni gsang bar bshad pa yin/ /gsang bar snang ba mched pa bshad/ /'dud nas de ni snang ba mched—/ /de ni gcig pu pho brang gsang / /der ni rang gis shes par bya/ /sems ni 'dam skyes nam mkhar min/ /de nas slob ma dgug ②par bya/ /de nas ras kyis gdong yang dgab/ /pad+ma rab kyi kha dbus nas/ /rdo rje rgyal po drang bar bya/ /bu yi kha pad nang du ni/ /sbom po tha ltag gis mnan no/ /rtsa gnyis mchog gi nang nas ni/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i nang du btang / /skyes bu bdud rtsi ji lta bu/ /khyod kyis spros shig snedaga' ba yin/ /e ma'o mchog gi bdud rtsi yin/ /e ma'o ye shes bdud rtsi rab/ /e ma'o ro ni brjod mi lang / /e ma'o rdo rje bdud rtsi rab/ /di ring bdag skyes 'bras bu mchog /di ring bdag ni rab tu rgyal/ /di ring bdag ni 'khor las rgyal/ /di ring bdag la the tshom med/ /khyod kyi bka' drin yang dag mchog /brjod med gnas ni bdag gis rnyed/ /de nas yang ni zhu ba bya/ /bstod pa sna tshogs rab bgyis te—/ /ye shes bde ba'i gnas bzhugs te/ /rgyal 'gyur rgyal 'gyur mgon po khyod—/ /ā li kā li gnyis bdag can/ /legs dgyes bde mtsho rgyal gyur cig /mchog dang chad pa'i dbus su ni/ /rol cig khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /5—1802

mchog gi dbang phyug khyod kyis ni/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bdag stsol/ /khyod kyi bka' drin de nyid kyis/ /rang bzhin ye shes bdag rnyed 'ong / /yang na gcig pu'i gzhung du sbyor/ /yang na gzhan gzhung gzhung bzang ngo / /shes rab ye shes dbang 'di ni/ /brtags la de nyid sbyin bya ste/ /'dod chags chags bral med pa dang / /mnyam nyid ye shes sems dpa' dang / /chos rnams thams cad mi chags pa/ /ji ltar pad chus mi gos shing ①/ /de la 'bad de dbang gi rgyal po ni/ /gcig pu'i yan lag ma la 'dir skyon med/ /bla mas rtog pa med par sbyin par bya/ /ye shes zla gnas ②rgyud las de skad 'byung //don zin nas ni skad cig gis/ /ma dang 'dra bas bla ma dbul/ /'phyang ba'i sbyor thabs la sogs kyis/ /dang por bu mo'i 'dod mchog bya/ /de nas skad cig dga' yon tan/ /rang bzhin de yang gsal bar bya/ /'di ni rang bzhin gyi ni gnas/ /gnyis kyi bar na de ni yod/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma yi rtsa/ /nyid ni 'di yi nang na bzhugs/ /kun rdzob dngos po'i gzugs su ni/ /khyod ni bud med gzugs yin gyi/ /khyod ni gcig pu don dam par/ /phyag rgya chen po nyid yin no/ /khyod kyis thams cad kun bskyabs na/ /byang chub rab ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /shes rab skyabs sbyin byas langs na/ /slob ma'i lag tu sbyin par bya/ /'di nas khyod gzung ①bzang ba yin/ /rjes su mthun par sangs rgyas gsung / /ye shes gsum gyi rim pa las/ /dam pa'i bde ba stsong byed cing / /sangs rgyas rin chen snod kyi ni/ /g.yon ngos la ni rtsa yi gnas//de ni kha ga mu kha dngos/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma ni nyid/ /thabs gzhan dag gis byang chub ni/ /nam yang rnyed par yong mi 'gyur/ /de bas lhan 5—1803

cig mi gnas pa/ /dus 'di phyin chad ma byed cig /de la yan lag dri zhim gos bzang brgyan/ /yan lag me tog sna tshogs mang pos brgyan/ /gos med chu skyes seg seg ngag byas te/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas gsal bar ston par byed—/ /dri chen dri chu za ba 'di/ /skyes bu khyod kyis nus sam ci/ /rak+ta shu kra sha chen dang / /bud med brtul zhugs de bzhin no/ /bha ga'i pad+ma 'jib nus sam/ /skyes bu smros dang ji lta bu/ /lha mo bdag gis ci mi nus/ /rak+ta shu kra sogs za nus/ /rtag tu bud med brtul zhugs bgyid/ /bha ga yang ni gzhib par bya/ /de nas dga' ba'i bdag nyid des/ /byams pa'i spyan ras kyis ni gzigs/ /bde ba thams cad 'dug pa ni/ /bdag gis pad rgyas e ma'o—/ /gang 'di rab dang byed pa yi/ /de yi mdun du bdag 'dug gis/ /ji ltar pad+ma'i don gyis shig /yang dag sangs rgyas mnyes sogs bya/ /nyid kyi bde chen rgyal po ni/ /'di ni dus rtag yod phyir ro/ /bde ba chen po'i dmar thigs 'di/ /ngo yi chu skyes kyis mnyes kyis/ /de nyid gsum gyi dga' sbyor bas/ /rdo rje chu skyes bskyod ①par byis/ /brtan pa'i don ni khyod kyis kyis—/ /brtan pa med na bde mi 'grub/ /sngar gsungs pa yi bla ma'i bka'//ma brjed rtse gcig gis ni bsam/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma yi rtsa/ /g.yon gyi ngos la bzhugs pa ni/ /bla ma'i man ngag yang dag gis/ /phra mo'i lta bas blta bar bya/ /lta ba'i bdag nyid rnal 'byor kyis/ /sa bon 'bab par mi bya'o—/ /sa bon snying po yod pa na/ /ngo mtshar dga' ba'i bde ba 'byung / /thams cad bde ba'i gter gyur pa'i/ /byang chub sems bde babs gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal 'ong bas/ /dngos grub rab de ga la 'grub/ /la la 5—1804

mda' la mnyam sbyor bas/ /reg bya la ni bde 'di 'byung / /de dag smin pas mchog gi dga'/ /snang ba mched pa'i gzugs can tsam/ /bskyod pa'i reg bya babs pa yis/ /chad dang snang ba thob pa yin/ /lta ba brtan pas de nyid la/ /rnal 'byor pas ni mi g.yo blta/ /la la'i blta ①ba nam mkha' yi/ /mda' la gnyis kyi pho brang mnan/ /rdo rje skyil krung gi ni sems/ /rin chen nang du blta bar bya/ /gsung lam gyis ni brjod med pa'i/ /ye shes mchog 'di skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni de nyid man ngag yin/ /mkhas pa yis kyang rnyed dka' ba/ /skal dang ldan pa'i don bsgrub phyir/ /de ni bdag gis gsal bar byas/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /de ni yang dag dri med gnas/ /bde ba chen po'i 'bras gzugs can—/ /ye shes lta ba'i rnal 'byor na/ /'gro ba med pa'i bde ba brtan/ /snga dro dus na nyin gcig dang / /bskal pa stong gi bar du ni/ /dpal rdor dbang phyug ji lta bar/ /ye shes nga rgyal brtan sbyor ba'o/ /kye mgon gang gis khyod la bstod/ /ji tsam bdag gis khyod bstod bya/ /tshad med pa dang brjod mi nus/ /rmad byung chen po gzhal du med/ /khyod kyi yon tan yang dag ni/ /kha cig gis ni brjod mi nus/ /cig gis dad pas ④ci bstod kyang / /de ni bdag la bzod par mdzod/ /①reg bya nang 'jam la phyag 'tshal/ /reg bya nang grol la phyag 'tshal/ /reg bya nang sbyin la phyag 'tshal/ /bzhi pa'i dbang bskur mchog 'di ni/ /mchog gi dbang phyug bdag la stsol/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /khyod kyis brdzun du smra bar gyis/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long / /gzhan gyi bud med spyad par gyis/ /'di 5—1805

rnams byas na sdig med cing / /bsod nams chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de rnams khyod kyis nus na ni/ /bzhi pa'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin la/ /mgon po chen po bdag gis ni/ /slob pa'i spyod pa sems kyis brtag /ji ltar dbang sbyin rim pas gsungs/ /gtong dul gting ring spyod yod na/ /dbang ni rin chen tshig gis sbyin/ /shes rab ye shes ma rnyed na/ /dam tshig sbyin par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig nyams pas 'jigs phyir ro—/ /phyag na rdo rjes ma gnang ngo / /yang dag dbang ni ma rnyed na/ /phyi nas de ltar sbyin par bya/ /dbang bskur de ni bzhi pa can/ /bzhi ru gyes pa yod pas so/ /bum pa la sogs nu reg pas/ /dang ①po'i 'bras bu dga' ba yin/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i sbyin pa ④yis/ /gsang ba mchog gi dga' ba yin / /gsum pa gcig tu sbyor ba yisasne/ /shes rab 'dod chags me 'og gis—/ /yongs su gyur pas chad pa yin/ /de nas shes rab ye shes bshad/ /de yi 'gog pa bzhi pa yin/ /rang bzhin de ni de ltar 'ong / /de ni dgongs par bshad ma yin/ /mkhas pas 'bad pas shes par bya/ /bzhi pa yi ni don rnams la/ /mi mthun pa ni mang smra ste/ /de la gzhan ni 'di skad gsungs//btang snyoms dngos po bsgom pa yis/ /'bras yod bde ba'i dngos po ni/ /ye shes gsal bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /btang snyoms dngos por bdag sbyor ba'i//lha mo'i de nyid bsgom pa yis/ /'bras bu'i rgyun ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /gzhan kyi gzhung gis de skad gsungs/ /lha yi dngos po med pa dang / /btang snyoms dngos po yod pa yis/ /bde ba yod pa 'bras bur 'gyur/ /gzhan kyi gzhung gis de skad gsungs/ /bag chags bde ba khyen nas ni/ /bag chags ma yin 5—1806

bde bar 'gyur/ /yang dag mchog ni rdzogs pa yin/ /gzhan gyi gzhung gis de skad gsungs/ /bag chags ma yin bde ba'i dngos/ /lha yi bsgom pa yang dag gis/ /rab tu bde ba'i ye shes 'byung / /de ni gzhan gyis gsungs pa'o//de gzhung tshad ma ma yin te/ /de don tshad ma yang ma yin/ /btang snyoms bsgom pa'i don gyis ni/ /'bras bu bde ba rnyed gyur ①na/ / de ni sbyor ba ma yin pa—/ /snenam mkha' me tog skye ba'i dpe/ /de bzhin gsungs pa kha che yi/ /rin chen rdo rje zhabs kyi ni/ /ma mthong ba la bsgom pa med/ /mthong ba la yang bsgom pa med/ /bdag la btang snyoms sbyor yod dam/ /lha yi bsgom pa yod pa yis—/ /'bras bu rgyun du rnyed 'gyur zer/ /de ni rmongs pa'i gzhung yin no//thams cad dngos po'i btang snyoms kyis/ /dngos po ma yin 'ong ba yin/ /dngos po ma yin lha yi dngos/ /de skad 'byung ba su yi gzhung / /'byung ba yin na de nyid min/ /dngos po'i gzugs can 'khrul pa yin/ /dngos po mi rtag bden pa yin/ /de yi don la the tshom med/ /btang snyoms dngos po yod pa dang / /lha yi dngos po med pa yis/ /dri med 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur na—/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'god par 'gyur/ /lha yi dngos po med gyur na/ /btang snyoms de yis ci zhig bya/ /yod na de la btang snyoms dgos/ /dngos po min na mi dgos so/ /rtag pa yi ni gnas med de/ /ri bong rwa sogs dpe dang 'dra/ /bag chags bde ba bzung na ni/ /bag chags ma yin 'ong 'gyur na//de ni skyon du 'gyur ba'i tshig /'bru nang las ni nan ①yang min④/ /'bras la sogs pa 'byung mi srid/ /mnyam pa kun gyi gzhung lugs so/ /yang dag rab bde'i bsgom pa yis/ /rab tu bde 'bras 'byung 'gyur na/ /de la khyad 5—1807

par ci zhig yod/ /ci phyir don du sgom par byed/ /rab bde ba la khyad yod na—/ /de la bsgom pa bya dgos so/ /khyad par gnas 'gro na yang skyon/ /de ni de nyid mtshan ma yin/ /gnyis su med pa'i mchog dga' dngos/ /lha yi dngos po rab bde ba/ /sgyu 'phrul ye shes chen po yi/ /'bras bu de ni rang bzhin gzhung / /rang brtags yang na gti mug gis/ /de la mkhas pa rnams ni 'khrul—/ /de yi gzhung lugs gsal brtags nas/ /phyi nas rang gzhung gsal bar bya/ /shes rab ye shes zin nas sems/ /myong ba de ni bzhi pa yin—/ /de yi man ngag slob rnams la/ /slob dpon gcig gis tshig gis bshad—/ /shes rab ye shes zin nas su/ /slob dpon slob la gsungs pa 'di—/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub las ni/ /'di yi ye shes gsal bar 'byung ①/ /yang dag de yi don shes ni/ /gzhan bzhi pa rab yin par gsungs/ /shes rab ye shes zin nas su/ /mtsho skyes 'byung bar babs pa ni/ /rin chen skar khung kha mi reg /thams cad kyi ni dngos po la/ /'du shes med pa bzhi pa yin/ /gzhan dag de skad gsung ba yin/ /shes rab ye shes zin nas su//'dam skyes 'byung ba babs pa 'di/ /rin chen skar khung kha reg pa/ /'di yis dngos po thams cad la/ /dran pa med pa bzhi pa'o/ /gzhan dag gis ni de skad gsungs—/ /shes rab ye shes zin nas su/ /dang po'i yid ni nam mkha'i dbyings—/ /babs pas chos rnams thams cad la/ /rnyed pa med par gyur pas so—/ /de ni bzhi pa yang dag rab/ /gzhan gyis de skad gsal bar gsungs//thams cad pad+ma 'byung ba ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su babs gyur na/ /chos thams cad la btang snyoms so/ /gzhan gyis bzhi pa gsungs pa'o/ /de dag 5—1808

thams cad dor byas te/ /rigs pa med pas gzhung lugs min/ /shes rab gang yin ye shes gang / /de yi 'bras bu gang yin gsungs/ /'di yi don de mi shes na/ /gzhan gyi gzhung la 'bras bu med/ /ma zin na ni myong ba med/ /zin na myong ba yod pa yin/ /zin na myong ba ci zhig yod/ /song nas 'ong ba ga la yod/ /zin nas myong ba phyir gyi ste/ /byol song gi ni las yin no/ /dang po dang ni zin nas gcig /phyi ma nus nas de bzhin no/ /zin nas nub pa yod pa yis/ /de la dpe ni gang gis byed/ /zin nas nub pa de ni gcig /de la khyad par ci yang med/ /zin nas rin chen kha la ni/ /ma reg 'gro ba de gzhung na/ /'gro na de ni chad pa yin/ /de la blta rgyu ma mchis so—/ /reg nas 'gro ba de dang mnyam/ /gang ①du smras pa de yin no/ /dang po nam mkha'i dbyings la ni/ /rim pas gzhan yang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /thams cad de ni babs gyur na/ /tha mal pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /tha mal pas ni bde chen ni/ /nam yang shes pa ma yin no/ /de la bde chen med par ni/ /ye shes 'byung bar ga la 'gyur/ /ye shes srid pa nyams dga' ba/ /shes rab mya ngan 'das las chad/ /de gnyis 'bras bu de nyid yod/ /de yi 'bras bu don dam yin/ /de bzhin kye yi rdo rje yi/ /le'u brgyad pa'i nang nas gsungs—/ /de ni gnyis med zhi chen po/ /'dod chags chags bral med pa dang / /rang rig brjod du med pa dang / /rtog pa thams cad med pa'o/ /rang bzhin sgrub thabs sogs kyis ni/ /yan lag gsum ni yod pa yi/ /rang bzhin nyid ni bzhi pa'o/ /la la mda' ②la mnyam sbyor ba/ /sgrub thabs phyi ma yin par bshad/ /hūṃ phaṭa kyi ni mnyam pa ni/ /bsgrubs pas de ni sgrub thabs so//5—1809

sgrub thabs nang na sems yod na/ /rtags ni 'di lta bu dag skye/ /'dar dang rngul dang stsos pa dang / /lus mi brtan par dbugs rgod dang / /bkrag dang drod ni de ltar brgyad/ /'bras bu'i dus na skye bar 'gyur/ /sgrub chen yan lag 'bras bu 'di/ /ye shes gsum ni med pa'o/ /rang bde mchog ni zhi chen po//ye shes 'od ni rang bzhin can/ /de yi rdzogs pa'i rim pa yis/ /'bras bu 'bad de shes par bya/ /de 'bras ye shes rigs pas ni/ /slob ma la ni tshig gis ni/ /bla mas don ni bshad par bya/ /blta bar dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do//dbang gsum las gzhan gzhan na med/ /bzhi pa gang na yod pa yin/ /'bras bu gzugs can de nyid ni/ /gsal bar de ltar bzhi pa'o/ /de bzhin dpal rin rdor zhabs kyis/ /dpal bsgom pa yi rim las gsungs/ /gsum ni med pa gsum rang ste/ /de bzhin gzhung yin de ltar ro/ /gzhan gyi don la rab dga' bas/ /ro yi dgug pas dbang du bya/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba ci brjod pa/ /thugs rje can rnams bzod par mdzod/ /thabs kyi rgyud ni 'dus pa las/ /de lta'i gzhung lugs med na yang / /de bzhin rigs pa ci smras pa/ /shes rab rgyud kyi rim las so/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med dngos/ /de ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'o/ /'khor lo bzhi ni mnyam sbyar ba/ /phra mo'i thig le de nang du/ /rang bzhin gcig cig gzhan ma med/ /dngos po med pa'i dngos po can/ /gzhan ma gsum ni 'dab la gnas/ /'khor lo re re so so yin/ /sprul pa'i 'khor loshe'adab ma gsum/ /chu skyes lte ba yod pa'o/ /de ni phyi rol shes par bya/ /brgyad po brgyad ni de nang du'o/ /de yi nang na gsang ba bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas rin po che yi snod/ /baṃ rmi dngos po yang dag 5—1810

'jam / /sna tshogs can ni g.yo ba'o/ /sangs rgyas rin chen de na gnas/ /rang bzhin ye shes mtshan nyid do/ /'phyang ba'i rtsa yi nang na bzhugs/ /khams gsum du ni rol pa mdzad/ /gsum ni rab tu yod pa ste/ /nang dang phyi rol bar ma yin/ /phyi rol g.yas kyi ra sa nā/ /nang gi g.yon gyi la la nā/ /dbus kyi a ba dhū tī la/ /nyid kyi 'dug sa byed pa'o/ /gcig pu yi ni gtso ①mo yi/ /kun rdzob tu ni gsum du 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems ni gcig /sna tshogs gzugs su yod pa'o/ /dbang byed longs spyod brlag pa ni/ /de rnams ngal sor bstan pa'o/ /dbang byed mgrin pa'i gnas su ni/ /longs spyod bar du mchog 'di bstan/ /brlag ni kha las shes par bya/ /de ni chad pa gsal ①ba'o/ /mchog ni mgrin pa'i gnas su ste/ /rang bzhin bar na yod pa'o—/ /nang dang phyi rol dbus kyi ni/ /rnal 'byor de yang mi shes na/ /de dus rang bzhin mi rnyed de/ /shes na rnyed par the tshom med/ /de ni shes rab skyabs yang dag /shes rab bla ma'i kha las 'gyur/ /rtsa rnams de ni med gyur na—/ /khu ba khrag ni sbyor ba med/ /khu ba khrag ni med gyur na/ /rnam par shes pa sbyor ba med/ /rnam par shes pa med gyur na/ /thams cad g.yo ba med par thal/ /g.yo med bde ba chen po ni/ /rnam yang shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /bde ba chen po med gyur na/ /nam yang byang chub mi rnyed de/ /ting 'dzin bzlas pa sbyin pa ni/ /bskal pa brgyar ni spyad na yang / /man ngag de ni med gyur na/ /ji ltar rdo stengs sa bon bzhin/ /de ni thams cad 'grub don du/ /thabs ni cung zad bdag gis bshad/ /thabs gang gis ni rnal 'byor rnams/ /rang bzhin gyi ni gnas der 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg thab ①ni med gyur na/ /rnal 5—1811

'byor dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /lte ba'i hom khung gtum mo'i gnas/ /shes rab rang rig mtshan nyid do/ /rdo rje chu skyes mnyam sbyor bas/ /yang dag 'jigs par 'bar ba'o/ /phung po lnga yi rigs lnga yi/ /rnam par rtog pa'i sreg pa dang / /de bzhin spyan la sogs pa ni/ /skye mched khams ni gzugs can no/ /phung po la sogs yam shing dang / /dang por sreg rdzas gsal bar bya//yam shing thams cad bsregs pa'o/ /haṃ gi dngos po kha bub no/ /yon po'i rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /smin phrag 'khor lo'i nang na yod/ /de nas de ni yang dag 'bab/ /shu kra bdud rtsi rab rgyun no/ /de yi gsang ba'i sreg rdzas sbyin/ /lte ba'i ho khung phyi rol min/ /yang dag par ni dgyes nas ni/ /ci bsams pa yi 'bras bu smin/ /'od kyi gzugs ni gtum mo yin/ /a ba dhū tī'i ①zhi ba'i gzugs/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs lam gnas/ /'gro dang 'ong ba yang dang yang / /skra yi rtse mo 'bum gyi cha/ /che bar lta bas mthong mi 'gyur//de yi ro yod mnyam pa yis/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin la/ /phra mor lta ba'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par ②'gyur/ /de yi nang na sems yod na/ /skad cig gcig gis byang chub sems/ /'di ni gsang ba mchog yin te/ /lung las gsal bar byas pas so/ /bdag gis sngon med rang bzor ni/ /rgyud rnams don las mi mang ngo / /de yi 'bras bu ji snyed pa/ /bla ma rab kyi bka' drin no/ /'jig rten tshad med myur bar ni/ /de yis 'gro ba grol bar shog /srid pa'i gti mug dgon pa la/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi ①lam rab gtor/ /shes rab dpal ni gsang bas ni/ /rin chen snang ba gsal byas pas/ /su la bdag gis dbang bskur bas/ /bdag la de 5—1812

bzhin gang gis thos/ /de ni rang gis 'di shes la/ /gzhan dag la yang 'chad nus so/ /gang la bdag gis bskur ba min/ /gang gis bdag la thos min la/ /de ni rang gis mi shes te/ /gzhan la 'chad par nus min no/ /dbang rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhabs dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba kam dge bsnyen chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug brtsams dbang phyug rgya mtshos zhus te gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/1792 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rabang rin chen snang ba bzhugs/1792 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha'i/1794 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'izung / ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༄ga1795 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉zabathong /1796 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'ams can/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'a/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra / du〈〈pe〉sko' ra 〉s+dza/ rjo〈〈co〉〉rin/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazo/ ⑦〈〈co 〉〉kyi mu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉skorartsi/ 〈〈co〉rgam1797 ①〈〈pe 〉dze' ra 〉'izung / ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phong /1798 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'izung /1799 ①〈〈pe 〉rdzar/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'izung /1/༷༷ ①〈'ar 〉sko〈co 〉thazung / ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉zugs/18༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thas/ ②〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉zotshang ro/1/༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉ragud/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mkhyes bdag ni/18༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhin/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'isang / ①〈〈pe 〉jung / 〈〈co 〉thazung /5—1813

༄ga /dpal chen po ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs/sti༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā dzñā na ḍā ki ②shwa ra sā dha rna no pi ka /bod skad du/ dpal chen po ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs/dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das na bzhugs—/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das dang bral/ /bzhugs dang bral las rnam grol ba/ /brjod du med pa la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan thig le'i rgyud dbang po—/ /rgyud kun gyi ni mnga' bdag che/ /gang gi drin gyis rnyed sla ba/ /bla ma'i zhal snga bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud 'di yi ni rgyal po yis/ /skal ldan rnams ni 'grub don du/ /rgyud kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa yi/ /mdor bsdus sgrub thabs bdag gis bshad/ /dri med chu yis bskor ba yi/ /de'u sing 'jam mo dang ldan pa—/ /me tog 'bras shing yod pa yi/ /der gnas te ru ka mnyes bya/ /dang po rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /'di ltar bur ni rab bsgom bya/ /lte ba'i rtsa 5—1815

bar yi yig 'bru/ /yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi steng du ram̐ yig 'ab/ /ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de gnyis yongs su gyur pa yis 'bar ba'i me ni yang dag bsgom/ /rtog pa'i bdag nyid lus po kun/ /me de yis ni sreg par byed/ /bde 'khor bdud rtsi yod pa dang / /'od du zhu ba'i gzugs bsgom bya/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba yis/ /bsregs pa'i lus po gso bar bya/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /dbang po'i gzhu dang mtshungs par blta—/ /gzugs kyi phung po'i bdag nyid ni/ /'gro ba kun la khyab pa yin/ /de ni gti mug yin pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bdag /tshor ba'ang de bzhin kun la khyab/ /rin chen 'byung ldan nga rgyal phyir/ /'du shes kyang ni 'gro la khyab/ /snang ba mtha' yas chags pa'i phyir/ /'du byed 'gro la khyab pa ste/ /don yod grub pa phrag dog phyir/ /rnam par shes pas 'gro kun khyab//mi bskyod pa ni zhe sdang phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs kun gzugs su ni/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid bzhugs/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang ni/ /lce dang lus dang de bzhin yid/ /rang rang gi ni rang 'od can/ /shes rab dbang po dag pa yin/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /mā ma tī sogs khams yin no/ /legs dgyes dbang mo rnal 'byor ma/ /nam mkha'i khams su shes par bya/ /de kun gyi ni ngo bo bdag /yin par 'di dag dpyad par bya/ /chos 'di kun kyi rang ngo bos/ /bdag med ma skyes pa yin no/ /de dag 'khrul pas mig yor ni—/ /smig rgyu chu zla ji bzhin ni/ /byang chub kyi ni tshogs bsgom pas/ /sems tsam nyid la rab gnas shing / /de nas rang snying mkha' pad du/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sems kyi sa bon de dbus su/ /'od zer lnga 5—1816

ni rab tu 'phro/ /de yi snang bas mdun du ni/ /nam mkhar gser gyi pad+mo che//'od zer 'bar ba dang ldan pa/ /lte ba yod pa'i 'dab ma 'bum/ /'dab mar sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /chos kyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i mchog /dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid/ /nam mkha' khyab par mthong nas su/ /mchod pa byas nas skyabs su 'gro/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang 'dus gtso la/ /byang chub job par skyabs su mchi/ /rang dang gzhan ni 'grub don du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byung byas nas/ /sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /'gro ba kun la phan don du/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /dgyes mchog byang chub spyad par bgyi/ /de nas tshangs pa yi ni gnas/ /byams pa la sogs ldan bsgom bya/ /bu gcig pa yi ma lta bur/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis mthong ba yin/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /sems bgyed de ni byams pa'o—/ /gang gis thabs kyi sems can 'di/ /sdug bsngal me las bdag gis gdon/ /de lta bur ni gang zhig sems/ /de ni snying rjer bstan pa'o/ /sdug bsngal me las bton pa yis/ /rang gi yid ni dga' ba yin/ /bdag gis sems can phan don byas/ /de ni dga' bar bshad pa'o/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i sems can rnams/ /de la zhe sdang bskyed mi bya/ /btang snyoms kyang ni mi bya ste/ /sems can nang na yod phyir ro/ /de lta min na smon lam ni/ /the tshom med par don med 'gyur/ /skyon la btang snyoms ldan pa'i 5—1817

sems—/ /de ni btang snyoms mchog yin no/ /de yi bsod nams kyi ni tshogs//yang dag par ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ye shes tshogs ni 'phel don du/ /stong pa nyid ni bdag nyid yin/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs pa/ /da ltar byung ba'i 'khor ba gsum/ /ngo bo nyid bral stong pa yin/ /ji ltar nam mkha' de bzhin no//oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu n+ya tā sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shu n+ya tā haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā ko3haṃ/ de yis ye shes kyi ni tshogs/ /yang dag par ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /tshogs gnyis po ni rdzogs pa yis/ /the tshom med par byang chub 'thob/ /de nas paṃ byung pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dmar po 'dab ma brgyad/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi steng du sa bon hūṃ/ /'od zer lnga ni 'phro ba yin/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa yis/ /skad cig gsum rgyal nyid du 'gyur/ /sku mdog gnag la 'jigs byed che/ /bskal pa'i me bas drag 'jigs che/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhabs bzhi dang ni ldan pa'o/ /zhabs kyis bdud bzhi po ni mnan/ /zhal ni re re spyan gsum ldan①/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis bdud phur 'dril/ /gzhan ni ral gri dbyug pa 'dzin/ /de lta bu yi khro rgyal po—/ /bdag rang nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag ni sum̐ bha nyid yin phyir/ /de la go cha dgos ma yin/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa greṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ kṛṭ+wā pa ya kṛ2 pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra bibyā khrurā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shar phyogs la sogs se gol rmis/ /sum̐ bha'i rnam pas sngags gdab bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje sa yi 'og /hūṃ las 'od ni spro bar bya/ /de yi 'od kyis snang ba yis/ /rtsig pa dang ni bla re'o/ /rdo rje me lce 'bar ba yin//5—1818

steng du mda' yi dra ba'o/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya rtswa ta ya/ sarba dubye phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya/ badz+ra dha rā dzñā pa ya ti/kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la ya/ ā ko ṭa ya ①hūṃ phaṭa/ de lta'i cho ga'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i gur ni bsam par bya/ /de yi dbus su snyoms pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bha ga'i dbyibs/ /rlung la sogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ /de yi nang du bsgom par bya/ /yo gi yig 'bru las byung rlung / /dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs lta bu/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi nang du ni/ /nag po rgyal mtshan dang ldan bsgom/ /ram̐ gyi yig 'bru las byung me/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum kha dog dmar/ /me lce dang ni ldan pa ste/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng du bsgom/ /baṃ kyi yig 'bru las byung chu/ /dkyil 'khor zlum po'i dbyibs lta bu/ /bum pas mtshan pa kha dog dkar/ /me yi steng du bsgom par bya/ /lo gyi yig 'bru las byung sa/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'i dbyibs lta bu/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa kha dog ser/ /chu yi steng du bsgom par bya/ /'khor bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ /gzhal yas khang du rab tu bsgyur/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa//rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed chun 'phyang dang / /'dod yon ②rin chen la sogs brgyan/ /de yi phyi rol dur khrod bcas/ /phyogs mtshams bye brag brgyad po ru/ /gtum drag de ni tshig pa yin/ /dbyibs can de ni ma tshig pa/ /tshang tshing dum bur gyur pa yin/ /'bar ba dum bur ma gyur pa/ /dmyal sogs 'jigs par bshad pa yin/ /mi bzad pa ni 'jigs par byed/ /ha har dgod ni mdung rtser bskyon/ /g.yer ka can ni 'gegs pa'o/ /pa ta li dang pan+da ①li/ /sa le shing dang shi ri ṣa/ /u 5—1819

durtswa ra n+ya gro dha/ /a shwata nā ga ①ge sar shing / /dur khrod re re shing re ni/ /dpa' bo sogs kyis dbang du byas/ /bya rog byi la 'ug pa dang / /stag dang khyi dang bya rgod phag /sha za'i gdong bcas brgyad po ni/ /shing rnams steng na 'dug pa yin/ /bya rog spyang ki 'ug pa dang / /dpa' bo khyi dang srin po dang / /phag pa dang ni ro langs dag /rang rang rnam par 'og na gnas/ /de lta bu yi dur khrod kyis/ /gzhal yas khang ni yang dag bskor/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad—/ /de yi dbus su bsgom par bya/ /lte ba'i nang du phyag rgya ni/ /gru gsum me tog kun+da mtshungs/ /nyi zla ā li kā li las/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can/ /rang gi rig pa dang ldan pa/ /phyag rgya yi ni dkyil du bsgom—/ /bde ba chen po 'byung ba ni/ /mchog gi dga' ba'i pho brang las/ /rdo rje ro langs ma ni 'phros④/ /de ni dang po'i ro las so/ /gnyis pa'i ro ni 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje dra ba ma ni 'phros/ /gsum pa'i ro ni 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje rtse mo ma ni 'phros/ /bzhi pa'i ro ni 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje zlum po ma ni 'phros—/ /gcer bu dang ni skra grol ba/ /shar sgo la sogs shes par bya/ /gnag dang dmar dang ser dang dkar/ /spyan gsum pa dang phyag bzhi pa/ /chu srin nya dang seng ge dang / /ga ru ḍa ni phyag g.yas bsnams/ /ka pā la dang kha ṭī ga /sgeg mo yi ni phyag g.yon bsnams/ /gzhan gnyis rdo rje mda' gzhu ni//rna ltag tu ni 'gengs par mdzad/ /kun kyang phyag rgya lnga po 'chang / /sna tshogs pa yi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'jigs byed ro yi gdan gnas nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa/ /yang na shes rab thabs sbyor bas/ /bde chen rgya mtsho'i pho brang las/ /rdo rje'i ske rags ma ni 'phros/ /de ni lnga pa'i ro las 5—1820

so—/ /drug po'i ①ro yi 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje ser mo ma ni 'phros/ /bdun pa'i ro yi 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje rgod ma ma ni 'phros/ /brgyad pa'i ro yi 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje nyi ma mo ni 'phros/ /bcom ldan 'das ni mnyes byed gnas/ /mtshams ni bzhi po ②dag na bzhugs/ /rnga dang de bzhin gling bu dang / /rgyud mangs dang ni rdza rnga dang / /rdza rnga chung ngu chal chung dang / /tam bu ra dang ka ra to/ /de rnams phyag ni gnyis gnyis shes/ /gzugs gnyis pa la 'jig ①chen ma/ /yang ni shes rab thabs sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i nang gi pad chen las//rdo rje legs dgyes ma ni 'phros/ /de ni dang po'i dga' ba las/ /gnyis pa'i dga' ba 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje rgya mtsho ma ni 'phros/ /gsum pa'i dga' ba 'byung ba las/ /rdo rje glang chen ma ni 'phros/ /de dag gnag dang ser dang dmar/ /phyag rgya yi ni grwa na bzhugs/ /gur kum ro dang ga pur dang / /de yis pad snod bkang ba'o/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag na bsnams/ /kha ṭī ga ni g.yon na'o/ /gru gsum phyag rgya dbu steng du/ /mdzub rtse gnyis ni thur du btsugasaske/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub ster ba'o/ /yang ni shes rab thabs sbyor bas/ /rang bzhin gyis dhini dga' ba 'byung / /rang gi rig ma dang ldan pa/ /rang bzhin las ni nyi 'od zhu/ /de nas smon lam gzhan don du/ /rnal 'byor ma la lha mos zhu/ /bde chen legs dgyes mgon po bzhengs/ /rdo rje legs dgyes bdag dga' mdzod/ /mgon po khyod min bdag ro 'dra/ /thugs rje ro yis bdag skye mdzod/ /kye mgon stong pa ⑤chad pa'i mtshan/ /rdor mtsho ma bdag dga' bar mdzod/ /pad+ma'i kha phyi rjorol cig rol/ /mgon po stong pa'i rang bzhin min/ /a la la 5—1821

la legs dgyes mgon/ /rdo rje glang chen ma dga' mdzod/ /khyod rang gis gsungs bdag min na①/ /sangs rgyas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /glu 'di yi ni ngor mdzad nas/ /oṃ hūṃ 'od du zhu las 'phros/ /de las rdo rje gri gug ni/ /yongs su gyur pa las ni nyid/ /dpal chen ye shes mkha' 'gro che/ /lha mo legs dgyes dbang mos 'khyud/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /snying rje yis ni rngam pa ②bzhengs/ /sku mdog sprin byi gnag dang mtshungs/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /zhal ni re re spyan gsum pa/ /zhabs gcig gyen du bsgreng ba ste/ /bdud bzhi yan lag ma dang ldan/ /zhabs gcig gis ni gnon pa yin/ /thod rlon phreng ba'i do shal byas/ /sna tshogs 'od ldan nyi la ①bzhugs—/ /dpa' bo mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug gis yan lag brgyan—/ /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan/ /thor cog zla ba phyed kyis mtshan—/ /sku smad gshin rje'i pags pas dkris/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa'o—/ /gnag dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /g.yon nas bskor ba'i zhal dang ldan/ /'khyud pa'i phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa na ni dril bu'o//nyi ma mda' dang ka pā la/ /khrag gis bkang ba g.yas na bsnams/ /zla ba gzhu dang kha ṭī ga /rdo rjes mtshan pa g.yon na bsnams/ /legs dgyes dbang mo ④de dang mnyam/ /yang na phyag ni gnyis dang ldan/ /zhal gcig pa dang spyan gsum pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyag na gri gug snod ni bsnams—/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs 'khyud cing / /mchog gi rnam pa rang 'od 'byung / /mtshan kun dang ni ldan pa'o/ /skra grol ba dang spyan ring ba/ /sku smad ske rags bar du chad/ /ji ltar sgo sogs rnal 'byor ma/ / brkyang ba ⑤5—1822

la sogs pa yis bzhugs/ /de bzhin gru gsum grwar bzhugs pa/ /sgom pa yis ni shes par bya/ /de lta'i ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /bdag nyid dang ni bcas par bsgom/ /de nas bde ba chen po'i gzhi/ /pad+ma'i snod kyi dbus su ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi lha yi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag nyid/ /lte ba'i me 'od tsha ba yis/ /bdud 3rtsi de ni zhu bar bya/ /rdor gsum ye shes sa bon gyis—/ /dkar byas dag byas 'bar byas rka so/ /sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs gukyis ni/ /rang gi lce yi 'dab mar gzhag /phyi dang nang gi sbyor ba yis/ /lus ni de yis tshim par —bya/ /oṃ yo ga a mṛ ta shudhaḥsarba dharma yo ga a mṛ ta shusgo3haṃ—/ /de nas mgon po'i snying po ni/ /thams cad 'grub don bzlas par bya/ /oṃ ma hā gro dhe shwa ra dzā ya we dza ya ṣ+ṭaṣ+ṭa hā sa ma hā ka pā khāsne bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ṭi dzu gra z-i z-i phaṭa / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ so ra ta 37sa ma ye shwa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ kli sh+lau zlo phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /thog mar oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa mthar/ /bar du ming ni spel bar bya/ /'khor gyi lha mo thams cad kyi/ /mchod pa'i sngags su dran pa'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /de nas gtor ma gtang bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab ni sprad pa'o/ /mthe'u chung lug rgyud rnam pa'i tshul/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni cung zad dgug /rnal 'byor ma rnams thams cad dang / /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad tshur spyon/ /sha dang nya la sogs pa yi/ /gtor ma 'di long sha 7dam tshig bsrungs/ /bdag gi don thams cad la grogs mdzod/ sgrub thabs 'di la dad pa yod pa de bsrung ba'i don du sprul 7 cig /oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/5—1823
