shri ye hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags des me long gi dbang bskur sbyin par bya'o/ /mchod pa byas nas dang po ni mar nag gi hūṃ phaṭa sngags kyis blugs gzar gyis nyi shu rtsa bdun byas te/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dgang gzar gyis gcig pu dbul bar bya'o//de nas bha ga'i phyag rgya bcas te/ sngar gyi rim pas rkang mar la sogs pa zhu ba byas te gcig dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas spyan dang ldan pa'i bha ga'i phyag rgyas khrag gis gcig go/ /de nas rdzas thams cad zur gsum gyis gsum gsum/yam shing sum cu rtsa bdun/ ma du ba la sogs pas re re thug pas bdun bdun no—/ /de nas ma mo chen mo rnams la rdzas thams cad kyis re re/ mar khu dgang gzar gyis gsum gsum/ de rnams la sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ mergalha la hūṃ phaṭa/ khro ①bo mig ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nag po'i pho nya mo la hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sdenag po'i me ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ drag po'i mig ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gshin rje'i lce ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gshin rje'i mche ba ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gshin rje'i rgyal mtshan ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rlung gi brtson 'grus ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rgya mtsho'i snying po ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ chu srin mig ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ chu srin khri kha ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ glang chen rna ba ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ glang che gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ glang chen lto ba ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sbrul lce ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sbrul gyi spyi gtsug ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lo ma gyon ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stag gi gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ seng ge'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dom gyi gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṣ+pe le'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byi la'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ khyi'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phag gi gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bong bu'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khrung khrung gi gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ 'ug 5—1937

pa'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khwa'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bya rog gi gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rma bya'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sha za'i gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ glang chen lngags ①gyon ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ glang chen lce ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mi khrag dga' ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mi'i pags pa gyon ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nag po'i dril bu ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lha thams cad rnam par 'joms ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lha min thams cad 'joms ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lus 'bar ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ral gcig ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ral gsum ma la hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ thal ba'i lus ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bum pa'i rna ba ma la hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ rlung gi shugs can ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ zhal drug ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nu 'phyang ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gsus 'phyang ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ keng rus gdong pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ thal bas byugs ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sha chen dga' ma la hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ nam mkhar 'gro ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sprin sgra ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ glog gdong ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ chu rgyun ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gar byed ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pags mgo ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsā kā'i dbang phyug ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sme sha can ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sme sha can chen mo la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gtum mo la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ thod pa ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ thod pa chen mo la hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod pa byas nas ma mo la rang rang gi sngags kyis dung chen phreng bas re re la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o//de nas me lha'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rdzas thams cad la re res sum cu rtsa bdun dbul bar bya ste/ de gnyis kyi sngags kyi ②brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas snepar bya'o/ /de nas tri hri gi sngags kyis mar snod kyis dgang blugs byed byas te/ phreng ba'i sngags kyis brgyad dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rno ba'i gri gug bzung ste/5—1938

dgra'i cha byad dum bur dum bur byas nas/ phreng ba'i sngags dang rtsa ba'i sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad bsreg par bya'o/ /ma mo rnams la rang rang gi sngags kyis bdun bdun no/ /'byung po dang yi dwags dang sha za la sogs pa la gsum gsum mo/ /phyi nas yang yan lag thams cad dang ldan pa'i mchod pa byas nas/dgra bo'i ming dang spel te/ sngags 'dis khro bo'i ngag gi tshul rmis brgya rtsa brgyad bsreg par bya'o/ /oṃ a mu shaṃ da ha da ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas ma mo rnams la bdun bdun/ 'byung po rnams la re re/ de nas me'i lha'i snying po'i sngags kyis sum cu rtsa bdun grangs kyi rdo rje dril bu dkrol te/ dgang blugs gsal bar bya'o/ /rkang mar la sogs pa rdzas cung zad gtor ma la bzhag ste/gzhan thams cad mar khya dang bsres nas langs te bar ma chad pa'i rgyun gyis nye ba'i snying po'i sngags 'dis dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa dz+dza da ya/ da ha ya na/ sarba duṣ+ṭa hūṃ rben sha ka ya hūṃ hūṃ hri tri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de'i dus su dur khrod kyi skras dgang gzar phyis te/ me lha'i zhal du hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sngags kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i dus su me 'bar ba'i mdog blta bar bya'o/ /mdog dmar po kun du yin na/ the tshom med par don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bstod pa'i rgyal po bya'o/ /bskal pa'i me'i 'od chen po'i sku bdud kyi gnod pa bcom pa rgyal bar gyur cig /sdig pa 'jigs ①par byed pa/ dgra kun 'jigs ④par byed pa rgyal bar gyur cig /bsam du sked pa 'od dpag med bsam 'grub skye ba med pa yin yang de bzhin du don mdzad pa rgyal bar gyur cig /lha dang lha ma yin gyi mgo bo ka pā la dpe med pa'i do shal 'dzin pa rgyal gyur cig /de lta bu'i bstod pa'i rgyal po byas nas/ phyogs bzhi ru sol ba dang ldan pa'i thal bas/5—1939

oṃ be+e tram̐ sa ya bi tram̐ sa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sngags kyis rab tu dgram par bya'o/ /de nas nyid la me'i hom khung gi nang nas oṃ byedahūṃ phaṭa kyi sngags kyis lte ba snying gar mgrin pa dpral bar zig le bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma chen pos bskor te rdo rje glu dang ldan pa'i rdo rje rkang pas gar bya'o/ /de nas mtshan phyed na ral gri la sogs pa mdon cha bzung ste/ sngags 'dis dur khrod don por gtor ma gtang bar bya'o//oṃ ho lo ho lo na ta na ta bi na ta bi na ta tru ta ya tru ta ya tā sa ya tā sa ya/ dgra thams cad sod sod/ bdag la zhi bar mdzod rgyas par mdzod/ sems la bkra shis par mdzod/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de lta bu'i rim pas mar ngo la nyi ma bdun byas te/ oṃ byedahūṃ gi sngags kyis gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de dag gi nyi ma'i bar du dgra nges par 'chi'o/ /gal te re zhig cung zad 'gor na de la gzhan nyi ma bdun bsam gtan 'di bya'o/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/ dgra bo'i lus po dri ma can du bsgom snum pa skra 'dzings pa/ khu ba dang khrag 'dzag cing 'dar ba mdun du bsam par bya'o/ /yang na mngon sum du bsgoms te/ 'bar ba'i khab gzhang kha'i sgor zhugs te/ ha na ha na da ha da ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sngags kyi kha sbub tu ltung bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bsam gtan gyes lha chen po yin yang 'chi'o//'on kyang 'khor ba na gnas pa'i mi lta ci smos/ slob dpon shes rab dpal kyis mdzad pa yan lag brgyad pa'i rim pa las/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstan pa zhes pa'i le'ur bcad pa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bshad de/ tshogs ni 'dir gnyis su dbye ste/ dam tshig tu grags pa dang / ye shes su grags pa'o/ /5—1940

ye shes grags pa la gnyis su dbye ste/ rgyur grags pa dang / 'bras bur grags pa'o/ /rgyur grags pa ni rkun rta bzhin no/ /'bras bur grags pa ni bde ba'i ngo bo la gnyis su dbye ste/ rig pa'i bdag nyid dang / rig pa la sogs pa dang bral ba'o/ dam tshig tu grags pa la yang gnyis te/ bza' ba dang / bsrung ba'o/ /bsrung ba la yang gnyis su dbye ste/ gzhon pa rnams bsrung ba dang / rgan pa rnams la zhe sa dang brda'i tshig go/ /bza' ba la yang gnyis su dbye ste/ thog ma'i bdud rtsi rkan gyi bu ga dang lce gnyis pyong ba de ni gcig go/ /sems can skal ldan byi tshogs su yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs ①pa'i bdud rtsir byas pa ro drug dang ldan pa'i zas mnyam pa'i stabs brim pa zhes pa gnyis pa'o/ /de la dang por re zhig yid dang mthun ②pa'i gnas chom rkun la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral bar/ sna tshogs dri zhim po'i me tog gis yan lag thams cad dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor bya'o/ /der rang gi rim pas dkyil 'khor de'i dkyil 'khor ba'i grangs kyis shes rab dang ldan pa'i stan gcig gi steng du rim pas tshogs gzhag ①par bya'o/ /de yang legs par khrus byas pa dang / sna tshogs gos dang / me tog la sogs pas brgyan pa dang / dam tshig gcig pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i dbus su tshogs kyi gtso bo yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa—/ sna tshogs pa'i stan steng du shin tu mtshan dang ldan pa/ dbang thob pa/brgyad gnyis lo dang ldan pa'i gzugs kyi shes rab ma dang ldan par bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /der las byed pa yang dbang thob pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa—/ nga rgyal med par rem pa/ rnam par mkhas pa ser sna med pa/ khro bo dhi5—1941

la sogs pa dang bral ba sgo srung yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rim pas gtor ma chen po bya'o/ /de'i phyogs dang mtshalas bye brag tu brgyad cu dang ldan par gcig go /de nas kha zas thams cad yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ dang por gtor ma chen pos ①rab tu tshim par bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod de/ tshogs kyi gtso bo la mchod par sdebya'o/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/ dang por re zhig gzhi mnyam gyis byugs te/ me tog dang / mar me dang / spos dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / bye ma dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /'phan dang / dril bus kun du mchod par byas nas/ de'i 'og tu tshogs kyi slob dpon gtso bo yan lag ma la yang de bzhin no/ /las kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon la yang gtso bo bzhin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa so so re re'i me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang tshangs pa'i skud pas so/ /las byed pa la sogs pa la yang de bzhin no/ /tshogs kyi nang na re re zhing rim pas dang po tshogs kyi gtso bo la mchod pa byas te/ de'i 'og tu so so la dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i me tog dang / sgos la sogs pas 'khor lo'i mtha' yan chad do/ /de'i rjes su shin tu sar pa dri ma med pa dum bu gcig pa'i pad+ma'i snod rigs kyi me tog la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ chang gis shin tu khengs par byas pa ste/ yon bdag gi stan gyi steng du tshogs kyi gtso bo'i mdun du gzhag ④par bya'o/ /tshogs dang shes rab dang thabs gnyis la re re'o//de ltar rdzogs nas tshogs kyi gtso bos sngags kyis byin byis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ oṃhūṃ gi sngags kyis brjod de/ gang gi rim pas dkyil 'khor de'i rim pas 5—1942

ka pā la'i nang du bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms te/ rnam par zhu ba'i bdud rtsi bzhin rang gi zhal du gsol te/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo mchod do/ /gru gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gtor ma chen po la yang cung zad dbul bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i rim pas tshogs kyis kyang bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod de/ dam tshig gi kyo ba legs par brim par bya'o/ /de'i 3dus su tshogs kyi gtso bos spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu dkrol te/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo la bsrung bar bya'o/ /las kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis sngags 'dis so/ /oṃ hri hri bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ tre tre kro kro phro ā+oṃ thru sum̐ to ro to ro/ kye bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po tshur gshegs tshur gshegs tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di la rnam pa thams cad kyis bsrung ba mdzod cig /tshogs kyi gtso bo la snying gar 'jug cing ro thams cad kyi ro'i mchog gsol cig hūṃ la 7hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar bsrung ba dang spyan drang ba byas nas las kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang byas te/ pad+ma bskor ba'i phyag rgyas tshogs kyi gtso bo la pad+ma'i sgod dbul bar byas te/ tshogs la yang 'di skad bsgo ba sbyin te/ kye tshogs kyi bdag po pad+ma bskor ba'i phyag rgyas snod bzung la shes rab dang lhan cig tu btung ba mdzod/ dam tshig gi kyo ba la gsol cig /de rnams kyis kyang tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag byas te/ de ltar bgyis zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gzhan las kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyis ji ltar bka' stsal pa de ltar dad par bya'o/ /gang gi phyir zhe na/ de ni rje btsun rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa'o/ /de bzhin du yang dpal ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ji ltar dpal rdo rje sems dpar grags/ de ltar dpal ldan las kyi rdo rje zhes 5—1943

gsungs so/ /gang gi skabs su tshogs kyi gtso bo ji lta ba'i phyag rgya bcing ba mdzad pa de lta bur tshogs kyis kyang bcing bar bya'o/ /skabs su gang zhig la sogs pa'i dgongs pa tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal te/ thams cad bya'o/ /tshogs kyi nang du rkang pa brkyang ba dang / ka ba la sogs pa la brten pa dang /rked par lag pa 'jog pa dang / sor mo la sogs pa 'dren pa dang / rgod pa dang / phan tshun gtam smra ba dang / the tshom dang gnyid dang / mchil ma la sogs pa 'dor ba dang / gzhan gyi snod la blta ba dang / bdag la byin zhes pa'i tshig dang / mi dga' ba dang / chang mang po 'thung ba dang /kham che ba dang / lag pa gcig gis 'thung ba dang / gzhan gyi shes rab ma la 'dod pa dang / lhag ma sbyin pa dang tshul 'chos 3kyi bsam gtan dang /lta ba dman pa'i phyogs su lta ba dang / skyug pa la sogs pa mi bya'o/ /de rnams kyi nang na gal te cig chad nas des kyang ci 'byor pa'i chad pa bya'o/ /de yang chad pa 'phel bar byas nas/ tshogs tshim par bya'o/ /de nas rim gyis bdud rtsi bcud dang ldan pa'i zas dang btung ba brim par bya'o/ /de yang dal bu dal bus gsol bar bya'o/ /gang gis dga' ba 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs su ngal bso ste/ las kyi rdo rjes gang bgyi bka' stsal pa de'i tshe mnyan pa dang / dbyangs 'jam pas bya'o/ /de'i dus su gal te rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa brtag pa'i phyir 'ong na/ de rnams la tshogs kyi gtso bo'am las kyi rdo rje bsnyun gsol ba la sogs pa mdzad pa de bzhin du tshogs kyis kyang bya'o/ /de lta bu'i rim pas nyin bdun nam yang na gsum bya'o/ /rtag tu zas thams cad dang ldan pa chu la sogs pa dang bsres nas gtor ma oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ gi sngags 5byed/94 4

kyis 'bad pas gtang bar bya'o/ /thams cad rdzogs nas drug ldan la sogs pa'i glus mchod par bya'o/ /lhag ma gcig tu byas nas 'phan la sogs pas brgyan par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gshegs su gsol ba'i mchod pa byas nas gtor ma'i nang du me bzhag ste/ gtor ma re re so so'i lag tu sbyin par bya'o/ /gtor ma chen po las kyi rdo rje slob dpon la chu dang bsres pa sgo srung ba la/ kha cig rdo rje dril bu 'khrol zhing / kha cig rnge'u chung / kha cig spos 'dzin/kha cig me tog bkram par byed pa/ kha cig snod 'dzin pa/ kha cig glu len pa/de ltar rim pas chu bo chen por song nas/ rdo rje rkang pa dang ldan pa'i gar bya'o//de'i 'og tu mchod pa byas te/ bcom ldan ma ro langs ma'i sngags kyis sam/yang na gang gi rim pa'i dkyil 'khor rmi 'khor lo de'i rim pa'i sngags kyi gtor ma chen po gtong bar bya'o/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma/ oṃ ustsoṣ+ṭa badz+ra yak+ṣa aṣ+ṭi ti tiṣ+ṭha bi ba ta hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jig rten skyong ba la phyogs dang mtshams bye brag brgyad oṃ gyi rnam pa dang / hūṃ phaṭa mthar/ bar du ming spel te 'byung po dang yi dwags dang sha za rnams la chu dang bsres pa sngar bstan pa bzhin no/ /de'i dus su gal te gang zhig brgya byen 'dra ba 'ong na de la re zhig 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /de'i mdun du g.yas brkyang ba bya ste/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ khro bo'i tshul kyis phe'i rnam pa drug brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma chen po'i snod la sogs pa ②chus gang bar byas nas/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad la sogs pa brjod la gnas su 'gro bar bya'o/ /slob dpon shes rab dpal gyis mdzad pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i rim pa las/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'ur 1bcad pa dgu pa'o// //5—1945

gang rgyud pad+ma la dga' yis gsungs rnal 'byor ma la sogs ni rmad du byung / /de yi nang nas shin tu rnam dpyad 'di drangs bla ma kun gyi yang dag nor—/ /'dir ni bdag rang gis ni cung zad rang bzo ma yin 'on kyang 'dus pa byas/ /de las gang zhig 'bras mchog thob pa de ni sems can kun la 'phel bar shog /yan lag brgyad pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad nas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //a ṭi rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1891 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zon lag brgyad pa'i rim pa bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko / 〈〈snar 〉sko rje/1892 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7gang / ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ripa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉skos 1ṇa/⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ston cig du〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7)/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 pa'i/1893 sne〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉(6sa so/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)/ ①〈〈snar 〉maradi ltar/1894 nyu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tharlab ste/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉she ra/ ①〈〈snar 〉ra / dhirjodu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉sprosasti/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ste// ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉5)/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku/1895 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉'jigs/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanam/ du〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉mizhag⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkaste/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7bzhi pa ni slob ma'i sta gon/ ⑧rte〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dkyil 'khor ba'i/1896 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dang / ⑤〈〈co 〉thaphen/ pe〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉glo'i/ ④〈〈snar 〉zab/1897 ⑨snozhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thazhag1898 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kujig rten/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tha/ ④〈〈co 〉༅/5byed1946
bsdur 'bras re'u migathad/ (165)5wa 1950

༄ga /rin po che'i 'od ces bya ba/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na pra bha nā ma/ bod skad du/ rin po che'i 'od ces bya ba/ rang snang rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum gsal thugs rje rig pa'i dpal/ /sku gsum rig pa nyid ldan la/ /dang ba'i tshul byis 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje byin rlabs rna brgyud la/ /'phags pa'i gsung dang byin rlabs kyis/ /rang snang nyi ma lta bur gsal/ /gsal byed rin chen snang ba 'di/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad la/ /dbyer med tshul du ldan gyis kyang / /bdag 'dzin log pa'i sems kyis dkrugs/ /sa 'og bum pa ji bzhin pas/ /rin chen snang ba rang 'bar yin/ /'gro ba'i bla ma 'das gyur kyang / /'gro ba mun pa la gnas nas/ /mos pa'i rnal 'byor mig med la/ /snying po 'od kyi don du bshad/ /gting ltar mi gsal rin po che/ /skal ldan rnal 'byor mos 'jug gis/ /rtog med mthong ba'i lam 5—1951

rtogs dang / /bgrod ①med 'bras bu rang snang yin/ /pad+ma gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bde gshegs gsum gyi sku ldan pa/ /rnam grol 'bras bu rang gzhag sdeyin/ /gzhi nas ma g.yos rang bzhin 'grub/ /chos nyid sku la 'gyur ba med/ /rang rig bde ba chen po nyid/ /rgyu la mi gnas mthar thug pa—/ /theg chen rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /rin chen gsung gis shes 'gyur te/ /bsam med brjod bya snying po'i don/ /kun gyi brjod pa sems kyi dbyings—/ /rang rang mos pa'i shes pa rtogs/ /lam gyi rtsol bas 'bras bu tshol④—/ /rang mos bsam pa'i sa la gnas/ /sman pa'i 'dod pas re ba 'jog /snying po lam la 'dod pa bral/ /yid la mi byed rang bzhin gnas/ /rig pa'i gzer gyes 'da' ba med/ /sgom pa med la bya ba bral/ /lta ba med pa'i snying po ni/ /rang gzhag sems kyi rig pas shes/ /char yang dang ni thig le tshul/ /tshul tsam mchog dang gzhan mchog don/ /shes rab gsang bas na ro la/ /snyan khung brgyud pa bzhi yi gnas0/ /rdo rje bka' ni rtogs pa'i lam—/ /byed pa'i sgra la gnyer ba'i sems/ /tshul bzang rtsol la gang gnas pa / /byed pa'i don dang phrad gyur nas/ /bya ba'i rang bzhin shes par bya/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rig pa nyid/ /gsum gyi byed pa'i 'od kyis mthong / /gsum gyi 'od gsal gzhi yi lam/ /byed dang bral ba nyid la gnas/ /lam gyis lam kyi 'bras bu mthong / /'bras bu dgongs pa rgyal ba'i thugs/ /bsam med rang gzhag rig pa'i ngang / /bde chen mi rtog rgyu ba bral/ /yid la mi byed snang ba dag /rim pa ma 'gags ye shes gsal/ /dbang po pad+ma rgyas pa'i sems/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /mjong ba log pa gzhan 5—1952

yod kyang / /sprul sku dang po gzhan las min/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa nyid—/ /snang ba'i dus ma bzung byas la/ /dran pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs—/ /'phen pa dang po'i dus na'o/ /rin chen gsung gis brtags pa las—/ /thabs kyi bye brag shes 'gyur na/ /thog ma pad+ma ji bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi ye shes 'phro/ /de ldan rgyal ba'i gral du gnas/ /thugs rjes kun ldan rnyog pas bslad/ /dngas ma dus gsum 'gyur ba med/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma sngags kyi sems/ /spyod pa bral ba'i dus na shes/ / btang gzhag ①rang bzhin ma tsha bral/ /'khor ba rnam par mi sems te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu ba bral/ /rdzogs pa'i dgongs pa bya ba med/ /dus gsum ma yengs srog tu sems/ /blang dor mi mnga' lta ba med/ /rang bzhin rgyal ba'i lta ba yin/ /mi rtsol dbu ma dang po lam/ /gang gis ma bcos thugs kyi lam//snying ga pad+ma rin chen 'od/ /'od gsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /chags pa la sogs nyon mongs lnga/ /mthar thug tha ma dus na mthong / /gang skyes dus na yul mi dpyad/ /mi 'gag ngo bo nyid la gzhag① /gsang ba'i pad+ma chos kyi sku/ /ma bcos rang gsal gzung 'dzin bral/ /rdzogs pa'i longs spyod bde ba'i sku/ /sprul sku gang la ngos gzung med/ /dbyer med rig pa gcig la gnas/ /'dzin dang bral ba'i mngon sum pa/ /chags dang bral ba'i bde ba che/ /tha snyad bral ba'i thabs kyis mtshon/ /rtsod dang bral ba'i spyod pas blang / /spro bsdu med pa'i dgongs par gnas/ /snang ba rgya mtsho chen po bzhin/ /rang bzhin ①rig pa de bzhin no/ /yon tan sna tshogs nam mkha' bzhin/ /dus gsum 'gyur med kun du bzang / /sangs rgyas sems 5—1953

can gnyis su med/ /'khor ba nyid na rang bzhin dag /rin chen dag pa ji bzhin no/ /ji ltar bcos kyang 'gyur ba med/ /rang bzhin chos nyid ngo bo la//sgo skur spros pa dang gis med/ /'dzin pa'i spyod pa log pas bslad/ /rang 'byung rig pa'i don ma rtogs/ /rang 'byung kun mkhyen rig pa'i thugs/ /'gyur med 'gro ba kun la gnas/ /mkha' 'dra ①ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /sgrub med dngos grub chen po la/ /bsrung med dam tshig rang gzhag ②ste/ /mtha' med dbus med rig par gsal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo la sems can kun kyi rang bzhin yin/ /ye shes rig pa rtogs gyur nas/ /thugs rje mdzad pa'i lam yang ston/ /sems kyi 'bras bu rang gzhag ④la/ /'dod pa'i rtsol bas sgrub mi byed/ /byang chub sems kyi lam chen ni/ /rnam dag ye shes dgongs pa'i lam/ /thun mong 'gro ba yongs la gnas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas las byung bdu/ /bgrod med rang rig ye shes lam/ /rang 'dod bltas pas grub pa med/ /rdzogs pa'i lam la gang gnas pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rang gzhag ⑤la/ /yid la mi byed yengs pa med/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs pa bcos med la/ /'dod rtsol thig le spro bsdu med/ /ye nas rjordzogs pa'i rnam dag la/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun dang ldan/ /rlung gi 'jug pa rang bzhin zhi—/ /ye shes brtsal med bde ba la/ /dga' ba bzhi yi bde ba gnas/ /gang spyod thabs la ma brten yang / /rin chen snang ba'i thabs kyis shes/ /brda sprod tshig la gnas 'gyur yang / /thig le rang byung nyid la 'chang / /rtog dpyod yan lag the tshom bral/ /sems kyi dga' bde rtsol ba med/ /gnas pa rtse gcig yengs pa med/ /bde ba mtshan nyid chos skur gnas/ /ye shes gsang 5—1954

ba thabs chen gyis/ /sems kyi bag chags thabs chen kyi/ /gyur pa gsum la de bzhin 'gyur/ /sems kyi ye shes gter kha dbye/ /rang 'byung ye shes 'od gsal la/ /rgyu med rig pa gdod nas gnas/ /ye shes rang gnas bde ba che//kun mkhyen me long lta bu nyid/ /ma lus snang ba'i rang bzhin dag /sems kyi chos nyid bde ba ①shes/ /kun bzang nyams cig cir ma mthong mthong med gsal ba'i me long nyid/ /dngos po med pa'i rig pa yin/ /'dra'am mi 'dra rgyu gang nyid/ /bdag gam gzhan nam ②de nyid gang / /grub bam ma grub ji ltar bskyed/ /de ltar grub na thug pa med/ /de ltar min na gang zhig ni/ /gnyis ka de med ri bong rwa/ /gang gzhan rgyu las grub pa ni①/ /gcig dang du ma gang du 'grub/ /'jig rten rgyu 'bras chos bzhin nadu/ /yang dag ye shes brdzun nam ci/ /de ltar bdag lta log pa bzhin/ /spang bya nyid 'gyur yang dag min/ /mi mthun gnas pa'i chos yin na/ /zhen pa nyid 'gyur de nyid rig /de lta min na gang zhig 'thad/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gang gnas par/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang 'jug pa/ /gang gis gang zhig ji ltar gnas/ /rtsol ba'i bskyed pa de nyid dam/ /ye shes rig pa'i don la 'jug /de nyid yin na de lta mod/ /de lta min na gang zhig 'thad/ /thams cad thams cad grub pa'am—/ /ma yin de la 'thad pa dang / /rjes mthun rgyu yis mi gnas na/ /de bzhin rjes mthun nyid du 'gyur/ /des na seng ge phru gu bzhin/ /sku gsum lhun grub bde ba'i lam/ /rtsol ba'i 'bras bu mthar phyung nas/ /'jig rten chos la'ang de bzhin no/ /sbyang bya 'bras bu yin pa na/ /khyod la dag pa'i ye shes gang / /de lta nyid na rtag par 'gyur/ /des na rang 'byung 5—1955

rdzogs pa'i lam/ /rgyu la mi gnas rtsol ba med/ /rang gnas ye shes gdod nas grub/ /grub pa'i rang bzhin bskyed ①mi dgos/ /ye gsal nam mkha'i rang bzhin pas/ /gsal byed rnam pa ji bzhin no/ /zla ba gzugs 'dra gang gis 'byung / /dbyings kyi 'bras bu bsam mi khyab/ /mi rtog 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /che ba'i sku gsum mu mtha' med/ /ye shes rig pa thug phrad du/ /rin chen snang bas gzhag ①par bya/ /brjod bral rig pa thog babs nyid—/ /ma brtsal rang 'byung bde ba nyid/ /yi ge med pa'i gsum mchog ste/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ston/ /mi rtog don mjal ①goms shing rtogasag/yi ge med dang rig pa'i gsung / /don gyi chos nyid mjal ⑤bar ston/ /gsang sngags gter byi mdzod 'dzin cing / /rgyal ba'i grag sngags tha snyad bral/ /sngags tshig bral ba'i nus mthu ldan/ /las gzhi dumed pa'i don gyis 'grub/ /rgyu med 'bras bu mthar thug yin/ /rig pa mtha' bral dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhen med tshul gyis 'jug na bde/ /dang po rang sems tshul la brtag /rig pa bla ma'i gdams pa bzhin/ /drod dang ldan na brda don sprad/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi ye shes la/ /sgra yis mtha' la gzhag dze+epar bya/ /myong ba med pa'i rnam pa yin/ /tshor ba bral ba'i reg byas go⑧/ /phyi rol tshul bzhin nges par 'gyur/ /tha mar dran bsams rgyu ba bral/ /dpa' rtul ⑨za byed sems lta bu/ /shes pa dang bzhag ma brtul ⑩ba/ /stag mo lta bu sems la ni/ /ye shes rol pa mi 'gag pas/ /rtsol ⑪med ye shes rig pa'i ngang / /des na rang bzhin cog 'jog go /dngos po ji ltar snang ba yang / /rang gi shes pa nyid du mthong / /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /thugs la 'jog pa'i 5—1956

man ngag bcud/ /rin chen shar bas rang la rdzogs/ /rtsol ①bral rig pa mi rtog pa/ /ma bcos rang snang bde ba'i klong / /ye shes lhun grub klong du shar//rang 'byung nam mkha' lta bur khyab/ /rang gsal rig pa'i dang la gnas/ /spros bral ye shes thig le che/ /rnam rtog bral ba'i rig pa gsal/ /rang gi cir yang mi rtog pa/ /ye shes rang gnas sems su gsal/ /ci yang mi rtog sems su smin/ /ci yang ma yin dmigs su med/ /rnam rtog sems kyi rgyu ba bral / /rig pa'i ye shes 'dzin pa bral/ /rang snang rol pa byang chub sems//sgyu ma'i ye shes bde ba'i klong / /rang rig ye shes 'dzin pa yin/ /rang 'byung sgyu mar mngon sum gsal/ /lhun grub ye shes ma bcos pa/ /bde ba'i sgyu ma rang rig nyid/ /thams cad ye shes sems su 'char/ /rig pa'i ye shes don gsal ba/ /thams cad ye shes nyid du mthong / /ye shes ma yin gang yang med/ /khams gsum dngas ma ye shes nyid/ /ye shes rig pa'i thabs kyis shes/ /'khrul pa'i sa nas brda bkrol sdete/ /ye shes rgyal ba'i gral du gzhagaske /ma bcos sku gsung thugs su gnas/ /rang rig sems kyi 'bar ba nyid/ /ye shes sems kyi phur pa thebs/ /rnam rtog bzhon pa rlung dang bral/ /dngos grub bde ba'i rang byung nyid/ /thar pa'i lam mchog byang chub sems/ /'bras bu mthar phyin rig pa nyid/ /rang byung sems kyi ji bzhin la/ /rnam pa'i rig pa thabs kyis gnas/ /bcos med dgongs pa bde chen 'di/ /mngon sum mthong la ngos gzung rjomed/ /rang shar dngos por grub pa med/ /bde chen rig pa ma mthong ste/ /'di dang bral na rtog pa nyid—/ /bka' yi don dang de mi ldan/ /dmus long mdun du gzugs snang 5—1957

bzhin—/ /'bras bu mthar phyin yod ma yin/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i don dang 'gal/ /rang gsal dgongs pa'i thugs ma rig /'dzin pa'i cha la gang gnas kyang / /'khor ba'i 'bras bu nyid du 'gyur/ /rang 'dod don gyi mthar ma phyin/ /ye shes gsang ba bde ba'i sa/ /'dod pas mi 'grub thob pa med/ /'dod med rang bzhin nyid las byung / /shes pa rang lugs so ma nyid—/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'o/ /tha mal shes pa 'di nyid la/ /bsams ①pa'i sems med rang gzhag ④yin/ /nges pa'i gzhi ①ni don la gnas//yid ches bla ma nyid la gus/ /rin chen gdams ngag gter du 'chang / /lung gi dgongs pa'i don gsal te/ /rig pa rang gsal gtan la phebs/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa' 'chang / /ston pa rang rig nyid yin pas/ /drang ba'i don la sems mi 'jug /phyi rol 'dod rtsol sems dang bral/ /rdzogs pa'i bka' la yid mi 'gyur/ /bla ma rin chen srog tu 'dzin/ /mos pa rang gi 'dod pa gtong / /rin chen gter gyi ngo bo 'di/ /srog dang bral ba'i kha bzhin bsdam/ /rang sems byang chub sems 'di la/ /ye shes ma rig tha dad med/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul rig par gcig /zhen rtog brtags pa sna tshogs dang / /ye shes 'od gsal ngo bo nyid/ /'od gsal rang 'byung sems su gcig /byang chub sems la ngo bo bral/ /don ldan ye shes nyid du mthong / /bsam pas brtags pa sna tshogs pa/ /bag chags log pa'i rkyen gyis mthong / /rang rig ye shes/ 'jug pa dang / /rtog pa'i bag chags dang po ni/ /sgrib pa ma lus bzhin grub cing / /byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid la/ /thog ma dang bral tha ma med/ /thog med 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di/ /byang 5—1958

chub sems la ye nas dag /sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ /blo bur gzugs brnyan sprin gyis bsgribs/ /ngo bo ma yin rkyen gyis snang / /me dang lcags kyi rang bzhin 'dra/ /rang bzhin bral ba ma yin te/ /dus gsum ma yin nam mkha' bzhin/ /chos sku rang bzhin ye nas dag /longs spyod rang gi bde ba nyid/ /sprul pa chu zla lta bur snang / /dbyer med rig pa gcig gi ngang / /blang dor gnyis bral mnyam pa nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes la/ /snying po mnyam nyid ye sangs rgyas/ /snying po don la rtsol ba med/ /don gyi rang 'byung gnyis su med/ /sems kyi rang rig rtog pa nyid/ /rnam rtog ye shes nyid du 'bar/ /brtsal med 'bras bu mthar thug nyid/ /bka' yi bcud 'dus snying po 'di/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du bdud rtsi 'dus/ /snying po'i don 'di gsang ba'i bcud/ /gsal ba'i sgon ma snying po 'di/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i 'khor lo yin/ /snying po gsung gis rtogs bya ba/ /sems nyid rang 'byung snying po nyid/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dus/ /'byung 'jug mi mnga' snying por gsal/ /rang 'byung rdzogs pa'i dgongs par gnas/ /ye shes snying po mkha' 'dra ba/ /mtha' dbus mi mnga' blang dor med/ /mi len snying po bdag med gsal/ /bka' yi bcud 'dus snying po 'di/ /rang bzhin snying po sman chen rtogs/ /'khor ba'i zug rngu 'byin pa'i mchog /byang chub sems kyi sman med na/ /rtsol ba'i 'jug pa mtho ris rgyu/ /sman chen rang la gnas bzhin du/ /mi rtog gzhan nas tshol bar byed/ /rnyed pas rang sems sman du mthong / /rtogs pas gzhan nas ma 'ongs te/ /rang 'byung snying po thog ma med/ /spros bral nam mkha' lta bur gnas/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang rang 5—1959

bzhin ldan/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i dang la bzhugs/ /bde ba'i don la ma chags rol/ /snang ba ye shes rig par gnas/ /byang chub sems kyi sman chen 'di—/ /ye shes rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas lam du bde—/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dgongs pa ni/ /shes pa rang gzhag ①so ma nyid/ /snying po don rtogs bya ba bral/ /rang gsal rig pa'i ngang la bzhugs/ /bcos med 'dzin bral ①'phro 'du med/ /byang chub rgyu ba snying po bral/ /kun 'byung rig pa 'pho 'gyur med/ /thugs rje rang 'byung ye shes nyid/ /rtsol bral rang snang byin rlabs 'byung / /phyogs ris mi mnga' kun la khyab/ /snying po nyid du kun sgol mdzad/ /byams pa chos nyid ngang du skyabs/ /dga' ba rang rig mi 'bral ba/ /blang dor gnyis med btong snyoms che/ /rang 'byung snying po 'khor lo la/ /rtogs ②bral 'khor ba rang bzhin dag /thugs rjes sems can don mi mdzad/ /dngos po mi mnga' rang 'byung sems/ /'od gsal snying po rdzogs pa 'di/ /rin chen gsung gis brtags pas shes/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ /rang gnas ye shes nyid ldan pa/ /brtag pa gsum kyis shes par 'gyur/ /ming dang sems la ye shes tshol/ /dngos po gang yang rung ba la/ /brtags pas rang log shes par 'byung / /yid bzhin rin chen nor bu bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i gnas lugs dang / /thun mong dam tshig gsum ldan pa'o/ /lce mnan nang yig sgra la sogs/ /de bzhin gnas skabs gzhan du yang / /snying po ye shes gzung bar bya/ /snying po gsung 'di don dang 'byel/ /skal ldan rin chen lta bu yis/ /grub mtha' ngan la gnas dus su/ /'di yis don kun rig par gyis/ /'di yis rang 5—1960

sems ma rig na/ /sgra 'am tshad ma gang gis kyang / /rig pa'i ye shes rnyed mi 'gyur—/ /gzhi nyid rang 'byung 'gyur ba med/ /rtog pa rang 'byung sems kyi lam/ /ma yengs byang chub sems su gsal/ /rang 'byung 'bras bu mthar phyin pa/ /'gro don mdzad la rtog pa grol/ /'od gsal dbyer med gcig gi ngang / /byang chub sems kyi rang rig 'di/ /bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis na/ /brtags pas sna tshogs med bzhin grub/ /sems kyi bag chags phyir snang yang / /rig pa 'od gsal 'gyur ba med/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i rang bzhin 'di/ /snying po gsung gis brjod bya ste/ /'khrul pa ma yin log snang bas/ /rang rig byang chub sems su brjod/ /rtog pa'i rtsa ba byang chub sems—/ /rang rig sems la rtog par 'khrul/ /thog ma med dus bag chags dang / /rin chen gdams ngag rkyen med pas/ /rtog med snying po sems ma goms/ /thag pa sbrul min snang ba bzhin/ /lus ngag sems dbyen sgyu ma'i lus/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i rang bzhin 'di/ /chos nyid yin par dbyer med pas/ /zung du 'jug pa gang dgongs pa/ /gsal ba'i sems de nyid la ni/ /chos nyid ma yin bag mi snang / /thams cad snang ba'i ngo bo 'di—/ /ye shes snying po nyid du mthong / /ngo bo nyid la brjod pa bral/ /rang bzhin rnam dag rig pa la/ /brjod med don du ma brjod na/ /rig pa'i don la mjal ①ba med/ /brjod pa'i sgra la sems drangs pas/ /ma bcos rang 'byung chos nyid mthong / /rang rig sems la don rtogs nas/ /'jug thabs mi gnyis tshul gyis gnas/ /cig car rdzogs pa bde ba che/ /phyogs su ma lhung gzung ba'i sems/ /rdzogs pa'i ye shes snying po la/ /rim 5—1961

pa'i lam med mthar phyin sa/ /rang byung rtogs pa'i 'jug pa la/ /de nyid snying po don ldan pas/ /'dod pa'i tshogs la yid mi 'jug /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa drug /rang 'byung rdzogs pa'i sems la gnas/ /bsam bral mi rtog ①dgongs pa la/ /de nyid pha rol phyin drug ldan/ /mi rtog 'dzin med tshul la gnas/ /ma yengs rig pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /dmigs med shes pa pha rol phyin/ /sems nyid stong pa'i dngos med la/ /chos dang chos can mi gnas pas/ /dbyer med bden pa bzhi po don/ /dngos po ye shes 'gags ma yin/ /bden brdzun nyid ②kyi mthar mi 'dzin/ /snying po'i don la 'dod pa bral/ /kun bzang ye shes 'od gsal la/ /bsam bral ye shes nam mkha' 'dra / /rdzogs pa ye shes ma bcos pa/ /mi 'gyur chos nyid dbyings kyi thugasarka/ /mi 'gag ye shes rig pa'i gsung / /dbyer med chos sku gzung 1'dzin bral/ /sku gsung thugs bral sku gsung thugs/ /phyi nang mi mnga' rang gsal nyid/ /'byung 'jug mi mnga' rang bzhin gnas/ /dbang po ngo la snang ba'i ④rnams/ /chos nyid byang chub sems su mthong / /nyon mongs lnga po ye shes lam/ /thams cad byang chub sems kyi gzhi/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /dag pa'i sems la brtsal rjomed de/ /brtsal duba'i kun rdzob grub ma yin/ /dam pa'i don la gang 'jug pas/ /gsang ba rdzogs pa'i don nyid la/ /chos nyid gsang ba 'di dmigs na/ /nges pa'i gdams ngag zab mo yis/ /brtsal ⑦med rang gzhag brtsal ⑧ba dang / /mi bsgom rang lugs bsgom pa dang / /mi gnas tshul la 'dug pa dang / /gzhag stimed mnyam gzhag ⑩rang 'byung bde/ /mi rtog don la byi na ba/ /dge mi dge yi rnam 5—1962

rtog bral/ /byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rang 'byung byang chub brtsal ①ba min/ /byang chub 'dod la byang chub sems/ /yang dag don gyi snying po 'di//btsal bas rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ /zhen sems nyid la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /nyal ba'i bsam gtan 'khor lo bde/ /ma lus byang chub sems kyi ngang / /chos nyid byang chub mnyam gzhag na/ /dngos med byang chub rang 'byung dang / /'dus ma byas pas bde ba'i klong / /sems nyid bsam med brjod las 'das//ye nas rnam dag bsam du med/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor rig ②pa yis de la ma brtsal ①gnas na bsgoms/ /rig pa rjodabyings la yan bzhag na/ /brtsal ⑤ba'i nad bral bsgom pa yin/ /bde dubs snying po dri ma med/ /rig pa 'od gsal nyid du bsgom/ /'od gsal sems la gnas gyur na④/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma rang bzhin zhi/ /skye ba med pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /rang snang kun bzang rol pa 'grub/ /dngos med dngos la mi dmigs shing / /dbu ma'i sems bral rgyu ba bral/ /sems kyi rgyu ba med pas na/ /thams cad rang 'byung stong pa nyid/ /sems nyid rig pa rang 'byung ba/ /'gyur med skyod ⑦med gsal bas na/ /yi ge med pa'i snying po gsung / /dam pa byang chub sems la gnas/ /rgyal po'i dam tshig ma bcos pa/ /bsrung ba med pa'i tshul gyis bsrung / /'gyur ba med pa'i phyag rgya la/ /'gyur ba med pa'i don gyis 'debs—/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ye shes 'phro 'du med par gsal/ /bsam bral rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs/ /byang chub sems la 'da' ba med/ /sa 'dzin rnam pa'i sems bzhin du/ /gzhan nas rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ /brtags na rang sems nyid la thug /gzhi la rang gzhag ⑨5—1963

gzhan 'dod bral/ /rang sems rig pa 'gyur ba med/ /ji bzhin mi rtog chos kyi sku/ /bya bral lhun grub ji bzhin gnas/ /rang 'byung 'od gsal ye nas dag /cir yang mi dgongs bsam mi khyab/ /shes rab snying rje ldan pas 'grub—/ /snying po byang chub rang bzhin la/ /bsam med rang gzhag ①thugs su bde/ /'khor lo'am rig pa bde ba yis/ /rang gnas rig pa tshol ba nyid//rnam rtog yin te don la med/ /blon rigs ②gsum las dmangs kyi yang / /chags pa'i 'du shes drang ba'i don/ /nges par spros bral rang 'byung sems/ /chags pa'i lam gyis shes mi 'gyur/ /blang dor med pa'i brtul zhugs kyang / /nges par brtags na blang dor nyid/ /rang rig bsam bral gzhag ①pa ste/ /don dngos 'dzin pa zhen par gnas/ /rang 'byung 'od gsal snying po 'di/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rang bzhin pas/ /shes rab thabs kyi chags pa bral/ /thig le 'dod rtsol spro bsdu med/ /rang rig rtsol bral bde ba'i gnasarjo/ /shes rab thabs la snyoms 'jug pas/ /bde ba'i bsam gtan chen po yin/ /sgyu ma'i ro la ma chags pas/ /chags med ye shes rdzogs pa'i lam/ /byang chub sems kyi rang gsal 'di/ /dngos med shes rab thabs kyis 'grub/ /snang gsal 'khor lo rig pa 'di/ /ngo bo ma grub me shel 'dra/ /dngos med ye shes mthong ba grol/ /gzugs sogs snang ba brtags pa yin/ /dngos po rang bzhin thams cad ni/ /chos nyid dbyengs kyi thig le yin/ /de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs su ni/ /snying po rig pa nyid shar bas/ /mtha' yi mun pa ngang gis dag /sgrub med rang 'byung sgrub pa 'dis/ /khams gsum 'od gsal thugs su sgrub/ /rang sems rig pa'i spyod pa bde/ /ye shes spyod pa rang 5—1964

gzhag ①nyid/ /bsal ②nas 'dod pa'i mtha' mi 'gegs/ /thugs rje tshogs kyi bsod nams 'dir/ /rang 'byung rig pa rtogs gyur nas/ /'gro ba drang phyir rgyun mi bcad/ /snying po sems kyi don rig na/ /ye shes mthar phyin 'bras bur gnas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rang bzhin grub/ /sprul pa rang 'dod cir yang 'byung / /chu gsal ri bong can bzhin no/ /ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs/ /me shel gzugs ltar 'gro ba sgol/ /ye shes rang byung de bzhin gshegs/ /yan lag mi mda' rtsis las 'das/ /mthar phyin dga' ba rig par gsal/ /dgongs pa rang gzhag ①ye sangs rgyas/ /rig pa rang gsal chos rnams la/ /gang yang bsam du med par gnas/ /de ltar byang chub sems nyid la/ /ma rig med pas 'khor ba med/ /sems can skye ba'i rgyu ma gnas/ /rang 'byung sems la rtag par gzhug /srid pa'i chos la rgyu med pas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam dang bral/ /ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la/ /nam yang skye bar mi 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas sems can rang bzhin gcig /sems kyi ye shes gsang ba 'di/ /snying po don las rmad du byung / /rang 'byung che ba bdag nyid sku/ /rang rig bde ba rdzogs pa che/ /thugs rje snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /ngo bo ma grub gsang ba'i sems/ /snang dang mi snang dbyer med do/ /yod dang med pa byang chub sems/ /snang ba rang rig tha dad pa/ /don dang rtags la sogs pa'i rjornams/ /rnam pa tha dad bag chags snang / /yang dag ma yin 'khrul ba'i sems/ /bsam pa'i dbang gis der 'gyur ro/ /bde gshegs ye shes gsang ba de/ /ma mthong rnam rtog spros 'chal bas/ /stong nyid rig pa'i man ngag yin/ /dran rtog rlung gi rgyu 5—1965

ba bral/ /mtha' ru ma skyes bsam gtan bya/ /chos dang chos nyid gang yang min—/ /nam mkha' lta bu bdag med pa/ /ye shes stong pa'i ngo bo'o rang bzhin stong pa mtshan ma med/ /rnam thar gsum ldan bde ba che/ /chags med gzhi yi lam nas 'jug① /mtshan med ngang la gnas pa na/ /rang 'byung 'bras bu ngang gis 'char/ /yon tan nam mkha' mtha' dang mnyam/ /rang gi ye shes snang ba la/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gsal/ /rgyun gyi 'khor lo sku yi dang / /chags bral dag pa rig pa'i rgyan/ /rang rig gsal ba ting 'dzin nyid/ /mi zad 'khor bo bsam du med/ /sgo bral stong nyid zhi gnas la/ /'du shes 'jug med mnyam gzhag la/ /mtshan med zhi gnas lhag mthong 'byel/ /mos 'jug lam la gang gnas nas/ /mi rtog gsal ba'i don gyis go/ /bsam dang bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /snying po don la rtog pas 'jug /thabs bral rig pa rtsol bas tshol/ /ra gan gser 'dod de bzhin no/ /'dod pa'i sems dang ma bral na/ /snying po don la bdag 'dzin byed—/ /bde ba'i sems la re ba na/ /rtog pa'i rjes 'jug zhi gnas yin/ /rang lugs sems su ma rtogs par/ /'dra 'bag lha yi rnam pa gzung / /lus kyi dbe+en pas chos nyid tshol/ /rang lus sems su shes pas na/ /gang na gnas kyang sems nyid dben/ /snang srid sems su shes pas na/ /dbang po yan lag ye shes gsal/ /snying po don gyi rang bzhin la/ /ci yang mi bsgom gang yang min/ /khyu mchog sems ltar ma bcos pa/ /rang gzhag ②rig pa'i 'khor lo nyid/ /dus gsum du yang btang gzhag ①med/ /gang yang mi 'dzin dgag pa med/ /snying po don byi rang bzhin la/ /skyon dang 5—1966

yon tan gnyis med pas/ /rdzogs pa'i lta ba blang dor med/ /'jug med ting 'dzin ma yengs pa/ /'od gsal rgyal ba'i sems nyid yin/ /rang 'byung thugs kyis ma bcos pa/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs/ /brtsal ①med snying po don las 'byung / /byang chub sems kyi don nyid la/ /nges pa'i theg gcig snying po'i don/ /phyag rgya rim bzhi sbyor ba drug /bsam pa'i theg pa sna tshogs pa/ /drang ba nyid 'gyur nges pa min/ /ngo bo nyid la mthon dman med/ /mos 'jug bsam pa'i rtog par zad/ /sems nyid nyag gcig phyogs bral ba/ /du ma'i 'bras med lam du min/ /ma bcos rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i lam/ /mi gnas rang bzhin sems su gcig /ma bgrod mthar phyin 'bras bu'am/ /rgyu rkyen bral ba skye 'jig med/ /gdod nas rang 'byung snying por gsal/ /rig sdedrug ji ltar snang ba dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dbyer med rang 'byung sems su gcig /ris drug sems kyi rtog pa dang / /ye shes rang gsal rig pa nyid/ /khyad par med de snying por gcig /khams gsum 'khor ba snang ba dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i ye shes nyid/ /rtogs ma rtogs kyis gnyis su byung / /rtogs pas rang sems nyid la thugs①/ /gzhan 'dod re ba rtsol ba bral/ /rang sems rnam dag ye sangs rgyas/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i sems nyid bde/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad la/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes rang chas ldan/ /bsam bral rang lugs cir mi dgongs/ /ye shes nam mkha'i mkha' dang mnyam/ /yid la mi byed bya ba btang / /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /rnam pa phra rags cir snang yang / /rang gzhag rjobasam bral nyid du bde/ /chu yi snang ba de bzhin du/ /5—1967

phra rags rnam rtog ye shes nyid/ /rang rig gnyug ma pad+ma ltar/ /'khor bar gnas kyang gdod nas dag /mtshan ma'i rnam pa ci 'byung yang / /chu shing lta bur snying po med/ /ma rig 'thibs pa'i 'khor ba na/ /rig pa mar me lta bur gsal/ /rnam par rtog pa cir 'gyur yang / /rang rig gnyug ma'i rgyun mi bcad/ /nam langs sems dang nub kha bzhin/ /ye shes don gsal de bzhin no/ /ma bsgrubs rang gsal ngang gis 'byung / /skal ldan ma bcos rnal 'byor pas/ /sems nyid steng kha ltar gnas na/ /lus ngag rtsol ba ngang gis zhi/ /bde ba'i ye shes mi rtog pa/ /shes rab gsal ba'i snying por phyin/ /mthar phyin rang 'byung mi rtog pa/ /dri med rgyal ba'i ye shes gsal/ /rang gnas 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med pa/ /'gro ba'i sems las gzhan la med/ /rtog med ngang la rang shar ba'i/ /rig pa bde ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /'dzin pa dag byed ye shes ni/ /ma bcos ngang gis rang rig gsal/ /ye shes thig le'i don 'di ni/ /shes rab gsal bas bdag la bstan/ /bde ba'i rang rig rtog pa bral/ /rang gnas ye shes 'od gsal sems/ /mthong bas the tshom rgyu ba bral/ /ye shes ngang gnas sgrib pa med—/ /thams cad ye shes gsal mthong bas/ /snying po don la gos pa ①med/ /rnam dag rig pa'i 'khor lo 'di/ /rtsol bral rang 'byung ye shes yin/ /rang 'byung ye shes kun gyi bdag /lus dang bral ba yan lag med/ /sgo skur bral ba'i dngos gzhi can/ /snying po kun bral kun gyi bdag /ma bcos rig pa'i ting 'dzin gsal/ /bya ba med bzhin don kun rdzogs/ /rang 'byung ②gnyug ma kun gyi gzhi/ /bgrod med rnal 'byor lhun grub lam/ /ji bzhin kun 5—1968

rdzogs 'bras bu nyid/ /thig le dbyer med gcig gi ngang / /sems nyid bya bral rdzogs pa'i gter/ /bde ba'i ye shes mi rtog thugs/ /skal ldan dang po nyid nas rdzogs/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i rtog pa dang / /rgyal ba'i ye shes mya ngan 'das/ /bde chen rig pa gcig gi ngang / /rang 'byung ji bzhin ma bcos pa/ /lhun rdzogs spros pa med pa'i ngang / /bsam du med pa'i ye shes 'di—/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rgyu ba bral/ /dus gsum mi mnga' rgyun mi 'chad//sems nyid grub pa'i lam mchog 'di/ /dbyer med kun la ldan bzhin du/ /snang ba'i lam med 'khor bar 'kha/ /sdug bsngal rtsol ba'i nad kyis gdungs//des na snying po sgon ma 'di/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor rnams don du/ /bla ma 'phags pa'i byin rlabs dang / /mos pa'i mthu ldan bdag gis rtogs/ /snying rjes kun bslang yongs la bsngo/ /snying po de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs/ yang dag pa'i sa la gnas pa/slob dpon na ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra gu na bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ro// //5—1969
1967 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉btsal/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ris/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thug rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bzhag1968 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉byung /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (166)5—1971

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā su kha a mṛ ta pra bha nā ma/ bod skad du—/ bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi'i 'od ces bya ba/ dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo pad+ma rgyas gang ba/ /rang gi gnas ni nyid du 'khyil//sangs rgyas kun byi gsang ba ste/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /yang dag pa de rab tu bshad/ /yang dag pa yang rnam pa bzhi/ /de ni lus la rab tu gnas/ /'di ltar shes pa'i lus nyid ni/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ /lte ba gsang ba'i drug cu bzhi'o/ /sprul pa'i yig 'bru dkar po bkod/ /ā li kā li g.yas dang g.yon/ /ye shes bzhi yi yi ge oṃ/ /dbus kyi ri bong 'dzin par ro/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes su bshad/ /sems kyi gnas su sku sogs brgyad/ /kha dog dkar po yi ge dgu/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hri khaṃ yig rnams/ /dbus nas byang du rim bzhin dgod/ /mtshams su lo la sogs pa bzhi/ /5—1972

mtshan ma med pa'i sku zhes bshad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bcu drug /mgrin pa'i gnas su yang dag skyes/ /de yi ri bong 'dzin par oṃ/ /ya wa ra la yi ge rnams/ /shar nas byang du rim bzhin no/ /rtogs yul bcu rlung gnyis kyi gnas/ /'byung bzhi'i rtags ni 'dzin par bshad/ /sa bon zla ba rgyas 'dra ba/ /bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'khyil/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis rang bzhin gnas/ /de yi gnas na ā li gnyis/ /g.yas dang g.yon gnyis mgo dang mjug /gcig tu phrad pas brgyan pa yin/ /de dbus haṃ las sra ma na/ /longs spyod mkhyen la bde chen thur/ /thabs dang shes rab tshul du gnas/ /chos dang sprul pa'ang de bzhin no/ /kun gyi dbus nas ri bong 'dzin/ /'khor lo yi ge kha dog dkar/ /yi las 'byung ba rlung dkyil 'khor/ /ha gnyis gnas su bsam par bya/ /de steng re byung ①gru gsum me/ /rang gi gnas su bsam par bya/ /de ltar rang bzhin kun shes nas/ /ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs las/ /rlung gis me bus bcu drug 'bar/ /de nyid ye shes me zhes bya/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te/ /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs nas/ /kun gye lus bsregs mgo gcig bsams/ /longs spyod gsum skar 'byung bzhi'o/ /bsregs nas g.yas 'byung sangs rgyas dang / /sems can kun bsregs dbu ma g.yon/ /thim ste bde chen g.yon nas bskor/ /bsregs nas rna ba g.yas su 'du/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun bsregs gcig byed/ /a ba dhū tī'i gnas nas byung / /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med bsregs/ /steng gi zhabs su sra ma na/ /bde ba chen po'i lus kyang skyes/ /haṃ dkar las byung ser po dkar/ /lus 5—1973

skyes ①mi la ye shes bskyed/ /de ru ma nus chu yi rtsa/ /g.yon gyi rtsa nas sprul pa ru—/ /der ni yang dag rab tu gzung / /de ru mi gnas sam po ka /rtsa ba'i rdo rje lam nas 'gro/ /sam po ka nas chos sku'o/ /lus rnams yang dag skye bar 'gyur/ /skyes nas bskal pa'i bar du gnas/ /chos kyi gnas su ma skyes na/ /nir ma ka yi gnas su bsam/ /yang dang yang du 'di bzhin bya/ /rnam rtog med pa'i rnal 'byor skye/ /yar gyis bsregs shing mar byis gso/ /rnal 'byor mig gi 'od zer gyis/ /rtag tu 'di la blta bar bya/ /nam zhig 'di la brten snegyur na/ /mtshan ma lnga 'am yang na g.yo/ /'bar zhing g.yo na yig go bcad/ /bcad pas bzhi po yang yang zhu/ /rtsa ba'i rdo rje lam nas ni//til gyi 'bru bzhin rgyas par 'byung / /rnal 'byor mthar phyin 'bras bu ste/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ /gzhan byi don sogs yon tan rnams/ /'bad pa med par lhun rmis grub/ /bla na med pa'i dgongs rgyud 'di/ /dpal gyi zhabs kyis bdag la bstan/ /rkyen dang rnal 'byor gnyis su 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po zhes su bstan/ /sbyor ba'i rgyud ni thams cad las/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis sbas pa bshad/ /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas pa'i/ /snod ldan bdag nyid chen pos gzung / /lus sems bde bar spyad nas ni/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba bsten par bya/ /bdag gis brtsams kyi bdud rtsi 'od/ /'di ltar khams gsum kun kyang de/ /shing dang 'dra bar mtshungs pa'o/ /yang dag bde bas 'tsho bar shog /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ye shes rin po che'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5—1974

bsdur mchan/1972 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉thade ba chen po'i bdud rtsi'i 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so//1973 ①〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉ringab 'byung /1974 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskyed/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉brtan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (167)5wa 1975

༄ga /byang sems thigs pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo bye s+dza be+en+d+ra u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du—/ byang sems thigs pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa bon zla ba rgyas 'dra ba/ /'khor lo chen po'i gnas su 'khyil—/ /sangs rgyas kun byi snying po ste/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gnas//yang dag par te dang por bshad/ /rtog yul chu rlung gis 'khyags te/ /de na sdug bsngal sna tshogs bskyed/ /de 'gags nas ni 'jug par 'dod/ /cha ni sna rtser bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma'i lte bar shes rab thabs/ /kha sbyor bar ni der gas pa/ /shel ltar dri med yungs kar ro/ /rnga 'brum brgyar gshags ②skar khyang ni/ /thabs kyi cha yi dkyil 'khor du'o/ /ba thag yi ger ldan pa yis—/ /rdo rje las su dkri ①bar bya/ /rnal 'byor mig gi 'od zer gyis/ /yungs kar dag la blta bar bya/ /nam zhig de la brten du'agyur na/ /mtshan 5—1976

ma lnga dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba skyed par byed pa yi/ /tshogs kyi rang bzhin dri ma med/ /'di ltar khams gsum kun kyang ste/ /rgyu yi ye shes dmigs med pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i rnam pa ste/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ye shes so/ /sna yi lam nas 'phro ba yi①/ /rang gi gnas nas rlung bskyod pa'o/ /g.yon pa dang ni 'bar ba yis/ /skar khung dag gi lam nas ni/ /'khor lo cher ni 'gro bar 'dod/ /yang dag pa ste 'ju bar 'gyur/ /rtsa yi rdo rje'i lam nas ni/ /til gyi 'bru bzhi rgyas par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor mthar phyin 'bras bu ste/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ /gzhan gyi don sogs yon tan rnams—/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub④/ /ye shes drug pa gsang chen po/ /rgyu zhes bya ba yin par bshad/ /sangs rgyas zhabs kyis bdag la bstan/ /rkyen dang rnal 'byor gnyis su 'gyur/ /'bras bu bzhi ni gsang chen bo/ /bde ba chen po zhes bya ste/ /sbyor ba'i rgyud ni thams cad las/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis sbas pa yang / /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas pa'i/ /snod ldan bdag nyid chen pos gzung / /lus sems bde bar spyad nas ni/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba bsten par bya/ /sangs rgyas zhabs kyis bstan pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes 'di/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pa bsgom par shog/ //thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa byang ①sems thigs pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po las kyi zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5—1977

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ra ha gya ā nan+da ti la ka nā ma/ bod skad du/gsang chen dga' ba'i thig le zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma las byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs sel mdzad pad+ma las byung lha mo'i mchog gnyis dga' ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad khro bo'i rgyal po dga' byed thugs rje'i dgos/ /'gro ba bde ba sbyin mdzad phongs pa thams cad skyob pa lha yi gtso bo mchog /srid gsum skyob ②'os 'byor pa ma lus 'byung la rab tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje theg pa 'di la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /sku dang gsung dang thugs gsang chen dag gis/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i thig le la 'jug pa bshad par bya'o/ /de la re zhig dang por sku'i gsang chen brjod par bya ste/ 'dir bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs pa ltar tha dad par snang ba'i lha yi dmigs pa ni mi bya'i/ gang 5—1979

la bdag tu brtags shing mi gsang bar brtags pa'i lus 'di ①nyid kho na la lhar dmigs par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ myur du yongs su dag par rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /tha dad pa ni de las bzlog pa'o/ /de'i phyir gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor yang dag ma yin sems/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa dag /rnal 'byor gzugs brnyan rang bzhin te/ /lugs ma la sogs rnal 'byor skye/ /yang dag mchog sems rnal 'byor skye/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa dag /rang gi dam tshig bdag sbyor bas/ /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub ④par byed—/ /ces so/ /ci'i phyir dang po'i dmigs pa dor zhe na①/ 'di ni dam pa'i bsgrub pa ste/ gang gsungs pa/ tha mal rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rang la lha yi ngar 'dzin bya/ /zhes so/ /yang dugasungs pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bde ba chen po so sor gsungs pa thos nas/ ched du brjod pa'i ched du brjod do/ /tha mal rnam rtog gzhom don du/ /yang dag bsgom pa rab grags kyi—/ /tha mal gnas skabs choms nas ni/ /sgom pa'ang bsgom par mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dud ni de lta'o/ /de de lta mod kyi 'on kyang mi gtsang ba'i lus 'di sbyangs la sangs rgyas kyi skur rnam par bsgom par bya'o zhes so/ /thabs gang zhig gis 'di bsgom par bya/ 'dir ni skyes nas drod gsher dang /mngal dang / sgo nga dang / rdzus dute 'byung ba dag gis bsgom mo/ /ji ltar 'gro ba dang 'dren pa nyid do/ /brjod pa mi 'dra ba nyid kyis bstan te/rnal 'byor rnam gsum zhes bya ste/ byin gyis brlabs dang yongs brtag dang / /gzugs nyid yongs su rdzogs pa dag /rnal 'byor yin zhes sangs rgyas gsung //5—1980

de bzhin du dang po dam tshig byin byis ①brlab pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa dag gis brtags/ /dbu ma yongs su rdzogs pa dag /rnal 'byor gyi ni cho gar bshad—/ /ces so/ /'di ni rim pa las ma 'das pas bsgom ste/ gang gsungs pa/ dang po'i las can rnal 'byor pa/ /de sprul sku la goms par bya/ /sprul pa'i sku ni brtan gyur nas/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa brtan par bsgom/ /sprul pa'i sku ni gsal gyur cig /longs spyod rdzogs pa gsal tsam na/ /chos sku dmigs pa med pa ste/ /'di ni mdor bsdus smos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rim pa gnyis kyang de bzhin te/ ji skad du slob dpon ḍom+bi pas bshad pa/bskyed ②pa'i rim pa bsgom pa blo bzangs kyis/ /rtag tu dang po nyid du bya ba ste/ /phyag rgya sngags ni rnam par dag tsam dang / / cho ga dze+ethams cad brjod par bya ba min/ /phyi nas khyad par ldan zhing bde blag tu/ /yud tsam re res de nyid sems gcig na/ /srid pa 'jig pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa rtag tu bsam dupar bya/ /zhes so/ /'di ni thams cad du gnas pa ma yin pa ste/ ji skad gsungs pa/ tha mal rnam pa gzhom don du/ /rang la lha yi ngar 'dzin bya/ /ngar 'dzin de yang gzhom pa'i phyir/ /dmigs pa med pa rnam par bsgom/ /gang tshe sems ni mnyam gnas pa/ /de tshe de nyid yin par nges/ /zhes pa dang / yang gsungs pa/ tha mal rnam pa gzhom don du//yang dag bsgom par rab grags kyi/ /tha mal gnas skabs choms nas ni/ /sgom pa'ang bsgom par mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /thogs pa med pas 'di gnas te/ /gang gsungs pa/ phyag na rdo rjes yang gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das lus dang ldan par bsgom pa 'di la dgos ⑤pa ci mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 5—1981

bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po dgos pa yod do/ /bcom ldan 'das mtshan ci skad ces bgyi ba mchis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kyi de kho na nyid ces bya ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi de kho na nyid ces bgyi ba de ji lta bu/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /de ci nus can zhig gam/ de ni de bzhin du bden no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rdo rje 'dzin gyis bka' stsal pa—/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku 'di ni nga yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yul rnams kyis rgyus nga bsgrub par bya ba yin pas na'o/ /phyag na rdo rjes yang gsol ba/ ci bcom ldan 'das bems po'am/ rdo rje 'dzin gyis bka' stsal pa/ nga ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes de ji lta bu/ rdo rje 'dzin gyis bka' stsal pa/ de bden pa yang ma yin zhing brdzun pa yang ma yin la/ blang bar bya ba yang min la dor bar bya ba yang min no/ /de bzhin du mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyang nga'o/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyang nga'o/ /bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes kyang nga'o/ /de bzhin du shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyang nga'o/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' chen po byang chub 'di/ dngos po med pa de skad du ma smra shig /dngos po med nyid dngos po'ang nga de bzhin gshegs par gdod nas grol/ /mchog gi sku dang ldan pa ste/ /zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ /he ru ka nga'o sems dpa' che/ /bdag med ma dang thabs cig sbyor/ /bde chen nga ni be+ems po min/ /'jig rten gzhug phyir bems po nga zhes/ /yang gsungs pa/ gzugs brnyan rang bzhin ji lta ba—/ /de bzhin bsgom bya'i dngos gang yang / /stong zhing snang med gnas 5—1982

mchog ste/ /de tshe sdig dang bsod nams med/ /dper na chu nang zla ba ni/ /grogs dag bden min brdzun pa'ang min/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di—/ /dang zhing gsal ba'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3haṃ/ zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni med pa las brtags pa tsam ma yin pa ste/ gang gsungs pa/ lha yi sku yi sbyor ba yang / /skyes tsam nyid nas mngon par gnas/ /kha dog phyag zhal dbyibs 'dra las/ /cung zad rang bzhin bag chags so/ /zhes pa dang / yang gsungs pa①/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems can sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /cung zad glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de bsal ba ni sangs rgyas so/ /zhes so/ /'di yi bsgrub pa nyid ci ②gang gi tshe mngon sum du gyur pa kho na'o/ /'di ni sku'i gsang chen mngon par brjod pa'o// //da ni gsung gi gsang chen mngon par brjod par bya ste/ sku'i gsang chen la gnas pa de'i ngag gi gnas su yi ge s+thāḥdamar po las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsams la/ lce'i 'dab ma la yi ge hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po bsams te/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa zhes pas byin gyis brlabs la/ de nyid du de thim pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos pa bskyed de/ khro bo'i brjod pa'am/ rdo rje'i brjod pas rang gi bla ma'i gdams ngag dang mthun pa'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /de la khro bo'i brjod pa ni/ sprin byung 'brug sgra yi ge hūṃ/ /zab mo rdo rje'i tshig brtan pa/ /khro bo gsal ba khro ①chen po'o④/ /rdo rje'i tshig ces grub pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje'i brjod pa ni/ lce rtse shin tu mi bsgul zhing / /so dang 5—1983

mchu gnyis 'byar byas pa/ /rtog pa kun la sbyar ba ste/ /rdo rje'i brjod pa sgra yangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang thun mong gi yan lag ni/ rtog pa kun las btus pa las gsungs pa/ bzlas brjod byed tshe khro mi bya/ /yul gyi bdag nyid dga' mi bya/ /zhum dang mi dga' 'jigs pa dang / /'jungs dang nga rgyal yongs su spang / /zlos tshe ci yang mi bsam zhing / /yan lag 'gyur bar mi bya'o/ /kun rtog rlung gis bskyod nas ni/ /ci yang rung ba mi bsam mo/ /rig spusngags lha ni ma gtogs pa/ /sgom pa mchog tu gyur pa yang / /zlos pas bzlas brjod byed pa'i tshe/ /kun rtog bzung nas mi bsam mo/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar zhugs pa des ci tsam gyi dngos grub tu 'gyur/ phreng ba las ltos pa ni/ mkhas pas gsang sngags yi ge ni/ /bco lnga man chad grangs rnams la/ /yi ge'i sdom ni du yod pa/ /de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas brjod bya/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ /bzlas brjod sum 'bum bya bar bshad / /yi ge de las lhag pa las/ /sngon du bsnyen pa khri bya'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa med par yang / /las rnams ②phal ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang du dus la ltos pa ni/ rdzogs ldan dus su yi ge 'bum bzlas te/ /gnyis ldan dus kyi sngags pas 'bum phrag gnyis/ /gsum ldan dus su de nyid gsum du 'gyur/ /bye ba phrag gsum 'bum bzhi rtsod dus sbyar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhi la ltos pa ni/ rgyud la lar ni ci nas sngags bye ba bzlas par gsungs so/ /bsod nams 'bring po rnams kyis 'bum bzlas par bdag smra'o/ /bsod nams che bas khri bzlas pas shin tu myur bar 'grub po/ /de ltar rdo rje can chen po rgyud kyi bdag pos gsungs so/ /bsod nams chung 5—1984

ba'i sems can rnams kyis ni bye ba bzlas par gsungs so/ /sems can 'bad rtsol chung ba rnams kyis ni 'bum bzlas par bdag smra'o/ /sems can bsgom pa la gzhol ba rnams kyis ni khri kho na bzlas par ①bya'o/ /sems can 'dod chags la zhugs pa rnams kyi sngags kyi bzlas pa ji ltar lags/ blun pa dang lkugs pa'i rigs can rnams kyi sngags kyi grangs ci ltar lags/ shin tu dmigs pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa ji ltar lags/ 'di ltar phan tshun smra bas bzlas na dngos grub gzhan du 'gyur ro/ /gal te dman pa'i sems kyis nyon mongs bzhin pas bzlas na/ /bskal pa skar ma lta bu bye bar yang de la dngos grub med do zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i grub pa nyid ci/ bya ba nges pa thob pa nyid do/ /'di ni gsung gi gsang chen mngon par brjod pa'o// //da ni thugs kyi gsang chen brjod par bya ste/ sngar bshad pa'i sku dang gsung gsang ba chen po la gnas pa des/ dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing //phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gzod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes pa ②rtogs pa'o/ /'di yang gang rig 1pa'i rjes su 'gro ba ni/ 'phags pa nā ga rdzu na'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i dbu ma las grub pa'o/ /thabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag gis ni/ rlung dang / rtsa dang / thig le dang / phra mo dang / rdo rje nor bu'i nang dang / rig ma la brten pa dang / ril por 'dzin pa dang / rjes su 'dzin pa dag gi 'grub po//bgrang dang rjes su 'gro dang gnas/ /mtshan nyid de nas rnam sdog dang / /5—1985

yongs su dag pa nyid dang drug /'di ni 'ong ba gzung bar dran/ /'dir thun mong min pa sbyar ba rlung las grub pa'o/ /lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī sbar ①bas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsreg cing / /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te/ /bsregs pas haṃ las zla ba 'bab/ /rtsa las grub pa'o/ /ji skad du/ kasbra la ār+yas bshad pa/ /thig le sgra ni rnam spangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /thig le dang phra mo dag gi 'grub pa'o/ /chu bo'am lteng ka'i chu ni dri med dag la zla ba gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin de la rim gyis 'jig pa rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bsam—/ /me long la ni rlung dag rim gyis zar ②pa bzhin du'ang blta bya ste/ /ril por 'dzin pa la bya ba'i rim pa 'di ④ni de bzhin rab tu brtag ces bya ba ni/rdo rje nor bu'i nang du rtogs pa'i 'grub pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub pa na/ /bsgrub pa kun du brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs ④'char ba'i dus dag tu/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pa ni/ rig ma la brten pas 'grub pa'o/ /ril por 'dzin pa rjes su gzhig pa ni/ chu bo'am lteng ka'i chu ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar 'das ma thag pas 'grub pa'o/ /'di dag ni shes rab ye shes la brten pas 'grub la/ gsang ba gnyis ni bum pa'i dang gsang ba'i 0dbang las 'byung ba'o/ /yong ni thugs kyi gsang chen ma grub par nyon mongs pa mi 'gog la/ de la bum 'gags na sku dang gsung gi gsang chen mi 'grub ste/ji skad du/ yab gcig lha rnams thugs rje med dam ci/ /da lta'i sems can shin tu 'grub par dka'/ /bu gcig lha rnams thugs rje'i rang bzhin na/ /ding sang sems can nyon mongs dra bas khyab/ /ces bshad do/ /thugs kyi gsang chen nyid du sku'i gsang chen dang gsung gi gsang chen yang 'jug ste/5—1986

ji skad du/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas 'phags pa zla ba'i sgon ma las bshad pa—/ nam mkha' 'dra zhing rdul bral gzugs bzang 'char/ /shes rab sras po lus dang mtshan mi mnga'/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rab zab thugs rje can/ /mtshungs med phyag ni bdag gi spyi bor zhog /ces pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan las kyang / 'jig rten sgron ma khyod kyi gsung / /ye shes rgya mtsho de thos na/ /de dag dri med bde ba 'thob/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'od kyang 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang gsungs pa/ gsang sngags bzlas brjod mi bya ste/ /dka' thub sbyin sreg ma yin no/ /dkyil 'khor ldan med dkyil 'khor med/ /de yi gsang sngags bzlas pa dang / /de yi dka' thub sbyin sreg ni/ /sems ni mdo ru bsdus tshul lo/ /zhes so/ /mtshan mar bcas pas mtshan bcas kyi//dngos grub rgyal ba dam par bzhed/ /mtshan ma med la gnas pas ni/ /mtshan par ①bcas pa 'grub tu rung / /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /mtshan ma med la gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas na grub pa gsum char gyi thugs gsang bas 'thob pa yang ngo / /gang gis thugs gsang chen ma shes par gnas pa de ni/ dbugs ⑤ma phyin par gnas pa ste/ ji skad du gsungs pa/gang gis stong pa ma mthong ba/ /de dag 'khor zhing nyam ①nga zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ stong pa'i chos kyis mi mkhas gang 'jigs pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas byang chub ring po yin/ /stong nyid chos la the tshom su med pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa nā gārdzu nas bshad pa/ gang gis stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de la thar pa'i skal med de/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson ra ru/ /rmongs pa de ni 'khyam par 'gyur//5—1987

zhes so/ /de bzhin du gang gis thugs gsang chen ma shes pa des ni/sangs rgyas mthong ba ma yin te/ de skad du gsungs pa/ ji ltar mthong bzhin su blta ba/ /de dag 'dren pa mi mthong ngo / /rnam par rtog pa mi 'jug cing //gang tshe sangs rgyas mi mthong la/ /'jug med sangs rgyas yin par ni/ /gal te mthong na de sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ de ltar skye 'jig spangs pa yis①/ /thub pa zhi ba sus mthong ba/ /de dag 'di dang slad mar yang / /chags med nyer len med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/gang zag med cing phung po med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zag med pa/ /rtag tu zhi ba rnam bsgoms te②/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ gang gis nga la sgrar shes shing / /gang gis nga la gzugs su mthong / /log par spong bar zhugs pa ste/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos nyid lta/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /chos nyid shes par bya min pas/ /de ni rnam par shes mi nus/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ rtag tu skye med chos ni de bzhin gshegs/ /chos rnams thams cad bde bar gshegs dang 'dra/ /byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams//'jig rten dag na med pa'i chos la spyod/ /ces so/ /yang gsungs pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi sku yin gyis/ dge slong dag 'jig tshogs la skur ma 'dzin par/ dge slong dag nga ni chos kyi sku yongs su rdzogs par ltos shig /ces gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs pa 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par blta'o zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gzugs kyi skur mi blta ste/5—1988

de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi sku'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos nyid ni 'ong ba 'am 'gro ba med de/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la byon pa'am bzhud pa med do zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ gang gis sangs rgyas spyan drangs shing / /gang gis gshegs su gsol ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa rnams/ /gang na 'ang yod pa ma yin no/ /dri ma med cing dag pa'i lus/ /gang gis spyan drangs gshegs su gsol/ /de nyid kyis ni rtag med par/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'di'i grub pa de ①nyid ci/ /chos kyi sku la gnas pa nyid dang / grub ②pa'i skyes bur gyur pa na'o/ /'di ni thugs kyi gsang chen mngon par brjod pa'o/ /da ni gsang ba gsum las byung ba'i 'bras bu brjod de/ yang gsungs pa/chu rgyus dra ba dang bcas shing / /yan lag kun ldan bu ga can/ /lus de med par snang gyur pa/ /de yi skad cig de la ni/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i skur 'dzin 'gyur—/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin dmigs med cing / /mtshan ma med cing skye ba med/ /sna tshogs rnam bral sgrib lnga spangs/ /sangs rgyas dngos rnams dang bral ba/ /me long gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /de'i bdag nyid du rab snang ba①—/ /he ru ka yi dngos por gsal/ /'di nyid dbang po yul rnams dang //phung por gnas pa mkha' dang mnyam/ /bden nyid 'dir rab skye lus te/ /'dus byas don gyis gzhan min pas/ /mig gis gzugs ni 'dzin med cing //rna ba yis ni sgra min no/ /lce yis kyang ni ro mi tshor/ /sna yis kyang ni dri la 5—1989

min / /lus kyi gong bus reg med de/ /bde ba chen po'i gzugs phyir na'o//bud med mchog mthong las bde zhing / /glu thos las kyang yang dag bde/ /dri zhim ma ①las bde ba che/ /skye gnas reg las kyang bde che/ /ro mchog btung ba'i rab sbyor skeba'i/ /bde ba dag ni su yis bzlog /ces so/ /don 'di nyid ni rim pa lnga pa las kyang bshad de/ ji ltar dang ba'i chu dag las//nya ni myur du ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung bar bshad/ /ces so/ /da ni 'di ltar gyur pa de'i mtshan ma bstan pa lung la 'jug par bya ste/ ji skad du dpal yang dag sbyor ba'i thig le'i phreng ba las gsungs pa/ de nas gang du rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa der 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ sa 'di dga' zhing mgu la rangs pas rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa①/ bdud kyi gnas su cha lang lta bu'i sgra grags rjopa dang / phyogs bcur bskal pa'i me 'bar ba lta bu'i skar mda' rtsang ba dang /rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs pa'i sgra dang / thams cad du gnam rdo lhung ba dang /de nyid bskal pa'i me'i gzugs lta bu'i ye shes kyi snang ba 'bar ba dang / phyag rgya'i skye gnas kun du khams gsum thams cad snang ba dang / tshangs pa dang /khyab 'jug dang / chu bdag dang brgya byen dang / drag po dang me dang /stobs bzangs ⑤dang nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / grub pa dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye dang / lha'i mchog dang /rigs 'dzin dang / chu 'byung ba la sogs pa gang yin pa dang / gzhan yang sum cu rtsa gsum du gnas pa'i lha rnams der 'ongs nas yang dag par dga' bas me tog gis mchod par byed do/ /pi wang dang / gling bu dang / mu 5—1990

kun+da dang / tasru ra ①dang / dung dang / zangs dung dang / brnyi dang /rnga pa ṭa ha dang / rdza rngas nam mkhar gnas te rtag tu mchod par byed do/ /lha'i bu mo dang / rigs 'dzin rmi rgyal po'i bu mo thams cad kyis gar byed pa dang sil snyan du ma byed pa dang / mi'am ci dang / gnod sbyin gyis glu len par byed cing / de la dga' ba dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sgras rtag tu rol pa byed pa dang / gang gis grub pa la nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis ni legs pa'i rnam pa rab tu gsol bar byed do/ /dga' ldan du gnas pa'i lha rab mchog gang yin pa dang / lha'i bu gang yin pa dang /rigs 'dzin dang / 'og min gyi bar dag 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog sna tshogs kyi dri'i char dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyi khyad par gyis/ gus pa'i tshul byis mchod par byed de②/ gzhan yang khyod la rgyas par bshad pa'i tshul gyis ci zhig bya ste/ bsgrub par byas pa'i bsod nams kyis khams gsum gyi gagang zhig mchod pa de rnams kyis mchod par byed do/ /de yang gsungs pa/rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni/ /gang du mchis dushing gang du gnas/ /gnas la the tshom 'di rnams ni/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni/ /gang du yang mi 'gro—/ /gang du yang mi gnas so/ /the tshom 'di dag ni/ thog ma dang /tha ma dang / dbus dang bral ba/ gnyis su med pa/ gnas gsum du snang ba—/ thams cad du son pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad pa/thams cad kyi don/ sems can thams cad kyi sems la gnas pa/ sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba/ yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan par byas pa/5—1991

thams cad dang ldan pa/ zhi ba mnyam pa med pa/ rtag par brjod pa/mgon po skyob pa/ kun du rtog pa spangs pa/ dbyibs dang / kha dog dang bral ba/ rgyal ba'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir rgyal po/ phyed par dka' ①ba'i phyir rdo rje/ nyon mongs pa'i nye bar gdung ba las grol ba'i phyir zla ba/'jigs pa med pa'i phyir seng ge/ gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir chu'i phung po'o//de ltar dpe sna tshogs kyis rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dper bya'o/ /de nyid ni gcig pu ①ste/ sems can thams cad rnams kyi don byed pa dang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs kyang / bltams dze+epa ston pa dang / khab nas mngon par 'byung ba dang / gzhon nu'i rol rtsed mdzad pa dang / rdo rje gdan gyis mnan pa dang / bdud btul ba mnyam pa med pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bstan pa dang / lha las babs pa nyams dga' ba dang /shin tu sna tshogs pa'i cho 'phrul dang / glang chen nor skyong btul ba dang /skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye bo dag gzhug pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcad ④pa dang / bsod snyoms kyi ldung bzed ltos pa med pa dang / 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo 'dul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal tshab nyid dang /yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po chen po ste/rigs kyi bu de ltar 'di lta bu'i khyad par du ma mi lam lta bur sangs rgyas kyi rol pa mchog ston par mdzad do/ /grub pa gang yin pa ni sgyu ma'i tshul rmis 'gro ba thams cad kyi don mdzad do/ /'di ni gsang ba gsum las byung ba'i 'bras bu mngon par brjod pa'o/ /5—1992

yong ye gang zhig 'jig rten las ma chags pa des 'di 'grub ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas kyang tha na rgyal srid kyi bde ba la yang mi chags par bya zhes bshad la/ dpal shākya thub pa mngon par bskul ba las kyang / gang lha rnams kyis smras pa/ na tshod thog mar gzugs mchog 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /phongs ①shing sdug 'dod 'di ni byes pa'i spyod/ /rga na sdug bsngal gzi brjid lus bcom na/ /rnam par spong ste ri dwags klung skam bzhin/ /nor 'bru dam pa rdzas mang stobs ldan tshe/ /phongs ②shing sdug 'dod 'di ni byis pa'i spyod/ /nor nyams sdug bsngal bar ni gyur pa'i tshe/ /rnam par spong ste mi yis 'phrog stong bzhin/ /ji ltar me tog shing dang 'bras bcas shing / /de bzhin sbyin 'dod ma la dga' bar byed/ /nor nyams sdug bsngal nyen cing spang ①ba na/ /de tshe dga' bar mi 'gyur bya rgod bzhin/ /rdzas ldan gzugs mchog ldan tshe dpon po bzhin/ /phrad na sdug cing dbang po dga' bar byed/ /rga na sdug bsngal nyen cing nor zad na/ /de tshe 'dod par mi 'gyur 'chi bdag bzhin/ /rga bas rgas byas na tshod yal 'gyur na/ /sdong po gnam lcags kyis ni bcom pa bzhin—/ /rga bas 'khogs na 'jigs bcas khang rul 'dra/ /rga las 'byung ba thub pa myur du smyos/ /skyes pa bud med tshogs rnams rga bas skems/ /ma lu'i khri shing sā la'i nags stug bzhin/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ srid gsum mi brtan rjoston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs—/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu lta bur myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ nad med mi rtag tshe ring rtag ma yin/ /lang tsho mi rtag 'byor pa rtag ma yin/ /zhes so/ /5—1993

'phab/sa pa shā ri'i bus bshad pa la yang / grogs dag tshe 'di mi rtag myur 'gro ste| /ri gzar chu dag ①mgyogs 'dra na/ /byis pa skye bos mi shes te/ /mi mkhas gzugs kyi dregs pas stsos/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /'phags pa ṭ+wā gārdzu nas kyang / /de ltar 'di kun mi rtag bdag med de/ /skyabs med mgon med gnas med de slad du/ /'khor ba chu shing snying po med pa la/ /mi mchog khyod kyi thugs ni 'byung bar mdzod/ /ces bshad do/ /gang dbang thob pa yang ste/gsang ba'i mdzod las gsungs pa/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye dang skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgrubs par ni dngos grub thob④/ /gang yang bsgom pa dang ldan zhing / /gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /skye 'dir las dbang gis ma grub/ /skye ba gzhan du dngos grub 'thob—/ /re zhig dam tshig nyams pa la/ /dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi/ /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ /gang yang bla mar brgyud pa yi/ /rim 'ongs de nyid rim pa yis/ /sgrub po de yis 'grub snyam dgongs/ /zhes so/ /'di ni gsang ba gsum 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo mngon par brjod pa'o/ /gang rab tu dga' ba'i nam mkha' la/ /tsan+dan me tog bud med bzang //mthong ba gang tshe 'dzag gyur pa/ /de tshe dga' bar yang dag bshad/ /sems can kun la rnam par gnas/ /sems can de dag kun gyi sems/ /dpag dka' skad cig nyid las shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ni bdag gis ma bkag ste/longs spyod spyad par ma gsungs te/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis spyod pa gsungs—/ /zhes gsungs la/ yang pad+mar chags pa'i sems spangs te/zhes rgyud dag las bkag pa bstan pa dang bcas pa brjod pa'i phyir dang /5—1994

rgyud las gang gsungs longs spyod ni bdag gis ①kyang bkag pa med do/ /de ltar gsang chen gsum gyi bdag /mngon par brjod las byung ba yi/ /dge ba bdag la skyes gyur na/ /'gro ba gsang chen gsum 'dzeg shog /gsang chen dga' ba'i thig le zhes bya ba/ slob dpon yu so ma pu rir byung ba'i dge slong dpal ldan byang chub bzang po'i bla ma/ dpal ma hā ma ti'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gye slob dpon ā tsar+ya du lo pa dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1979 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rasang chen dga' ba'i thig le bzhugs so// ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ma ba/198༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7'di/ sde〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thāb/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kus/ rjo〈〈pe〉ra〈snar 〉7yang /du〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉8/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thardzus/1981 ①rte〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7gyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉skyed/ ①〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉rga cha/ dhi〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉sngagasal bar/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ragongs/1983 ①〈〈pe 〉rasol ba/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉racig ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7bo/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉sko〈co 〉༅'i/1984 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sdegs/ sne〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉ra la/1985 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mizla bar/ sde〈〈co 〉7sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉sdegs/1986 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mdor/ sne〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'ams kyis zad/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉modir/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈shar 〉'ang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7dang gsang ba'i/ rjo〈〈pe〉skosnar 〉ṅkal/19/7 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ra/ ②〈〈snar 〉rabu/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7yang /1988 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yonan/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thasgom ste/5—1995

deb lnga pa/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkrams/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe sgrun khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/krung go'i glog brnyan dpe sgrun khang par khang gis dpar btab/— lo 999pa'i 7par par gaji dang po bsgrigs/ lo 999rnam 7par par zengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ byed 52ma7—80057—22—8snu 98
